neon-maze.intro: Neon Maze is a logic puzzle where you clear the grid by tapping arrows in the right order. Each level has a limited number of moves, so think before you tap.
tips: Before tapping any arrow, check that the path in front of it is completely free. A blocked arrow will not clear the way.
Look for arrows that are already free and note which arrows they are blocking. Clearing those first often opens up the rest of the board.
Plan a few moves ahead instead of tapping at random. Since each level has a limited number of moves, a wasted tap can make the puzzle harder to finish.
Work through the board in a sequence, tracking which arrows you have removed. This keeps you from losing track of the remaining tangles.
Use the hint when you are stuck on a section, then go back to planning on your own. Hints can help you learn the pattern for later levels.
faq: What is the goal of Neon Maze?
Your goal is to clear the board by removing every arrow in the right order. You win when the full maze is untangled.
How do I remove an arrow?
Tap an arrow only when the path in front of it is free. A correct move removes that arrow and opens more space on the grid.

madness-online.intro: Madness Online is a top-down multiplayer survival shooter where you fight zombie waves, gather resources, and build fortified bases alone or with friends.
tips: Use Spacebar to dodge incoming zombies and enemy attacks rather than standing still and trading shots, since dodging keeps your health up during long waves.
Press B early to check your inventory and keep room for resources you will need to craft gear and repair defenses.
Reload with R during quieter moments, not in the middle of a crowd, so you are never caught with an empty weapon.
Use Q to swap weapons quickly when a different weapon suits the enemy in front of you, especially when several zombies approach from different directions.
If you play with friends, split up roles such as gathering, crafting, and guarding, and use Enter to chat so everyone knows where to build and where to hold.
faq: What is the main goal of Madness Online?
The game is about surviving in a hostile, infinite world by fighting off waves of zombies and enemy entities while gathering resources and building fortified bases.
How do I aim and shoot?
Move the mouse to aim and click to shoot. Use WASD to move around the map while you fire.

stickman-io.intro: Stickman.io is a real-time arena game where you grow your stickman by eating food and smaller opponents while avoiding bigger ones. Good positioning and timing matter more than speed alone.
tips: Eat food and smaller opponents whenever it is safe, since growing is the main way to get stronger in the arena.
Keep track of larger stickmen near you and move away from them early, before they close the distance.
Save speed boosts for escaping a dangerous situation or catching a target, rather than using them constantly, so you do not lose control of your position.
Use the mouse to make small, steady movements instead of sharp swings, which makes it easier to steer around larger foes.
Watch the whole arena rather than focusing only on one opponent, so you can spot openings to grow and threats coming from other directions.
faq: How do I grow my stickman?
You grow by consuming food and smaller adversaries in the arena. Each one you collect makes your stickman bigger.
What should I do when a larger opponent is near?
Dodge them rather than trying to fight head-on. Moving away early gives you more room to maneuver and outsmart them.

curve-free-kick.intro: Curve Free Kick is a 3D free kick game where you bend the ball around a wall and past the goalkeeper. Wind and spin both affect the shot, so reading the conditions matters on every level.
tips: Before you shoot, check which way the wind is blowing. Curving with the wind gives a much bigger swerve, so you may need less angle to reach the target.
Use the angle of your run-up to control how much the ball curves. A wider angle adds more curve, which helps when the wall blocks a straight line.
Make your run-up longer when you need more power, but keep in mind that a longer run-up also changes your approach. Practise a few shots to find a balance.
Watch the goalkeeper's position before you shoot. The keeper can be fooled by wind and spin, so aim for the side he is not covering.
You have 10 tries and every goal gives one back, so scoring early helps you keep shooting. Do not waste tries on shots that are clearly going wide.
faq: How do I aim my free kick?
On desktop, move the mouse to position your player behind the ball, then click to shoot. On mobile, drag to position your player and tap the SHOOT button.
How does the wind affect the ball?
The wind blows from the left or right on every level and pushes the ball in the air. Curving with the wind gives a huge swerve, while curving against it cancels the wind out.

mini-car-racing.intro: Mini Car Racing lets you design a small car and race it through circuits full of obstacles. Earn bonuses along the way to upgrade your ride and improve your lap times.
tips: Look at the track layout before you commit to a design, since the obstacles you will face should guide which car features you prioritize.
Pay attention to where bonuses appear and try to collect them without losing control of your car, because they are meant to improve your ride.
Take a few early laps to learn how your car handles at high speed, then adjust your approach to corners and obstacles accordingly.
Avoid pushing at full speed into every section. Slowing down briefly before a tricky obstacle often lets you recover faster than crashing.
After each race, compare how your car performed against your previous attempt and change one design choice at a time so you can see what actually helps.
faq: What is the main goal of Mini Car Racing?
You design your own mini car and race it through thrilling circuits while navigating obstacles. The aim is to become a skilled mini car racer.
How can I make my car faster or better?
Earn bonuses during races, which are used to enhance your ride. Testing different designs and seeing how they perform on the track will help you decide what to change.

worms-zone.intro: Worms Zone is a Snake-style game where you steer a worm through colorful zones, eating to grow longer while rival worms compete for space. The goal is to become the longest worm on the map.
tips: Keep your worm moving toward open space rather than tight corners, since running into a wall or a rival's body ends your run.
Use speed sparingly: boosting helps you cut off rivals or escape danger, but it can leave you with less room to react when you grow long.
Watch the rivals around you and try to steer them into dead ends or away from your path instead of racing them head-on.
Pick up power-ups when they are safe to reach, but do not chase them through crowded areas where a collision is likely.
Plan a few moves ahead by heading toward wide areas of the zone, so your long body has space to curl without trapping you.
faq: What is the main goal of Worms Zone?
The goal is to grow as long as possible and become the longest worm, while avoiding collisions with walls and rival worms.
How do I avoid losing a run?
Stay away from edges and the bodies of other worms, and turn early so you always have an open path ahead.

bumbly-bee.intro: Bumbly Bee is a casual pixel arcade collectathon where you fly a bee through 40 levels, collecting honey while dodging local wildlife. You can chase gold medals against the clock or take your time and gather everything.
tips: Scan each level before moving so you can spot where the honey is and which wildlife tends to sit in the way.
If you are going for a gold medal, plan a route through the level first and then repeat it, rather than improvising every run.
Collect all the honey on your first pass of a level when you can, since that is the goal you can return to without pressure from the timer.
Use short, controlled movements to dodge enemies instead of big swings, which can carry you into danger.
Replay levels you found tricky once you have the layout memorized, as the timed runs become much easier with practice.
faq: What is the main goal of Bumbly Bee?
Move your bee through each level while collecting honey and avoiding the wildlife. You can aim for gold medals against the clock or simply collect all the honey at your own pace.
What controls does the game use?
On PC, you move with the mouse and can optionally use the spacebar. On mobile, you control the bee with touch.

bandits-bane.intro: Bandits Bane is a 2D Wild West shooter set in a robbed city bank. Aim with the mouse, shoot the most dangerous bandits, and rescue hostages across five levels.
tips: Before you fire, check who is in the line of fire. Hostages are in the scene too, so a careless shot can hurt your progress.
Pick your targets rather than shooting at everything. The game asks you to focus on the most dangerous bandits first.
Keep moving your aim toward the next threat as soon as one falls. Quick re-aiming helps you clear a room before the time runs out.
Clear every bandit in a level before moving on, because you only advance once they are all gone. Track where any remaining enemies are hiding.
Replay earlier levels when you want a steadier run. Learning the layout of each level makes it easier to spot the bandits and hostages quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Bandits Bane?
Save the city from the bandits by shooting the most dangerous ones and rescuing the hostages. You must kill all the bandits in a level to advance to the next one.
How do I shoot in Bandits Bane?
Move the mouse to aim, then click the mouse button to shoot. Mouse movement controls the aim direction.

geometry-vibes-x-arrow.intro: Geometry Vibes X Arrow is an arcade game where you steer an arrow through geometric paths and reach the portal at the end of each route. Your timing and control of altitude decide how far you get.
tips: Use short, light taps instead of holding the button down, since each tap raises your arrow and holding sends it higher than you want.
Release the button early when a path starts to slope downward, so you have room to react to the next obstacle.
Watch the pattern ahead rather than the arrow itself, because obstacles appear in sequence and you can plan your altitude a moment before you reach them.
If you are playing multiplayer, practice with the H, L and Up Arrow keys on their own first so you know where each player's controls are before the round starts.
Try a few runs in different modes, since each one tests a different skill and you may find one that suits your timing better.
faq: What is the goal of Geometry Vibes X Arrow?
Guide your arrow through dangerous geometric paths and reach the portal at the end of each route without touching anything. The paths get harder as you go.
How do I control the arrow?
Click the left mouse button or press SPACE to move upward, and release to move downward. On touch screens, tap to accelerate upward.

untangle-threads.intro: Untangle Threads is a puzzle game where you drag glowing nodes until no thread crosses another. Six worlds each add a new mechanic, and you earn up to three stars based on how few moves you use.
tips: Look for the red threads first, since they show exactly which crossings still need fixing.
Move one node at a time and check the thread colors after each move, so you can tell which change helped.
Try to keep your moves few in every world, because stars depend on move count and the Crystals world limits how many you can make.
In the Space world, plan around the locked nodes first and work the free nodes around them.
In the Steampunk world, remember that linked nodes mirror each other, so one move can fix or create a crossing on both sides.
faq: How do I know when a puzzle is solved?
The threads turn green when no thread crosses another. Red threads mean at least one crossing is still there.
How are stars awarded?
You earn up to three stars, and using fewer moves gives you more stars.

stack-the-blocks.intro: Stack the Blocks is a puzzle game played on a 10x10 grid. You place the blocks you are offered to complete horizontal or vertical lines, which clear away to make room for new pieces.
tips: Keep the board open in the middle so you still have space for larger or awkward pieces when they appear.
Before placing a block, check which rows and columns are nearly full, and aim for the spot that completes one of them.
Try to clear lines in a way that leaves gaps you can fill with the next offered blocks, rather than isolated single holes.
Avoid filling a row or column with a single stray cell, since a lone gap can be hard to fit later.
When you have several options, pick the one that keeps the most flexible shapes on the board for future turns.
faq: What is the goal of Stack the Blocks?
The goal is to place the offered blocks on the 10x10 grid so that complete horizontal or vertical lines form. Each completed line disappears and earns points.
What happens when a line is completed?
A completed line disappears from the board, which frees up space for new pieces to be placed.

the-man-from-the-window.intro: In The Man from the Window, you play as Mama Rabbit, protecting your family while you piece together a dark mystery. Strategy, puzzles, and close attention to detail drive the story forward.
tips: Look closely at your surroundings before making a move, since the game says every detail matters.
Treat each decision as one that could affect your family's safety, and think about the likely outcome before you commit.
Keep notes on clues and events as you go, so you can connect them when a puzzle or story thread comes back around.
When tension rises, slow down and review what you already know rather than rushing into the next choice.
Revisit earlier scenes after learning something new, because a detail that seemed minor may now make sense.
faq: What is the main goal of The Man from the Window?
You play as Mama Rabbit and work to keep your family safe while unraveling the dark narrative behind the danger around you.
How does the game make progress?
Progress comes from making strategic decisions and solving puzzles that reveal more of the story.

click-click-clicker.intro: Click Click Clicker is an idle clicker where you click a button to earn cash, then spend it on upgrades and unlock new buttons, cursors, backgrounds, and music. Your progress keeps building between clicks.
tips: Early on, keep clicking yourself, since every click adds to your cash while you are still building up your first upgrades.
Compare the three upgrade types, which are passive earnings, cash per click, and cursors, and buy whichever gives you more cash over time for your current amount.
Buy passive or cursor upgrades when you want income to keep coming in while you step away from the game.
Check which unlocks are close to being affordable, so you can save toward the one you want most instead of spreading cash thin.
Come back after a break to collect your idle earnings, then spend them right away on the next upgrade.
faq: What is the goal of Click Click Clicker?
The goal is to build up cash by clicking and idle earnings, then use it to unlock new buttons, cursors, themes, and music.
How do I earn money?
Click the button to earn cash with each click, and your passive income adds money over time without clicking.

ping-pong-table-tennis.intro: Ping Pong: Table Tennis is a casual sports game where you control a racket, hit the ball accurately, and fight for every point against opponents who get tougher as you go. The game is played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Watch where the ball is heading before you act, since accurate hits matter more than fast clicking.
Vary where you send the ball instead of hitting it the same way each time, so your opponent has to move.
Pay attention to how each opponent returns the ball and look for a pattern you can exploit.
When opponents get tougher, change your approach rather than repeating what worked earlier.
Stay focused on each point, because every point counts and a single lapse can cost you a rally.
faq: How do I control the racket?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. Time your clicks so the racket meets the ball where you want it to go.
What is the goal of the game?
Beat your opponent by winning points in each match. The game rewards accurate hits and quick reactions.

mini-golf-3d.intro: Mini Golf 3D is an arcade mini golf game with more than 40 levels that grow harder as you go. You aim, charge your shot, and try to sink the ball using careful, precise strikes.
tips: Before you swing, study the whole course and plan a route that avoids sand traps and water hazards.
Charge your shot with a moderate amount of power on early levels, since overshooting is a common way to lose strokes.
Treat sand traps as slow ground and keep your next shot short and controlled when the ball is stuck in one.
When the ball is near water, aim for a safer line even if it means taking an extra stroke, because a water penalty costs you a stroke anyway.
Use the mouse click or tap to aim and release calmly, and stay patient on tricky courses so precision matters more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Golf 3D?
The goal is to get the ball into the hole in as few strokes as possible on each of the 40+ levels. Sand traps slow you down and water hazards cost you a stroke.
How do I control the ball?
Use mouse click or tap to play. Aim, charge your shot, and release to strike the ball.

4-color-card-game.intro: 4 Color Card Game is a quick card game where you match cards by color or number and try to empty your hand first. Action cards can shift the round, so keep an eye on what others play.
tips: Before you play, check whether you have a card that matches the discard pile by color or by number, and choose the one that leaves you with the most flexible hand.
Hold on to Wild cards for moments when no other card matches, since they let you pick the color that suits your hand.
When you are down to your last card, click TAP right away so you avoid the penalty.
Watch which colors other players are getting rid of, and try to keep cards in colors that are still in play for you.
If you have no matching card, draw from the draw pile rather than waiting, because each turn ends automatically after an action.
faq: What is the goal of 4 Color Card Game?
The goal is to match cards by color or number and be the first player to get rid of all your cards.
How do I play a card?
Move your cursor over a matching card in your hand at the bottom of the screen and left-click it to place it on the discard pile.

color-sorting-rooms.intro: Color Sorting: Rooms is a calm puzzle game where you pour colored liquids between flasks until each one holds a single color. Each level adds more colors and tighter layouts, and rewards you can use to decorate rooms.
tips: Look for a flask whose top layer is a color that appears in only one place, and move that color first. Clearing the top of a flask gives you more room to work with.
Before each pour, check what is underneath the top layer. A move that looks fine can bury a color you need to reach later.
Try to empty one flask early in a level. An empty flask accepts any top color, so it is your best spare space for moving stacks around.
If you get stuck, use the undo bonus to step back one move rather than restarting. You can also try the extra flask or remove a color bonus when the layout is truly blocked.
Keep an eye on your quests while you play. Collecting specific colors across levels earns points, so it helps to notice which colors a quest asks for.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win by sorting all the colors so that every flask holds only one color. Plan your moves so no flask ends up with mixed layers.
How do I pour liquid from one flask to another?
Tap a flask to pick up its top color, then tap another flask to pour. The pour only works if the colors match or the target flask is empty.

rolling-balls-sea-race.intro: Rolling Balls Sea Race is a physics-based racing game where you roll along narrow elevated tracks to the finish line without falling into the water. You can race solo or head-to-head with a second player on the same keyboard.
tips: Ease off before sharp corners, since speed carries your ball toward the edge on elevated tracks.
Hug the inside of turns to keep more control over your ball's momentum.
Survive first and collect coins second, especially in the early levels where the edges are most dangerous.
In two-player mode, use wide sections to bump your opponent, but keep your own ball away from the edge while you do it.
Make small, smooth inputs rather than sudden presses, because the controls respond tightly and momentum carries through every turn.
faq: How do I move my ball?
In solo mode, use W, A, S, D or the Arrow Keys. In two-player mode, Player 1 uses W, A, S, D and Player 2 uses the Arrow Keys.
How do I win a two-player race?
The first player to cross the finish line wins, so keep your ball moving forward while staying on the track.

knockback.intro: Knockback is a party board game where you race your pegs home while arenas erupt and black holes swallow pieces. Pop the dome to roll, then move a peg and try to get all your pegs home first.
tips: Check the board before each move, especially for black holes and erupting arenas, since they can remove a peg you have already advanced.
Knock back a rival when you can, because a peg sent to the start loses all the progress it made.
Save Power-Ups for moments when a board change will help you most, such as when a rival is about to get home first.
Choose which peg to move based on risk and reward: advance a peg that is safe and close to home, and think twice before moving one into danger.
Watch the how-to video when you start if you are new, so you know the rules before your first roll.
faq: How do I start my turn in Knockback?
Pop the dome to roll, then pick one of your pegs to move.
How do I knock a rival back?
Land your peg on a rival's peg to send it back to the start.

kart-chaos.intro: Kart Chaos is a 3D kart racer with Grand Prix races against CPU racers, Time Trial ghost races, a Daily Challenge, and online rooms for racing friends. Drifting is the key skill to learn.
tips: Drift through corners on purpose, since that is how you charge speed boosts. Practice the same corner until you can hold a drift through it consistently.
Watch for ramps and aim for them with enough speed to attempt a ramp trick, because landing tricks gives you extra speed.
In Time Trial, race against your own ghost lap by lap and focus on the corners where you lose the most time.
Use the Daily Challenge to practice a fixed setup and compare your results against your earlier attempts.
If you play on gamepad or touch, learn the steering and drift inputs on a quiet track before entering a Grand Prix race.
faq: What is the goal of Kart Chaos?
You race karts around tracks to finish ahead of your opponents. The Grand Prix pits you against CPU racers, while Time Trial lets you chase ghost times.
How do I get speed boosts?
Drift through corners to charge speed boosts. Landing ramp tricks also gives you extra speed.

tangram-puzzle-2.intro: Tangram Puzzle 2 asks you to fill a target outline with colorful tangram pieces, with no overlaps or gaps. Fewer moves earn more stars, so planning each placement helps.
tips: Start with the corners or edges of the outline, since those spots usually have only a few pieces that can fit.
Look at the colors along the borders. Pieces must match bordering colors exactly, so check those edges before placing a piece.
Work out the rotation on paper or in your head before dragging, so each piece goes down in one clean move and you save moves for stars.
Use undo if a placement blocks a better option, rather than building on a mistake.
Save hints for when you are truly stuck. Using them early leaves less room to work out the puzzle yourself.
faq: How do I rotate a piece on PC?
Select the piece with a left click, then use the mouse wheel or press the R key to rotate it. Right-click flips the piece when that option is available.
How do I rotate a piece on a touchscreen?
Tap and hold a piece to select it, then use a two-finger rotate gesture. Tap outside the piece to deselect it.

moto-extreme-halloween-land.intro: Moto Extreme: Halloween Land is a spooky 3D side-scrolling motorcycle game. Ride dark, mysterious tracks, keep your bike balanced, and try to reach the end of each course.
tips: Use the balance keys (A and D, or Left and Right) in small, steady taps rather than holding them down, so your bike doesn't tip too far in either direction.
Before a jump or rough patch, ease off the forward key slightly so you can adjust your balance in time.
Watch the obstacles ahead and plan your line early, since the tracks are described as dangerous and you need room to react.
If you tip over or get stuck, use the backward key to reposition your bike before pushing forward again.
Keep a steady rhythm of forward throttle and balance corrections instead of making sudden big inputs, which tend to cause crashes on uneven ground.
faq: What is the goal of Moto Extreme: Halloween Land?
Your goal is to overcome the obstacles and reach the end of each dark, spooky track while keeping your motorcycle balanced.
How do I control the motorcycle?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward and S or the Down Arrow to move backward. Use A and D or the Left and Right Arrows to balance the bike.

duckling-rush-io.intro: Duckling Rush.io is an arcade game where you lead a mama duck around a pond, gathering ducklings into the longest conga line before the 90 second round ends.
tips: Since the duck always swims forward, plan your route a few seconds ahead and steer in wide, smooth curves so your line does not tangle.
Keep an eye on where rival lines sit, and look for chances to cut through them when your own line is long enough to benefit.
Save the QUACK burst for a moment when it counts, such as escaping the pike or getting into position to make a rival wobble.
Pay attention to the duckling personalities and go out of your way for the rare golden ducklings, since they are worth extra.
Check the timer as the round goes on, and use your last moments to grab any nearby ducklings that will extend your line.
faq: What is the goal of Duckling Rush.io?
Finish each 90 second round with the longest conga line of ducklings to win bread.
How do I steer the duck?
Hold and drag with your mouse or touch, or use the arrow keys or WASD. The duck always swims forward, so you steer its direction rather than its speed.

bean-party-obby.intro: Bean Party Obby is a 3D party game where you race, jump, and survive against 14 computer-controlled beans. You can pick a bean character and hat, then try one of five modes, from three obstacle courses to survival and color-matching rounds.
tips: Start with Rainbow Road, which is listed as the easy course, to learn the jump timing before trying High Peaks or Turbo Galaxy.
Use the double jump to correct your position mid-air, especially on the bridge and ramps in High Peaks.
Reach a checkpoint before attempting a hard section, so pressing R sends you back to a point you have already passed.
In Color Block, look for the announced color right away and move toward it, since the other tiles fall before the round ends.
In Hexagon Survival, keep an eye on which layers are about to vanish and move to a solid hexagon early rather than waiting until the ground drops.
faq: What is the goal in Hexagon Survival?
Four layers of hexagons vanish under your feet, and you must be the last bean standing.
How do I return to my progress after a fall?
Press R to return to the last checkpoint you reached in the course.

age-of-heroes.intro: Age of Heroes is a strategy and tower defense game where you build an army of heroes and pets, then lead them through eras from the Stone Age to space. Each era brings new battles, towers and wars.
tips: Build a balanced squad that mixes knights, mages and warriors, since the game highlights these three types combining their strengths.
Protect your towers first and treat defense as the base of your strategy before you push into enemy territory.
Strike first when you can, because the game encourages you to take the initiative in tower defense battles.
Keep developing your heroes as you go, since they grow alongside your army and you will face tougher waves in later eras.
Focus on one era at a time and learn how its tower and army work before moving on, as each era introduces a new battle and a new evolution.
faq: What is the main goal of Age of Heroes?
Your goal is to summon warriors and heroes, destroy enemy towers, and lead your army through all eras and centuries. Each battle decides the outcome of your campaign.
Which eras can I play through?
The game covers the Stone Age, Middle Ages, Age of Gunpowder, Modern Era, Future and Space Era. After finishing all eras on Earth, new worlds and planets open up.

draw-path-to-finish.intro: Draw Path To Finish is a puzzle game where you sketch a line that becomes the route for a moving platform carrying the heroine. Your drawn path must carry her past saws, fire, lava, cannons and other traps to the finish.
tips: Before you start drawing, study the whole level and note where each hazard sits so you can plan the full route in your head.
Keep your line a little away from saws and fire, since the platform needs room to pass safely around them.
Watch how the platform moves after you release, and use short test lines to learn how the route behaves before committing to a long one.
Look for coins on the way, but do not risk the run just to collect them; reaching the finish matters most.
If a level keeps failing, try a different route shape instead of small tweaks, because each level mixes hazards in its own way.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to draw a route that lets the heroine's moving platform reach the finish without being caught by traps.
How do I control the platform?
Press or touch the screen and, without releasing, draw a line from the starting point toward the finish. Releasing sends the platform along the path you drew.

roadster-dash-halloween-night.intro: Roadster Dash: Halloween Night is a 3D arcade racer where you drive a flying car down a haunted highway. Chain stunts, collect pumpkins, and race solo or against a friend in split-screen.
tips: Chain jumps, flips and barrel rolls together to build stunt combos, since the combo is what drives your score up.
Save Left Shift boost for stretches where the road is clear so you can use it at full effect.
Use the slam (S) to come down fast when you need to land cleanly, rather than staying in the air past the traffic.
Grab power-ups when you can, and keep your item (Q) ready for the moment you need it most.
In 2 Player mode, watch for your rival's hexes such as fog, blackout and reversed controls, and stay calm when the controls flip.
faq: What is the goal of Roadster Dash: Halloween Night?
Your aim is to build a high score by chaining stunts, collecting glowing pumpkins and staying on the haunted highway. In 2 Player mode, you race a friend on the same road over best of 3 rounds.
How do I control my car?
Player 1 moves with A and D, jumps with W, slams with S, boosts with Left Shift, uses items with Q and hexes with E. Player 2 uses the Arrow Keys to move and Right Shift to boost.

kick-the-zombie-ragdoll-sandbox.intro: Kick the Zombie is a physics sandbox where you play with Gus, a cartoon zombie, using a set of tools. Drag him around, pick a tool, and see what happens when you launch him, kick him, or freeze him.
tips: Drag Gus gently at first to see how he moves before throwing him hard, since his body reacts differently depending on how fast you fling him.
Use the bouncy headstones and walls as launch points by flinging Gus into them, which can send him flying in unexpected directions.
Switch tools often from the toolbar so you can compare the kick, smack, zap, and freeze effects on the same setup.
Try the balloons and pumpkin cannon for longer, more varied reactions, since the floating and blasting results are some of the most distinct.
Tap the door to move between rooms when you want a fresh space to experiment, rather than staying in one spot.
faq: How do I move Gus?
Drag him with your mouse or your finger to grab him and fling him around the screen.
How do I use a tool?
Select a tool from the toolbar, then tap or click to use it on Gus. Tap the toolbar again to switch to a different tool.

the-space-mover.intro: The Space Mover is a logic puzzle where you guide a robot through space-like levels, using magnetic power to move boxes into the right spots. Timing and planning matter as much as quick reactions.
tips: Look at where each target block needs to end up before you touch any box. Working backward from the goal often reveals the order you need to move things in.
Plan your robot's route before you start moving. Mistakes in timing can make a puzzle harder to fix, so think through a few steps ahead.
Use the jump only when you need it to reach a higher spot or clear an obstacle. Jumping without a plan can put you in a worse position.
If you get stuck, reset your thinking by checking which boxes are already in the correct position and which are not. Focus on one box at a time.
On PC, keep one hand on WASD for movement and the other ready for Space and E, so you can react quickly when you need to jump or interact.
faq: What is the goal of The Space Mover?
Your goal is to complete each mission by placing every target block into its correct position. You do this by guiding the robot and using magnetic power to move boxes.
What are the controls on PC?
Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and E to interact. These controls let you steer the robot and operate the magnetic movement.

vega-mix-2-adventure.intro: Vega Mix 2: Adventure is a match-3 puzzle game set on a mysterious island. You swap colorful pieces to make lines and clear the board while working through obstacles and levels.
tips: Look for moves that create power-ups before clearing small groups, since a Rocket, Spinner, Bomb or Rainbow Flower can clear far more of the board in one turn.
Combine two power-ups when you can. The game says pairing any two gives a variety of strong effects, which is often the fastest way to finish a hard level.
Scan the board for obstacles first and plan moves that break them, especially when they block pieces you need for the level goal.
Save the Rainbow Flower for a color that appears often on the board, so it clears many pieces at once.
Check the level goal before each move and choose matches that help meet it, rather than only chasing the highest score.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear the board and complete the level's objective, which can involve breaking obstacles as you progress through the island. The exact goal is shown at the start of each level.
How do I make a Bomb?
Make a T-shaped match of 5 pieces. The Bomb then creates a massive explosion across the board when it is activated.

spotless.intro: Spotless is a pressure-washing game where you clean 100 jobs, from small signs to huge ships and rockets. Spray away mud, moss, rust and grime, and chain combos to build your progress.
tips: Switch nozzles often with the number keys, the scroll wheel, or the toolbar on mobile, so each surface gets the spray it needs.
Use the dirt detection key (E or F on PC) to find hidden grime before you start spraying a large area.
Spend your coins on pump upgrades early, since a stronger pump makes big jobs much less tedious.
Keep your spray moving in steady passes instead of holding in one spot, which helps you keep combos going.
Save the Boss and Legendary contracts for when your pump and nozzles are well upgraded, as they are the hardest challenges.
faq: What is the main goal of Spotless?
Your goal is to clean 100 jobs, removing mud, moss, rust and grime. Larger jobs range from stop signs to cargo ships and rockets.
How do I earn coins?
You earn coins by cleaning jobs and building up combos. Use the coins to upgrade your pump and unlock new nozzles.

chute.intro: CHUTE is a factory puzzle where gravity moves the parts. You lay chutes and place tools to turn grey parts into the colours each bin asks for, then press Start and watch the line run.
tips: Before you press Start, trace the path from each hopper to its bin and check that every gap has a chute, since parts only fall along other parts.
If a hopper pours faster than one painter can keep up, add a second line instead of trying to speed up the first one.
Press Start and watch the parts closely; a queue or a spilled part shows you exactly where the line needs another piece.
Use a filter or splitter early if a stream mixes parts that need different treatment, so each bin gets only what it asks for.
Aim for fewer lost runs, because the score rewards a clean run, so rebuild and retry rather than accepting a messy result.
faq: What is the goal of CHUTE?
Fill every bin with the parts it asks for before the hoppers run dry. You do this by building the full line from hopper to bin.
How do I place tools and parts?
Pick a tool and tap a cell to place it. Tap a ramp again to flip its direction. On a keyboard, keys 1 to 9 select tools.

slowmo-sniper.intro: SlowMo Sniper is a 3D sniper game where you leap out of cover and take down every enemy before you land. Time slows down during the jump, so you can line up each shot carefully.
tips: Plan your order before you jump. Scan the level for the enemies closest to your landing path, and shoot those first.
Watch for red barrels and hanging cargo. A single well-timed bullet can take out a whole group at once.
Keep a second bullet ready for helmeted enemies, since the helmet falls off after the first hit and the head becomes the target.
Count your bullets as you go. Running out before the last enemy means the level is lost, so skip nothing you can safely take.
If a level keeps defeating you, spend cash on Damage so a body shot is enough, or on Bullets for more shots per level.
faq: How do I earn 3 stars on a level?
Miss no more than once during the level to earn the full 3 stars. Each extra miss makes the star rating harder to keep.
How do I aim and shoot with the mouse?
Hold the left mouse button inside the circle, or hold Space, then move the mouse to aim. Release the button to fire, and drag outside the circle to turn the camera.

aura-farm-rng.intro: Aura Farm: RNG is a 3D collection game where you roll for random auras and coins, then build your look and upgrade your luck. Each find can fill a gap or become a new favourite.
tips: Spend coins on luck upgrades early, since better luck makes every roll more worthwhile over time.
Check My auras often after rolling, and equip the finds you like best so your character shows your progress.
Head into the Wilds to gather materials, then use Crafting to make potions and luck gloves that support your rolls.
Keep up with daily quests and weekly challenges, which give you clear goals while you build your collection.
Pay attention to time of day and world events, since they change which auras you are likely to find.
faq: What is the main goal of Aura Farm: RNG?
The goal is to build your collection of auras by rolling for them, equipping the ones you like, and growing your luck and roll speed over time.
When does auto-roll unlock?
Auto-roll unlocks after 25 rolls, so you can keep the search going without pressing Roll each time.

sky-wars-battle-of-the-islands.intro: Sky Wars is a blocky island battle where you face seven bots and try to be the last player alive. Loot your island, bridge to the center, and knock rivals into the void.
tips: Open all three chests on your island first so you have a weapon and armor before you start bridging.
Take the bridge to the middle island early, since the better loot there helps you compete for the rest of the match.
Use Shift or hold a block at an island edge so you auto-sneak and stay on the bridge while you build.
Check the Tab scoreboard now and then to see how many opponents are left and where the fights are happening.
Keep an eye on the clock, because the super chest in the center unlocks every 2.5 minutes with top-tier diamond gear, so plan to reach it on time.
faq: How do I win a round?
You win by being the last player alive. Players who fall into the void are out, so keep your footing and push rivals toward the edge.
How do I avoid falling off while building bridges?
Hold Shift at an edge to sneak, or hold a block near the edge so you auto-sneak. Place blocks one at a time so the path stays solid under you.

rc-racing.intro: RC Racing puts you behind the wheel of a 1:8 nitro buggy on a series of dirt, clay, sand and snow tracks. Race five rivals, earn prize money, and rebuild your car between events.
tips: Spend prize money on the parts that match your weakest area first, such as tyres for grip or a repair when something breaks, rather than buying everything at once.
Broken parts slow your car down, so repair them as soon as you can instead of waiting until a race is already lost.
Switch to mud tyres when the weather turns wet, since the default tyres are not meant for rain.
Use time trial against ghosts to practise a single lap and learn the lines before you try to pass rivals in a full race.
Use the throttle and brake gently with W and S so the car keeps grip on loose surfaces instead of sliding out of corners.
faq: How do I win a race?
Finish ahead of the five rivals in each race. Tournaments and long finals reward you for strong results and pay prize money.
What do the steering keys do?

A and D or the left and right arrows steer. By default the controls work like a real RC transmitter, so left and right reverse when the car drives toward you; switch to Simple in Settings if you prefer.

fake-hunter.intro: Fake Hunter is an arcade game where you run a collectibles shop and decide whether each Blobby a customer brings is real or fake. You have to judge quickly, using the official card and your detective tools.
tips: Look at the official model on the corner card before you inspect the figure, so you know exactly what to compare, such as the number of eyes or the ears.
Turn the figure around early to check the back label, since a label that looks wrong is often the quickest sign of a fake.
Use the UV lamp and magnifier only when a figure looks close to the official one, so you don't waste time on obvious fakes.
Keep an eye on the customer's patience and decide before it runs out, because a rushed call is still better than none.
Spend your coins on upgrades and staff between days so that checking each figure becomes faster and less stressful.
faq: How do I decide whether a Blobby is real or fake?
Compare the figure on the counter with the official model on the corner card, then check the back label. Use the other tools if you are still unsure, and then tap REAL or FAKE.
What happens when I make a wrong call?
Right calls earn coins and stars, while mistakes cost money. Try to be accurate as well as quick.

nextbot-can-you-escape.intro: Nextbot: Can You Escape? is a survival chase game where you are trapped in a nextbot world. Survive for a set amount of time and find your way out before the Nextbot reaches you.
tips: The Nextbot moves quickly and simply chases you, so keep moving rather than standing still to look around.
Use F to hide when the Nextbot is close, and stay put until it has moved away from your position.
Press T only when you are sure the Nextbot is clear of your hiding spot, since leaving early can expose you.
Keep track of how long you have survived, because the escape only comes after the required time has passed.
Use ESCAPE to pause if you need a moment to plan your route; it is a safe way to step back from the chase.
faq: What is the goal of Nextbot: Can You Escape?
Your goal is to survive for a certain amount of time and escape the nextbot world. The Nextbot will chase you the whole time.
What happens if the Nextbot touches me?
Close contact knocks you away and instantly kills you. The Nextbot has no cooldown and can eliminate several humans at once.

barrel-roller-stack-and-run-3d.intro: Barrel Roller is a 3D endless runner where you steer a runner left and right, gather barrels into a growing stack, and avoid obstacles and traps on the way to the finish line. This guide covers steering, stacking, and staying on course.
tips: Start moving early when you spot barrels or obstacles ahead, since a quick sideways drag can be too late to change lanes safely.
Go for barrels when the path is clear, because a taller stack is the main goal of the run.
Look ahead for traps and obstacles and plan your route a few moments in advance rather than reacting at the last second.
Use short, controlled drags to steer, which helps you line up with barrels and gaps without overcorrecting.
Keep a steady focus on the finish line, since reaching it is what turns your stack and run into a win.
faq: How do I steer my runner?
Swipe or drag left and right to move the runner across the track. Small, controlled movements are usually easier to manage than large ones.
How do I make my stack taller?
Collect barrels as you run to add them to your stack. Steer toward barrels when it is safe to do so.

tangram-triangle.intro: Tangram Triangle is a puzzle game where you drag and rotate triangular pieces in blue, yellow, red, and orange to fill irregular silhouettes on a grid. Each level asks you to use every piece with no overlaps or gaps.
tips: Look at the silhouette's corners and straight edges first, since they often show where a piece must go.
Rotate a piece to the right angle before you drop it, so you don't have to move it again later.
Start with the piece that has the most distinctive shape or fits a tight corner, then fill the open areas around it.
Aim for the 3/3 star on each level by checking for gaps and overlaps before you finish.
If you want to practice quick placement, try the time-attack mode and aim to beat your own high score.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to fit all the available pieces into the silhouette on the grid with no overlaps or gaps. Completing this unlocks the next, tougher puzzle.
How do I rotate a piece on touch screens?
Use a two-finger pinch or rotation gesture to adjust the piece's orientation. You can also tap a piece to select it, then double-tap or use the rotate button if it is shown.

halloween-hand-care.intro: Run a spooky clinic and help six monster patients by treating their hands. You'll tackle swollen fingers, red bumps, scratches, and splinters before finishing with some Halloween decorations.
tips: Flip the hand early and check both sides, since some problems only show up after you turn it over.
Use the X-ray when a problem looks unclear, so you can spot hidden injuries before you start treating.
Hold each tool on the problem for a moment rather than tapping, because treatment only happens while you hold.
When using tweezers, grip the splinter firmly and move the jaws over the disposal tray before releasing so it's properly discarded.
Clean all five fingernails by zooming in, and do this before decorating so the healthy hand is fully ready for its drawings.
faq: What is the goal of Halloween Hand Care?
Treat the problems on each monster patient's hand, then decorate the healthy hand with colorful drawings. Work through all six patients.
How do I treat a problem on the hand?
Select a tool with your mouse or finger, place its working tip or surface directly on the matching problem, and hold it there to treat it.

traffic-rush-online.intro: TRAFFIC Rush Online is a 3D driving game on a busy city highway. Weave between moving cars, manage your speed, and try to drive as far as you can without crashing.
tips: Watch the cars two or three lanes ahead rather than only the one directly in front of you, so you can plan your lane change early.
Pick your moment to switch lanes when there is a clear gap. Rushing a move into a tight space is the most common way to crash.
Use the handbrake (Spacebar on PC) sparingly to control speed in tight spots, and ease off the throttle when traffic bunches up.
Try different camera views with the C key on PC to find the one that gives you the clearest view of traffic around your car.
Since distance drives your earnings, a safe, steady run usually pays more than a risky one that ends early. Spend your gold on upgrades that make your car easier to control.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to drive as far as possible along the highway, avoid crashing into other cars, and beat your record.
How do I earn money?
The farther you drive, the more money you earn, and you can spend it on upgrading your car or buying new vehicles.

park-sort.intro: Park Sort is a color-sorting parking puzzle where each vehicle drives along its roof arrow toward the matching garage. Garages open in order, so planning ahead matters as much as the next tap.
tips: Check the NEXT list before each move so you know which garage opens soon and which vehicles you will need to park first.
Remember that garages fill in order: big vehicles first, then cars, then bikes. Hold back smaller vehicles if a big one is still waiting for its garage.
Before tapping a vehicle, look at the empty spaces in its garage. A vehicle that can leave now is not always the one that should leave now.
Keep an eye on the waiting slots. Cars that cannot park yet will fill them, and the game ends when they are all full, so clear the path for vehicles that can move.
Use Undo to test a move you are unsure about, and use Hint when you are stuck. Scan can lock vehicles that cannot park right now, which helps you focus on the others.
faq: What is the goal of Park Sort?
Your goal is to sort every vehicle into the garage of its matching color. Clear the jam before the waiting slots fill up.
What happens when the waiting slots are full?
The level ends when all waiting slots are full. Vehicles that cannot park yet stay in those slots until their garage opens.

steal-car-duel.intro: Steal Car Duel is a competitive action game about racing, colliding, and stealing cars in arena duels. You can play alone or with a friend in 2 Player mode, and build up your garage with coins and tickets.
tips: Learn both key sets early. Player 1 uses W, A, S, D, and Player 2 uses the arrow keys, so you can practice moving and jumping before a real duel.
Use Sprint to close distance on a rival or to get away after a steal. Save it for moments that matter, since it is a short burst of speed.
Pay attention to timing when you attack. Hitting with F or the Left Mouse button works best when the rival is in range and not already moving away.
Collect coins and tickets during matches so you can keep buying upgrades for your garage. Spending early on small upgrades can help you compete sooner.
Watch what your rival is doing before you commit to a steal. Jump with Space or L to avoid hits, then steal when the opening appears.
faq: What is the goal of Steal Car Duel?
The goal is to outperform your rival in arena duels by racing, colliding, and stealing your way to the top. Each match rewards skill, timing, and strategy.
What are the controls for Player 1 and Player 2?

Player 1 moves with W, A, S, D, jumps with Space, steals or buys with E, hits with F or the Left Mouse button, and sprints with Left Shift. Player 2 moves with the Arrow Keys, jumps with L, steals or buys with O, hits with K, and sprints with J.

geovex-daily-geography-challenge.intro: GeoVex is a 10-round daily map challenge where you identify a flag and place a pin on the country it belongs to. Easy mode shows country names and borders, while Hard mode removes them.
tips: Start each round by reading the flag's colours, symbols and layout before touching the map, so you know what region to search in.
Zoom in before dropping your pin. A correct guess inside the country earns the full 10 points, while a pin near the border only earns partial points.
If you are unsure, drop your pin in the most likely area and check how close you are. Distance matters, so even a near miss within 500km earns 5 points.
Use Easy mode to learn where countries sit relative to their neighbours, then switch to Hard mode when you want a real test of your knowledge.
Play the daily challenge each day to build your streak, and compare your final score with friends once you finish all rounds.
faq: How do I score the most points?
Place your pin inside the correct country to earn the maximum of 10 points for that round. Scores drop as your pin gets further away from the target.
What is the difference between Easy and Hard mode?
Easy mode shows country names and map borders to help you find the right place. Hard mode uses a completely borderless map, so you must rely on your own geography knowledge.

soccer-legends-2026.intro: Soccer Legends 2026 is a fast arcade soccer game where you score more goals than your opponent before time runs out. You can play solo or challenge a friend in 1v1 and 2v2 matches, with tournaments to enter.
tips: Learn the Slide control early, since sliding in at the right moment can stop an opponent's attack and win back the ball.
Save your Supershot for a moment when the opponent expects a normal shot, so it has the best chance to surprise them.
Pick a character whose special ability suits your style, and try a few different players before committing to one in tournaments.
Time your jumps and shots rather than rushing them, because a well-timed strike usually beats a hurried one.
In 2v2 matches, decide with your teammate who attacks and who defends so you do not both chase the ball at the same time.
faq: What is the goal of Soccer Legends 2026?
Score more goals than your opponent before the time runs out. You can do this in solo play, 1v1 or 2v2 matches, or tournaments.
What does the Supershot do?
The Supershot is a special shot you can use to surprise your opponent and gain the advantage. Press Z or K to use it.

simulator-gt-motorsport.intro: Simulator GT Motorsport lets you drive GT-style cars in four modes: Circuit, Short Race, Drag Race, and Drift. Pick a car, upgrade it, and build your skill tree as you go.
tips: Start with Short Race or Circuit to learn how your chosen car handles before trying the other modes.
Use the WASD keys smoothly rather than tapping hard, since sudden inputs can unsettle the car at speed.
Spend your early upgrades on the areas that match your favourite mode, so each run gets noticeably better.
In Drift mode, focus on keeping the car sliding steadily instead of chasing the biggest angle right away.
Try Drag Race to practise quick starts, then carry that habit of controlled acceleration into the longer races.
faq: What is the goal of Simulator GT Motorsport?
The game challenges you to drive GT-style cars through Circuit, Short Race, Drag Race, and Drift modes while improving your car and skills.
How do I control the car?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to move the car.

cadillacs-dino-riot.intro: Cadillacs: Dino Riot is a 2D side-scrolling rescue brawler where you play as Kira or Bo. Fight through eight chapters to stop a dinosaur-smuggling convoy and free the caged animals.
tips: Use the combo attack in short bursts and watch how enemies react, so you can step back before they counter.
Grab and throw enemies when you are surrounded to clear space, then return to punches and combos.
Pick up found weapons when they appear, but keep an eye on how many hits they last before you rely on them.
Free caged dinosaurs when you can, because rescued animals can turn a fight in your favour during tough moments.
Pause with Esc to take a breath and plan your route through each combat zone before pushing into a compound.
faq: What is the main goal of Cadillacs: Dino Riot?
You fight through eight chapters to stop a dinosaur-smuggling convoy, rescuing caged dinosaurs along the way.
Which keys control movement and attacks?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, J for combo attacks, Space to jump, and K to grab and throw enemies.

rainbow-ball-runner-2048.intro: Roll your ball along a colorful water track, dodging obstacles and collecting matching balls to grow. Each level gets harder as you go, so steady steering matters.
tips: Look a few seconds ahead rather than at your ball, so you can start steering away from obstacles before they reach you.
Make small, gradual steering moves instead of sharp jerks, since big sudden turns are more likely to push you off the path.
Plan your route toward matching balls when it is safe, but do not chase them into danger, because staying on the path matters most.
If you keep losing at the same spot, right-click to restart the level and try a different approach from the start.
Pay attention to how your ball changes as it grows, and adjust your steering to its new size near tight sections.
faq: How do I steer my ball?
Hold the left mouse button and move the mouse left or right. On mobile, swipe left or right.
How do I start or restart a level?
Click or tap to start. Right-click to restart the current level.

obby-all-games-dash-or-die.intro: Obby All Games: Dash or Die is a parkour game with colorful rainbow courses, a lava escape, and a bike challenge. Pick a map and race to the finish line without falling into the gaps.
tips: Watch the platform layout before you jump. Some obstacles look easy, but a single bad jump can send you back to the start.
Keep your momentum steady. The game rewards speed and timing, so build up pace on safe stretches and slow down only when a gap or trap requires it.
On the lava map, do not stop to look around. Keep moving forward so the rising lava never catches you.
In bike parkour, make small steering corrections with W, A, S, and D rather than sharp turns. This helps you keep your balance on difficult obstacles.
Use the mouse on desktop to look ahead and plan your route, and on mobile swipe to rotate the camera. Seeing the next platform early makes timing your jumps much easier.
faq: What is the goal of Obby All Games: Dash or Die?
Your goal is to reach the finish line on each map or mini-game by jumping across platforms, avoiding traps, and not falling into gaps.
How do I jump on desktop?
Press the Space bar to jump, and use W, A, S, and D to move your character or steer the bike. Use the mouse to look around.

yarn-fever-unravel-puzzle.intro: Yarn Fever! is a calm thread-sorting puzzle where you unravel knitted shapes and fill spools with matching colors. Each level gets more complex, so planning each move matters.
tips: Before you move a thread into a temporary slot, check whether it can go straight onto a matching spool. Free slots are limited, so saving them is the main way to avoid a restart.
Look closely at similar shades before you act. Misreading one color can send a thread to the wrong place and fill slots you need later.
Work through the knitted shape layer by layer, starting with the threads that are exposed and easy to reach. Clearing the outer layer often opens up the threads underneath.
Save boosters like Magic Box, New Hole, or Broom for levels that feel stuck, rather than using them early. Use Clean when waiting holes are taking up too much space.
If a level looks impossible, try the extra box or slot options to give yourself more room to work. Stop and rethink your plan instead of clicking quickly, since the game rewards careful choices.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Unravel the knitted shapes layer by layer and place every thread onto spools of the matching color. You win when all threads are on spools without using up your spare slots.
What happens if I run out of free slots?
If you run out of free slots before the toys are fully unraveled, you have to restart the level. Keeping track of free space is the key to avoiding this.

tricky-story-friendly-help.intro: Tricky Story: Friendly Help is a brain test built around everyday-life scenarios. You solve logic puzzles level by level, using hints when you get stuck.
tips: Read each scenario twice before acting, since the clue that matters is often in an ordinary detail.
If you are stuck, try a different approach, such as working backward from the goal or testing a new idea, instead of repeating the same attempt.
Use the hints when you need them rather than guessing at random, so you can learn the trick behind each puzzle.
Think about what the story is really asking, because the answer may be simpler or more creative than it first looks.
Keep notes of the brain tricks you spot, so you can recognize similar ones in later levels.
faq: What is the goal of Tricky Story: Friendly Help?
The goal is to solve each tricky logic puzzle and find the solution to crush every level. The puzzles are based on original scenarios from daily life.
What should I do if I get stuck on a level?
You can get hints when you are stuck. It also helps to change your approach and think bigger before trying again.

burger-restaurant-simulator-3d.intro: Burger Restaurant Simulator 3D is a cooking and management game where you run your own restaurant. You cook orders, manage money and staff, and grow into new locations and formats.
tips: Check your daily tasks with J and claim your daily reward with H at the start of each session, since both are easy to forget.
Use profits to upgrade equipment before you hire more people, so your kitchen can keep up with the orders you already take.
Train your staff as well as hiring them, so new employees can help you during busy periods.
Focus on keeping customers happy, because satisfied customers bring tips and build your reputation, which both support growth.
Press P to pause when you need a break or want to plan purchases, and use Tab to free your cursor when you need to click menus.
faq: How do I earn tips and reputation?
Happy customers give you tips and raise your reputation. Serve orders well and keep the wait manageable to make this happen.
What do the controls do?
Use WASD to move, E to interact, and the mouse to rotate the camera. M opens the shop, J shows daily tasks, H collects the daily reward, Tab shows or hides the cursor, and P pauses the game.

battlebox.intro: BattleBox is a memory-based puzzle where you uncover hidden treasure on a secret grid while avoiding monsters. Remember the layout, keep your health up, and plan each move carefully.
tips: Try to memorize where the monsters and treasures are as the grid is revealed, since the layout is a secret you need to recall.
Think through each move before you make it, weighing the reward of nearby treasure against the risk of a monster.
Keep an eye on your health and collect strawberries when you are running low, so you can keep exploring safely.
Use the early part of each round to build a mental map of the grid, which will make later decisions easier.
If a path looks dangerous, consider whether a safer route to the treasure exists before committing to it.
faq: What is the goal of BattleBox?
Your goal is to uncover hidden treasures while avoiding treacherous monsters on a secret grid. Each round rewards careful planning and good recall.
How do I stay alive in BattleBox?
You maintain your health by collecting strawberries. Watch your health and grab them when you need them to keep playing.

obby-cart-rush.intro: Obby Cart Rush is a 3D cart-coaster racing game. Ride a wooden minecart down roller-coaster tracks across five themed worlds and aim for the flag with the fastest time you can manage.
tips: Hold accelerate only on straight stretches and open sections, since speed you build up is what carries you through the rest of the track.
Start braking before you reach a speed sign rather than at it, so the cart has time to slow down before the sign.
Ease off speed before loops and steep drops, because carrying too much speed into them is the most likely way to fail.
Replay the same world several times to learn where the drops and sign positions are, then push harder on the sections you already know.
Press R to restart quickly after a bad run instead of finishing a track you have already lost, so you save time for another attempt.
faq: What is the goal of each track?
Survive the loops and drops and reach the flag. Your finish time decides which Bronze, Silver or Gold medal you earn.
How do I control the cart on desktop?
Press W or the Up arrow to accelerate, S or the Down arrow to brake, and R to restart the track.

sky-ace-stunt-plane-islands.intro: Sky Ace is a 3D stunt flying game where you pilot a bright plane over islands, canyons, snowy peaks and a sunset city. Chain rings, balloons, loops and barrel rolls to build big combos across 28 missions.
tips: Learn the bank and roll keys (A and D) before chasing combos, since most stunts depend on rolling cleanly.
Plan your route so that one trick flows into the next, such as a loop leading into a barrel roll, to keep combos going.
Use the boost (Space) in straight sections to reach the next ring or balloon, then ease off before tight turns.
Adjust your speed with the throttle (R and F) before a landing, and aim for a runway or carrier deck with a steady approach.
Try different planes once you unlock them, since each one has its own handling and may suit certain missions better.
faq: How do I build bigger combos?
Link several tricks together, such as glowing rings, balloon pops, chained loops and barrel rolls, without long gaps between them. Keep moving through the course so the combo doesn't break.
What are stars and coins used for?
You earn stars and coins across the 28 missions. Stars and coins unlock new planes and paint jobs, with five planes and eight paint jobs available in total.

spider-evolution-runner-game.intro: Spider Evolution Runner is a 3D arcade runner where you play as a spider that grows by eating insects and smaller spiders. Run through varied terrain, dodge threats, and work toward becoming the biggest spider in the realm.
tips: Grab insects and smaller spiders whenever you can, since growing larger is the core of the run.
Keep an eye on the path ahead so you can react early to threats instead of reacting at the last moment.
Before committing to a route, check whether a bigger spider or obstacle is nearby, as those can end your run.
Vary your approach across different landscapes, because the terrain changes and what works on one section may not work on the next.
Play in short sessions and reset your focus after each run to keep your decisions sharp.
faq: What is the main goal of Spider Evolution Runner?
Your goal is to grow as big as possible by consuming insects and smaller spiders while surviving the run. The game ends your attempt if you are caught by a threat.
How do I grow my spider?
Consume insects and smaller spiders along your path. Each one you eat helps your spider get bigger over time.

car-eats-car-3d.intro: Car Eats Car 3D is a racing battle game where you drive, smash enemies, and take on alien invaders and bosses. Use the controls carefully, since speed and weapons both matter in every fight.
tips: Use the turbo key (Left Shift or M) in short bursts for quick escapes or to close the gap on an enemy, rather than holding it constantly.
Save bombs (Space) for tougher enemies and bosses, where their damage is most useful.
Keep moving with the left and right keys to dodge incoming threats while you chase targets.
Use the brake (Down or S) to line up a sharp turn or a bite and smash attack instead of overshooting your target.
Upgrade your car's stats and equip weapons between battles so your next fight starts on stronger footing.
faq: What is the goal of Car Eats Car 3D?
You race and fight through battles, destroying enemies, completing missions, and defeating powerful bosses.
How do I attack enemies?
Smash, bite, shoot, and destroy enemies by driving into them and using your equipped weapons; bombs are dropped with the Space key.

rolling-football.intro: Rolling Football is a physics puzzle where you guide a soccer ball into the net using ramps, platforms, fans and other objects. Each level adds new obstacles that test your logic and timing.
tips: Before placing anything, study the whole level to spot where the ball starts, where the net is, and which obstacles stand in the way.
Build the simplest path first. A short ramp or single platform that gets the ball moving in the right direction often works better than a complicated setup.
Use fans to adjust the ball's speed or direction, and test how far a push carries it before committing to a full build.
Watch the ball's motion after each attempt. If it overshoots or bounces away, change the angle or height of one object rather than rebuilding everything.
Pay attention to timing with moving parts. Waiting for the right moment to release the ball can matter as much as where you place the objects.
faq: What is the goal of Rolling Football?
Your goal is to guide the soccer ball into the net on each level by arranging ramps, platforms, fans and other objects.
How do I control the game?
You play with the mouse, using it to place and set up the objects that build the ball's path.

match-mystery.intro: Match Mystery is a match-3 puzzle adventure where each strategic move reveals more of the story. Its levels keep coming and get harder as you go, so it suits players who enjoy brain-teasing challenges.
tips: Look for moves that create the biggest matches or combinations before making a quick one, since bigger plays can clear more of the board.
Scan the whole board before each move to spot matches you might otherwise miss.
Pay attention to how each move affects the story, as the plot unfolds based on your strategy.
Take short breaks when a level feels stuck, then return with fresh eyes to find a new approach.
Expect the challenges to get tougher over time, so practice on early levels to build habits you can use later.
faq: What is the main goal of Match Mystery?
You play through a match-3 puzzle adventure, making strategic moves that solve puzzles and unravel the storyline.
Does the difficulty change as I play?
Yes, the game has increasing difficulty, so later challenges are harder than the early ones.

wild-love.intro: Wild Love is a story-driven point-and-click adventure set on a mysterious island. You read through the story and make choices that shape how the heroine acts and speaks.
tips: Pay attention to what each character says and how they act before you pick a choice, since the story gives clues about who can be trusted.
Treat every choice as meaningful, because the heroine is in danger at many points and a poor decision can lead to trouble.
When you are unsure who is a friend and who is an enemy, compare what each person says with what they do later in the story.
Read the text carefully rather than rushing through the pages, since the mystery of the island is revealed bit by bit.
Try different choice paths on a replay to see how the story changes, and note which options led to safer outcomes.
faq: How do I move through the story?
You flip through the novel page by page. When the game offers choices, press the buttons to decide what the heroine will say or do.
How do I know who to trust?
The game asks you to guess who is a friend and who is an enemy, so watch characters closely and think about their motives. Your choices in the story are the main way to find out.

mud-truck-simulator-game.intro: Mud Truck Simulator Game is an offroad racing game where you drive powerful trucks over muddy roads and rough terrain. Use the keys to steer and move, and the mouse to click buttons.
tips: Use small, steady steering inputs with A and D so the truck stays balanced on uneven muddy ground.
Before you commit to a difficult stretch, look ahead and pick the line that avoids the deepest mud.
Use S to back out of a bad spot instead of forcing forward movement, which can leave the truck stuck.
Take the first few minutes to learn how the truck responds on different surfaces before attempting harder routes.
Try both the WASD keys and the arrow keys to find the control layout that feels most comfortable for you.
faq: What is the goal of Mud Truck Simulator Game?
The game is about driving powerful trucks through muddy roads and challenging offroad environments. Your aim is to navigate difficult routes and test your driving skills across rough terrain.
How do I control the truck?
Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use the mouse to click any buttons.

ball-sort-puzzle.intro: Ball Sort Puzzle asks you to pour balls between flasks until every flask holds balls of a single color. The levels start easy and get harder as you go.
tips: Before moving anything, look at the top ball of each flask, since only the top ball can be moved.
Try to empty a flask that has few balls, because an empty flask gives you extra room to rearrange colors.
Avoid placing a ball on top of a different color when you can, as it can block the ball underneath it.
Plan two or three moves ahead on harder levels rather than making quick moves that fill up flasks.
If you get stuck, step back and look for a color that can be gathered in one flask before working on the others.
faq: How do I move a ball?
Click the flask you want to take a ball from, then click the flask you want to send it to.
What is the goal of each level?
The goal is to sort the balls so that each flask contains only balls of one color.

eat-blobs-simulator.intro: Eat Blobs Simulator is a growing game where you collect slime pieces, get bigger, and eat smaller blobs to take the top spot in the arena. Plan your moves around the sizes of the blobs near you.
tips: Collect the nearby slime pieces first so you grow before you look for bigger targets.
Check the sizes of the blobs around you before every chase, and only go after ones that are smaller than you.
Rotate the camera with the left mouse button now and then so you can spot a larger blob coming up behind you.
Wait until you are clearly bigger than the blob you want before you start the hunt, since a close fight with a larger player can end your run.
In two-player mode, decide early whether to split the arena with your friend or compete for the same targets.
faq: How do I make my blob grow faster?
Eat the small slime pieces across the map, then chase smaller opponents, since eating another slime can give a major growth boost.
What happens if a bigger blob catches me?
Larger opponents can eat your character, so keep track of their sizes and stay away from them when you are smaller.

break-a-lucky-egg-brainrots.intro: Break eggs, collect Brainrot characters, and get them back to your base before their timers run out. Skeletons chase you while you carry them, so every run mixes quick reflexes with careful planning.
tips: Check the timer on a Brainrot as soon as you pick it up, and plan the route back to your base before you move on to another egg.
Watch for skeleton enemies before you start carrying a Brainrot. Taking a safer path, even a slightly longer one, can protect a valuable catch.
Put early earnings into stronger pickaxes and hammers so you can break higher tier eggs. Better tools speed up your progress.
Expand your base floors when your storage starts filling up, since more floors give you more capacity for Brainrots that generate income.
Use the Egg Index (H) to see what is available, and save tickets for the cosmetics, pets, or steals you care most about.
faq: What is the main goal of Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots?
The goal is to break brainrot eggs, collect rare Brainrot characters, and carry them safely to your base before their timers expire.
How do I stop skeletons from catching me?
Skeletons chase you while you carry a Brainrot, so keep moving and use Run (Left Shift) and Jump (Space) to get away from them.

beam-drive-car-crash-test-simulator.intro: Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator is a sandbox where you drive, crash, and test three cars on eight classic maps or your own custom maps. This guide covers the controls and a few ways to get more out of each run.
tips: Try each car on the same obstacle first, such as Caro, Flash, and Syper, to see how each one holds up on impact.
Use the camera keys (C) and the look-back key (B) to check your surroundings before you commit to a turn or a hit.
Use the Z and X keys for turn signals and the H key for the horn when you want to signal your intent, especially in busy areas of a map.
If you want a controlled test, drive slowly toward the obstacle and use the handbrake (Space) to stop, rather than racing at full speed.
In the Map Editor, build one simple obstacle at a time and test it, so you can see exactly how a change affects the crash.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The game has no fixed goal. You can complete challenges to test how durable each car is, or simply crash your car and watch what happens.
Which keys control the car?
Use WASD to drive, reverse, and steer, and Space for the handbrake. Z and X operate the left and right turn signals.

super-billy-boy.intro: Super Billy Boy is a pixel platformer where you work through traps and alien foes to rescue your friend. Each level adds new challenges, so steady progress matters more than speed.
tips: Slow down at the start of each new level and look for traps before you move forward. Learning the layout first saves lives later.
Take each jump deliberately. Platformer challenges here reward precision, so a short pause to line up a landing is often better than rushing.
If you lose a try at a tricky section, study exactly what went wrong, such as a misjudged jump or an enemy's path, and change only that part of your approach.
Expect the twists. Levels can change how things work in unexpected ways, so stay alert rather than relying on what worked in the previous stage.
Keep your end goal in mind. Every level moves you closer to rescuing your friend, so use each one to build the skills you will need for harder stages.
faq: What is the main goal in Super Billy Boy?
Your goal is to rescue your friend by getting through the pixelated levels, avoiding traps and alien foes along the way.
Does the game require precise timing?
Yes. The platforming challenges are built around precision, so careful, well-timed movements are key to getting past obstacles.

warfare-area.intro: Warfare Area is a shooting game where you are the last soldier from your troop, fighting to take back a base that enemies have captured. Use the rifle to clear the enemies and get ready for battle.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since staying in one spot makes you an easy target.
Turn and aim with the mouse or right side of the screen before you fire, so your shots go where the enemies are.
Use the movement keys or joystick to create distance between you and enemies instead of letting them surround you.
On touch screens, get comfortable with the joystick and fire button before the fighting starts so you can react quickly.
Pay attention to which direction enemies are coming from and turn toward them early.
faq: What is the goal of Warfare Area?
You are the last soldier from your troop in the base, so your goal is to fight back and take the base from the enemies.
How do I move and aim on desktop?
Use the arrow keys or W, A, S, D to move, and use the mouse to turn, aim, and shoot.

the-room.intro: The Room is a 2D pixel art shooter where you defend the heart of your domain from waves of enemies. Each challenge escalates, so sharp aim and quick reactions matter from the start.
tips: Spend the first few seconds watching where enemies come from, so you can decide where to focus your attention before the pressure builds.
Aim for precision rather than firing constantly. Steady, accurate shots usually protect the heart better than panicked spraying.
