In Campaign, clear each level fully before moving on, since new levels unlock only as you win. In Survival, focus on steady control to push your highest wave higher.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You must kill every zombie in the level to complete it. Campaign levels get increasingly difficult as you progress.
How do I play Survival mode?
Survival throws endless waves of zombies at you until you fall. The game tracks the highest wave you manage to survive.

noob-steal-the-egg.intro: Sneak up on animal nests, steal an egg, and race back to your base before the owner catches you. Hatch pets, build your collection, and grow your farm across nine zones.
tips: Watch the owner before you move in. Get close to a nest only when you have a clear path back to your base, since the owner can catch you on the way.
Train on the treadmill early. Faster running gives you more room to escape once you have an egg.
Use the central fence opening as your route out of the green zone, as the starting task suggests. Knowing this exit makes your escapes quicker.
Spend coins on base upgrades and check which tougher animals they unlock. Upgrading steadily helps you reach better pets.
Merge matching pets to build a stronger collection, and keep an eye on your farm score if you are competing with the computer-controlled neighbours.
faq: How do I steal an egg?
Move close to an animal nest and press E near the egg to steal it. Then run back to your base and press E there to place it.
How do I earn coins?
Hatch and grow pets, since they provide income for your farm. You can also use the optional rewarded videos, which offer coins and cosmetic items.

samurai-brawling.intro: Samurai Brawling is a 3D adventure where you play as Arashin, a Yakuza warrior. You fight strategic battles against tough foes while uncovering hidden truths in a world of samurais, ninjas, and intrigue.
tips: Study how each enemy attacks before committing to a move, since the battles are described as strategic rather than button-mashing.
Practice your special moves in less dangerous fights so you can use them confidently when a tougher foe appears.
Pay attention to the storyline, because the hidden truths you uncover can give you context for who you are fighting and why.
Track how Arashin's abilities evolve and make sure your playstyle takes advantage of the strengths you gain.
If a fight becomes too hard, step back and rethink your approach rather than repeating the same attacks.
faq: What is the main goal of Samurai Brawling?
You play as Arashin, a Yakuza warrior, and work through the storyline while battling formidable foes and uncovering hidden truths.
How does Arashin get stronger?
Arashin develops through evolving abilities and by mastering special moves, so improving those skills is key to progressing.

bonecrypt.intro: Bonecrypt is a dungeon action roguelite where you fight through branching crypt floors as a Knight, Ranger or Mage. Each run is different, so learning to read enemy attacks matters as much as your choice of weapon.
tips: Watch the colour of each enemy attack. Parry yellow attacks with Right mouse or K for a big counter, and dodge red attacks with Space or Shift.
Clear each room before moving on, and look for keys, since they are needed to open the way down to the chapter boss.
Use the secret walls, locked vaults and cursed chests you find along the way, because each run places them differently.
Keep your flask for dangerous moments. Press Q to drink it when your health gets low during a tough fight.
Spend what you earn at camp on permanent upgrades before trying harder runs, and move up to Nightmare difficulty only after you feel comfortable with the basics.
faq: How do I win Bonecrypt?
Clear the rooms on each floor, find keys to reach the chapter boss, and defeat all three bosses across the three chapters.
What is the difference between parrying and dodging?
Parry yellow attacks with Right mouse or K to set up a big counter, and dodge red attacks with Space or Shift because they cannot be parried.

farming-simulation-game.intro: Farming Simulation Game puts you in charge of a modern farm. You drive tractors, work the fields, and complete farming missions in a calm countryside setting.
tips: Practice steering with W A S D or the arrow keys before taking on missions, so you can line up your tractor along the rows of your fields.
Finish one task at a time, such as cultivating a field before planting it, so each step of the farming cycle goes smoothly.
Check each mission's requirements before you start, so you know which fields and tasks to prioritize.
Use the money and progress from completed tasks to improve your equipment, since better tools can make later jobs easier.
Take your time with the controls. Smooth, steady steering helps you avoid mistakes when working close to field edges.
faq: How do I drive the tractor?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. These keys drive and steer the tractor.
What is the main goal of the game?
You cultivate fields, plant and harvest crops, and complete farming missions while growing your farm.

ragdoll-mega-dunk.intro: Ragdoll Mega Dunk is a 3D basketball game where you guide quirky ragdoll characters through imaginative obstacle courses to pull off the perfect dunk. Physics and timing decide how the dunk turns out.
tips: Watch how your ragdoll moves before committing to a jump, since the physics can make each launch feel a little different.
Time your moves around the trampolines, because a well-timed bounce is what sends your ragdoll soaring.
Look ahead at the barriers on each course and plan your route so you avoid them before you reach them.
Treat each attempt as a chance to learn how the physics react, and adjust your timing a little at a time.
Don't rush the final dunk; a calm, controlled approach usually works better than a hurried one in this unpredictable setup.
faq: What is the goal of Ragdoll Mega Dunk?
The goal is to guide your ragdoll through each imaginative obstacle course and finish with the perfect dunk. You need to master the physics and timing to do it.
What should I focus on to get better?
Pay close attention to timing and how the ragdoll reacts to the physics. Learning to bounce off trampolines and avoid barriers will help you land stronger dunks.

go-kart-racing-game.intro: Go Kart Racing Game is a fast racing game where you drive go-karts across changing tracks, dodge obstacles, collect rewards, and race against skilled opponents. Use the keyboard to steer and the mouse for buttons.
tips: Learn the controls on an early run so steering feels natural before you face skilled opponents.
Watch the track ahead rather than only your kart, so you can spot obstacles early enough to steer around them.
Use the left and right keys in short taps when you need small corrections instead of holding them down, which can push you off line.
Pay attention to how each track changes, since the environments are designed to be challenging and may call for different driving approaches.
Collect rewards when they are on your path, since they can help you unlock new karts that you can use to improve your racing.
faq: How do I steer my kart?
Use A or Left Arrow to move left and D or Right Arrow to move right. Use W or Up Arrow to move forward and S or Down Arrow to move back.
What should I avoid while racing?
Obstacles on the track can slow you down, so keep an eye on the road ahead and steer around them when you can.

park-the-cars.intro: Park the Cars is a driving game about precision. You move through increasingly challenging levels, fitting into tight spaces and avoiding obstacles to park cleanly.
tips: Study the whole space before you start moving so you know where the car needs to fit and which obstacles are closest.
In tight spaces, make small, slow adjustments. They are much easier to correct than a large steering mistake.
Steer around obstacles early rather than correcting at the last second, which often leads to a crash or a bad park.
If a level keeps defeating you, replay it and focus on one part of the route at a time until the movement feels steady.
Take a short break when you feel rushed, since patience tends to matter more than speed on the harder levels.
faq: What is the main goal of Park the Cars?
You drive your car through each level and park it precisely while navigating tight spaces and avoiding obstacles.
Does the game get harder as I progress?
Yes, the levels become increasingly challenging, so the precision you build early on is needed later.

police-car-parking-2026.intro: Police Car Parking 2026 is a parking challenge where you steer a police cruiser through city streets, narrow alleys, and busy lots. Levels get harder as you go, so precise control matters.
tips: Take each level slowly at first. Small, steady inputs with W, A, S, and D usually give you more control than holding a key down.
Before you turn in, check the space you need. Tight alleys leave little room for correction, so line up the car early.
Use reverse with S to fix your angle rather than driving forward and back many times. Short, controlled movements keep the car clear of obstacles.
Watch for traffic and keep to the road rules as you drive. Stopping for other vehicles at the right moments helps you avoid collisions.
Expect the levels to become harder. Practise the earlier parking routes until you can park them smoothly before moving on.
faq: What is the goal of Police Car Parking 2026?
Your goal is to park your police cruiser correctly on each level. The levels take you through city streets, tight alleys, and busy lots.
How do I control the police car?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to drive the car. W and S move it forward and back, and A and D steer it left and right.

red-boy-and-blue-girl-forest-adventure.intro: Red Boy and Blue Girl Forest Adventure is a two-player adventure game in the style of Fireboy and Watergirl. Each player has their own set of keys, so it works best with a friend.
tips: Agree on who plays which character before you start, so neither of you is fighting over the same keys.
Keep your fingers resting on your keys, WASD on the left and arrows on the right, so you can react quickly without looking down.
Move slowly at first to learn how each character responds, then speed up once you are comfortable with the timing.
Talk to your partner before each move, especially when one of you needs to wait for the other.
If you get stuck or lose your place, pause and look at the whole screen before trying again, since the answer is often in the layout around you.
faq: Which keys control each player?
Player 1 uses W, A, S and D to move, and Player 2 uses the arrow keys.
Do I need a second person to play?
The game is set up for two players with separate controls, so playing with a friend on the same keyboard is the intended way to play.

stickman-prison-counter-assault.intro: Stickman Prison Counter Assault is a fast 3D shooter where you pick a side, either the SWAT team or the prisoners, and fight in quick battles. Aim and movement matter more than complex controls.
tips: Pick a side before you start and learn how each one plays, since the SWAT and prisoner roles are the core choice of the game.
Focus on aiming and firing in short bursts rather than holding fire, so you stay accurate at close and long range.
Keep moving to avoid standing still in one spot, which makes it easier for enemies to hit you.
Watch where enemies come from and use the space around you to outmaneuver them instead of charging straight in.
Expect quick respawns after a defeat, so jump back in and apply what you learned from the last fight.
faq: What is the main goal of Stickman Prison Counter Assault?
The goal is to fight through 3D battles on your chosen side, either SWAT or the prisoners, by aiming, firing, and outmaneuvering your opponents.
Do I need to learn complicated controls to play?
No, the game uses simple controls, so most of your effort goes into aiming, firing, and moving well during battles.

monster-card-shop.intro: Monster Card Shop is a clicker where you run a trading card store, restock packs, serve customers and collect monster cards. Your shop keeps earning while you are away.
tips: Restock packs before shelves run empty, since you need stock to sell and open for your album.
Keep the shop clean by tapping trash and spills as they appear, so your store stays in good shape while you focus on customers.
Spend coins on staff such as a cashier, stocker or cleaner early on, so routine jobs get done without constant tapping.
Open packs steadily and aim to complete sets, because every new card and every finished set boosts your income.
Check the event button for auctions and tournaments, and grade your duplicate cards in the lab, then claim quest rewards and free daily gifts.
faq: What is the main goal of Monster Card Shop?
You run your own trading card shop by stocking packs, serving customers and filling your album with monsters from four worlds. Growing your income and expanding the store are the core aims.
How do I serve customers at the till?
Tap the till, then either swipe the customer's card or give them the right change. Serving customers quickly helps keep your shop earning.

grow-the-baby.intro: Grow the Baby is a cozy idle tycoon where a very small founder runs a growing toy empire. You complete jobs by hand, then hire crew to keep earning while you play other parts of the game.
tips: Start by clicking jobs yourself, since the founder's cash from completed jobs is what pays for your first upgrades and businesses.
Reinvest in equipment and new businesses early, then hire crew once you have a job worth automating.
When assigning crew, match each employee's specialty to the job they are placed on, then promote them to raise their output.
Check the Goals panel regularly so you do not miss rewards you have already earned.
Before you leave, note which crew are on which jobs, then collect their offline earnings when you return.
faq: What is the main goal of Grow the Baby?
You build and grow a toy empire by choosing businesses, upgrading equipment and hiring crew. Progress through Toys, Goals and Home expansion works toward the final property, Planet Ego.
How do I earn money?
Click or tap a job to send the founder over to complete it for cash. Crew assigned to owned jobs also earn automatically.

max-speed.intro: Max Speed is a 3D arcade racing game where you drive sports cars over tracks full of jumps and stunts. Use the flips, barrel rolls, and nitro boost to stay fast and win battles.
tips: Use nitro in straight, open stretches where you are already moving well, so the speed boost is not wasted on turns.
Plan your flips before a jump rather than mid-air, and pick the flip that matches how you plan to land.
Keep your steering gentle through turns, since sharp corrections can cost you speed and control.
Upgrade and customize your car early to find a setup that suits your driving style, then adjust it as tracks get harder.
Try each location a few times to learn where the jumps and battles come up, so you can prepare your nitro and tricks ahead of time.
faq: What is the goal of Max Speed?
You race sports cars on 3D tracks against other drivers, aiming to finish ahead while performing jumps and stunts along the way.
How do I perform flips and barrel rolls?
Use the Up or W key for a front flip, Down or S for a back flip, and Left or Right (A or D) for barrel flips when turning. Mouse click or tap starts the game.

push-noob.intro: Push Noob is a physics adventure where you use snowballs to knock tough characters off high places. Bounces earn diamonds, and the falls are the main event.
tips: Aim for high ledges, since the description says the characters fall from dizzying heights and bigger drops set up more dramatic results.
Pay attention to how characters bounce after a hit, because the game rewards bounce mastery with maximum diamonds.
Don't worry about breaking things too gently; the characters are resilient, so focus on sending them into the most spectacular falls.
Experiment with different snowball hits and positions to learn how the ragdoll physics react, then repeat the setups that bounce best.
Take your time to watch each fall play out, since learning how the physics behave will help you plan your next push.
faq: How do you earn diamonds in Push Noob?
Diamonds are rewarded for mastering bounces, so try to knock characters into bounces that score the most.
What is the goal of Push Noob?
The goal is to use snowballs to knock resilient characters from dizzying heights and enjoy the physics-driven falls.

bun-boss.intro: Bun Boss is an arcade tycoon game where you run a bakery by moving with one finger. Harvest wheat, bake goods, stock shelves and serve customers to grow your business.
tips: Follow the yellow arrow when you are unsure what to do next, since it always points to the next useful step.
Keep your stack moving between the wheat field, the oven or mill, and the shelves so the bakery never runs out of stock to serve.
Save your coins for the glowing pads that unlock new machines and helpers, because those speed up every part of the bakery.
Watch for Rush Hour, when prices are higher, and try to have plenty of stock ready before it starts.
Keep an eye on VIP guests with big orders, and make sure you have the goods they want before they reach the counter.
faq: What is the main goal of Bun Boss?
Your goal is to grow a bakery empire by harvesting wheat, baking goods, stocking shelves and serving customers. Spending coins on new machines, helpers and areas helps the bakery grow.
How do I move my character?
Touch and drag anywhere on the screen to move, or use the WASD or arrow keys on a desktop. Most other actions, like harvesting and serving, happen automatically when you stand in the right place.

ww2-call-of-sniper.intro: WW2 Call of Sniper puts you in control of a stealthy marksman on solo missions behind enemy lines. Success depends on precise shots, careful planning, and staying unseen.
tips: Scout the area before you commit to a shot so you know where enemies are and how they move.
Choose your loadout to match the mission plan, whether that means staying far back or moving in closer.
Treat staying undetected as the main goal. One careful shot is usually safer than a rushed one that draws attention.
After each shot, reposition to a new hiding spot before enemies can locate where the shot came from.
Pay attention to the surroundings, since intense environments can offer cover, sightlines, and routes you can use to outmaneuver foes.
faq: What is the main goal of WW2 Call of Sniper?
You complete daring solo missions in enemy territory while avoiding detection by enemy forces.
How do I stay hidden during a mission?
Move slowly, scout ahead, and use the environment for cover. Reposition after each shot so enemies cannot track your position.

correct-math.intro: Correct Math is a quick puzzle game that tests your addition and subtraction skills. Pick the right answer from three options before the time runs out.
tips: Work out the answer in your head before looking at the options, so you are not pulled toward a wrong choice.
Start with small sums and differences to build speed, then push yourself on bigger numbers as you get comfortable.
Check the sign carefully. Mixing up addition and subtraction is the most common reason for a wrong click when you are rushing.
Stay accurate first. Each click that is wrong costs you the chance to earn points, so a steady pace usually scores better than panicked guessing.
Keep your eyes on the question and the three answers together, and tap as soon as you are sure, since the thinking time is short.
faq: What is the goal of Correct Math?
The goal is to earn as many points as you can by choosing the correct result to each addition or subtraction question.
How do I play Correct Math?
Tap on the screen to play, then click the correct answer from the three options shown for each math question.

car-eats-car-dungeon-adventure.intro: Race along the highway, overtake rivals, and build your own car in the incubator. Use turbo, bombs, and careful balancing to stay in control while you chase the cops and fight the boss.
tips: Save turbo for straight stretches of road where you can use the speed safely, and avoid firing it into tight turns where you may lose control.
Use the A and D keys, or the left and right arrow keys, to balance the car often in small adjustments rather than large swings.
Ease off the gas with W or the up arrow before corners, and tap S or the down arrow to brake so the car stays steady.
Keep Space for bombs when a rival or police car is close behind or beside you, since a well-timed hit can matter more than speed.
Think about how you build your car in the incubator, since the way you upgrade it affects how you handle overtaking and the boss fight.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Eats Car: Dungeon Adventure?
You race on the highway, overtake enemies, and fight to free your friends from prison while surviving chases with the police and the boss.
Which keys control the car?
W or the up arrow gives gas, S or the down arrow brakes, A and D or the arrow keys balance the car, X activates turbo, and Space fires bombs.

sliding-slide.intro: Sliding Slide is a tile puzzle where you rebuild a vibrant illustration by moving pieces into place. You race the clock across different difficulty levels and aim to beat your best score.
tips: Start by finding the corners and edge pieces first, since they are easier to place and give you a framework for the rest of the picture.
Work on one section of the illustration at a time instead of jumping between areas, which keeps you from undoing progress.
Before each move, look at where the tile you need is and plan a short sequence of slides rather than reacting to each tile as it moves.
Try a lower difficulty first to learn how the tiles respond to your touches or clicks, then move up as your speed improves.
Keep an eye on the clock but do not rush every move; a few careful placements usually save more time than fast, mistaken ones.
faq: What is the goal of Sliding Slide?
The goal is to piece the illustration back together by shuffling and positioning the tiles. You are also trying to finish quickly against the clock.
How do I move the tiles?
You move tiles with simple touches or clicks. Choose a tile and place it where it belongs in the picture.

obby-traps-and-jumps.intro: Obby: Traps And Jumps is a platforming game with 20 levels and 60 stages in total. Jump across platforms, avoid traps, and collect the stars hidden in each stage.
tips: Watch the arrows on each stage so you know the route before you commit to a jump.
Use R to restart right after a fall instead of walking back, since fast restart keeps your progress moving.
Use sprint for long gaps and save precise jumps for short, careful steps.
Try to go for the time limit and the hidden star on early stages, while the layouts are still easy to learn.
In levels 6 to 20, slow down when platforms start to disappear and plan your next landing before you step.
faq: How do I earn stars?
You earn stars by finishing a stage, beating its time limit, or finding the hidden star. Each stage has 3 stars to collect.
What changes as I go further in the game?
Levels 1 to 5 are basic, 6 to 10 add disappearing platforms, 11 to 15 add traps, and 16 to 20 combine both.

knight-launch.intro: Knight Launch is a physics launch game where you load a trebuchet and send your knight as far as possible. You earn gold for every meter and spend it on upgrades for longer flights.
tips: Watch the release timing closely and let go inside the gold zone to get a PERFECT launch.
Use haystacks and cows to bounce your knight onward instead of letting the flight end early.
Save your powder kegs for the air, and tap to blast one when your knight is heading somewhere you want to go farther.
Open your cape to glide, but try to hold it long enough to use the distance it gives you before you land.
After each flight, spend your gold on the upgrade that fixes your weakest part of the run, such as the counterweight for launch power or the cape for gliding.
faq: What is the goal of Knight Launch?
Your goal is to fly as far as you can. Every meter earns gold, which you can spend on upgrades to fly farther on your next launch.
How do I get a PERFECT launch?
Hold to load the trebuchet and let go while the launch is inside the gold zone. Letting go there is what counts as a PERFECT launch.

catcha.intro: Catcha is a cozy pixel-art cat collecting game. Fill your room with cats, pair them up for gift boxes, and work toward completing your Album.
tips: Watch for hearts above cats' heads. Those cats are ready for love, so drag two of them close together to get a gift box.
Check your Album before opening boxes or trading at the Auction so you can see which cats and cards you still need.
Use the drag and fling controls to rearrange your room and keep cats apart from each other so they are easier to pair up.
Compare the card rarities (Common up to Super, including FULL ART) before deciding whether to keep, sell, or buy a cat at the Auction.
Open gift boxes regularly, since each box is how you get new cats and it also helps you level up.
faq: How do I get new cats?
Put two cats that have hearts above their heads close together and they will leave you a mystery gift box. Open the box to discover new cats on collectible cards.
How do I move a cat around the room?
Drag a cat to pick it up and move it. Release to drop it, or fling it to toss it.

friday-night-funkin-vs-garcello.intro: Face off against Garcello in the back alley across three original songs: Headache, Nerves, and Release. The game is best played on hard mode, and you control everything with the arrow keys.
tips: Since ghost tapping is turned off for Garcello, avoid pressing arrow keys when no note is coming, because extra presses count against you.
Keep your eyes on the incoming arrows rather than on your fingers, so you can time each press as the note reaches the target.
Try the songs on a lower difficulty first if you are new, then move to hard mode once you can keep a steady rhythm.
Practice the section of a song that gives you trouble on its own, then play the full track to build consistency.
Stay relaxed and keep your hands loose on the arrow keys, since tense fingers tend to press too early or too late.
faq: What is the goal of Friday Night Funkin VS Garcello?
You face off against Garcello in the back alley by hitting the arrows in time with the music across three songs: Headache, Nerves, and Release.
Which keys do I use to play?
The game uses only the arrow keys to play.

sir-shiba-monster-island.intro: Sir Shiba: Monster Island is an idle arcade game where you guide a Shiba Inu knight across floating islands. Your job is to move him, collect treasure, and grow your island over time.
tips: Attacks happen automatically, so your main job is positioning. Steer Sir Shiba so nearby monsters stay within range.
Sell treasure at the market regularly so you have coins ready for new land, upgrades and hunters.
Check the goal at the top of the screen before spending coins. It shows what to work toward next.
Set up hunters before you leave the game, since they keep defeating monsters and filling storage while you are away.
Use quests, trophies and the wardrobe as side goals between bigger upgrades to keep progress steady.
faq: Do I need to attack the monsters myself?
No. Attacking is automatic when a monster is close, so you mainly need to move Sir Shiba into range.
What should I spend my coins on first?
Coins are used to unlock new land, buy upgrades at the Town Hall and hire hunters. Follow the goal at the top of the screen to decide which one helps most right now.

pier-and-lighthouse-merge-story.intro: Help Hazel restore her late grandmother's seaside diner and the pier around it. Merge items, serve the townsfolk, and uncover clues about the night the lighthouse went dark.
tips: Merge identical items as soon as you have a pair, since combining two lower items is how you reach better ones.
Every tap on a generator costs one energy, so plan which items you need before you spend taps on the fryer, tool crate or taffy puller.
Check the characters' orders before merging, and aim your items at the requests you can deliver, because that is how you earn starfish.
Save starfish for the restoration tasks in the town view rather than spending them as you earn them, so you can choose which tasks matter most.
Finish each day's tasks to open its chest, and finish a place before moving on, so you do not leave unfinished work behind.
faq: How do I merge items?
Drag two identical items together, and they will combine into a better one.
What does tapping a generator cost?
Each tap on a generator costs one energy, and energy refills over time.

watermelon-merge-fruit-drop.intro: Watermelon Merge: Fruit Drop is a physics puzzle where you drop fruits into a jar and merge matching pairs into bigger ones, aiming for the giant watermelon. Keep the jar clear and chain merges for a higher score.
tips: Aim each drop carefully with left and right movement before releasing, since fruits stacked unevenly can roll and block your merges.
Keep an eye on the dashed line at the top of the jar and act early when fruits start to rise toward it.
Save the Golden Seed for a crowded jar or a chance to build a long chain, because it merges with any fruit and upgrades it by one level.
Use the Hammer, Upgrade and Shake boosters when the jar gets stuck, rather than waiting until the game is nearly over.
Look for quick chain merges, since combos multiply your score and a single well-timed merge can clear space for the next drops.
faq: What is the goal of Watermelon Merge: Fruit Drop?
Your goal is to merge fruits all the way up to the giant watermelon while setting a high score. Each merge moves you closer to the largest fruit.
How do I drop a fruit?
Move your finger or mouse left or right, then release or click to drop the fruit. On keyboard, use the Left and Right arrows or A and D, and press Space or Enter to drop.

4-colors-multiplayer.intro: 4 Colors Multiplayer is a card game where you match colors and numbers to empty your hand before your rivals. You can play against friends or AI opponents, and action cards can change how the round goes.
tips: Before each play, check which colors and numbers you can match, and think about which card will leave you with the most useful options next turn.
Save your action cards for moments when they will hurt a rival the most, rather than using them as soon as you can.
Keep an eye on how many cards each opponent has left, so you know when to press your advantage and when to play more carefully.
Do not forget to call out when you are down to one card, since the game expects you to announce it.
Try to get rid of cards that are harder to match early, so you do not get stuck holding them at the end of the round.
faq: What is the goal of 4 Colors Multiplayer?
The goal is to be the first player to clear your hand by playing all of your cards. Matching colors and numbers correctly is how you get rid of them.
Can I play against computer opponents?
Yes, you can play against AI opponents or against friends. Both options let you test your strategy against different rivals.

zumba-mania.intro: Zumba Mania is a marble shooter puzzle where you aim and fire marbles to clear chains before they reach the end. Your goal is to finish every level with three stars.
tips: Look for groups of marbles that are one colour away from a match of three, and aim your shot to complete them.
Keep an eye on how close the chain is to the end, and prioritise clearing the marbles nearest that point when things get tight.
Use the frog to swap your current marble with the next one when the colour you are holding won't make a useful match.
Save power-ups for crowded moments where many marbles are about to reach the end, rather than using them on an easy board.
Replay levels you finished with fewer than three stars, since a cleaner run is how you earn the top rating.
faq: How do I shoot a marble?
Tap the screen to fire the marble you are holding. Aim before you tap so it lands where it can make a match.
What counts as a match?
Three or more marbles of the same colour touching each other are eliminated when they connect. Longer runs clear more marbles at once.

hungry-squirrel.intro: Hungry Squirrel is an animal game where you guide a squirrel through forests, dodging birds while collecting nuts. The pace rises as you play, so quick reflexes help you last longer and climb the high score list.
tips: Watch for sneaky birds before you reach for nuts. Spotting a threat early gives you more time to react.
Practise the easy controls for a short while before aiming for a high score, so your movements feel natural when things speed up.
Don't chase every nut at any cost. Grabbing nuts is useful, but staying alive longer is what keeps your score growing.
Stay calm as the pace increases. Shorter, steady movements usually work better than sudden panicked reactions.
Play several rounds and note where you lost your squirrel. Those moments show which kinds of challenge you need to react to faster.
faq: What is the main goal in Hungry Squirrel?
Your goal is to guide the squirrel through the forest, dodge the birds, and collect as many nuts as you can. Lasting longer also helps you climb the high score list.
Why does the game get harder over time?
The pace increases the longer you play, and the challenges escalate. This is designed to test and improve your reflexes.

hexa-village-sort-and-match.intro: Hexa Village mixes two puzzle games: sorting colored hexagon stacks and connecting number tiles. Earn stars from both to rebuild a village hidden in the fog.
tips: In Hexa Tower, place stacks so that matching colors touch, since neighboring tiles of the same color merge and help you clear space faster.
Keep an eye on the board's free space as well as the goal bar, because the level ends if the board runs out of room before you fill the goal.
In Hexa Number, look for longer chains that reach the goal sum, since longer chains score more.
Save power-ups like Bomb, Shuffle, and God Hand for moments when you are stuck instead of using them right away.
On the village map, spend stars on the builds and upgrades that matter most to you, and drag around the map to see what is available before you tap to build.
faq: What is the goal in Hexa Tower?
Drag hexagon stacks onto the board and fill the goal bar before the board runs out of space. A tall enough stack clears when it is complete.
How does scoring work in Hexa Number?
You drag across neighboring number tiles so their sum equals the goal. Longer chains score more, so look for longer chains when the board allows it.

car-parking-driving-game.intro: Car Parking Driving Game is a racing and parking game where you steer realistic vehicles through city streets and parking lots. Each level asks you to park accurately before the timer runs out.
tips: Ease off the accelerate key before you reach the target spot, since smooth, slow approaches are easier to line up than fast ones.
Use the brake key early rather than at the last second so the car stops where you want it.
Check the look back key and camera change before reversing into a space, so you can see how close the obstacles are on each side.
Steer in short taps instead of holding the turn keys, because large turns can swing the back of the car into obstacles.
Keep an eye on the clock and avoid rushing in the early part of a level, since a clean, controlled park matters more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to park your vehicle in the right spot before time runs out while avoiding obstacles along the way.
Which keys control the car?
W or the up arrow accelerates, A or the left arrow turns left, D or the right arrow turns right, and S or the down arrow brakes. B looks back and C changes the camera view.

super-oliver-world.intro: Super Oliver World is a retro pixel platformer where you guide Oliver through trap-filled realms. Smash blocks, collect coins, and find hidden power-ups to get past the foes.
tips: Hit blocks when you are unsure what is inside, since they can hold surprises that help you move forward.
Watch how enemies move for a few seconds before you approach, so you can time your moves instead of rushing in.
Collect coins as you go, but do not chase them into danger if a trap or foe is waiting nearby.
Look for hidden power-ups in places that seem out of the way, especially near spots where you feel stuck.
When a section feels too hard, slow down and plan the route ahead before trying again.
faq: What is the goal of Super Oliver World?
Guide Oliver through perilous realms filled with traps and foes. Use blocks, coins, and power-ups to get past the challenges.
How do I get power-ups?
Smash blocks for surprises and look for hidden power-ups. Some are not obvious, so check areas that seem out of reach or out of the way.

grid-hole-master.intro: Grid Hole Master is a block puzzle on a 10×10 board where gravity changes direction every set of pieces. Clear lines directly or set off chain clears as blocks fall toward the glowing wall.
tips: Before each placement, check which way gravity will pull the blocks next. Leave space where the falling blocks are likely to land and complete new lines.
Fill a row or column that is already nearly full first, since clearing it makes the blocks above or beside it fall into place.
Watch the faces on the blocks. When they look nervous, space is running out, so switch to safer placements that keep the board open.
Save Undo for a bad placement, and use Bomb or Rotate when a piece won't fit cleanly. Boosters are most useful when they rescue a run.
Read the level goals at the top of the screen before you start. Playing toward gems, ice, score or lines changes which clears matter most.
faq: What is the goal of Grid Hole Master?
Each level has goals shown at the top, such as collecting gems, cracking ice, reaching a score or clearing lines. Complete them to win the level.
How does gravity work in this game?
Gravity turns after every set of three pieces and can point down, left, up or right. After a clear, the remaining blocks fall toward the glowing wall in that direction.

capy-market.intro: Capy Market is an arcade management game where you run a small supermarket as a capybara. You harvest crops, stock shelves, collect cash and grow your market across farm, beach and ski worlds.
tips: Keep your shelves stocked before customers run out of patience, since a waiting customer is a lost sale.
Spend early cash on fields and shelves first, because more production makes every later purchase easier to afford.
Hire a cashier and farmers once you can afford them, so your market keeps earning while you are busy elsewhere.
Upgrade your crate and speed at the office early, so you can carry more and move faster between fields and shelves.
Grab speed boots and cash suitcases when they appear, and watch for VIP shoppers who pay extra for their purchases.
faq: What is the main goal of Capy Market?
Grow your supermarket by harvesting crops, filling shelves and collecting cash, then use that money to expand. Finishing the Golden Capybara statue takes you on to the beach and ski worlds.
How do I move my capybara?
Use WASD, ZQSD or the arrow keys, or click and drag. On mobile, drag anywhere on the screen.

lorin-adventure.intro: Lorin Adventure is an action RPG built around combo attacks as you fight through a quest to defeat the demon king Chaos and his three demons. Weapons, armor, boss hunting, and artifacts shape how your hero grows stronger.
tips: Learn the rhythm of your combo attacks early, since the game is built around chaining them together in fast battles.
Save materials for the blacksmith until you know which weapon you plan to keep, so your upgrades go to a weapon you will use for a long time.
Compare armor sets by the combat stats they boost and pick the set that fits how you fight rather than switching often.
Hunt boss monsters when you are ready for them, since collecting them is part of growing your champion.
Check your artifacts when you find them, because they can dramatically change how your adventure plays, so pick the ones that support your style.
faq: How do I move and attack on desktop?
Use the Left and Right arrow keys or A and D to move, or click the on-screen left and right buttons. Attacks are part of the same controls, so tap or click the buttons to fight.
How do I attack on a touchscreen?
Tap the left and right on-screen buttons to move and attack. Keep your taps steady to chain combos during battles.

obby-sail-for-egg.intro: Obby Sail for Egg is a sailing adventure where you raid island nests for eggs, outrun a hunter ship, and hatch pets that earn money. Build up your boats and upgrades as you go.
tips: Save your boat-buying money for speed upgrades early, since getting home fast matters as much as grabbing the egg.
Watch the hunter ship before you commit to the trip back. Try to keep your distance from it rather than racing past it at close range.
Eggs from farther islands are rarer, so plan a route that lets you reach distant nests and still have a clear path home.
If you need cash fast, the booster pads near spawn offer x2 Speed or x2 Money for a short video, so use them when you are about to make a run.
Use the mouse to look around while walking to the harbour, and press Tab if the cursor gets stuck so you can get back to the controls quickly.
faq: How do I start sailing my boat?
Walk to the harbour and press E to board your boat. Then use W and S for throttle and A and D to steer.
What do I have to do to earn money?
Steal an egg from an island nest, sail it back home, and place it on your farm to hatch. The hatched pet earns money over time.

brain-test-iq-challenge.intro: Brain Test: IQ Challenge is a single-player puzzle game built around logic. You solve pattern, odd-one-out and sequence puzzles using mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Look for the rule before you touch anything. Check how the shapes or numbers change from one step to the next.
When you see a sequence, compare each item with the one before it, then with the one after it, to spot what is repeating or growing.
In odd-one-out puzzles, list the features each option shares first. The item that breaks the shared pattern is usually the answer.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and come back with fresh eyes. Patterns often become clearer after a short break.
Keep your clicks deliberate. Move the pointer or tap slowly enough to be sure of each choice before you commit.
faq: What is the goal of Brain Test: IQ Challenge?
The goal is to solve logic puzzles, including pattern recognition, odd-one-out challenges and sequence puzzles. Each puzzle tests how well you spot the underlying rule.
How do I control the game?
Use the mouse to click and move, or tap the screen if you are on a mobile device.

battle-simulator-stickman-zombie.intro: Battle Simulator Stickman Zombie puts you in charge of a stickman warrior who must survive waves of zombies in 3D fights. This guide covers practical habits to help you last longer.
tips: Keep your distance when a horde closes in, and avoid getting surrounded by moving toward open space rather than standing your ground.
Spend upgrades on the weapon you use most often, since one well-developed weapon usually helps more than several weak ones.
Watch how zombies approach before committing to an attack so you can pick the moment when you are least exposed.
Change your position between clashes instead of staying in one spot, because a stationary warrior is easy for a crowd to trap.
Treat each fight as a chance to reset your plan: check your health and your nearby threats before you move on to the next group.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You command a stickman warrior and must survive relentless zombie hordes while fighting to save humanity. Staying alive through each clash is the core objective.
Does the game explain its controls?
The game description and instructions do not list specific controls, so check any on-screen prompts or hints in the game for how to move and attack.

wild-camp.intro: Wild Camp is a survival and village-building adventure. You gather materials in the forest, build your camp, and recruit helpers with the help of a witch.
tips: Gather wood and stone from nearby trees and rocks first, since you need materials before you can build anything.
Stand on a build spot to place your structures, and plan your camp so work areas are close together.
Keep the fire burning before night falls, because wolves come after dark and the fire is your main defense.
Feed the witch when you can, since she is the one who makes it possible to summon new villagers.
Save up for the night summon: step into the witch's magic circle after dark, and try to have a useful job ready for each villager you bring in.
faq: What is the main goal of Wild Camp?
You survive in the forest and grow a village by chopping trees, building a camp and summoning villagers. The game focuses on keeping your camp running from day to night.
How do I get new villagers?
Feed the witch, then stand inside her magic circle at night to summon a new villager. Villagers help you work and fight.

patchwise.intro: Patchwise is a calm logic puzzle inspired by bojagi, Korean cloth sewing. Fill each empty cloth with the patches in the tray, using every patch exactly once. Each world adds a new rule.
tips: Before you sew anything, check the rule of the current world, such as knots, seams or grain, since it decides which placements are allowed.
Start with the most constrained spots, like a knot with a small number or a corner with a clear count, because they limit the options around them.
Use the largest patches early, since they are the hardest to place once the cloth has many small gaps.
Patches can be turned and flipped unless they are printed, so try rotating a patch in your head before you give up on a spot.
If you get stuck, step back with UNDO rather than using a hint, because finishing a cloth without hints earns the second star.
faq: What is the goal of Patchwise?
Fill the whole cloth on each board so that every patch in the tray is used exactly once. There is no timer, so you can take your time.
Can I undo a mistake?
Yes. UNDO takes back your last move, and RESET clears the whole board if you want to start over.

stickman-archero-fight.intro: Stickman Archero Fight is a 2D fighting action game where you hold off enemies in changing environments. Objects around you can be used as weapons, so watch your surroundings as closely as your opponents.
tips: Look at the arena before engaging. Note which objects nearby could work as weapons so you can use them quickly.
Don't rush into every fight. Space out your attacks and wait for openings, since the description stresses strategic combat over button mashing.
Grab power-ups when you can do it without taking a big risk. They can change the balance of a tough fight.
Pay attention to how each environment changes the challenge. Adjust your approach to the terrain instead of using the same tactic everywhere.
If you get overwhelmed, step back and reassess the enemies in front of you before you commit to the next move.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Archero Fight?
You fight off enemies across challenging environments and try to survive the chaos while becoming a stronger stickman warrior.
Can I really use any object as a weapon?
Yes, the game is built around the idea that nearly every object in the world can be used to fight your enemies.

cyber-truck-drive-simulator.intro: Cyber Truck Drive Simulator is a 3D racing game where you drive a truck across a map, collecting flags before time runs out. Your car takes damage, so careful driving matters as much as speed.
tips: Plan a route through the flags before you start moving so you do not waste time backtracking.
Slow down before tight turns and obstacles, since keeping damage low is part of the goal.
Use the brake with Space early when approaching a corner instead of braking at the last second.
Switch camera angles with the C key to see the road ahead and judge distances to flags more easily.
Keep an eye on the clock and be willing to skip a distant flag if it would put the timer at risk.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Collect the flags on the map before time runs out, while keeping damage to your car as low as possible.
Which keys control the truck?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to drive, Space to brake, and C to change camera angles.

pearl-paws.intro: Pearl Paws is a cozy arcade game about running a beach shop with animal friends. You stock shelves, serve customers, and grow the shop into a larger resort.
tips: Pick up goods from the crates and carry them to the shelves early on, since stocked shelves are what keep the shop running.
Keep an eye on the register and collect the cash piles as soon as customers pay, so your money goes toward new shelves and stalls.
Spend your earnings on upgrades and new areas one at a time, so each purchase builds on the last instead of spreading cash too thin.
Watch for sneaky raccoon thieves and run into them to catch them before they get away with your goods.
Work through the daily quests as you go, because they point you toward collecting pearls and growing the resort.
faq: What is the main goal in Pearl Paws?
The goal is to grow a small beach shop into a full beach resort by stocking shelves, serving customers and spending money on new stalls, areas and upgrades.
How do I move my character and interact with things?
Use WASD or the arrow keys, or drag with the mouse. Walk onto a dashed pad to build or buy, and run into raccoon thieves to catch them.

slime-assembly-endless.intro: Slime Assembly Endless is an element-themed survival roguelike where you fight endless waves of monsters across multiple themed chapters. Expect fast progression, constant chaos, and frequent upgrades.
tips: Start by clicking and dragging to get a feel for how your slime responds before the first wave arrives.
Pay attention to each upgrade you receive and choose ones that fit the element you are playing with, so your build stays focused.
Stay mobile during fights. Endless waves can close in quickly, so avoid getting pinned in one spot.
Take a moment between waves to check your current upgrades and plan which ones you want next.
Each chapter has its own theme, so adjust your approach when you move to a new one rather than repeating the same tactics.
faq: What is the goal of Slime Assembly Endless?
The goal is to survive endless waves of monsters while building up your slime through upgrades. Each run continues until you are defeated.
How do I control my slime?
The game is played by clicking and dragging. Use this input to move and act as the waves come in.

chasinghunters.intro: ChasingHunters is an arcade shooter where you play as a bounty hunter tracking outlaws across the Old West. Your sharpshooting and upgraded weapons decide how well you handle increasingly dangerous foes.
tips: Look for explosive opportunities in the scene, since the game points them out as a way to beat stronger enemies.
Spend upgrades on the weapons that suit how you shoot, so your arsenal grows in a direction you can rely on.
Take careful aim rather than firing wildly, because your sharpshooting is the core skill this game tests.
Keep an eye on where the outlaws are heading so you stay on their trail in this fast-paced world.
Expect foes to get tougher over time, and adjust your approach each time a new threat appears.
faq: What is the goal of ChasingHunters?
You play as a bounty hunter tracking down ruthless outlaws and bringing justice to the Old West.
How do I get stronger during a run?
You can upgrade your arsenal, so use your upgrades to improve the weapons you rely on most.

subway-surfers-in-berlin.intro: Subway Surfers Berlin is a 3D running game where you guide your hero as far as possible while overcoming obstacles and dodging. It is played with the arrow keys and the space bar.
tips: Look ahead to spot obstacles early, so you have time to switch direction before you reach them.
Dodge with small, quick arrow key taps rather than holding keys down, which makes it easier to react to the next obstacle.
Use the space bar to activate the skate at a time when it will help you get past an obstacle, rather than pressing it at random.
Jump only when you need to clear an obstacle, since landing badly can leave you in a bad spot for the next one.
Try to stay calm and keep your focus on the path ahead, because the longer you run, the more important steady timing becomes.
faq: What is the goal of Subway Surfers Berlin?
The goal is to run as far as possible while overcoming obstacles and dodging them. Your distance is your main measure of progress.
Which keys control the game?
Movement is controlled with the arrow keys, and the space bar activates the skate. Both are used on a computer keyboard.

pixel-gun-apocalypse-9.intro: Pixel Gun Apocalypse 9 is a blocky shooter with multiplayer battles and offline zombie missions. Matches are fast, with many guns, zombie waves, and colorful maps to play on.
tips: Try several of the many guns early on to find the one that suits how you like to fight.
In zombie waves, keep moving rather than standing still so you are not surrounded.
Use the colorful maps to learn where cover and open lanes are before the action picks up.
Since controls are simple, focus on timing your shots instead of rushing them.
If a match feels chaotic, take a breath and reposition before you commit to a fight.
faq: How do I control the game?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, and the controls are designed to be simple.
Can I play with friends?
Yes, you can play multiplayer battles with friends, or play the offline zombie missions on your own.

reaper-s-graveyard-shift.intro: Reaper's Graveyard Shift is a cosy 3D idle management game where you run a spooky graveyard as the Grim Reaper. You chop trees, build coffins, bury ghosts and grow your plot into a full cemetery.
tips: Keep moving between tasks so ghosts do not run out of patience before you bury them.
Walk over items to pick them up, then carry them to the right build or burial spot without wasting trips.
Spend early earnings on upgrades that speed up chopping or coffin building, since faster work pays off throughout the game.
Hire skeleton crew members as soon as you can afford them, because automated work keeps the graveyard running while you handle other jobs.
Check the menu with P now and then to review your progress and plan which expansion to tackle next.
faq: What is the main goal of Reaper's Graveyard Shift?
Your goal is to run a spooky graveyard as the Grim Reaper, growing it from one plot into a full cemetery by chopping trees, building coffins and burying ghosts.
How do I move my Grim Reaper?
On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys. On mobile, drag anywhere on the screen to move.

swipy-basketball.intro: Swipy Basketball is a sports game where you swipe to shoot baskets. Timing and trajectory matter, because the hoops keep moving and each made basket adds to your high score.
tips: Watch the hoop for a few moments before your first swipe, so you can judge how it is moving.
Focus on timing as much as power. Release your swipe when the hoop lines up with your shot path, not as soon as it appears.
Pay attention to the arc of your shot. Small changes in swipe direction can change where the ball lands, so adjust gradually instead of making big swings.
Stay relaxed and keep your reactions quick. Since the hoops shift unpredictably, a calm, steady rhythm usually works better than rushing.
After each basket, reset your focus for the next shot. Consistent scoring builds your high score faster than trying to make one risky shot.
faq: What is the main goal of Swipy Basketball?
The goal is to score baskets by swiping, and each basket adds to your high score. The challenge comes from the moving hoops.
How do I aim my shots?
You aim by swiping, so the direction and strength of your swipe set the trajectory of the ball. Practice a few shots to learn how your swipes travel.

vangers-hd.intro: Vangers HD is a vehicle combat game set on an alien landscape. You fight in explosive battles, upgrade your vehicle, and complete missions for rewards.
tips: Treat each mission as a source of rewards, and check what you earn before choosing your next task.
Spend upgrades on the abilities you use most in battle, so your vehicle fits the way you actually fight.
Look at your vehicle's capabilities after each upgrade and note what changed before you head into the next fight.
Explore the alien landscape before committing to a fight, so you know where threats and useful routes are.
Pick your battles carefully, since gripping fights can drain your resources and vehicle condition over time.
faq: What is the main goal in Vangers HD?
The game centers on completing missions for rewards while battling in your vehicle and upgrading it along the way. Progress comes from combining these activities.
How do I improve my vehicle?
You enhance your vehicle's capabilities through upgrades, which you can use to strengthen it for combat and missions. Choose upgrades that match your playstyle.

ladybug-jigsaw-puzzle-collection.intro: Restore the photo album pictures of Lady Bug and Super Cat by solving a collection of 12 jigsaw puzzles. The game is played with the mouse.
tips: Finish each puzzle before moving on, since you unlock the next ones by collecting the earlier puzzles one by one.
Start with the edges and corners of the picture to build a frame, then fill in the middle.
Sort pieces by color, such as the red of Lady Bug's suit or the dark tones of the night scenes, to find matches faster.
Work on one area of the picture at a time so you do not lose track of where pieces belong.
Take short breaks between puzzles to keep your focus when a picture has many similar-looking pieces.
faq: How do I unlock the other puzzles?
You unlock the rest of the puzzles by collecting the puzzles in the game one by one. Complete the first picture to start the next.
How many puzzles are in the collection?
The collection has 12 puzzles, all showing the heroine Lady Bug and her partner Super Cat.

pencil-jam.intro: Pencil Jam is a relaxed colorful puzzle where you sort pencil-shaped pieces by color. Each solved puzzle fills in a bright picture as you play.
tips: Look at the picture you are building before you start, so you know which areas need which colors.
Work toward groups of three pencils in the same color, since that is how the pieces sort and merge.
There is no timer, so take a moment to scan the whole board before each tap.
Play in short sessions if you like. Each finished picture is a good place to stop and come back later.
If a move does not seem to help, look for another color group that is closer to completing.
faq: What is the goal of Pencil Jam?
Sort three pencil-shaped pieces of the same color so they merge and help fill in a full picture.
How do I control the pieces?
Tap the hexagons to move them, and watch them merge into place as you build the picture.

zombie-catchers.intro: Zombie Catchers is a one-player action adventure where you hunt down zombies across a world overrun by an invasion. Catch zombies, collect coins, and finish missions to unlock upgrades.
tips: Focus on catching zombies early so you have a steady flow of coins to spend.
Read each mission before you start and plan your route so you can complete objectives without backtracking.
Spend your coins on upgrades that address your biggest problem, whether that is speed, reach, or capacity.
Keep an eye on your surroundings while chasing one zombie, since others may approach from the side.
Use the keyboard and mouse for precise aiming, or switch to touch buttons if you prefer quick, simple inputs.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Catchers?
Catch all the zombies and help save the planet Earth by working through the game's missions.
How do I earn coins?
Coins are collected during play, and completing missions also helps you build up your supply for unlocking upgrades.

popcorn-race-3d.intro: Popcorn Race 3D is an arcade runner where you play a corn kernel racing against the clock. You move through tracks, collect kernels, and turn them into popcorn explosions with dynamic machines.
tips: Keep your eyes on the track a few steps ahead rather than on your kernel, so you can react before obstacles or turns arrive.
Watch the timer as you go. Racing against time rewards steady progress more than rushing into a risky section.
Pay attention to how the dynamic machines behave before you commit to them, since timing matters more than speed.
Treat each new level as a fresh layout and adjust your approach instead of repeating the same moves from the last track.
Practice short stretches of a level to build your reflexes, then combine them into a full run once they feel reliable.
faq: What is the main goal of Popcorn Race 3D?
You race against time through tracks, collecting kernels and turning them into popcorn explosions with the help of dynamic machines.
Does the game get harder as you progress?
The game moves through diverse levels, so each one asks you to adapt your reflexes and strategy to a new track layout.

pondhero.intro: PondHero is a memory puzzle where you study a safe path across the pond, then guide the little frog along the same route after it disappears. One wrong move means you start the attempt again.
tips: Study the whole path before it vanishes, and note its turns and direction changes rather than trying to memorize every single square.
Break longer paths into short chunks, such as three or four steps at a time, and link each chunk to a simple pattern.
Look for landmarks in the pond scenery to help you remember where the path bends.
Stay calm and deliberate with each click, since one wrong move sends you back to the start of the attempt.
Expect paths to get longer and trickier as you advance, so take your time on early levels to build a steady routine.
faq: What is the goal of PondHero?
Your goal is to guide the frog along the exact safe path you saw earlier, using only your memory. Reach the end of each path to move on.
What happens if I click the wrong square?
One wrong move ends the attempt, and you have to try the level again from the beginning.

draft-arena-battle-cards.intro: Draft Arena is a short strategy auto battler where you pick cards each round to build an army that fights on its own. Your choices and the timing of your bomb or lightning decide the battle.
tips: Look at all three cards before you pick. Think about which mix of fighters works well together rather than grabbing the first option.
Keep an eye on what the rival army is made of, and pick cards that counter it when you can.
Save your bomb or lightning for a moment when the armies are clashing, so it hits the most enemies or turns a close fight in your favour.
Upgrade your fighters to stronger ranks when you can afford it, since a few high-rank units often matter more than many weak ones.
Matches are short, so play one at a time and review what worked after each win or loss to get better at reading the battle.
faq: What is the goal of Draft Arena: Battle Cards?
Win matches by building a stronger army than your rival. Winning moves you along the Victory Road and unlocks new fighters.
How do I control my army?
You do not control the fighting directly. Each round you click or tap one of three cards to add fighters, then watch the armies battle on their own.

hlbina.intro: Hlbina is a push-your-luck fishing game where you lower your hook into deeper water for bigger catches. The longer you stay down, the more risk your line carries.
tips: Deeper fish are worth more, but every fish on the line adds strain. Decide how many bites you can handle before heading back up.
Rise before your line snaps, because a snapped line loses everything on it. Going up is what keeps your catch safe.
When a fish bites, watch the line colour and tap only while it is green. Tapping on red is the fastest way to lose the fight.
Sell your catch at the Market early so you can reinvest in stronger lines and hooks before diving deeper.
Check the Weather Station and the time of day before you dive, since weather, time and the moon change which fish bite in each zone.
faq: What is the main goal of Hlbina?
Catch fish, sell them at the Market to rebuild your village, and then hunt the legendary creatures of the deep.
How do I keep my catch safe?
Go UP before your line snaps. Everything you have caught is safe once you rise, but a snapped line loses the fish on it.

galactic-pixel-storm.intro: Galactic Pixel Storm is an arcade space shooter where you fight through pixel art arenas, firing explosive rockets at foes and upgrading your ship as you go.
tips: Spend upgrades on the ship as soon as you can afford them, since a stronger ship makes later arenas much easier to survive.
Pick up power-ups when it is safe to do so, and keep an eye on which ones you are carrying so you know when they are running low.
Rockets deal damage in an area, so aim for clusters of foes rather than single targets to clear the screen faster.
Move between arenas with purpose: stay mobile and avoid lingering in one spot where enemies can focus fire on you.
Use a short pause between waves to check your upgrades and plan which ones matter most for the next fight.
faq: What is the goal of Galactic Pixel Storm?
The goal is to battle through the pixel art arenas, destroy the foes with explosive rockets, and keep your spaceship alive as the battles get harder.
What controls does the game use?
The description and instructions do not list the controls, so check any on-screen prompts or the start menu when you begin playing.

cloudburg-sky-farm.intro: Cloudburg: Sky Farm is a cozy clicker where you tap crops, harvest coins, and grow a floating island over time. Goose mayor Gosha comments on everything you build.
tips: Tap growing crops early, since tapping them makes them grow faster and fills the tempo meter.
Keep an eye on ripe crops and harvest them regularly, because that is where your coins come from.
Spend coins on beds and buildings first so you can keep expanding the island quarter by quarter.
Watch for falling stars, gift balloons and leaping fish, which give extra rewards when you tap them.
Tap seagulls as soon as they show up so they are scared off before they become a nuisance on your farm.
faq: What is the main goal in Cloudburg: Sky Farm?
Your goal is to grow the floating island by spending coins on beds, buildings and upgrades, one quarter at a time.
How do I move around the island on a computer?
Drag with the mouse or use the WASD keys to move, and use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out.

idle-noob-lumberjack.intro: Idle Noob Lumberjack is a relaxed, blocky adventure about gathering resources, growing your island, and managing a team of workers. Progress builds over time as your operation expands.
tips: Keep gathering resources steadily, since the description ties your progress directly to how much you collect.
Think about whether each investment will help your operation grow faster before you spend what you have.
Expand your island in stages so you can keep track of what each new part of the island is contributing.
Check your team regularly as it grows, and make sure your workers are still matched to the work you need done.
Unlock new areas as soon as you can afford them, because each new area opens more ways to grow.
faq: What is the main goal of Idle Noob Lumberjack?
The goal is to gather resources, expand your island, unlock new areas, and grow a team of workers into a thriving operation.
How do I make progress faster?
Keep resources flowing in and spend them on investments that expand your operation, since the game rewards collecting more over time.

tavern-cardsharp.intro: Tavern Cardsharp is a pixel card duel against tavern rivals. You bet coins, fight across the table, and take the rival's whole deck if you win. Build a deck, pick the right table, and climb the ladder.
tips: Watch the rival's face before you commit. A smirk is a hint that they are holding a strong card.
Think about where you place each creature. Some cards get stronger next to allies, while others do better standing alone.
Remember that your bet is your life. Every hit on the rival's portrait takes coins from your pile, so attack creatures first when the board is crowded.
Choose a table that suits your deck instead of always going for the highest bet. Matching the table to your strategy makes wins more consistent.
Use the tutorial with the innkeeper to learn how each affix and class works before you risk a big bet.
faq: How do I win a duel?
Empty the rival's pile of coins to win the duel. You also take their whole deck.
What happens if I lose?
If you lose, you hand over your own deck, so think carefully about which bets you accept.

pinball-football-kids.intro: Pinball Football Kids is a pinball-style football game made easier for kids. You shoot the ball around the pins and try to score goals with your limited chances.
tips: Count your chances before each shot, since you only get a limited number. Plan each one instead of rushing.
Aim for a goal rather than a random bounce. Shooting wisely is the main way to score.
Watch how the ball moves around the pins and players before you shoot. Good timing can set up a clean path to the goal.
If a shot does not go in, note where the ball bounced and adjust your next attempt. Learning the pin layout helps you score more goals.
Keep your focus on scoring goals, because that is how you win. Avoid spending chances on shots that are unlikely to reach the goal.
faq: What is the goal of Pinball Football Kids?
The goal is to score goals so you can win the game. You need to shoot the ball wisely to get it into the goal.
How do I win the game?
You win by scoring goals before your limited chances run out. Each shot should aim toward the goal.

mad-day-special.intro: Mad Day Special mixes car racing with alien shooting. You drive up hills and through walls, then switch to running on foot with a shotgun to fight the invaders.
tips: Use Space to jump over obstacles and keep your momentum when climbing hills, since landing well keeps your car moving forward.
Save your rockets for dangerous moments, such as when several aliens or lasers are ahead, rather than firing them constantly.
Look for walls you can smash through instead of driving around them, because a straight line is often faster.
Spend upgrades on the part that suits your play style, whether that is the car, guns, or armor, rather than spreading them thin.
When you move on foot with the shotgun, stay close to enemies so your shots land reliably.
faq: What is the goal of Mad Day Special?
You battle the alien invasion of Earth to rescue your pet Octopus Fluffy and escape. You do this by racing, shooting, and smashing your way forward.
What do the controls do?
Space makes you jump. The instructions list rockets under the X key and the Up Arrow key.

trick-or-treat-candy-carnival.intro: Trick Or Treat Candy Carnival is a Halloween puzzle collection with seven mini-games set at a moonlit carnival. Pick gentle play or a challenge and collect candy as you go.
tips: Start on gentle play to learn how each of the seven games works before switching to challenge.
In the candy catching game, keep your basket moving early so you are already under the next falling candy instead of chasing it.
For jigsaw puzzles, begin with the 4-piece or 9-piece versions to get a feel for the shapes, then move up to 16 or 25 pieces.
In the matching pairs and monster face games, note where cards or faces appear as you go rather than guessing at random.
Spread your play across all seven games, since candy you collect helps you unlock the four baskets and fill your collection of 24 friends.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You play seven mini-games at a Halloween carnival, collect candy, unlock baskets and fill your collection of 24 cartoon friends.
How do I move the basket on desktop?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to move the basket and menu cursor, or drag the basket with the mouse.

deep-mine-1-strength.intro: Deep Mine: +1 Strength is a 3D clicker where you dig a shaft downward, one layer at a time. Each hit builds strength, and deeper rock becomes tougher but pays more ore.
tips: Keep holding the hit button on a block instead of tapping, since holding keeps the swings going without extra clicks.
Clear each layer fully before moving on, so you do not leave tough blocks behind that slow your progress later.
Spend your coins on pickaxes when you can, because a stronger tool gets you through deeper rock faster.
Use the lift to return to town when you have coins to spend, and go back down to the bottom of your shaft to keep digging.
Use the camera controls to check the blocks around you before swinging, so you can see which layer and which block you are working on.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You dig down through the mine layer by layer, building strength with every hit and clearing blocks to go deeper.
How do I hit a block?
On PC, left-click the block under the cursor. On phone, tap the block or use the hit button on the right side of the screen.

candy-match-saga-2.intro: Candy Match Saga 2 is a match-3 puzzle game where you swap colorful candies to make matches. You work through puzzles, obstacles, and levels, using power-ups and chasing high scores.
tips: Before each swap, check whether it creates a match right away, and look for moves that set up a second match.
Save power-ups for puzzles that look difficult, such as ones with many obstacles, rather than using them on easy moves.
Pay attention to the obstacles on each board and clear them when you can, since they often block your progress.
Try to plan a few moves ahead instead of making the first match you see, especially when a level is close to its goal.
If you are going for a high score, try to build longer chains of matches, since a single large move can score more than several small ones.
faq: What is the goal of Candy Match Saga 2?
You solve candy puzzles by swapping and matching colorful candies, while overcoming obstacles to unlock new levels.
How do power-ups help?
Explosive power-ups can clear larger parts of the board, which is useful when a level feels crowded or stuck.

collect-leaves-faster-than-anyone.intro: A 3D race where you vacuum up leaves, use them to build a bridge to the next island, and try to reach the finish before your rivals. Pick a game mode and start a match.
tips: Read the on-screen hints early in your first match, since they point out what to do next.
Keep collecting leaves while you move, so you always have enough to finish building the bridge without stopping.
Save your power-ups for moments when you are close to rivals or about to cross a bridge, so they make the biggest difference.
Check the game menu between matches and pick upgrades that help the part of the race you struggle with most.
Try different game modes to see which pace and style suit you best before you commit to one approach.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Collect leaves, build a bridge to the next island, and reach the finish before your rivals do.
What do I use to collect leaves?
You collect leaves with a vacuum cleaner, and the leaves go into your bag.

alpha-guns.intro: Alpha Guns is a shooter where you play as Max, upgrading your arsenal to outsmart tough enemies. Each level rewards sharp aim and careful tactics.
tips: Upgrade your weapons as you go, and pick the upgrades that match how you like to fight.
Slow down and aim before you fire, since the levels are built around sharp aim.
Look at the layout of each level before you commit, and plan how you will deal with the enemies.
Replay earlier missions to test different approaches, which is the game's suggested way to refine your strategy.
If a level keeps beating you, change your approach instead of repeating the same moves.
faq: What is the main goal in Alpha Guns?
You play as Max, upgrade your arsenal, and outsmart challenging foes through intense levels that demand sharp aim and tactical thinking.
How can I get better at the harder levels?
Replay past missions to perfect your strategy. Repeating a mission lets you try different tactics and improve your aim.

stickman-simulator-final-battle.intro: Stickman Simulator: Final Battle!! is a 3D fighting game about choosing your troops and winning battles across several levels. You play entirely with the mouse, so the focus is on quick, careful clicks.
tips: Pick your troops with your victory goal in mind, since the game is built around choosing your army before the battle.
Watch the battlefield for a few seconds before acting so you can see where your troops are and where the enemy is coming from.
Because the game is played only with the mouse, keep your hand steady and make deliberate clicks rather than rapid, random ones.
Try each level to learn how the 3D battlefield is laid out, then adjust your troop choices for the next attempt.
Keep the tab-style gameplay in mind and move between sections in a steady rhythm so you do not fall behind during the fight.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Simulator: Final Battle!!?
The goal is to choose your troops and claim victory on the battlefield across its 3D levels.
How do I control the game?
The instructions say to use only the mouse, so every action in the game is done by clicking or moving the mouse.

santa-wood-cutter.intro: Santa Wood Cutter is an arcade skill game where you chop firewood with an axe while dodging branches. The pace rises over time, so timing and rhythm matter more as you go.
tips: Watch the branches closely before each chop so you know which ones you need to avoid.
Keep a steady rhythm rather than swinging as fast as possible, since the pace increases and rushed moves are easy to mistime.
Focus on the next obstacle instead of the one you just passed, so your reactions stay ahead of the action.
Stay calm when the speed picks up. Short, controlled reactions usually work better than big, panicked movements.
Treat each round as practice. Noticing which patterns cause your mistakes will help you improve on the next try.
faq: What is the main goal of Santa Wood Cutter?
The goal is to collect as much firewood as possible by chopping wood while avoiding tricky branches.
What makes the game harder as you play?
The pace intensifies over time, so you need to keep your rhythm and react faster to stay on track.

doodle-guard-draw-to-save.intro: Doodle Guard is a physics drawing puzzle where you protect a cartoon hero from falling hazards. Draw one line, let it become a real object, and keep the hero safe until the timer ends.
tips: Match your shape to the threat: a dome over the hero stops bees and balloons, while a wall stops cannon tomatoes.
Watch which hazard is coming first and draw your line before it reaches the hero, since the line becomes a physical object as soon as you release.
Keep lines short where you can, because using less ink is what earns more stars.
Look for open space above or beside the hero, since you cannot draw through the ground or the hero.
If a line does not work out, press R to restart the level and try a different approach.
faq: How do I earn three stars?
Use less ink to complete the level. Fewer ink strokes give you more stars, so plan a line that does the job without extra length.
What shape should I draw to stop the bees?
A dome over the hero stops both bees and water balloons. Draw the dome before the bees reach the hero.
