In Adventure, count your remaining moves against the level goal and favor placements that move you toward it.
faq: How do I complete an Adventure level?
You must reach the level goal within the move limit, such as collecting gems, clearing blocks of one color, or reaching a score.
How does the game end?
The game ends when none of the three pieces at the bottom can fit anywhere on the board.

sortilege-magic-shop-sort.intro: Sortilege is a cozy sorting puzzle set in a magic shop. Move potions, candies, toys, flowers and books between shelves, match sets of three, and fill customer orders.
tips: Before each move, check which items sit at the front of every shelf, since only front items can be moved.
Aim to gather three identical items on the same shelf, because matches only count when all three are together there.
Keep a few free spots open on your shelves so you always have room to shift items around.
Look at what the customer orders first and plan toward that set, so one move can earn a tip and clear space at the same time.
Save the Wand, Broom, Hourglass and Extra Drawer for when you are truly stuck rather than using them early.
faq: What is the main goal of Sortilege: Magic Shop Sort?
Clear every shelf of items before you run out of moves. Making the sets that customers ask for also earns tips.
How do I move items?
Tap or drag an item from the front of one shelf to a free spot on another shelf. Both touch and mouse controls work.

pop-and-splat-squishy-merge.intro: Pop & Splat: Squishy Merge is a cozy bakery game about poking, squishing, and flinging bouncy jelly-like squishies. Collect coins, merge matching squishies into new ones, and fill customer orders.
tips: Tap squishies steadily to collect coins, and try quick tap streaks to set off the fiery jiggle frenzy.
Before merging, look for two matching squishies and drag one onto the other to reach the next tier.
Fling squishies at the ceiling or walls to make them stick, then use them to knock down other squishies mid-air for trickshots.
Check your bakery orders often so you can time your merges and flings to finish them and earn more coins.
Watch how each squishy sags and wobbles after a throw, since that shows where it will settle and helps you plan your next move.
faq: What is the goal of Pop & Splat: Squishy Merge?
The goal is to collect coins and discover new squishy characters by merging matching squishies into the next tier. Completing customer bakery orders also helps you build up your coins.
How do I collect coins?
Tap or poke squishies to collect coins. Fast taps send them into a happy, fiery jiggle frenzy and help you chain tap combos.

case-opener-case-clicker-simulator.intro: Case Opener is a clicker where each click reveals a Counter-Strike 2 skin. You can keep skins for your collection or sell them for profit as you build up your stock.
tips: Decide early whether you are collecting or selling, and stick to that plan so you don't lose track of what you're building toward.
Put your first upgrades toward luck and speed, since the game says both lead to bigger rewards.
Check in for your daily bonus every time you play, because it adds value without extra effort.
Compare the skins you pull against the ones you're keeping before selling, so you don't sell a piece you'd rather collect.
Take short breaks between sessions to keep your decisions sharp, especially when deciding what to sell.
faq: What is the main goal of Case Opener?
The main goal is to reveal Counter-Strike 2 skins with each click and grow your collection. You can also sell skins for profit.
How do I get bigger rewards?
The game says you can upgrade your luck and speed to earn bigger rewards. Focus on those upgrades as you progress.

the-panda-brother.intro: The Panda Brother is a puzzle game where two kung fu panda brothers challenge your right and left hands. The instructions say to click to play.
tips: Think of each hand as its own opponent, and warm up with slow, steady clicks before trying to go faster.
Keep your eyes on the panda brothers rather than your mouse or cursor so you can react to what they do.
If one hand keeps falling behind, pause for a moment and reset your rhythm instead of rushing the same pattern.
Take short breaks between rounds so your timing stays sharp and your clicks stay accurate.
Play several rounds in a row to learn the pattern of the challenge, since familiarity usually helps more than speed.
faq: What is the goal of The Panda Brother?
The description says the panda brothers come to challenge your right hand and left hand, so the aim is to meet that challenge as well as you can.
How do I control the game?
The instructions say to click to play, so clicking is the main way to take part.

obby-dig-to-the-center-of-the-earth.intro: Dig straight down through layers of earth to reach the center of the Earth. Break blocks, upgrade your drill, hatch pets, and climb the leaderboard against other diggers.
tips: Spend your currency on drill upgrades before you reach a new layer, since each layer gets stronger and needs powerful upgrades to pass through.
Hatch pets early, because they give loot bonuses and speed up your progress, which helps you collect currency faster.
Hold the left mouse button to gain power and interact with the blocks, and keep your drill working on the layer you are in.
Use the right mouse button on PC, or the sensor on mobile, to rotate the camera and check the area below before you dig further.
Check the leaderboard now and then to see how your digging speed compares, and use that to decide whether to focus on upgrades or pets.
faq: What is the goal of Obby: Dig to the Center of the Earth?
Your goal is to dig straight down by breaking blocks, get past each layer of earth, and reach the bottom. Going deeper also lets you compete on the leaderboard.
How do I control my character on PC?
Use WASD to move, the right mouse button to rotate the camera, and the left mouse button to gain power and interact with blocks.

farm-around.intro: Farm Around is a tractor tycoon game. You drive carts to gather resources, process them at your mill, and use your earnings to add, merge and upgrade tractors.
tips: Keep your cart moving between pickups and the mill, since releasing the drive control stops it and wastes time.
Spend early earnings on upgrades that raise speed or cargo capacity, because a faster or fuller cart brings in more per trip.
Plan your route so each run carries a full load, which makes every trip to the mill more profitable.
Look at which tractors you can merge before buying new ones, as merging creates stronger units that may be worth more than extra basic carts.
Expand your chain of tractors gradually and check that your mill can keep up with the extra resources you are gathering.
faq: How do I make my tractor move?
Hold the left mouse button or press anywhere on the field with touch to drive, then release to stop. Driving only happens while you hold.
How do I add, merge or upgrade my tractors?
Click or tap the buttons on screen to buy new carts, merge tractors together, or upgrade speed and carrying capacity.

baby-taylor-stomach-care.intro: Baby Taylor Stomach Care is a doctor-style game where you help Taylor feel better after she gets a stomachache from eating too much ice cream. You work with a nurse to treat her, and you play by clicking or tapping.
tips: Watch Taylor closely before you start treating her so you understand how she is feeling.
Follow the order of steps the game shows you, since each treatment step builds on the last one.
Pay attention to what the nurse is helping with so you know which tool or action to use next.
Try the dress-up and cleaning parts slowly, so you can enjoy the small details without rushing.
If you make a mistake, just try the step again; the game is designed to be played at your own pace.
faq: What is the goal of Baby Taylor Stomach Care?
The goal is to become a doctor and treat Taylor's stomachache with the help of a nurse. Taylor feels sick after eating ice cream, and you help her feel better.
How do I control the game?
You play by mouse click or tap. Click or tap on the items and actions on screen to move through each step.

millionaire-life.intro: Millionaire Life is a casual adventure where you start from humble beginnings and build up a lavish lifestyle. You buy flashy cars, mansions, and golden accessories using mouse clicks or taps and drags.
tips: Look at every menu and purchase option before you spend, so you can compare what each one unlocks.
Use drag to move and place objects, and check how each item looks in its new spot before you move on.
Unlock new items first, since the game rewards you for exploring what is available to buy and place.
Work through the tasks in order and finish one before starting another, so you do not lose track of your progress.
On mobile, tap to interact with items and swipe to collect or place them, and practice both to get comfortable with the controls.
faq: What is the goal of Millionaire Life?
The goal is to live lavishly, make bold choices, and rise from humble beginnings to the lifestyle you dream of. Unlocking items and upgrading your lifestyle moves you forward.
How do I buy items and upgrades?
On desktop, click buttons and purchase options with the mouse. On mobile, tap the items, buttons, or upgrade options you want.

paco-paco.intro: Paco Paco is an arcade maze game where you guide a hungry sphere through twisting 3D mazes, eating pellets while avoiding ghosts. Each new level gets harder as you go.
tips: Scan the whole maze before you move so you can spot where the ghosts are and plan a route that keeps you away from them.
Because the ghost patterns are unpredictable, avoid stopping in long corridors where you can get trapped with no way out.
Watch the ghosts for a few moments before committing to a path, and only move when you have a clear gap ahead.
Collect pellets in a steady pattern rather than chasing scattered ones into dangerous corners.
Use each completed level to learn how the maze layout and ghost movement work, since reflexes and timing matter more as the difficulty rises.
faq: What is the goal of Paco Paco?
Your goal is to guide Paco Paco through the 3D maze, eat the pellets, and escape without getting caught by the ghosts. Clearing the maze unlocks new levels.
Does the game get harder as I progress?
Yes, the game becomes more difficult with each new level, and the ghost patterns grow harder to predict. Quick reflexes and good timing help you keep up.

skill-driver-game.intro: Skill Driver Game is a racing game that tests your skills, reflexes, and strategy. You drive with the keyboard and click buttons with the mouse.
tips: Pick either WASD or the arrow keys and stick with it, so your hands always know where the controls are.
Make small, steady direction changes instead of sharp presses, which helps you keep control of the car.
Look ahead rather than at your car, so you can react to what is coming before you reach it.
Practice in short sessions to build your reflexes, and pay attention to which moves cost you the most.
Use the mouse for any on-screen buttons, and keep your other hand near the movement keys so you can respond quickly.
faq: What is the goal of Skill Driver Game?
The description says the game tests your skills, reflexes, and strategy in a racing setting. Focus on controlling your car well and reacting quickly to challenges as they come.
How do I move the car?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use the mouse to click any buttons on screen.

highway-car-racer.intro: Highway Car Racer is a fast-paced driving game where you race powerful cars along busy highways full of traffic and obstacles. Your reflexes and driving skills decide how far you get.
tips: Look ahead, not just at your car. Spotting traffic and obstacles early gives you time to move over calmly instead of making sharp last-second turns.
Use short, controlled side moves with A and D or the arrow keys. Small corrections keep you steady in heavy traffic better than big swerves.
Remember that your score and rewards rise the farther you drive. Staying alive on the highway matters more than taking risky shortcuts.
Use W and S, or the up and down arrows, to adjust your position as the traffic changes. Moving forward or back can help you find a gap.
Use the mouse to click any on-screen buttons, such as menus, so your hands stay on the keys for driving.
faq: How do I move my car?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right.
How do I increase my score?
Your score and rewards grow the farther you drive, so the longer you survive on the highway, the more you earn.

cut-art-master.intro: Cut Art Master is a puzzle-style slicing game where you guide a flying knife to collect fruit and level up. Your score grows with each clean slice, and the game is played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Watch where each fruit is heading before you commit to a cut, so your knife meets it at the right moment instead of chasing it.
Aim for steady, accurate slices rather than rapid clicking, since each successful slice is what moves your score forward.
Keep track of your progress as you level up and try to beat your previous score on each run to see how much you are improving.
If you miss a fruit, reset your focus quickly and look at the next one rather than dwelling on the miss.
Play in short sessions and take breaks, which helps you keep your timing sharp when you return.
faq: What is the goal of Cut Art Master?
The goal is to fly your knife through fruit to collect it, gradually level up, and push your score higher with each successful slice.
How do I control the knife?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. The game is controlled entirely with clicks or taps, so no other inputs are needed.

fish-rain.intro: Fish Rain is a fishing game that focuses on realistic angling across locations around the world. Success depends on watching carefully, choosing bait well, and changing your approach for each fish.
tips: Spend a little time watching before you act, since patient observation is central to this game's approach to fishing.
Try different bait choices rather than sticking with one, and notice which ones seem to work for the fish you are after.
Treat each fish as a separate challenge and adjust your tactics to its behavior instead of repeating the same method.
Stay patient after a missed catch and reassess your approach, since the game rewards strategy over rushing.
Pay attention to how each global location feels different, and let that guide what you try next.
faq: What is the main goal of Fish Rain?
The game asks you to build your fishing skills through observation, bait selection, and adapting tactics to each fish. Each catch is meant to test your mastery.
Does the game reward patience or speed?
Patience is emphasized. Watching carefully and planning your approach matter more than acting quickly.

my-sweet-candy-outfits.intro: Dress up the Rainbow High girls in candy-themed outfits for their weekend bash. Use point-and-click controls to mix colors and patterns and build sweet looks against a bright backdrop.
tips: Pick one main color or candy theme first, then add contrasting pieces so the outfit looks coordinated instead of crowded.
Try a bold pattern on one piece and keep the rest of the look simpler to avoid clashing colors.
Test a few combinations before settling on one, since the wardrobe offers many options that can look very different together.
Think about the weekend bash setting when choosing a look, and aim for a style that feels playful and fun for the occasion.
Work through each girl one at a time so you can focus on the details of each outfit before moving on.
faq: What is the goal of My Sweet Candy Outfits?
The goal is to style the Rainbow High girls in candy-themed outfits for their weekend bash. You create the looks yourself using the wardrobe options.
How do I change the outfits?
Use the point-and-click controls to select and place pieces. Clicking different items lets you mix colors and patterns until you are happy with the look.

domino-battle.intro: Domino Battle is a classic domino game where you race your opponent to play all your tiles first. You can choose between Draw and Block styles of play.
tips: Count the tiles still in play as the round goes on, so you know which numbers are likely to be blocked for your opponent.
Pay attention to which tile your opponent starts with, since the player with the higher tile on hand goes first.
Try to get rid of tiles quickly from the start, because the goal is to empty your hand before your opponent does.
If you prefer Draw, use the extra draws to find matching tiles rather than waiting on a block you cannot fill.
Remember that the game has several rounds, so do not worry too much about one lost round; the first player to reach 100 points wins.
faq: What is the goal of Domino Battle?
The goal is to play all of your tiles faster than your opponent. Each game has more than one round, and the first player to reach 100 points wins.
How does the game decide who goes first?
The player with the higher tile on their hand starts the round.

basement.intro: Guide the rubber monster through the Basement by clicking to jump. This one-player 2D clicker is built around chasing a high score, so every jump counts.
tips: Decide which side of the screen to click before you tap, so you can keep a steady rhythm instead of hesitating mid-run.
Use the small step for precise moves and save the big step for when you need to cover more distance quickly.
Keep your eyes on the monster rather than the edges of the screen, so you can judge the timing of each click.
Practice short sessions to learn how far each type of jump carries the monster before trying to beat your best score.
After a run, note where your jumps went wrong and adjust your timing next time to push the high score higher.
faq: What is the goal of Basement?
Your goal is to guide the rubber monster through the Basement and set as high a score as you can. The game is built around challenging the high score.
How do I control the monster?
Click on the side of the screen where the monster is to make a small jump. Click on the opposite side of the monster to make a big jump.

survive-the-disasters-obby.intro: Survive the Disasters: Obby is a hardcore obby survival game where floods, tsunamis, meteor showers, tornadoes and other disasters try to destroy you. Your goal is to survive while jumping and dodging through each map.
tips: Each round brings a new mix of disasters, so look at which hazards are active before you start moving. Plan your route around the ones that threaten you most.
Use your starting power-ups early in a round, since they are meant to give you an advantage when the disasters begin.
Keep your jumps and dodges short and controlled. Running too fast on obby sections makes it easy to fall off or get caught by a hazard.
Turn the camera often, by swiping on mobile or using your view controls, so you can see incoming meteors, floods or tornadoes before they reach you.
Invest in pets and rebirths over time. They are part of the progression system and can increase your power for later, harder rounds.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to survive all the disasters on each map. The game rewards you for staying alive while the hazards keep trying to destroy you.
How do I move and jump?
On a computer, use WASD to move and Space to jump. On mobile, use the joystick to move and the button in the lower right corner to jump.

3d-acrylic-nail-nail-art-game.intro: In this nail salon game you design acrylic nails for customers with unique requests. Pick colors, patterns, and charms to satisfy each order and earn money for salon upgrades.
tips: Read each customer's request carefully before you start, since every order has its own style they want.
Choose a base color first and then add patterns or charms, so the design stays clean and easy to match to the request.
Try different colors, patterns, and nail styles on the same customer to see which combination suits their request best.
Save some of the money you earn for salon upgrades, so you can improve your tools and decor over time.
Use the professional tools to add detail to nail art, and take your time with small accessories so the finished set looks polished.
faq: How do I earn money in this game?
You earn money by satisfying customers with the nail designs they ask for. Happy customers bring in income you can use to upgrade your salon.
What can I spend my money on?
You can spend money on new tools, decor, and accessories to upgrade your nail salon. Upgrades are a good way to make your work easier and more stylish.

feed-my-monster.intro: Feed My Monster is a colorful puzzle game where you feed and grow your monster. Collect food, avoid obstacles, and keep your monster happy and energized.
tips: Look at the whole screen before each move so you can spot food and obstacles at the same time.
Focus on collecting food, since feeding your monster is the core goal and keeps it energized.
Keep an eye on how happy and energized your monster looks, and adjust your play when either starts to drop.
Use the mouse to click buttons, and take a moment to read any on-screen prompts before you start.
Stay calm and pay attention to the controls, which are designed to feel smooth, so small, steady inputs usually work better than rushed ones.
faq: What is the main goal of Feed My Monster?
Your goal is to feed and grow your monster by collecting food while keeping it happy and energized.
How do I control the game?
The instructions say to use your mouse to click any button. Check the on-screen prompts for any other controls.

get-on-top-touch.intro: Get On Top Touch is a two-player fighting game where you and a friend each control a hero linked together. Each of you tries to get on top of the other by moving carefully.
tips: Move with purpose instead of pressing buttons at random, since the description warns that random play will lose.
Watch where your opponent is moving and time your jumps to respond to their position.
Use short, controlled movements to keep your hero balanced rather than making large jumps that leave you open.
Take turns testing different approaches with your friend so you learn how each move affects the link between the two heroes.
Keep your eyes on the characters' positions at all times so you can react before your opponent gets the advantage.
faq: How do I win Get On Top Touch?
You win by getting on top of the other character, which is the central goal of the game. Careful movement is the key to succeeding.
What are the controls for the first player?
The first player jumps with W, moves left with A, and moves right with D.

stickman-blast-puzzle.intro: Stickman Blast Puzzle is a fast clicker where you fire palm blasts to eliminate enemies and collect stickman skins. Tap the red item to start.
tips: Tap the red item first and watch how the palm blasts fire before you try to build a rhythm.
Because it is a clicker, keep your taps steady rather than rushing, so you stay consistent as enemies appear.
Pay attention to which enemies are closest to your stickman and focus your blasts on those first.
Collecting skins is a big part of the game, so keep an eye out for new ones as you play and note which you have already gathered.
The description warns that the game is hard to stop once started, so set a time limit for your session before you begin.
faq: How do I start the game?
Tap the red item to play. The instructions do not mention any other controls.
What is the main goal?
Fire palm blasts to eliminate enemies and collect skins. The description does not list a score or a win condition.

the-kitchen-spot-the-differences.intro: The Kitchen is a spot-the-differences game set in a busy kitchen scene. You compare nearly identical images, find the changes, and work against a timer with limited attempts.
tips: Scan the two images in a fixed order, such as left to right and top to bottom, so you do not miss areas you already checked.
Start with the largest, most obvious objects before moving to small details like utensils, labels, or background items.
Because wrong guesses carry penalties, only click when you are fairly sure something has changed rather than guessing quickly.
Keep an eye on the timer, but do not rush so much that you make errors; aim for steady, careful checks.
If you get stuck, shift your focus to a different part of the scene for a moment, then return with fresh eyes.
faq: What is the goal of The Kitchen - Spot the Differences?
The goal is to find the differences between two nearly identical kitchen images before time runs out or your attempts are used up.
What happens when I click the wrong spot?
Errors come with penalties, so a wrong click costs you something. Being accurate matters as much as being fast.

ultimate-evolution.intro: Ultimate Evolution is an adventure game where you battle other players in arenas, evolve through rebirths, and build your character across many worlds. Your choices in the Evolution Tree shape how you fight.
tips: Spend EVO points early on upgrades that match your play style, such as attack and speed or armor and regeneration, so your build has a clear direction.
Rebirth once you are stronger, since each rebirth grants permanent DNA upgrades that carry over to your next run.
Adjust your strategy for each world, because the description notes that every world requires a different approach.
Bring pets into fights, since they fight alongside you and boost your power.
Play the mini-games when you need EVO points faster, and use them to strengthen your pets.
faq: What is the main goal of Ultimate Evolution?
Fight other players in PvP arenas, defeat bosses, and evolve your character to grow stronger across 20 worlds.
How do I spend EVO points?
Spend them in the Evolution Tree to unlock new mutations, improve your build, and shape your own strategy.

drag-me-ow.intro: Drag me-ow is a cat adventure where you guide a nimble feline through pixel landscapes, dodging obstacles on the way to a cozy cushion. Challenges grow harder as you go.
tips: Watch the obstacles for a few seconds before you move, so you can spot safe gaps and timing.
Keep your moves small and deliberate rather than rushed, since quick mistakes are easy to make as speed builds.
Pay attention to how your cat responds to your input in the first level, and get comfortable with it before the challenges ramp up.
When a path looks dangerous, pause and look for a safer route instead of pushing straight through.
Expect the difficulty to climb at every turn, so treat each new section as a fresh test of your reflexes and planning.
faq: What is the goal of Drag me-ow?
Guide your cat through the pixel landscapes, dodge the obstacles and dangers, and reach the cozy cushion at the end.
Does the game get harder as I progress?
Yes. The challenges intensify at every turn, so each stage tests your cunning and speed more than the last.

car-parking-simulator-3.intro: Car Parking Simulator 3 is a driving game focused on precision parking. You pick a mode, drive compact cars or heavy-duty trucks, and work through levels that get harder as you go.
tips: Start with a compact car on the early levels to learn how the vehicle turns and how much room it needs before you try a larger model.
Move slowly and make small steering adjustments near the parking spot, since precision matters more than speed.
Before you reverse, check the space around the car so you do not bump into obstacles and lose progress.
Try the practice-focused mode when a level feels too hard, then return to the challenge levels once the handling feels natural.
Switch to a heavier truck only after you are comfortable, because larger vehicles take more space to turn and stop.
faq: How do I move the car in this game?
On PC, use the WASD keys to drive. On mobile, tap the on-screen buttons to operate the car.
What is the goal of each level?
The goal is to park your vehicle accurately as the levels become more demanding. Success on each level leads to a harder challenge.

tanks-1944.intro: Tanks 1944 is a tank combat game where you pick a tank and aim your gun to defeat every opponent on the battlefield. Its realistic physics make each shot depend on how you line it up.
tips: Before the first shot, look at the terrain and the distance to your target, since the physics will affect where each shell lands.
Fire a test shot first to see how far the shell travels, then adjust your aim for the next one.
Choose a tank early and learn its strengths, so you can pick shots and positions that suit how it fights.
Keep track of which opponents are still standing so you can plan the order in which you take them down.
Use the longer battles to build a steady routine of aiming, firing and checking the result rather than rushing your shots.
faq: What is the goal of Tanks 1944?
Your goal is to defeat everyone on the battlefield. The battle is won once every opponent has been defeated.
How do I take a shot?
Calculate the shot of the gun, then pull the trigger. Take your time with the aim, because the physics affect how the shell travels.

runner.intro: Runner is a fast arcade game where you guide a hurdler through challenging levels by jumping obstacles at the right moment. This guide covers how to keep your rhythm and avoid mishaps.
tips: Watch the course ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of you, so you can time each jump before you reach it.
Keep a steady stride instead of speeding up in bursts, since a consistent rhythm makes your timing easier to predict.
Practice the early levels to learn how the spacing of obstacles feels, then carry that rhythm into harder stages.
After a mistake, pause your focus for a moment and reset your rhythm before the next obstacle rather than rushing forward.
Aim for clean, controlled movement over speed, because a single missed jump usually ends a run more often than slow play does.
faq: What is the goal of Runner?
The goal is to get your hurdler through the challenging levels by jumping obstacles and avoiding mishaps. The game asks you to keep the rhythm and conquer the course.
How do I control the hurdler?
The game does not list specific controls in its description, so check the on-screen prompts when you start playing. Focus on timing your jumps to clear each obstacle.

stickman-kart-hero.intro: Stickman Kart Hero is a physics game where you fling your cart as far as you can without your stickman dying. The goal is to travel the greatest distance you can manage.
tips: Watch how the cart and stickman move after each launch before you try again, since the physics decide how far you go.
Make small changes between attempts instead of big ones, so you can see clearly what affects the distance.
Stay patient and treat early attempts as practice to learn how the cart reacts to your input.
Try to keep the stickman safe above all else, because a death ends the run and your distance with it.
Play in short sessions and take a break between runs to stay focused on the timing and aim.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Kart Hero?
The goal is to see how far you can fling your cart without your stickman dying. Distance is the measure of how well you did.
What controls does the game use?
You play with the mouse and the on-screen buttons. Use whichever feels more comfortable for each action.

ben10-omnirush.intro: Ben 10 Omnirush is a running adventure where Ben keeps moving, dodging obstacles and jumping across platforms. Your aim is to reach each level's goal safely and in good time while collecting coins.
tips: Watch the ground and platforms ahead rather than just the obstacle right in front of Ben, so you have time to decide when to jump.
Use a normal jump for low obstacles and a higher jump for taller ones or for reaching platforms that sit further up.
Practise your timing on the early part of a level so you learn the spacing of obstacles before the course gets harder.
Pick up coins when they are on your path, but do not risk a fall or a hit just to grab one, since reaching the goal safely comes first.
Keep an eye on the clock as well as the route, because the level is about arriving at the right time and not only about getting through it.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to reach the goal safely and arrive as soon as possible at the right time. Running without stopping is part of the challenge.
How do I jump higher?
On desktop, double click to jump higher, and on a touch screen, double tap. A single click or tap gives a regular jump.

word-solitaire.intro: Word Solitaire mixes classic solitaire with word puzzles. You build sets by matching words to category cards based on meaning and hidden connections. Each level starts with a partly filled board.
tips: Before placing a drawn word, check whether a matching category card is already on the board so you know where it belongs.
Set up a category card first, then look for every related word to finish the set rather than adding words at random.
Think about meaning, not just surface similarity, since the game rewards finding hidden connections between words.
Keep the empty spaces in mind when you draw a card, and place it where it helps a category stack grow instead of blocking one.
Play one level at a time and notice which kinds of categories you find easy, so you can spot them faster next time.
faq: What is the goal of Word Solitaire?
Build category stacks by placing a category card first, then adding all the related word cards to complete each set.
How do I draw and place cards?
Draw one card at a time from the deck and place it strategically on the board, as you would in classic solitaire.

fps-sniper-shooting-production-facility.intro: FPS Sniper Shooting: Production Facility is a first person shooter where you move through hostile terrain as a trained soldier. You choose between stealthy sniper shots and close-range combat to clear each mission without alerting the enemy.
tips: Scout the area before you take a shot so you know where enemies are patrolling and which positions give you a clear line of sight.
Pick your moment for a sniper shot when the target is isolated, since a quiet elimination keeps the rest of the enemies unaware of your position.
If an enemy spots you or a shot draws attention, switch to close-range combat quickly rather than staying exposed at long distance.
Try different weapons on early missions to learn which ones suit long-range shots and which work better in tight spaces.
Move carefully between cover points and avoid running in open areas, because noise and movement are the easiest ways to be noticed.
faq: What is the main goal of each mission?
The description says you must eliminate your foes and conquer the challenging missions. Pay attention to each mission's setup as you play to plan your approach.
How do I stay undetected?
Use stealthy sniper shots from a distance and avoid alerting nearby enemies. Taking your time to observe enemy movement before acting makes this much easier.

ragdoll-crash-test-throw-and-break.intro: Ragdoll Crash-Test: Throw and Break! is a physics puzzle game where you drag a stickman onto objects and watch it break apart. Your aim is to complete all the tests through chaotic, satisfying destruction.
tips: Try several different objects before settling on one, since each object has its own properties and may cause different amounts of damage.
Watch how the stickman reacts after each hit, then adjust your next drag based on what happened.
Think of each throw as an experiment. Note which objects produce the biggest impact and return to them when a test feels difficult.
Pay attention to where the stickman lands and which parts break first, so you can choose a better target for the next attempt.
Work through the tests in order and try not to rush. Small changes in your approach can make a big difference in the results.
faq: What is the goal of Ragdoll Crash-Test: Throw and Break!?
Your goal is to complete all the tests by breaking the stickman through hits, falls and collisions with different objects.
How do I control the stickman?
Drag the stickman onto the object you want to use. Release it to let the physics take over and watch what happens.

bomber-friends.intro: Bomber Friends is an action game built around mazes, where you place bombs to clear barriers and outwit your opponents. Plan each blast carefully, because your own bombs can catch you off guard.
tips: Before you place a bomb, check where its blast will reach so you do not trap yourself in a dead end.
Use bombs to open paths through barriers early, so you have more room to move when things get crowded.
Watch where your opponents are heading and try to block their escape routes instead of chasing them directly.
Power-ups can change how you play, so grab them when it is safe and think about how they fit your plan.
Keep moving between blasts rather than standing still, since staying in one spot makes you an easy target.
faq: What is the main goal of Bomber Friends?
Outwit your foes in the maze by placing bombs to blast through barriers and aim for victory.
Can my own bombs hurt me?
Yes. The game warns that a misstep can leave you caught by your own explosive arsenal, so always think about where your blasts will land.

wood-blocks-jam.intro: Wood Blocks Jam is a relaxed logic puzzle about dragging colorful wooden blocks into gates of matching color. There are no time limits, so you can take each move at your own pace.
tips: Look over the whole board before you move anything, and plan a few steps ahead so you do not block a gate you will need later.
Start with the blocks that have a clear path to their matching gate, which can reveal space for the harder ones.
Pay attention to which blocks are sitting in the way of others, since moving those first often opens up the rest of the board.
Save boosters for spots where you are truly stuck, and use the Saw on blocks that keep getting in the way.
When a level introduces a new mechanic or obstacle, spend a moment testing how it behaves before committing to a plan.
faq: How do I win a level?
You clear the board by matching each colored block with its gate of the same color.
Is there a time limit?
No. The game has no time limits, so you can think through each move calmly.

word-associations-solitaire.intro: Word Associations Solitaire is a calm card puzzle where you match words and images by shared meaning and clear the board one level at a time. It has no time limit, so you can think each move through.
tips: Before moving anything, scan the whole board and note which cards share a theme such as food, animals, or professions.
Look for cards that can only go one place. Clearing those first often opens up the cards underneath.
Save hints and special cards for moments when you truly have no moves left, rather than using them at the start.
If you get stuck, try looking at the less obvious associations, since a card may connect to a theme in a different way than you first thought.
Take breaks between levels; the game has no time limits, so a fresh look often reveals a move you missed.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Group the cards by shared associations and move them into matching categories until every card is cleared from the board.
When should I use hints and special cards?
Use them when no moves are left. The instructions suggest they are meant for getting past tricky situations rather than for every move.

steel-advance.intro: Steel Advance is a WWII tank shooter where you command an M4 Sherman, destroying German Panzer barracks while defending your own base. Sandbags act as both cover and a trap, so positioning matters as much as aiming.
tips: Before moving a sandbag, check that it won't close off your own route; a blocked tank is an immediate loss.
Use pushed sandbags as cover between you and incoming shells, placing them where enemy fire is most likely to land.
Keep an open path behind you at all times so you can back out of tight spots instead of getting boxed in.
Keep an eye on your base as well as the enemy barracks, since a leveled base ends the mission just like losing your tank.
If you do get trapped, remember the mission ends and you must refresh the page with F5, so avoid risky pushes when your route is narrow.
faq: What is the goal of Steel Advance?
Destroy the enemy Panzer barracks to win. You lose if your M4 is destroyed, your base is leveled, or your tank is trapped by sandbags.
How do I move and fire?
Use W, A, S and D to move the tank, and right-click to fire the cannon.

awareness-game-the-robot-bar.intro: Awարeness Game - The Robot Bar is a trivia memory challenge set in a robot nightclub. You watch a short video, then answer questions about what you saw.
tips: Watch the whole video without looking away, since every detail you miss could be the subject of a question.
Group what you notice into categories such as colors, objects, characters, and where things are placed, so you can recall them quickly later.
Pay attention to small details like counts and positions, because intricate questions often ask about exactly these.
Build a quick mental picture of the scene right after the video ends, before reading the first question.
Stay calm when answering. Think back to the scene you just watched rather than guessing from memory of similar places.
faq: What is the main goal of this game?
The goal is to watch a brief video of a robot nightclub and then answer trivia questions that test how well you observed it.
How can I get better at this game?
Practice focusing on details across the whole scene, and try to remember specific features like colors, objects, and their positions.

narcos-crime-master.intro: Narcos: Crime Master is a 3D adventure set in a colorful low-poly city. You drive through the streets, take on rival crews, and work through missions that mix car chases, street fights, and risky deals as you build your reputation.
tips: Learn how the car handles early on by driving around freely before a chase starts, so steering feels natural when it counts.
Use short bursts of steering rather than holding a single direction, which helps you stay on the road at corners.
Keep an eye on where rival crews are before committing to a route, so you can avoid getting boxed in during a chase.
Treat each mission as a set of goals: chases, fights, and deals can all show up in one run, so plan which one you need to handle first.
If you are on a touch device, practice the controls in a quiet part of the city so your movements stay steady during action sequences.
faq: How do I move and steer my character or car?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys on a keyboard. On mobile devices, touch controls are available.
What kinds of missions will I face?
Missions mix car chases, street fights, and risky deals. Your reputation grows as you work through them and rise through the city's underworld.

family-pet-dog-games.intro: Family Pet Dog Games is a casual adventure where you play as a loyal puppy helping your virtual family with household chores and neighborhood tasks. You move around the home and neighborhood to get things done.
tips: Use Left Shift to sprint when you need to cover ground quickly between chores, then ease off to keep control near furniture and objects.
Work through the messy house in a steady order, such as one room at a time, so you do not run back and forth across the home.
Press I to reread the instructions whenever you forget a control, especially the Action key you need for completing tasks.
Press P or Tab to pause when you need a moment, and check Settings with Ctrl if the controls feel unfamiliar before you start a task.
On mobile, use the joystick with short, deliberate movements so you stop precisely at each task spot instead of overshooting it.
faq: What is the goal of Family Pet Dog Games?
You play as a family dog who helps virtual mom clean the messy house, finish household chores, and help neighbours. Completing these daily activities is the main focus of the game.
Which keys do I use to move and act?
Use W, A, S and D to move, and press F for the Action control. Hold Left Shift to sprint when you want to move faster.

foot-chinko.intro: Foot Chinko is a 2D soccer game with over 90 levels, each with its own match to win. Quirky opponents, such as the Goalkeeper Duck of Evil, make every match a different challenge.
tips: Watch how the goalkeeper reacts before you commit to a shot, since the Goalkeeper Duck of Evil and other opponents are built to be tricky.
Pay attention to each opponent's habits in the early moments of a match so you can plan your next move.
If a level stalls you, step back and try a different approach rather than repeating the same play.
Take your time on the early levels to learn how the matches play out, because the later levels get harder.
Keep an eye out for trophies as you go, since collecting them is part of the game's progress.
faq: What is the main goal in Foot Chinko?
Your aim is to win each soccer match across the game's levels. Scoring big and beating the opponents move you forward.
Who are the opponents in Foot Chinko?
You face quirky rivals, including the Goalkeeper Duck of Evil. Each one adds its own challenge to the match.

street-ball-jam.intro: Street Ball Jam is a fast-paced basketball game built around simple tap-and-hold controls. Shoot for high scores, collect crystals, and unlock bonuses on your way to MVP status.
tips: Practice the tap-and-hold timing for a few minutes before chasing high scores, since small differences in hold length are likely to change your results.
Stay consistent with the shots you know you can make instead of forcing risky attempts that could break your scoring streak.
Keep an eye out for crystals while you play, since collecting them is one of the main ways to progress toward bonuses.
Play in short sessions and note which shots or habits bring your best scores, then repeat them on your next run.
Treat each unlocked bonus as a goal to work toward so you have a clear reason to keep improving your skills.
faq: What is the main goal in Street Ball Jam?
Your goal is to shoot for high scores, unlock bonuses and crystals, and work your way toward MVP status.
How do you control the game?
The game uses simple tap-and-hold mechanics, so you press and hold to take your shots.

chickz-stack.intro: ChickZ Stack is a one-tap arcade game where you stack flying chickens higher to clear walls, traps, and enemies. Build your stack, collect coins, and aim for high scores.
tips: Tap at a steady rhythm rather than in bursts, so your stack grows and you can judge each gap before you reach it.
A taller stack makes walls, traps, and enemies easier to pass, so prioritize adding chickens early in each level.
Watch the gaps ahead of you and make sure your stack height matches them before you fly into spikes or traps.
Collect coins whenever they are within safe reach, since they unlock new flying chickens to use.
Work toward 3 perfects to activate a special skill, and keep your timing clean during tight sections to build them.
faq: What is the goal of ChickZ Stack?
Your goal is to stack chickens high enough to clear gaps and get past walls, spikes, traps, and enemies as you fly through each level.
How do I control my chickens?
Tap the screen to stack chickens. The game uses simple one-tap controls, so every tap adds to your stack.

giant-snowball-rush.intro: Giant Snowball Rush is a 3D adventure where you push a snowball toward the finish line. The snowball grows as it rolls, so you must steer around obstacles while collecting gold coins and props.
tips: Hold down to move, and release to let your steering settle before the next obstacle arrives. Short, steady presses are easier to control than long holds.
Look ahead rather than at the snowball itself, so you can start adjusting early when an obstacle comes into view.
Collect gold coins and props when they are on or near your route, but do not swing wildly to reach them if it risks hitting an obstacle.
Expect steering to get harder as the snowball grows. Slow your movements down as it gets bigger, since large snowballs respond less precisely.
Keep your focus on reaching the finish line. Staying on a safe path matters more than picking up every coin along the way.
faq: How do I move the snowball?
Tap and hold to move. The description does not list other controls, so holding and releasing is the main input.
Why does the game get harder as I go?
The snowball keeps growing as you push it, and bigger snowballs are harder to control, so steering becomes more demanding.

funny-throat-surgery.intro: Funny Throat Surgery is a playful browser game about cleaning teeth, hunting germs, and styling the patient. It mixes dental care with creative design.
tips: Work through the mouth in an orderly way, such as one section of teeth at a time, so you don't miss spots where germs may be hiding.
Clean and scrub the teeth before you start styling the patient, since a clean mouth gives you a clearer view of what's left to do.
Look closely for small germs in corners and between teeth, because they are easy to overlook on a quick pass.
Try different styling choices to see how they change the character's look, and keep the finish in mind as you go.
Take your time with each step rather than rushing, since the game rewards careful dental work as much as creative styling.
faq: What is the main goal of Funny Throat Surgery?
You clean and scrub the teeth, hunt down germs, and then style the patient. The game combines dental care with creative design.
Does the game test dental skill or creativity more?
The game focuses on both. Cleaning and germ hunting test your dental skills, while the styling part gives you room to be creative.

runic-curse.intro: Runic Curse is an action-adventure set on a mysterious island, where you play Adrian, a shipwreck survivor searching for his lost crew. Explore ancient ruins, face bosses, and uncover the secrets of the Rune Curse.
tips: Use the roll (Shift) to dodge attacks, since it gives brief invulnerability frames. Time your rolls just before an enemy strikes rather than rolling early.
Watch your endurance bar before attacking or rolling. Running out mid-fight leaves you open to counterattacks, so spend it deliberately.
Try different combinations of cold weapons and runes early on to find a style you like. Note which combinations handle the enemies you meet most often.
Put your level-up points into the characteristics that match your playstyle, and check your equipment and abilities before heading into a new area.
Open the map (M) often while exploring the ten locations so you can track areas you have not yet reached and return once you have the abilities to get past blocked paths.
faq: What is the main goal of Runic Curse?
You play as Adrian, a shipwreck survivor, exploring the island to uncover the secrets of the Rune Curse and search for your lost crew.
How does combat work?
Fight with the left mouse button and use Shift to roll. Rolls provide invulnerability frames, and your endurance limits how often you can attack and roll.

stickman-fighter-mega-brawl.intro: Stickman Fighter Mega Brawl is an action fighting game built around endless stickman battles. Good timing and quick reactions matter most as enemies attack from both sides.
tips: Watch the rhythm of enemy attacks before you commit to a move, since timing matters more than rushing in.
Keep track of enemies on both sides of the screen so you are not caught off guard by attacks from behind.
Save your power-ups for tougher moments instead of spending them as soon as you get them.
Pick upgrades that support the way you like to fight, so your improvements build on each other.
Fight carefully rather than recklessly, because the game rewards skilled play and you can move on to the next level after each battle.
faq: What is the main goal of Stickman Fighter Mega Brawl?
The goal is to survive endless waves of stickman enemies coming from both sides and keep progressing through level after level. Your timing and reflexes decide how far you get.
How can I earn better rewards in the game?

The description says that fighting skillfully maximizes rewards, so focus on well-timed attacks and avoiding unnecessary damage. Using power-ups and upgrades with precision can also help you win more battles.

family-simulator-beach-games.intro: Family Simulator Beach Games is a family vacation simulator where you plan a winter trip with your virtual family. You can join picnics, hill station adventures, and snowy mountain drives in 4x4 vehicles.
tips: Learn the controls first: WASD moves your character, and Left Shift sprints when you need to cover ground faster.
Use the F key for actions and the I key to reread the instructions whenever you are unsure what to do next.
Before a long trip or drive, press P or Tab to pause and check your bearings, then continue when you are ready.
When driving the 4x4 on snowy mountain roads, slow down on the tricky stretches and take corners carefully to keep control of the vehicle.
Mix the activities rather than rushing through one: beach picnics and hill station adventures each offer different family moments to enjoy.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use the W, A, S, and D keys to move. On mobile, use the joystick instead.
How do I pause the game or open settings?
Press P or Tab to pause and Ctrl to open settings.

kiki-world-kawaii-doll-decor.intro: Kiki World is a home design game where you clean cluttered rooms, remove old items, and furnish them into cozy, stylish spaces. Use the left mouse button to place and mix furniture for each room.
tips: Clear out the clutter and old items first so you have a clean space to work with before adding new pieces.
Try a few color and pattern combinations on the same room before settling on one, since the game encourages mixing and matching.
Think about the client or neighbor you are decorating for, and choose pieces that match their personal style rather than only your own.
Balance large furniture pieces with smaller decorations so the room feels full but not crowded.
Spend the rewards you earn on new furniture to widen your choices for later rooms.
faq: What is the main goal of Kiki World?
Your goal is to turn cluttered rooms into stylish living spaces by cleaning, removing old items, and arranging furniture that fits the room's owner.
How do I place furniture and decorations?
Use the left mouse button to pick, mix, and match furniture. The game lets you explore different colors and patterns.

heroes-inc.intro: Heroes Inc! is a strategy action game about building an army of tech-infused stickman heroes. You direct your forces in battles and upgrade them to outplay a range of unusual enemies.
tips: Pay attention to the type of each foe before you commit your forces, since the game rewards countering enemies with clever tactics.
Spread your attention across your army rather than sending every hero into the same fight at once.
Upgrade the heroes you use most often so your army grows stronger as the battles get harder.
Try different hero combinations and approaches to see which setups handle particular enemies best.
Think a few moves ahead instead of reacting only to what is happening on screen, because strategy is central to victory.
faq: What is the main goal of Heroes Inc!?
You build an army of tech-infused heroes and lead them through strategic battles to win. Success depends on planning and creative tactics.
How do I control my forces?
You click and touch to direct your heroes during battles. Use these inputs to position your army and respond to each engagement.

poop-away.intro: Poop Away is a physics puzzle where you launch a projectile at the toilet. Each stage asks for accurate shots that use angle, timing, and momentum to get past obstacles.
tips: Before you release, look at the whole stage and find the path to the toilet, including any obstacles in the way. Plan the route first, then aim.
Make small adjustments to the drag before launching. A slight change in angle can make a big difference in where the projectile lands.
Pay attention to momentum. A harder pull will send the projectile farther, so match the strength of your drag to the distance you need to cover.
Watch how the projectile moves after a launch. Learning how it bounces and slows will help you judge your next shot.
If a level feels stuck, try a different angle or a different sized pull instead of repeating the same shot. Changing one thing at a time makes it easier to see what works.
faq: How do I aim and launch?
Click and drag with the mouse on desktop, or tap and drag on mobile, to aim. Release to launch the projectile.
What is the goal of each stage?
Clear the stage by getting your projectile into the toilet with accurate shots.

puzzlebot.intro: Puzzlebot is a jigsaw puzzle game with seven puzzles across three difficulty levels. You race the clock to finish each picture, and hints are available when you get stuck.
tips: Start on an easier difficulty tier to learn how the pieces fit before moving on to harder puzzles.
Look at the full image first and note the main colors and shapes, so you know where pieces belong.
Group pieces by color or by edge before you start placing them, which makes searching faster under the timer.
Save hints for sections that stall you, rather than using them at the very start.
Work on one area of the picture at a time so you don't lose track of progress while the clock runs.
faq: What is the goal of Puzzlebot?
The goal is to complete each jigsaw puzzle, of which there are seven, before the clock runs out. Each one reveals a detailed image once finished.
How many difficulty levels are there?
Puzzlebot has three difficulty tiers, each offering different challenges. Choosing the right one lets you match the game to your skill level.

crosswords-big-collection.intro: Crosswords: Big Collection is a classic word puzzle game with hundreds of levels and a daily crossword. You fill in answers from clues, and each solved word helps you solve the crossing ones.
tips: Start with the clues you are most confident about, since every solved word gives letters that help with the words crossing it.
Check the length of each answer and the letters already in place before guessing, so you can narrow down the options.
Use a hint only when you are truly stuck on a single letter, so you still get the satisfaction of solving most of the grid yourself.
Try the daily crossword regularly to build a routine, since it refreshes every day.
Switch to an unfinished level when a clue stops making sense; coming back later with fresh eyes often makes the answer obvious.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to read each clue and type the matching word into the grid, letter by letter. Solving words fills the whole crossword.
How do I earn points?
Every solved word earns you points, which move you up the leaderboard against other players.

void-rescue.intro: Void Rescue is a retro pixel-art rescue game set in glowing alien crystal caves. Fly your capsule through tight tunnels, collect stranded survivors, and bring them safely back to base.
tips: Keep an eye on your fuel from the start, since running out ends the run before you can finish a rescue.
Land gently next to a survivor and stay still for a moment so the pickup completes.
Try to carry several survivors per trip, but only if you can still get back to the base pad with fuel to spare.
Slow down and use small steering inputs in narrow tunnels, because a rushed turn can bring you into a wall or a hazard.
Watch the turrets and patrol drones and plan your route around their movement rather than flying straight through their path.
faq: What is the goal of Void Rescue?
Find stranded survivors in the crystal caves, carry them back to the base pad, and get as far as you can before your fuel runs out.
How many survivors can I carry at once?
You can pick up to 3 survivors per trip. Land next to each one and wait a moment to collect them, then fly back to base.

parmesan-partisan-deluxe.intro: Parmesan Partisan Deluxe is an adventure where you play the lone guardian defending against a rodent uprising. Across ten levels, you use a quirky arsenal to hold off the Mice People.
tips: Expect each level to be harder than the last, so use early levels to get comfortable with the action before the challenges ramp up.
Keep your reflexes sharp by staying alert for incoming threats rather than waiting for them to reach you.
Switch weapons deliberately based on the situation in front of you instead of sticking with one option out of habit.
Pay attention to how each weapon performs against different threats so you can choose the right one faster as the game goes on.
If a level gets overwhelming, slow down and reassess the threats before acting, since rushing tends to cost more than a short pause.
faq: What is the goal of Parmesan Partisan Deluxe?
You play as the lone guardian and must defend against the Mice People across ten levels of escalating challenges. Surviving the rodent uprising is the main objective.
How do the weapons work in this game?
Your arsenal is quirky and you can swap between weapons during play. The game rewards choosing the right weapon for each situation, so swapping strategically matters.

bus-escape-clear-jam.intro: Bus Escape: Clear Jam is a colorful parking puzzle where you move buses and cars into the right spots to free the parking lot and send passengers home. Levels get harder as you go.
tips: Before you move anything, look at the whole lot and note which vehicle is blocking which. The vehicle you need to move first is often hidden behind others.
Plan several moves ahead. Each car and bus has a limited number of spaces, so a move that looks helpful now can trap a vehicle later.
Sort by color as you go. Keeping matching colors together makes it easier to see where each vehicle belongs.
Clear the lanes closest to the exit first when you can. Opening a clear path usually makes the next steps simpler.
If you get stuck, step back and try a different order of moves instead of repeating the same ones. Early levels are a good place to test ideas before the puzzles get harder.
faq: What is the goal of Bus Escape: Clear Jam?
The goal is to free up the parking lot by moving buses and cars to the correct spots. Once the lot is clear, the passengers can go home.
How do I get past a hard level?
Look for the vehicle that is trapping the others and plan a sequence of moves before you start. Working backward from the correct final spots can help you find the solution.

black-hole-fill-3d.intro: Black Hole Fill 3D is a puzzle game where you steer a black hole, absorb objects, and fill the target area before the timer runs out. Clearing each level depends on planning your route.
tips: Start by scanning the whole level so you can see where the objects are clustered and where the target area sits.
Clear the items closest to your hole first, then work outward, so you don't leave scattered pieces behind near the end.
Keep the hole moving through open areas and sweep along rows of objects instead of backtracking across the map.
Watch the timer as you go and check whether any items are hard to reach, since missing a few can stop you from finishing the level.
Drag in short, controlled motions when you're near tight gaps, so you don't overshoot items you still need to absorb.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to absorb the objects and fill the target area before time runs out. The level is only complete when everything is collected.
How do I move the black hole?
Use a mouse drag or swipe to move the hole around the level. Objects that touch the hole are absorbed into it.

ragdoll-racing-extreme-downhill.intro: Ragdoll Racing: Extreme Downhill! is an arcade race where you guide a ragdoll stickman down steep slopes and sharp turns. Your goal is to reach the finish line before your AI rivals.
tips: Watch the upcoming turns and steep descents, and ease off your speed before a sharp bend so you don't lose control.
Remember that too high a speed can make you fall, so push hard on the straight parts and hold back when the track gets tricky.
Keep your stickman's head up by staying in control; a fall costs you time against your rivals.
Choose your skin and colors in the main menu before the race, since that is the only place the game mentions customizing your character.
Track the AI opponents as you race and use the moments when they stumble to pull ahead.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to reach the finish line faster than your rivals by controlling the ragdoll stickman down the track.
How do I speed up my stickman?
Press the character to speed up, and keep control of him so his head stays up.

tidewell.intro: Tidewell is a cozy match-3 puzzle where you swap sea treasures to clear crates, sand, nets and bottles across 100 levels. Rebuild the harbor with stars earned along the way.
tips: Look for moves that make four or more tiles in a row, since they create flares and buoys that clear more of the board when used.
Combine two power-ups by swapping them together for bigger chain reactions, especially when crates or nets sit in several places.
Keep an eye on your Harbor Pal's charge meter and fire its power when the board has many obstacles, not just when it is full.
Before each swap, check whether it opens a cascade that could clear sand or bottles near the edges of the board.
Use boosters when a level is nearly finished and a few obstacles remain, so you save stars and moves for harder boards.
faq: How do I make a match?
Swipe a tile, or tap one tile and then a neighbouring tile, to swap them. Lining up three or more matching treasures clears them from the board.
How do I use a Harbor Pal?
Tap the Harbor Pal's power once it has charged. The crab, puffin, octopus and turtle each have a different special power.

recoils.intro: RECOILS is a one-button shooter where you hang from a parachute gun. Every shot pushes you the other way, so you fight robots and steer with the same input.
tips: Aim your shots downward when you need height, since each shot kicks the gun upward. Use short bursts to climb rather than holding a steady stream.
Plan your shots so that each kick moves you toward the next target or away from incoming fire. Timing matters more than rapid tapping.
Try bouncing bullets off the edges of the screen to reach enemies you cannot hit directly. This can help you clear threats from awkward angles.
When a boss arrives every 300 m, clear its armor first and then aim for the core. Keep moving so its attacks are harder to land on you.
Chain kills quickly to build combos, and use the pause key P to take a moment and reset your position if things get crowded.
faq: How do I move the gun?
You can only move by shooting. Each shot kicks the gun in the opposite direction, and aiming down makes you fly up.
What controls do I use?
Tap or click, or press Space, to shoot. Press P to pause the game at any time.

mineclicker.intro: MineClicker is a blocky clicker where each click fights mobs and mines resources. You upgrade and recruit helpers, push through harder levels, and face timed boss battles.
tips: Keep clicking during the early levels, since every click is part of both fighting mobs and mining resources.
Spend resources on upgrades and helpers as you go, because idle progression keeps earning while you are not clicking.
Before moving on to the next level, check whether you can still gain more from the current one, since the description notes that maximizing gains first brings greater rewards.
Watch the timer during boss battles and plan your clicks so you deal as much damage as possible before time runs out.
Balance your spending between clicking power and helpers, so your progress stays steady as the levels become harder.
faq: What is the main goal of MineClicker?
Your goal is to battle mobs and mine resources with your clicks while upgrading and recruiting helpers to get through increasingly challenging levels.
How do boss battles work?
Boss battles are driven by a timer, so you need to maximize your gains before the time runs out. Making the most of each boss fight helps you earn greater rewards.

little-cute-summer-fairies-puzzle.intro: Little Cute Summer Fairies Puzzle is a fairy-themed jigsaw game. You assemble pictures piece by piece while racing the clock, and the puzzles get harder as you go.
tips: Begin with the border pieces and the corners so you have a clear frame to fill in.
Group pieces by colour and pattern, such as the fairies' wings, flowers, and sky, before you start placing them.
Keep an eye on the timer, but avoid rushing. Placing a piece in the wrong spot usually costs more time than checking first.
Look at the completed picture first to get a sense of where the main areas of colour sit.
Take a short break between harder puzzles so your focus stays sharp when the difficulty rises.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to assemble each fairy-themed jigsaw by fitting every piece into its correct place before time runs out.
Does the difficulty change as I play?
Yes, the jigsaws increase in difficulty as you progress, so later puzzles will be more challenging to complete.

sniper-attack2.intro: Sniper Attack2 is a first-person sniper game about precise shots and careful planning. You hold to aim, drag to line up your target, and release to fire across city, port, and desert missions.
tips: Hold the left mouse button early and keep it held while you scan the area, so you are already aimed when a target appears.
Move the view slowly and steadily when tracking an enemy. Quick drags make it easy to overshoot your target.
Before you release the button, check that the crosshair is on the enemy's center. Take your time, since you only get one clean shot per aim.
Each environment has different sight lines. In city streets, look at windows and rooftops, in ports check containers and open edges, and in the desert watch the distant ridges.
If you miss, stay aware of your position and look for the next enemy before moving on. Staying calm between shots helps you keep your accuracy throughout the mission.
faq: How do I aim and shoot in Sniper Attack2?
Press and hold the left mouse button to aim, then drag the mouse to move the camera and line up your target. Release the button to fire.
What is the main goal of the game?
You complete missions by eliminating enemies with precise shots in different environments such as city streets, ports, and desert battlefields.

motocross-racing.intro: Motocross Racing is an off-road dirt bike game with quirky riders, tricky tracks, and stunts. Race to the finish and try to pull off tricks along the way.
tips: Read the track ahead before you commit to a jump, since a bad landing usually costs more time than a slower approach.
Use the start of each race to get a clean launch, because a strong opening makes it easier to stay near the front.
Practice the stunts on easier stretches first so you know how your bike behaves in the air before you need the trick on a hard section.
Keep your bike balanced through corners and bumpy dirt, and avoid overcorrecting, which can throw you off course.
Watch for the riders around you and choose lines that keep your speed up without crowding into a crash.
faq: What is the goal of Motocross Racing?
Race through the off-road tracks and speed toward victory, while performing stunts along the way.
How do I control my bike?
The game does not list specific controls, so check the in-game prompts or on-screen hints when you start riding.

super-buddy-kick-2.intro: Super Buddy Kick 2 is an arcade game where you pick from a set of weapons and devices and use them on Buddyman. He respawns after each round, so you can keep going at your own pace.
tips: Try a few different weapons and devices early on to see which ones feel most satisfying to use on Buddyman.
Experiment with the mouse or touch controls to get a feel for how precisely you can aim and trigger each option.
Take short breaks between rounds if you are using the game to relieve stress, since there is no set goal to rush toward.
Watch how Buddyman reacts to each weapon so you can learn which choices create the most dramatic results.
faq: What is the goal of Super Buddy Kick 2?
The game does not set a fixed goal. You choose weapons and devices and use them on Buddyman as you like.
How do I control the game?
Use the mouse on a desktop or touch on a mobile device to select and use your weapons and devices.

master-of-3-tiles.intro: Master of 3 Tiles is a browser puzzle game where you match identical tiles in sets of three until the board is clear. Each level gets harder, so the game rewards careful planning as you go.
tips: Scan the whole board before you make a move. Identify every group of identical tiles so you can see which sets are easiest to complete.
Look for tiles that appear in pairs or near-complete sets first. Making a set when a third matching tile is already close can save you from getting stuck later.
Think one move ahead. Before you clear a set, check whether it leaves the remaining tiles in a usable arrangement.
Use the early levels to learn the layout and tile patterns. The skills you build there will help you handle the harder boards.
Take a short break if you notice you are missing matches. Coming back with fresh eyes often makes the next set easier to spot.
faq: What is the goal of Master of 3 Tiles?
Your goal is to match identical tiles in sets of three until you clear the board. Each completed level brings you to a harder one.
Why do the levels get harder?
Each level increases in difficulty to test and build your strategic skills. Later boards require more careful planning to clear.

screw-and-pin-puzzle-levels.intro: Screw & Pin is a physics puzzle game where you tap screw holes to release metal plates in the right order. Each level brings new challenges, with mazes of nuts, bolts, and plates to work through.
tips: Look at the whole product before tapping anything, and note which screws hold which plates in place.
Think carefully before each tap, since a wrong unlock can make the plates fall in an order that doesn't solve the level.
If you get stuck, keep trying different sequences. The solution often appears after a few attempts.
Save the hint button and the random screw removal for when you have genuinely run out of ideas, so you can still work the puzzle out yourself.
Try the Level of the day once you are comfortable with regular levels, since it contains only the most difficult puzzles.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You tap the screw holes on the product to unlock them so that the metal plates fall in the correct sequence.
What do the hint and remove screw buttons do?
They help you progress when you are stuck. Use the hint feature for guidance or remove random screws to move forward.

sticker-art-book-puzzle.intro: Sticker Art Book Puzzle is a calm coloring and brain-teasing game. You fill designs with colored stickers, matching numbers and shapes to reveal a hidden picture.
tips: Read the numbers and shapes on each cell before placing anything, since every sticker belongs in a specific position.
Work on one color at a time so you can keep track of which spaces are already filled.
Look for the patterns in the design first. Spotting repeated shapes can show you where several stickers go.
Save the available hints and power-ups for harder levels, where the designs become more complex and detailed.
If you get stuck, step back and look at the partly revealed picture. The shape of the image often suggests the next area to fill.
faq: What is the goal of Sticker Art Book Puzzle?
Your goal is to arrange the stickers in their corresponding positions so the hidden sticker picture is revealed. Each level is a color by number puzzle.
How do I know where each sticker goes?
Use the numbers and shapes shown in the design. Each sticker matches a spot with the same number or pattern.

spooky-halloween-makeover.intro: Spooky Halloween Makeover is a dress-up and room decorating game where you give a client a spooky makeover and then design a haunted, stylish room. Drag tools onto her face, pick an outfit, and match her wishes to earn three stars.
tips: Read the client's wishes before you start, since matching them is what earns the three stars.
Work through the makeup in a steady order, such as base first and details last, so you do not cover work you have already done.
Try a few outfit options from the cupboard and compare them against the wishes before settling on one.
Keep the Halloween theme consistent across the look and the room so the final result feels like one spooky style.
Use the room customization options to build a haunted but stylish space rather than picking items at random.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to give the client a Halloween makeover, choose an outfit, and match her wishes to earn 3 stars. You can then decorate a haunted Halloween room.
How do I apply makeup?
Click and drag each tool onto the client's face with the left mouse button. On mobile, tap and drag the tool instead.

frontline-assault-battleground-fire-max-.intro: Frontline Assault is a first person shooter about fighting alone through hostile terrain. Success depends on stealth, careful aim, and planning each move before you act.
tips: Move through each area slowly and watch where enemies are before you show yourself. Surprise attacks work best when you have not been spotted.
Pick your shots with care instead of firing at everything. Precision matters more than volume when you are on your own.
Plan a route through each challenging terrain before you commit. Knowing where cover and openings are will help you stay alive.
Use stealth as your default approach and only switch to open fire when you have a clear advantage. Retreating to a safer position can be a good choice.
Keep an eye on the rewards you are working toward and play in a way that supports them. Steady, patient play usually beats rushing.
faq: What is the main goal of Frontline Assault?
Your goal is to outmaneuver and outfire enemies across hostile environments while staying alive. The game rewards careful, tactical play.
Do I fight alongside other soldiers?
No, the game is played alone. You need to rely on your own instincts and planning to get through each challenge.

box-roller.intro: Box Roller is a logic puzzle where you steer a wooden box across terrain and stop it exactly over the target hole. Each level asks you to plan your route before you move.
tips: Look at the whole level before you move, and work out the route to the target hole in your head first.
Think about which direction the box will end up facing after each roll, since that decides where it lands next.
Make your moves deliberately rather than tapping keys quickly, because timing matters when you need to land precisely.
If you fall off course, restart the level and try a different plan instead of trying to recover from a bad position.
Use W A S D or the arrow keys consistently so your movements stay predictable as the levels get harder.
faq: What is the goal of Box Roller?
You roll the wooden box across the terrain and land it precisely in the target hole in each level.
How do I move the box?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to roll the box in each direction.

two-cups.intro: Two Cups is a pixel-art adventure where you run, jump, and slide through varied landscapes to rescue Cupgirl from a mischievous cat. Gather her fragments and get past obstacles and enemies along the way.
