tips: Try each movement early on, such as running, jumping, and sliding, so you know what each one can get you past before you need it in a tight spot.
Look at the layout of each area before you move. Spotting gaps, enemies, and obstacles ahead gives you time to choose the right move.
Pay attention to where Cupgirl's fragments are placed. Collecting them as you go is part of the quest, so it helps to plan a route that picks them up.
When an enemy or obstacle blocks your path, pause and consider whether jumping or sliding past it is safer than rushing ahead.
Since the description says every movement counts, avoid wasting actions. Move with purpose and keep your timing steady rather than mashing inputs.
faq: What is the main goal in Two Cups?
You play as a rescuer trying to save Cupgirl from a mischievous cat. Along the way you gather her fragments and get past obstacles and enemies.
What moves do I use in Two Cups?
The game is built around running, jumping, and sliding. The instructions are not listed here, so check any in-game prompts to confirm the exact controls.

baby-brainrots-multiplayer-with-friends.intro: Baby Brainrots is a multiplayer game where you explore different islands, find cute Brenrots, and play with other players. Your goal is to discover all the islands and collect every Brenrot.
tips: Explore each island fully before moving on, since you need to discover all the islands and find all the Brenrots.
Keep a mental or written list of which islands you have visited so you can spot the ones you still need to find.
Look around each island carefully, including corners and edges, because Brenrots can be easy to miss at first glance.
Talk to or play with other players you meet, since the game is built around playing with friends and making new friends.
Move in short, steady bursts with WASD or the arrow keys so you can change direction quickly when you spot a Brenrot.
faq: What is the main goal of Baby Brainrots?
Your goal is to travel to different islands, discover all of them, and find all the Brenrots. Playing with other players is part of the fun along the way.
What are the controls?
On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys to move. On mobile, tap the screen and a virtual joystick will appear for movement.

drive-crazy.intro: Drive Crazy is a fast racing adventure on chaotic tracks. Races reward quick decisions, careful driving, and upgrades that help you handle the obstacles along the way.
tips: Look a few steps ahead on the track rather than only at your car, so you have time to make split-second decisions before obstacles arrive.
Stay precise with your steering instead of over-correcting, since small, controlled movements usually keep you moving faster than sharp swerves.
Practice drifts in calm sections first so you learn how far your vehicle slides before you need to rely on them in a tight corner.
Spend upgrades with a plan. Pick improvements that help with the kinds of obstacles you struggle with most, rather than spreading them out.
After each race, think about where you lost time, such as a missed turn or a crash, and adjust your approach for the next run.
faq: How do I win a race in Drive Crazy?
Victory depends on racing strategy and precision, so focus on clean lines, controlled drifts, and smart decisions around obstacles rather than just going as fast as possible.
How should I use upgrades?
Upgrades help your vehicle handle diverse obstacles, so choose the ones that address the challenges that slow you down most.

funny-shooter-destroy-all-enemies.intro: Funny Shooter is a first person shooter where you fight waves of quirky AI enemies in a 3D arena. Its goofy movement and varied weapons keep each wave unpredictable.
tips: Watch how the enemies move before you commit to a shot, since their goofy movement can make them harder to track at first.
Keep moving around the arena instead of standing still, so you are not an easy target as waves arrive.
Try different weapons from your arsenal and notice which ones work best against each type of enemy.
Change your approach when a new wave starts, because the challenges shift and a tactic that worked earlier may not work now.
Pay attention to the layout of the 3D arena and use its open space to keep your distance and reposition.
faq: What is the main goal of Funny Shooter?
The goal is to destroy all enemies by fending off the waves of AI opponents in the arena.
How do I choose which weapon to use?
The game offers a diverse arsenal, so switch between weapons and see which one suits the enemies in front of you.

save-my-human.intro: Save My Human is a tile-by-tile puzzle game where you guide a brave cat through tricky puzzles and dangerous paths to rescue your owner. It has 50 levels and a short Story Mode.
tips: Look at the whole level before your first move, and trace a full route to the human so you can spot dangerous paths early.
Move one tile at a time and check the result after each step, since every move changes what is possible next.
Plan your route backward from the human when a level looks tangled, which often reveals the key path more quickly.
Try the short Story Mode first to get comfortable with the movement and puzzle style before tackling the 50 levels.
If you get stuck, stop and reread the layout instead of repeating the same moves, because a fresh look usually shows a different option.
faq: How do I move the cat?
Use the arrow keys on your keyboard or the on-screen arrows. The cat moves tile by tile, so each press is one step.
What is the goal of each level?
Guide the cat safely through the puzzle to reach and rescue your human. Avoid the dangerous paths along the way.

war-robot-earth-survival.intro: War Robot Earth Survival is an action shooter where you pilot a large battle robot in online player-versus-player fights. You can team up with friends in a clan and take part in clan battles.
tips: Keep moving with W, A, S and D so you are harder to hit instead of standing still while you fire.
Aim with the mouse and fire when your target is clearly in view, rather than shooting at random.
Read the in-game instructions after you start, since the game explains more about how to play once you begin.
Use tactics rather than charging straight in, because the game highlights tactical methods and complex maneuvers.
Team up with friends in a clan so you can coordinate with teammates during clan battles.
faq: What is the goal of War Robot Earth Survival?
You fight enemy mech warriors in online PvP battles and take part in clan battles for control of the earth. Open new weapons, robots, and areas as you progress.
What are the basic controls?
Use WASD to move, the mouse to shoot, and ESC to open the menu.

ninja-parkour-multiplayer.intro: Ninja Parkour Multiplayer is a fast race where you run and jump through changing obstacle courses against other players. Speed and precise jumps decide who gets ahead.
tips: Watch the course ahead rather than just the ninja, so you can plan your next jump before you reach the obstacle.
Keep your pace steady and avoid rushing every jump, since a missed landing can cost more time than a slightly slower approach.
Pay attention to how your opponents move through the course, and look for shortcuts or safer lines they take.
Expect the landscape to change, so stay alert and adjust your timing instead of repeating the same route every run.
Practice short stretches of the course to build reflexes for the tricky jumps before you race at full speed.
faq: What is the main goal in Ninja Parkour Multiplayer?
The goal is to get through the obstacle course faster than your opponents and finish ahead of them in the race.
What skills matter most in this game?
Quick reflexes and precise jumps matter most, along with the speed to keep moving through the changing course.

warfare-1942-online-shooter.intro: Warfare 1942 is a WWII shooter set on fast-paced battlefields where strategy and quick reactions both matter. It asks you to customize your soldier, take key locations, and win across several modes.
tips: Pay attention to the key locations on the map, since capturing them is central to winning and can shift the course of a fight.
Balance aggression with caution: rushing in without a plan can leave you outnumbered, so pick moments to push forward.
Use cover and reposition often rather than standing in one open spot, which makes you an easy target.
Try each mode to see which playstyle suits you best before settling on a favorite approach.
Adjust your soldier's customization to match how you like to fight, whether that is a more cautious or a more aggressive style.
faq: What is the main goal of Warfare 1942?
Your goal is to conquer key locations and achieve victory in the battles you join. Working as a team to hold these points is a practical way to earn the win.
Does the game reward strategy or just fast reflexes?
The game asks you to balance both, so quick aim alone is rarely enough. Thinking about where to fight and which locations to take makes a real difference.

colorturntable.intro: ColorTurntable is a colorful puzzle game where you click to play. It is built to test your eyesight and hand speed, and it is fun to challenge friends.
tips: Start by watching how the colors change before you click, so your eyes can settle on the pattern.
Keep your clicks steady and avoid rushing, since the game tests both eyesight and hand speed.
Play a few short rounds first to get comfortable with the controls before trying to go faster.
Take short breaks when your eyes feel tired, because staying focused on bright colors for a long time can slow your reactions.
Compete with friends on the same game to see who has the sharper eyes and quicker hands.
faq: What is the goal of ColorTurntable?
The game is designed to test your eyesight and hand speed. The description suggests you try to beat your own results and compete with friends.
How do I control the game?
The game's instructions say to click to play. Use mouse clicks as the main way to interact with the game.

road-chase-shooter-realistic-guns.intro: Road Chase puts you in a weak car with a large set of weapons. Your job on each level is to stop the pursuers and break away from the chase.
tips: Watch which vehicles are closing in and switch weapons with keys 1 to 4 to match the threat. Use a different weapon for a motorcycle than for a helicopter.
Aim at wheels and car parts when a pursuer is fast or hard to hit. Taking out a vehicle's wheels can stop it faster than targeting the body.
Reload with R during a lull in the chase, not in the middle of a fight. Running dry when a new group appears can leave you exposed.
Try to land headshots and chain shots together to build combos. Combo kills are a good habit to build early, since enemies keep coming.
Keep your aim moving with the mouse and don't rush. The enemy attacks vary, so check each approaching vehicle before you commit your ammo.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to break away from the pursuit by destroying all the pursuers. The chase ends once they are all stopped.
How do I shoot and aim?
Fire with the left mouse button and aim by moving the mouse. On mobile, push the screen to shoot.

arrow-patrol.intro: Arrow Patrol is a one-button hypercasual game where an arrow moves up and down, and you click to change its direction. The goal is to keep it clear of the saws.
tips: Keep your eyes on the arrow's path rather than on one spot, so you can react to saws before they get close.
Click at a steady rhythm instead of waiting too long, since each click changes the direction you need to follow.
Watch the saws ahead of the arrow and start planning your next click early to give yourself time to turn.
Stay relaxed and avoid rapid, panicked clicking, which can send the arrow into a saw as easily as waiting too long.
faq: What is the goal of Arrow Patrol?
The goal is to keep the arrow moving up and down while avoiding collisions with the saws. If the arrow hits a saw, the game is over.
How do I control the arrow?
Click to change the direction of the arrow so it goes up or down. Each click reverses its movement.

solitaire-klondike-treasure-island.intro: Solitaire Klondike - Treasure Island is a pirate-themed card game where you build four suit piles from Ace to King. Plan each move carefully, since you can review the deck as often as you like.
tips: Only a King can start an empty pile, so keep an empty pile free for a King that is buried in a column rather than filling it with smaller cards.
Before each move, check which face-down card a move will uncover, and favor moves that reveal new cards you can use.
Use the chance to review the deck without limit to plan ahead, and look for the low cards (Aces and Twos) that you need to start your suit piles.
When you move a stack, make sure it alternates colors and runs down in rank, so the whole group can be dragged onto a card of the right color and one rank higher.
Avoid rushing cards into the suit piles too early if they are still needed as a base for building down the columns.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Arrange all the cards into four piles by suit, building each from Ace up to King. The game ends when every card is placed in these piles.
Which cards can I place on a column pile?
You can place a card of the opposite color that is exactly one rank lower than the card beneath it. For example, a red 6 can go on a black 7.

noob-playground.intro: Noob Playground is a sandbox where you summon crash-test dummies and try out a range of destructive toys. With no tasks or pressure, you set the pace and experiment as you like.
tips: Test one toy at a time on a dummy so you can clearly see what each one does.
Keep notes or a mental list of combinations that produced the most interesting results, so you can repeat or build on them.
Change only one thing between tests, such as the toy or the dummy's position, to learn what caused a particular outcome.
Since there is no time limit or pressure, spend a few minutes just watching how things play out before moving to the next idea.
Mix toys in sequence rather than only using one at a time to discover combinations you might not expect.
faq: Is there a goal I need to reach?
The description does not set a goal. It is a sandbox built around creative experimentation, with no tasks or pressure.
What should I do first when I start playing?
Summon a crash-test dummy and try a few of the destructive toys one by one to get a feel for how the game reacts.

funny-food-duel.intro: Funny Food Duel is a fast-paced pet showdown where you race adorable pets to grab tasty food from a silver platter. Quick reflexes decide who becomes the culinary champion.
tips: Watch for the frozen and rotten items before you go for food, since they are the main surprises that can throw off your race.
Keep your eyes on the platter as a whole so you can spot the next food item early rather than reacting only after it appears.
Stay calm and focused, because the duel is fast and a moment of hesitation can cost you a lead.
The controls are described as easy, so spend your first round getting a feel for how your pet responds before trying to compete seriously.
Play a few rounds in a row to build up your reflexes, since timing improves quickly with repetition in a game like this.
faq: What is the goal of Funny Food Duel?
The goal is to race your pet to devour the delicious food on the silver platter faster than your rival. Quick reflexes decide the culinary champion.
What should I avoid during the duel?
Be careful of the frozen and rotten surprises on the platter, as they are the main hazards that can hurt your progress.

fnf-red-light-green-light.intro: FNF: Red Light, Green Light is a 3D shooting game based on the Squid Game first-round challenge, featuring Friday Night Funkin' style characters like Boyfriend and Garcello. You run using W, A, S, D, the arrow keys, the mouse, or touchscreen controls.
tips: Keep your movement controls comfortable and consistent so you can change direction quickly when the game calls for it.
Watch the characters closely and time your stops and moves rather than rushing ahead.
Pay attention to the shooting side of the game and aim before you commit to a path, since accuracy matters.
Try different control options, such as keyboard, mouse, or touchscreen, to find the one that feels most precise to you.
Replay the game a few times to learn the pacing and patterns, which makes it easier to react in later rounds.
faq: What is the goal of FNF: Red Light, Green Light?
The game is based on the Red Light, Green Light challenge from Squid Game, so you move forward through the round and try to reach the end while keeping up with the changing signals.
Which controls can I use to run?
You can run with W, A, S, D, the arrow keys, the mouse, or touchscreen input.

parking-solution.intro: Parking Solution is a car puzzle game where you untangle traffic jams and clear a parking lot. Levels grow harder as you go, and a speedrun mode adds a timed challenge.
tips: Before moving anything, study the whole lot and find which car is blocking the exit or the most other cars. Solving that blocker first often opens up the rest of the puzzle.
Plan two or three moves ahead instead of reacting to each one. Many traffic jams can be cleared in fewer moves if you think about the order of exits.
Avoid moving cars back and forth without a clear purpose. Wasted moves make later levels harder to solve and will slow your speedrun times.
When a level stalls, step back and look for cars you have not tried moving yet. Trying a different car often reveals the path you were missing.
Play the standard levels first to learn how the traffic jams are built before you try the speedrun mode. Speed comes more easily once you understand the patterns.
faq: What is the main goal of Parking Solution?
Your goal is to skillfully maneuver through each parking scenario and clear the parking lot. Each level is a puzzle built around a traffic jam.
How does the difficulty change as I play?
The levels become increasingly challenging, so later puzzles will need more careful planning. Taking time with early levels helps you build the thinking you need later.

sniper-master.intro: Sniper Master is an action shooter where you jump, float, and fire while airborne. Time your shots carefully to hit targets across multiple levels.
tips: Watch the target's movement for a moment before you shoot, so you can lead your aim rather than firing at where it currently is.
Plan your shot while you are still rising or floating, since timing in mid-air is the core skill this game tests.
Stay calm and avoid rushing. Taking a steady moment before each shot usually produces cleaner hits than firing quickly.
Pay attention to how each level's targets are placed and move, and adjust your timing to match what you see in that level.
Use the rewards you earn as a sign of progress, and try to notice which shots felt clean so you can repeat that approach.
faq: What is the goal of Sniper Master?
Your goal is to eliminate targets with precise shots while you are airborne. Each level tests your timing and aim.
How do I control the game?
Play with a mouse click or a tap. The game is built around timing your actions, so focus on when you act rather than how fast you act.

trz-battleship.intro: TRZ Battleship is a naval board puzzle where you hide and seek enemy ships. Each guess brings you closer to sinking the fleet before it sinks yours.
tips: Keep a record of every hit and miss so you never waste a guess on a square you have already tried.
Spread your early guesses across the board instead of clustering them, so you cover more area and find ships faster.
When you score a hit, check the squares around it, since a ship is made of connected squares and the rest of it is likely nearby.
Look for patterns in the misses and rule out whole areas where no ship can fit.
Balance attacking known targets with exploring new areas, so you do not run out of safe options late in the game.
faq: What is the goal of TRZ Battleship?
Your goal is to sink the enemy ships before they sink yours, using a series of thoughtful guesses.
How do I get better at finding enemy ships?
Track your hits and misses carefully, and use each result to narrow down where the remaining ships could be.

ellie-summer-spa-beauty-salon.intro: Ellie Summer Spa Beauty Salon is a relaxed dress-up and beauty care game set in a sunny spa. You pick a spa routine and guide Ellie through treatment steps to get her ready for summer.
tips: Read the on-screen guidance before each step, since the game asks you to complete activities in a set order.
Work through the treatment steps in the order they appear, such as cleaning, applying products, rinsing, and styling, so each stage builds on the last.
Take your time with each tap, drag, and swipe, because careful actions are what move a level forward.
Finish every required task in a level before moving on, since the next spa routine unlocks only after that.
If you feel stuck, pause and look again at the tools and products on screen, then follow the next prompt rather than rushing ahead.
faq: What is the goal of Ellie Summer Spa Beauty Salon?
The goal is to help Ellie prepare for the summer season by completing each beauty-care routine. You do this by finishing all required tasks in a level.
How do I unlock the next spa routine?
Finish all required tasks in the level you are playing. Completing them unlocks the next routine.

anime-mom-family-life-simulator.intro: Anime Mom: Family Life Simulator is a 3D family simulation where you handle household chores and daily activities while keeping your family happy. You move around colorful homes and complete simple tasks one after another.
tips: Move with W A S D or the arrow keys, and use the mouse to look around before you start a task so you can see what needs attention.
Use Left Click to interact with objects and pick actions, and check the nearby items before moving on so you do not miss a task.
Treat each task as part of a day's routine, since the game asks you to balance home activities with family responsibilities.
Take time for the relaxing family moments as well as the chores, because keeping the family happy is a central part of the game.
Explore the different areas of the home and environments to find new challenges, since each completed task brings something new to do.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move. Hold the mouse to look around the scene.
How do I interact with objects?
Point at an object with the mouse and press Left Click to select and perform an action.

hedgehog-go-home.intro: Hedgehog Go Home is a relaxing click puzzle about guiding a hedgehog safely back to its nest. Each level has a new layout, and the challenge grows as you go.
tips: Before you click anything, look at the whole layout and trace a possible route from the hedgehog to the nest.
Check which obstacles you can push and where they would end up, so you don't block the path you need.
Spot the traps early and plan a route that keeps the hedgehog well clear of them.
If a level stalls, step back and look for a different order of moves rather than repeating the same clicks.
Expect the later levels to demand more careful thinking, so take your time and move slowly at first.
faq: What is the goal of Hedgehog Go Home?
Your goal is to help the hedgehog find a safe path through each level and reach its nest. Every level has a different layout.
How do I control the hedgehog?
The game is played with the mouse. Click to move pieces and guide the hedgehog along its route.

animals-vs-zombies.intro: Aliens have kidnapped the animals, and your job is to rescue them. Tame and befriend creatures, evolve them, and gather resources to build a team strong enough to send the invaders back to the Moon.
tips: Explore each new area fully, since every location has new animals to save and resources to collect for upgrades.
Spend resources on upgrading your dogs regularly so your team keeps pace with tougher enemies.
Since attacks trigger automatically when you get close to an enemy, focus on positioning yourself to engage one target at a time.
Evolve animals once you can, because evolved companions gain their own abilities that can help against stronger opponents.
Before facing a boss, make sure your team has been upgraded and evolved as much as your resources allow.
faq: What is the main goal of Animals vs Zombies?
You need to save all the captured pets and send the aliens back to the Moon. Along the way, you collect resources and upgrade your dogs.
How do I attack enemies?
Attacks are automatic when you approach an enemy, so your main job is moving your character into range.

tile-valley.intro: Tile Valley is a Mahjong-inspired puzzle where you collect matching tiles to clear the stack. It is a calm brain game with hundreds of levels and helpful hints for tricky boards.
tips: Before you tap, scan the stack for tiles that already have a pair on your board. Collecting a third matching tile clears them, so spotting pairs early keeps your slots free.
Keep your 7 slots as open as possible. Avoid collecting a tile that you have no match for yet unless it is needed to reach a pair you can complete.
Look at the tiles that are fully uncovered before choosing. Freeing up tiles underneath often reveals the matches you need.
Save hints for levels where you are truly stuck. Try to find a solution on your own first, since the game is designed to train your mind.
If your board starts filling up, pause and count which tile types are waiting in your slots. Focus your next moves on completing one of those sets.
faq: What is the goal of Tile Valley?
Your goal is to collect three identical tiles to remove them from the board. You win when all tiles are removed from the stack.
How do I lose a level?
You lose if you fill all 7 empty tile slots on your board before clearing the stack.

stickman-attack.intro: Stickman Attack is a wave-based brawler where you fight off waves of stickman enemies using kung fu. Tap the white circle to attack, earn souls, and spend them on new weapons.
tips: Keep your attention on the white circle, since every attack starts from tapping it and steady tapping keeps enemies under control.
Watch the enemies closest to you first, because the waves are built to wear you down and the biggest threat is usually the one about to reach you.
Spend souls on new weapons as soon as you can afford a meaningful upgrade, so your attacks clear enemies faster in later waves.
Pace your taps rather than mashing them without thought, because the game rewards focus and waiting for your first mistake is what ends a run.
Play in short sessions at first to learn how quickly the waves ramp up, then push a little further each time you retry.
faq: How do I attack in Stickman Attack?
Tap or click the white circle to use your kung fu on the enemies. Each tap is one of your main actions in the game.
What do I do with the souls I earn?
You can use souls to buy new weapons. Weapons help you handle the waves more effectively as the fight goes on.

magic-finger-3d.intro: Magic Finger 3D is a hypercasual game where you use magic to flick, fling, and manipulate a 3D world to defeat alien invaders. The challenges grow harder as you go.
tips: Start with the early stages to learn how your magic responds before the challenges get harder.
Look at your surroundings first and think about which objects you can use against the aliens.
Try different flicks and flings in a calm moment to see how each one affects the world.
Plan your attacks instead of acting quickly. Clever, deliberate moves are the key to outsmarting the invaders.
When you gain a chance to strengthen your powers, use it to prepare for the tougher challenges ahead.
faq: What is the goal of Magic Finger 3D?
Your goal is to defeat the clever alien invaders by using magic to manipulate the world around you. The game's description does not list any other objectives.
What controls does Magic Finger 3D use?
The game's instructions do not list specific controls, so the main actions to learn are flicking and flinging. Experiment with these in the play area to see how they work.

run-gun-robots.intro: Run Gun Robots is an action game set on a futuristic battleground. You move through dangerous areas, take down rampaging machines, and earn currency to buy upgrades.
tips: Watch the obstacles before you commit to a move, since dodging them is as important as attacking.
Spend your earned currency on upgrades early, so you can handle the tougher challenges that come later.
Pay attention to the pattern of each robot you face, and time your attacks around its movements.
Keep your reflexes sharp as the challenges escalate, and avoid rushing into fights you are not ready for.
Listen to the music and use its rhythm as a cue to stay focused and keep your pace steady.
faq: What is the main goal in Run Gun Robots?
Your goal is to survive the futuristic battleground by navigating dangerous environments, defeating robotic foes, and dodging deadly obstacles.
How do I earn currency in the game?
You earn currency by defeating each robotic foe you vanquish. You can then use it to buy power-ups and upgrades.

your-obby-size.intro: Your Obby Size is a parkour course where you change your character's size to get past obstacles. Reach the end while avoiding lava, beating harder challenges, and finding shortcuts.
tips: Test both sizes at every new obstacle before committing, since a smaller or bigger character can fit through gaps or clear jumps that the other size cannot.
Use the camera controls early on. Zooming and rotating the view helps you judge distances and spot lava and monsters before you reach them.
Collect trophies when they are within reach. They unlock secret paths and new areas that can make later sections much easier.
Slow down near lava and guarded areas. Pause with Tab if you need a moment to plan your next jump.
Look above and around you for shortcuts to the top. Exploring a little off the main route often reveals a faster way up.
faq: What is the goal of Your Obby Size?
The goal is to get through the course to the end. You do this by jumping, running, and changing your size to clear each section.
How do I change my character's size?
Press Q or E to change size. Use WASD to move and the Space bar to jump.

royal-jewels-match.intro: Royal Jewels Match is a jewel-matching arcade game where you line up three or more jewels of the same type to clear levels and collect coins. Use those coins to decorate and earn crowns that unlock new adventures.
tips: Look for moves that line up three or more matching jewels, since that is the core action for completing each level.
Keep an eye on your coins as you go, because you need them to buy decorations.
Make a habit of checking your progress toward the next crown, since crowns unlock the next adventure.
Try the special events and surprise challenges when they appear, as they add variety to the standard matching levels.
Plan your coin spending on decorations so you keep enough progress moving toward new levels.
faq: What is the main goal of Royal Jewels Match?
The goal is to match three or more jewels of the same type to complete levels and earn coins. Your progress then unlocks new adventures.
How do I earn crowns?
You earn crowns as you progress and each time you make a purchase with your coins. Crowns help unlock the next exciting adventure.

airplane-flight-manager-game.intro: Airplane Flight Manager is a 3D flight simulator where you take off from one airport and land at another. You control the plane, fly through clouds, and complete missions to reach your destination.
tips: Take a moment to learn the controls before you start. W and the Up Arrow move the plane forward, S and the Down Arrow move it back, and A, D or the Left and Right Arrows move it sideways.
Make small, gentle inputs rather than large ones. This keeps the plane steady, especially when you are flying through clouds.
Keep your eye on the destination airport as you fly so you can line up your approach early. Correcting late tends to make landing harder.
Use the mouse for any buttons on screen, since the keyboard controls are for flying the plane.
Treat each flight as a chance to practice. Repeating a route helps you get a feel for how the plane responds.
faq: What is the goal of Airplane Flight Manager?
Your goal is to take off from one airport, complete your missions, and land safely at another airport. The game is built around flying a realistic route from start to finish.
Which keys control the plane?
Use W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use the mouse to click any buttons.

hill-climb-racings-2.intro: Hill Climb Racing 2 is an action-packed car racing game with realistic physics. You play with mouse clicks or taps, so quick, steady input matters from the start.
tips: Watch how your car sits on each slope before you commit. Realistic physics means weight and angle change how it handles.
Keep your inputs steady rather than tapping wildly. Small, controlled presses usually keep the car more stable on uneven ground.
Pay attention to the terrain ahead, not just the car under you. Spotting the next hill early gives you time to adjust.
If your car tips or loses balance, slow down and recover before pushing forward again. Pushing too hard after a wobble often leads to a crash.
Practise each track a few times to learn where the tricky bumps and climbs are. Repeat runs help you improve your timing.
faq: How do I control the car?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play, as the game instructions describe. Keep your inputs controlled so the car stays balanced on hills.
What makes this game challenging?
The realistic physics mean the car responds to slopes and bumps, so a small mistake can change how the run goes. Learning how the car handles on different terrain is the main challenge.

tank-war-simulator-game.intro: Tank War Simulator is a shooting adventure where you command heavy war tanks, aim carefully, and destroy enemy tanks across dangerous battle zones. Each level brings tougher opponents.
tips: Aim before you fire. Each shot matters, so take a moment to line up your target instead of firing rapidly.
Watch for incoming attacks and think about your position. Staying alert helps you survive enemy fire long enough to finish the fight.
Prioritize the enemy tanks that threaten you most. Removing the biggest danger first makes the rest of the battle easier.
Expect each new level to be harder. Stronger opponents appear over time, so use what you learned earlier and stay careful rather than reckless.
Use the mouse to click the on-screen buttons. Read each mission's goal before starting so you know what you need to achieve.
faq: What is my goal in Tank War Simulator?
Your mission is to aim carefully, destroy enemy tanks, survive powerful attacks, and lead your army to victory across the battle zones.
How do I control the tank?
The instructions say to click buttons with the mouse. Follow the on-screen prompts for any other actions during play.

wheelie-bike-for-2-players.intro: Wheelie Bike For 2 Players is a local two-player physics game where the Purple and Green stickmen compete to hold a wheelie the longest. Each round lasts 60 seconds, and the player with the most accumulated wheelie time wins.
tips: Keep your pressure steady rather than tapping wildly, so your bike stays balanced instead of tipping forward or backward.
Pay attention to your front wheel and make small corrections early, before the bike leans too far.
Plan your time across the full 60 seconds, since only the total accumulated wheelie time at the end decides the winner.
Watch your opponent for cues, but focus on your own balance, because a flip ends your progress more than a slower start does.
Practice a few short rounds to learn how your stickman responds to input before a serious match.
faq: How do I win a round?
The player with the highest accumulated wheelie time when the 60-second round ends is the winner.
What are the controls?
Player 1 presses W or uses the touch screen to make a wheelie, and Player 2 presses the Up arrow or uses the touch screen.

rabbit-samurai-2.intro: Rabbit Samurai 2 is an adventure game where you swing a rabbit samurai through colorful stages. Your goal is to collect every carrot while avoiding traps and keeping your timing sharp.
tips: Watch the rope swing for a few cycles before you commit, so you can judge its rhythm and where it will carry you.
Slow down near traps and plan your next swing before you move, since precision matters more than speed.
Aim for the carrots that sit on the way through a stage first, then go back for harder-to-reach ones once you know the route.
If you keep missing a section, pause and map out the path in your head, then try again with a single clear plan.
Treat each stage as a puzzle about timing: note where you lost a carrot or hit a trap, and adjust that moment on your next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Rabbit Samurai 2?
The goal is to collect every elusive carrot in each stage while avoiding tricky traps. Each level is designed to test your timing and precision.
What skill matters most in this game?
Timing is the key skill, especially when rope-swinging between points. Getting your jumps and releases at the right moment helps you reach carrots and stay clear of traps.

ace-brawl-battle-3d.intro: Ace Brawl Battle 3D is a 3D shooter set in a virtual combat arena. It rewards constant movement, smart power-up use, and well-chosen upgrades.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since the game stresses constant motion as a key to staying ahead of opponents.
Learn the layout of each battleground early so you know where to run, where to take cover, and where to flank.
Save power-ups for moments that matter most, such as a tough fight or a chance to turn the round, instead of using them as soon as you find them.
Think about which upgrades suit your style before spending them, and focus on the ones that improve the weapons you use most.
Try different advanced weapons to see which ones you handle best, then build your strategy around them.
faq: What is the main goal in Ace Brawl Battle 3D?
The game is built around outmaneuvering foes in a virtual combat arena, so your aim is to gain the upper hand over your opponents through movement, power-ups, and upgrades.
How important is movement in this game?
Constant motion is described as vital, so staying on the move makes it harder for enemies to pin you down and helps you find better positions.

let-s-kill-jeff-the-killer-jeff-s-reveng.intro: Let's Kill Jeff The Killer - Jeff's Revenge is a 3D action game where you can play as a Soldier hunting for Rusty Knifes or as Jeff The Killer, fighting soldiers to collect hearts.
tips: Try both the Soldier and Jeff The Killer stories, since each one gives a different goal and a different way to approach the level.
Use Right Mouse Button to aim when you want more accuracy, and save quick bursts of Left Mouse Button fire for close encounters.
Switch weapons with the Mouse Wheel as soon as you see a new threat, so you are not caught reloading at a bad moment.
Press R to reload while you have a safe gap, and keep an eye on your ammo before you walk into a crowded area.
Hold Left CTRL to crouch when you are sneaking around, and use Left Shift to run when you need to reach an item or get out of danger quickly.
faq: What is the goal when playing as the Soldier?
You need to find 8 of the killer's Rusty Knifes and then try to kill him. Walk around the abandoned town and check each area carefully.
What do I need to do as Jeff The Killer?
Fight the soldiers and find 8 hearts. Once you have collected them, you can open a gate to the Mystic dimension.

urban-echo.intro: Urban Echo is an action parkour game set in a city. You run, jump, and climb across rooftops while avoiding traps and keeping a fast pace. Good timing is the key to getting further.
tips: Learn the jump and double jump early, since you can use a second jump in the air to reach ledges and recover from a short fall.
Use the dash to close gaps or get past a trap quickly, and time it so you land on solid ground afterward.
Practice wall jumps on walls near the start of a run until you can bounce off them reliably before you need them on a harder section.
Watch the traps ahead of you and plan your next move before you reach them, rather than reacting at the last second.
Try to chain your moves together smoothly instead of stopping between them, because keeping momentum makes the next obstacle easier to clear.
faq: What is the main goal in Urban Echo?
You control a character who runs across rooftops and through an urban environment, overcoming obstacles and avoiding traps as you go further.
Which keys make the character jump?
Use W or the Up arrow to jump high, and press jump again in the air to double jump.

god-of-light.intro: God of Light is a puzzle game where you guide beams of light through mirrors and obstacles. Your light paths bring dormant flowers back to life, and each level has its own challenges.
tips: Before you act, study the whole level and follow where the light will travel from its source. This helps you spot the obstacles that stand in the way.
Work out which flowers you need to reach and think backward from them to the path that could get the light there.
Try your ideas one at a time, and watch how each change affects the beam so you learn what works.
Expect each level to be different, so avoid copying a solution from a previous level without checking it still fits.
If you get stuck, step away for a moment and look again with fresh eyes, since a new angle often shows an option you missed.
faq: What is the goal of God of Light?
Your goal is to guide beams of light through mirrors and obstacles so that the dormant flowers come back to life.
Do all levels have the same challenges?
No. Each level presents its own unique challenges, so you need to read each layout carefully.

mexico-rex-2.intro: Mexico Rex 2 puts you in control of a T-rex in Mexico City. You move through towns and settlements, crushing cars, collecting chilli peppers and eating humans.
tips: Pick up the chilli peppers as you go, since they are part of the main collection goal in each area.
Check the screen buttons and keyboard controls early on and choose whichever feels more comfortable before you head into busy streets.
Clear the nearby cars and people in one area before moving on, so you do not get caught out while you are busy elsewhere.
Work through the towns and settlements in order rather than wandering, so your progress through the game stays clear.
Keep an eye on your surroundings at all times, because enemies and obstacles can come from any side of the map.
faq: What is the main goal of Mexico Rex 2?
You play as a T-rex moving through different towns and settlements in Mexico City. Your aim is to destroy everything in sight, collect chilli peppers and eat as many humans as you can.
How do I control the T-rex?
You can use the keyboard or the on-screen buttons. Pick whichever input feels easier for you and practise moving before you start causing havoc.

from-nerd-to-school-popular.intro: From Nerd to School Popular is a makeover game where you dress up and style a character, moving from school outcast to center stage. You apply beauty treatments by dragging and dropping tools.
tips: Look for the glowing hints on the character's face first, since they mark exactly where a makeover is needed. Working through them one by one keeps each look organized.
Use the tutorial in the early levels to learn how each tool behaves before you start experimenting. Knowing the basics makes the later, freer levels much easier.
Once you move past the tutorial, try different combinations of makeup, hair, and accessories. Testing a few options side by side helps you find a style you like.
Keep an eye on what you unlock as you go, because new cosmetics, hairstyles, and accessories give you more ways to make your character stand out. Check your options before finalizing a look.
Think about the story of the character's change from outcast to popular while you style her. Choosing looks that match each stage of that transformation can make your choices feel more deliberate.
faq: What is the goal of From Nerd to School Popular?
The goal is to transform your character's look, moving her from a school outcast to the center of attention. You do this by completing beauty treatments and styling her appearance.
How do I apply makeup and styling in this game?
You drag and drop tools onto the character to complete each beauty treatment. The glowing hints on her face show where she needs work.

shape-transforming-shifting-run.intro: Shape Transforming: Shifting Run is a fast-paced skill game where you race across land, air, and sea. Change into the right form for each terrain to get past obstacles and keep moving.
tips: Look ahead to see what kind of terrain is coming before you commit to a form. Switching early gives you time to match the right character to the obstacles.
Think about each form's strengths. A car suits land, an airplane suits the air, and a ship suits the sea, so pick the one that fits the section you are entering.
Since the pace is quick, make your decisions early rather than waiting until an obstacle is right in front of you. Quick reflexes help most when you have already planned your next move.
Pay attention to the transitions between terrains, as these are where mistakes are most likely. Keep your eyes moving forward so you can change form in time.
Replay sections that give you trouble to learn the order of obstacles. Knowing what comes next lets you focus on timing your transformations.
faq: What is the goal of Shape Transforming: Shifting Run?
The goal is to dash through each unique terrain by transforming into the right character to navigate obstacles and keep moving forward. You are mastering land, air, and sea as you go.
Which forms do you transform into?
The game mentions a car for land, an airplane for the air, and a ship for the sea. Each form has its own strengths and challenges.

bazooka-survivors.intro: Bazooka Survivors is a bullet hell arcade shooter where you fight and survive massive hordes of enemies. Mouse click or tap to play.
tips: Watch the enemy groups as they arrive and note where the bullets are coming from before you commit to a position.
Bullet hell games reward patience, so avoid rushing into the thickest part of a horde.
Stay calm when the screen gets crowded and focus on the nearest threats first.
Try short sessions at first so you can learn how the enemy waves build up and how fast they come.
Pay attention to your own shots and clicks or taps, and aim for steady rhythm rather than frantic clicking.
faq: What is the goal of Bazooka Survivors?
The goal is to fight and survive the massive hordes of enemies that come at you. The longer you last, the more you have accomplished.
How do I control the game?
You play by mouse click or tap. The game does not describe any other controls, so the click or tap is your main input.

microplastics-feeding.intro: Microplastics Feeding is a 2D arcade game where you guide a fish through the open ocean, eating pollution while dodging obstacles. Timing and quick reactions are key.
tips: Watch the path ahead rather than just the fish, so you can spot obstacles early and plan your route around them.
Focus on timing. Move toward pollution when the path is clear, and avoid rushing into gaps you cannot safely pass.
Practice short runs first to get a feel for how your fish responds before trying to collect as much as possible.
If you miss a piece of pollution, stay calm and keep moving. Recovering smoothly is often better than chasing it into danger.
Take breaks between runs to keep your reflexes sharp, since the game rewards quick, steady decisions.
faq: What is the goal of Microplastics Feeding?
Your goal is to guide your fish through the open ocean, eating microplastics and pollution while avoiding obstacles. The game is about helping clean up the marine world with every nibble.
What skills matter most in this game?
Timing and reflexes are the main skills. Good timing helps you collect pollution safely, and quick reactions help you dodge obstacles.

bmg-crashday-2025.intro: BMG! CrashDay 2025 is an arcade racing game with lifelike physics. You choose from a range of uniquely built cars and race across tricky tracks with turns, slopes, and obstacles.
tips: Pick a car early and get used to how it handles, since each one is built differently.
Slow down before tight turns so you keep control instead of sliding wide.
Watch the slopes ahead of you and ease off the speed before a steep climb or drop.
Scan the track for unexpected obstacles and adjust your line before you reach them.
Replay tracks you find difficult, paying attention to where the physics catch you out.
faq: What is the main goal of BMG! CrashDay 2025?
The game is about racing through challenging tracks in arcade-style driving. Finishing well depends on handling turns, slopes, and obstacles with care.
How does the realistic physics affect driving?
The cars respond to speed, turns, and slopes in a lifelike way, so reckless driving tends to cause problems. Smooth, controlled driving usually works better.

spikes-and-feathers.intro: Guide a agile bird through a hand-drawn world, tapping in rhythm to dodge spikes. The challenge grows with every obstacle, so steady timing matters more than speed.
tips: Focus on rhythm rather than speed. The game rewards steady, well-timed taps more than rushing.
Watch the spikes ahead of the bird so you can start your tap before you reach the danger, not after.
Expect the challenge to rise with each obstacle. Settle into a calm, even tapping pattern early and keep it consistent.
If you make a mistake, reset your rhythm before the next obstacle instead of reacting with rapid, uneven taps.
Play in short sessions when you notice your timing slipping, since precision drops when you are tired or distracted.
faq: What is the goal of Spikes & Feathers?
You guide the bird through the hand-drawn world while avoiding spikes. The game is about mastering flight rather than moving as fast as possible.
How do the controls work?
The game is played through precision tapping, timed to the bird's movement. The page does not list detailed instructions, so watch how the bird responds in the first few obstacles.

baby-chicco-adventures.intro: Baby Chicco Adventures is a retro platformer where you guide a brave penguin through icy pixel worlds. Dodge foes, collect treasures, and use leaps and dashes to reach each level's challenges.
tips: Watch how foes move for a few seconds before you commit to a jump, so you can time your leap past them.
Use dashes to cover gaps and get past danger quickly, but plan your landing first so you do not overshoot into trouble.
Scan each level for treasures placed along side paths and high ledges, and pick up the ones you can reach safely before moving on.
Take a moment to explore when a level feels quiet, since secret wonders are often hidden off the main route.
If a section keeps defeating you, slow down and break it into smaller jumps instead of trying to clear it in one go.
faq: What is the main goal in Baby Chicco Adventures?
You guide Baby Chicco the penguin through each pixel world, dodging foes and collecting treasures while working toward the end of each level.
What moves does Baby Chicco have?
Baby Chicco can leap and dash, which you will need to clear gaps, reach higher platforms, and escape enemies.

monster-truck-simulator-game.intro: Monster Truck Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a monster truck in two modes: Demolish, where you smash everything in your path, and Stunt, where you jump and drive on tough tracks. Each mode has 10 levels.
tips: Start with Demolish Mode to get a feel for the truck's weight and handling before moving on to the more precise Stunt levels.
Before a big jump in Stunt Mode, check your landing angle and speed, since a bad landing is the most likely way to lose a run.
Use the Rewind feature as a practice tool: if a jump or smash goes wrong, rewind and try the same move with a small change rather than starting the level over.
Switch between the camera views to find the one that shows you the track ahead best, especially when you are judging distance for jumps or deciding which obstacles to hit.
Ease off the accelerator before turns and obstacles, and use the brake to stop when you need to line up a shot or a landing.
faq: How do I drive the monster truck on PC?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to steer and control the vehicle.
What is the difference between Demolish Mode and Stunt Mode?
Demolish Mode has 10 levels focused on smashing obstacles and destroying everything, while Stunt Mode has 10 levels focused on crazy jumps and impossible tracks.

roads-off-fury.intro: Roads Off Fury is an endless post-apocalyptic racing game. Pick a modified vehicle, drive through the ruins, and fight off oil-cultist scavengers who want your fuel for as long as you can last.
tips: Use ramps and hills to launch yourself over enemies, since jumping away from danger can be as useful as fighting back.
Try several vehicles early on, because each one handles differently and you'll find the driving style that suits you best.
Unlock offensive and defensive gear with a balance in mind, so your car can both hit hard and absorb damage.
Keep moving rather than stopping to trade shots, since the enemy types vary and staying mobile helps you survive longer.
Once you feel comfortable, try Smashy Mode, which removes your gear and tests your driving and combat skills on their own.
faq: What is the goal of Roads Off Fury?
The goal is to survive as long as you can while scavengers hunt to seize your fuel. The game is endless, so each run continues until you are defeated.
How do I avoid enemy attacks?
Use high lines, ramps, and hills to perform evasive acrobatic jumps that take you out of enemies' reach.

city-taxi-driving.intro: City Taxi Driving is a 3D driving game where you steer a taxi through busy city streets, pick up passengers, and drive them to their destinations. Use the keyboard to accelerate, brake, and steer through traffic.
tips: Ease off the accelerator before corners so you keep control of the car and can stay on the road.
Watch the traffic ahead and leave extra space between your car and other vehicles to avoid collisions.
Slow down early when you approach a passenger so you can stop smoothly where you need to.
Use the brake or reverse key in tight spots instead of forcing a turn, which helps you avoid getting stuck.
Keep your steering gentle on straight roads and only turn sharply when you need to, since quick jerks can cause you to swing wide.
faq: What is the goal of City Taxi Driving?
Your goal is to drive through the city, pick up passengers, and reach their destinations as a taxi driver.
Which keys control the taxi?
Use W or the Up Arrow to accelerate, S or the Down Arrow to brake or reverse, and A or D (or the Left and Right Arrows) to steer left and right.

ligmar-online.intro: Ligmar Online is a multiplayer browser MMORPG with leveling, rare loot, dungeons, and PvP. Its main draw is the people you meet, from your regular group to your rivals and guildmates.
tips: Join a guild early, since guild chat is where you hear about good loot first and where territory fights are organized.
Team up with a regular group for dungeons instead of running them alone, so you can share the workload and learn how your party works together.
Keep an eye on the gear you are chasing and look for upgrades that help you keep up with your group in dungeons and PvP.
Pay attention to your rivals' habits in PvP so you know when to press an advantage and when to back off.
Talk with your guild before fighting over territory so everyone knows the plan and who is covering each area.
faq: What is the main goal in Ligmar Online?
The game focuses on leveling up, collecting rare loot, clearing dungeons, and competing in PvP. Many players also work with a guild to fight for territory.
How do I control my character?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. The game is designed to be controlled through clicking or tapping.

mega-parkour-obby-escape-run.intro: Mega Parkour: Obby Escape Run is a running and parkour game with obby challenges across several maps and platforms, including a prison tower. Its controls are simple, so you can start jumping right away.
tips: Learn the basic jump and run moves on the first levels before you try the harder ones. Good timing on simple jumps makes the later obstacles much easier.
Look at each platform's layout before you move. Spotting the next landing spot early helps you plan the jump instead of reacting too late.
Take your time on the prison tower and other tricky maps. Slowing down for a few seconds to check the route is often faster than repeating a fall.
Switch your focus between levels when one feels stuck. The levels vary in style, so a fresh map can help you come back to the difficult one with new ideas.
Try different parkour gear and themes to find a look you enjoy. Picking a setup that feels comfortable can make the game more fun to keep playing.
faq: What is the main goal in Mega Parkour: Obby Escape Run?
You move through parkour and obby challenges across different maps and platforms. Each level tests your jumping and running skills as you work through the course.
How do I get better at the jumps?
Practice the basic moves on the early levels until they feel natural. Watching the platforms carefully before each jump also helps you land more reliably.

merge-elementals-castle-defense.intro: Merge Elementals: Castle Defense is a merge and tower defense puzzler where you combine matching elementals to build stronger fighters and defend your wall. Plan your line-up between waves, then use your spells to hold the horde back.
tips: Gold only buys tier one fighters, so treat higher tiers as something you earn by merging. Spend gold on the basics and save your grid space for combinations.
Grid space is limited, so before each merge check whether the result will help you more than the two fighters you are giving up. Avoid filling the grid with fighters you cannot merge further.
Merging locks once combat starts, so finish all your merges and rearrangements during the prep phase. Your fighters act on their own during a wave.
Pick your three battle spells with the enemy in mind. Fireball and meteor shower suit groups, while chain lightning and frost storm can help when the horde is spread out.
Use the gaps between waves to level up your magic, since your spells are your main way to act during combat. Check the boss wave at the end of each world and prepare for it in advance.
faq: How do I merge elementals?
Drag two identical elementals of the same type and tier onto each other, and they fuse into the next tier. Merging is only possible during the prep phase.
What can I do during a wave?
Your fighters aim and shoot automatically, so your main job is to cast your spells on time and keep the wall standing. Merging is locked during combat.

geometry-black-wave.intro: Geometry: Black Wave is a musical platformer where you steer a small arrow through obstacles toward the finish line. Timing your holds and releases to the soundtrack is the key skill.
tips: Tap and hold for short bursts instead of one long press, since holding longer raises the wave higher and it can climb into the wall.
Watch the wave's height after each hold and release so you can anticipate the ground and the next obstacle before you reach it.
Start with a level whose difficulty emoji is easiest, and move to harder levels only after you can keep the wave steady through the whole route.
Listen to each level's music, because the soundtrack is synchronized with the gameplay and can help you time your movements.
Expect to lose and retry, since touching any spike, block, or other obstacle ends the attempt, and practice is how you learn each level's layout.
faq: What is the goal of Geometry: Black Wave?
Your goal is to ride the wave past obstacles like spikes and blocks to reach the finish line of each level. Reaching the end completes the level and earns a high score.
How do I control the wave?
Tap and hold the screen to move up, and the longer you hold, the higher the wave rises until it reaches the wall. Release the screen to move downward until the wave reaches the ground.

head-the-ball.intro: Head the Ball is a soccer game built around headers, timing, and reading your opponents. This guide covers practical habits to help you win more matches.
tips: Watch where the opponents are moving before you commit to a header, since anticipating their next move is central to the game.
Time your jumps and headers carefully rather than rushing them, because precise timing is what turns a header into a real scoring chance.
Look for teammates who are in good positions and pass or set them up, since creating opportunities for others is part of winning.
Spend part of each match focusing on defense, staying between the ball and your goal so you can stop attacks before they build.
Keep an eye on the flow of the match and adjust your approach when the opponent changes tactics, rather than repeating the same move.
faq: What is the main goal of Head the Ball?
The goal is to win soccer matches by using headers to score and to defend well enough to keep the opponent from scoring. The description focuses on timing, strategy, and precise strikes.
Which controls should I use?
The game description does not list specific controls, so check any on-screen prompts or the menu when you start a match to see how to move and head the ball.

stickman-fights.intro: Stickman Fights is a one-on-one stick figure brawler. You control a fighter, move around with the keyboard, and attack with the mouse to defeat an online opponent and win a cash prize.
tips: Use A and D to space yourself before you commit to an attack. Staying just out of your opponent's reach lets you pick the moment to strike.
Mix your attacks. Left mouse kicks and right mouse punches have different timing, so alternate them rather than repeating one button.
Use W to jump away from danger or to change the angle of your attack, but avoid jumping in a predictable pattern your opponent can wait for.
Think about your bet before each fight. A higher bet means a bigger reward, so only raise it when you feel confident in your fighting.
Save your winnings for skins if you enjoy customizing your fighter, since the dollars you earn can be spent on new looks.
faq: How do I win a fight?
You win by defeating your online opponent in the battle. Keep attacking with punches and kicks while watching for openings.
Which buttons do I use to attack?
Left mouse button is for kicks and right mouse button is for punches. Use A and D to move and W to jump.

build-a-rollercoaster-simulator.intro: Build Rollercoaster: Simulator is a tycoon game where you buy tracks, construct your own roller coasters, and ride them to earn currency. Your goal is to grow the longest coasters you can.
tips: Spend your first earnings on track pieces that let you extend your current coaster, since a longer ride is the main goal.
Upgrade tracks once your income is steady, so each ride brings in more currency over time.
Save up for rare tracks rather than buying every cheap option, because they can help you build longer and more unusual coasters.
Ride your tracks regularly, since riding is how you earn currency and keep your income coming in.
Plan your layout before you spend, so each new section connects cleanly and you don't waste currency on pieces you can't use.
faq: How do I earn in-game currency?
You earn currency by riding your roller coasters, and your rides generate income over time.
What should I spend currency on first?
Start with track pieces to extend your coaster, then put money into upgrades once your income is steady.

money-rush.intro: Money Rush is an arcade game about picking the right gates to build your fortune. Each choice affects how quickly your wealth grows, so quick, sensible decisions matter.
tips: Compare the multipliers on the gates before you pick one, and go for the highest value you can see.
Stay focused on each decision, since the game tests how quickly you can judge your options.
Think about how each gate affects your total, because the multipliers build on one another and small early choices add up.
Don't rush every choice blindly. Pausing for a moment on the gates that look similar can help you avoid a weak pick.
Play a few rounds to get a feel for how the gates are arranged and how fast the decisions come, then adjust your pace.
faq: What is the goal of Money Rush?
The goal is to collect as much fortune as you can by choosing gates with the highest multipliers. The game is built around simple decisions that lead to larger riches.
How should I choose which gate to pass through?
Look for the gate with the highest multiplier and choose it when you can. Quick, clear comparisons between the options will usually lead to the best results.

zombie-space-episode-ii.intro: Zombie Space Episode II is a shooting game set on a space station where a zombie virus has broken out. Fight through the horde, search for hidden weapons, and look for survivors among the zombies.
tips: Open the chests you pass to find new weapons, and switch between them with Q (or K) to match the threat in front of you.
Spend your upgrades on the weapon you use most often, since a stronger main gun helps you through the whole fight.
Use your character's abilities with E (or M) during the hardest moments, such as when a crowd closes in or a strong enemy appears.
Save your super weapon with F (or J) for groups of zombies or tough monsters rather than using it on single targets.
If you play with a friend on the same device, split the work: one player can focus on moving and collecting weapons while the other handles shooting.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Space Episode II?
Your goal is to destroy all zombies and monsters on the space station. Along the way, you also look for survivors among the zombies.
How do I shoot and move?
Move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. Shoot with X, Space, L or KeyPad 0, and use the mouse to look around and shoot.

novice-fisherman.intro: Novice Fisherman is a fishing game where strategy and skill decide how well you do. You steer through dangerous water, reel in catches, and try to avoid sharks.
tips: Watch the water before you cast so you know where the sharks are moving and can plan your route around them.
Take your time with each catch rather than rushing, since good timing and steady control are what keep a fish on the line.
Pay attention to how your previous attempts went and adjust your approach if a certain area keeps costing you a catch.
Use your earnings to upgrade your gear when you can, since better equipment is part of how you get ahead of the competition.
Keep your sessions short at first and focus on one improvement at a time, such as safer routes or more reliable reeling.
faq: What is the main goal of Novice Fisherman?
The goal is to reel in impressive catches while navigating dangerous waters and staying away from lurking sharks. Your strategy and skill decide how far you get.
How do I avoid losing a catch to sharks?
Keep an eye on where the sharks are and choose your moves to stay clear of them. Slowing down to plan a safer path often beats rushing for a bigger catch.

cat-life-simulator-devil-cat.intro: Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat puts you in the paws of a mischievous cat causing chaos in Grandma's house. You explore a 3D home from a first-person view, making messes to rack up points.
tips: Keep track of where Granny is before you start a new prank, since she is the main threat to your run.
Plan a route that moves you through several rooms, so you can keep making messes without standing still for long.
Look for items that sit high up, like those on tables and shelves, and tackle them when you have room to escape.
Scratch walls and break items as you pass them, rather than saving everything for one spot, to keep your score climbing.
Stay on the move after each mess. Pausing in one place gives Granny time to catch up with you.
faq: What is the main goal of Cat Life Simulator: Devil Cat?
Your goal is to cause as much mayhem as you can in Grandma's house by scratching walls, breaking items and knocking things over. The bigger the mess, the higher your score.
How do I keep Granny from stopping me?
Stay on the move and avoid being caught while you continue your pranks. Keeping track of her position helps you choose where to go next.

fun-ragdoll-challenge-mini-games-collect.intro: Fun Ragdoll Challenge! Mini Games Collection! is a set of short ragdoll stickman challenges in a 3D physics playground. Each mini-game asks you to attack, throw, shoot or break things with accuracy.
tips: Look at the objects around the ragdolls before you act, since the description says they can help you complete a level.
Pause to choose your target before each click or tap, because each level rewards accuracy more than speed.
If a level stalls, switch tactics instead of repeating the same move. The game encourages trying different approaches on harder levels.
Treat failed attempts as part of the fun. Watching how the ragdoll physics react can show you what to change next time.
Try each mini-game in the collection to find which style suits you, from boxing and shooting to knife throwing and syringe attacks.
faq: What is the goal of Fun Ragdoll Challenge! Mini Games Collection!?
Your goal is to complete all the mini-challenges by destroying enemies, activating traps and performing tricks. The levels get harder and more fun the further you go.
How do I control the action on a computer?
Left-click on the point where you want to attack, throw or break something.

sausage-man.intro: Sausage Man is a running game where you guide a hot dog along an endless path. Pick your sausage, dodge hazards, and collect coins to spend on powerups.
tips: Grab coins whenever they are safe to reach, since they are what you need to buy buns of steel and other powerups.
Watch the path ahead rather than just your current position, so you have time to react to slicing, chopping, burning and smashing hazards.
Try a few different sausages and hot dog skins to see which feels easiest to control for your play style.
Save your coins for the powerups that help you most, rather than spending them as soon as you collect them.
Keep your pace steady and avoid rushing into gaps, because the endless path gets harder to read when you panic.
faq: What is the goal of Sausage Man?
Run along the endless path as far as you can while avoiding getting sliced, chopped, burned or smashed.
How do I get powerups?
Collect coins as you run, then use them to buy buns of steel and other powerups.

mountain-tank.intro: Mountain Tank is an adventure game where you command massive tanks across dangerous terrain. Success depends on quick reactions and careful planning in each battle.
tips: Read the terrain before you move, since rough ground and steep areas are central to the challenge.
Watch your reflexes during battles and avoid rushing into fights without a plan.
Think a few steps ahead, because strategy matters as much as fast reactions.
Pay attention to the upgrades you earn and choose the ones that suit how you like to fight.
Stay focused during combat, as small mistakes can have a big effect on how a battle turns out.
faq: What is the main goal in Mountain Tank?
You command massive tanks through difficult terrain and win battles by combining sharp reflexes with strategic thinking.
How do I get stronger in Mountain Tank?
The game includes unique upgrades that can improve your tank during battles, so it helps to use them wisely.

super-buddy-archer.intro: Super Buddy Archer is a shooting puzzle game where you aim arrows to cut the ropes holding Buddy's friends. Each level has a limited number of arrows, so every shot counts.
tips: Before you fire, look at the whole level and find which rope or object you need to deal with first. Your arrows are limited, so plan a route rather than shooting at random.
In levels where the angle matters, try a test shot or two to see how the arrow travels before committing to a final shot.
Watch for dynamite. Its explosion can free the characters without needing a direct hit on each rope, so aim to set off the blast near them.
Think about ricochet shots. Bouncing an arrow off a surface can reach ropes that a straight shot cannot, so check the angles around the level.
Be careful with your aim near the characters. The game asks you not to hurt them too much, so keep your shots clear of them where you can.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Aim and shoot arrows to cut the ropes that hold Buddy's friends, freeing them within the arrows you have.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use the mouse to aim and click to shoot on a computer, or touch the screen to aim and release on a touch device.

trend-family-merge-arena.intro: Trend Family: Merge Arena is a puzzle game where you merge trendy characters into stronger fighters and place them on the battlefield to defeat the enemy army. Your placement decides the outcome, so planning matters before each fight.
tips: Plan your formation before you press start, since the battle runs automatically and only your placement is under your control.
Mix close-range and long-range fighters so your front line can hold while your back line deals damage.
Look at the elements of each fighter and place units so their strengths cover the enemy's weak spots.
Merge two identical characters whenever you can, because a stronger fighter often makes a bigger difference than adding a weaker one.
Claim your daily rewards and open chests regularly, then spend coins and crystals on upgrading heroes you already use.
faq: How do I win a battle in Trend Family: Merge Arena?
Your goal is to defeat the enemy army and advance further. Place your units on the battlefield before the fight, then press start, because the outcome is decided by your placement.
How do I merge characters?
Drag two identical characters onto the same cell to create a stronger one. Merging is the main way to make your team more powerful.

draw-one-part-brain-puzzle.intro: Draw One Part: Brain Puzzle is a puzzle game where each level shows an incomplete picture. You solve it by drawing the missing part, using logic and creativity.
tips: Study the whole picture before you draw anything. Look for the shape or direction the missing piece needs to follow.
Check how the existing lines end and where they would naturally connect. The missing part usually continues one of those lines.
Keep your first stroke simple and clear, then adjust. Trying to get everything perfect on the first attempt can slow you down.
If you are stuck, step back and look at the picture from a different angle in your mind. Puzzles like this often hinge on a shape you missed at first.
Play one level at a time and do not rush. Taking a short moment to think often works better than quick guesses.
faq: What is the goal of Draw One Part: Brain Puzzle?
Each level shows an incomplete picture, and your goal is to draw the missing part so the puzzle is solved.
How do I control the game?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Click or tap to draw the missing part on the screen.

skate-1-speed.intro: SKATE: +1 Speed is a skateboarding parkour runner where your speed keeps building the longer you stay on the board. Jump traps, stay on the platforms, and push for faster times and records.
tips: Use the early part of each course to get a feel for the controls, since the game gets harder to control as your speed climbs.
Plan your jumps a moment ahead rather than reacting at the last second, especially over traps near the edge of platforms.
Spend your coins on skateboard upgrades that improve acceleration if you find you are slowing down before obstacles.
Watch for side routes and hidden paths, which the game says can hold extra rewards, and they may help you save time.
Try a course several times and focus on one section at a time, then combine the clean sections into a full run for better records.
faq: What is the main goal of SKATE: +1 Speed?
Your main goal is to become the fastest skater by completing the obstacle courses and speed challenges. Going further in a run makes you faster.
How do I jump and move on PC?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move your character and press the Spacebar to jump. Right-click and drag to rotate the camera.

dinosaur-bone-game.intro: Dinosaur Bone Game is a puzzle game where you play as an explorer digging for hidden fossils. Collect the bones you find and work to complete dinosaur skeletons.
tips: Dig slowly and carefully, since the game rewards careful digging over rushing. Take a moment to look at each spot before you click.
Keep track of which bones you already have so you can spot the pieces that are still missing from each skeleton.
Focus on finishing one skeleton at a time rather than scattering your digging across the whole area.
Use the mouse for every action, because all of the game's buttons are operated by clicking.
If you get stuck, step back and scan the area again, as hidden fossils can be easy to overlook at first glance.
faq: What is the goal of Dinosaur Bone Game?
Your goal is to search for hidden fossils, dig them out carefully, and collect dinosaur bones. Completing skeletons is how you uncover the mysteries of the prehistoric world.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse to click any button in the game. There are no other controls mentioned in the instructions.

formula-car-race.intro: Formula Car Race is a browser racing game where you drive a formula car, control your speed and steer through the turns to reach the finish first. Use the arrow keys to accelerate, brake and steer.
tips: Ease off the accelerator before a corner rather than braking hard in the middle of it, so the car stays stable through the turn.
Use the Down Arrow to brake early enough to take a corner smoothly instead of braking late and sliding wide.
Make small left and right steering adjustments instead of sharp jerks, which can throw the car off line.
Learn the shape of the track on your first lap, then push harder on the straights and take more care in the turns.
Keep your speed under control; going flat out into every bend usually costs more time than it saves.
faq: What is the goal of Formula Car Race?
Your aim is to race your formula car toward victory by controlling your speed and mastering the turns. The description invites you to become a racing champion.
Which keys control the car?
The Up Arrow accelerates, the Down Arrow brakes or reverses, and the Left and Right Arrows steer the car left and right.

fruits-shooter-pop-master.intro: Fruits Shooter Pop Master is an arcade skill game about popping colorful fruit clusters before time runs out. Patterns grow harder as you go, and power-ups can help you build combos.
tips: Scan the whole cluster before you act. Look for the group that will clear the most fruit in one go, not just the closest one.
Keep an eye on the timer from the start. Pop the fruit that is running out of room or time first so the board does not get crowded.
Expect the patterns to change. Pause for a moment at each new layout to find the best order of shots before you commit.
Save power-ups for tougher layouts where a single special effect can clear several clusters. Using them on an easy board often wastes them.
