Scan a few car lengths ahead rather than just the car directly in front of you. Spotting gaps early gives you time to steer calmly.
Spend your early coins on a supercar only after you have a feel for the traffic. Pay attention to how each car's handling and speed differ before choosing one.
Use the daily challenges as a focus goal for a session. Working toward one target can keep your attention on safe driving.
Take short breaks when your reflexes start to slip. Since a single mistake ends the run, staying sharp matters more than playing long sessions.
faq: What is the main goal in Car Rush?
Survive as long as you can on the endless highway without making a mistake. Each run ends after one mistake, so the goal is to keep your car out of trouble for as long as possible.
How do I steer my car?
Tap and hold the left side of the screen to steer left, or the right side to steer right. Release your hold to center the car again.

candy-mahjong-3d.intro: Candy Mahjong 3D is a 3D matching puzzle where you clear the board by pairing identical candy tiles. Rotate and zoom the scene to find hidden matches as the layouts grow more complex.
tips: Rotate the board before picking a tile to check whether any matching candy is hidden behind or under other pieces.
Start with tiles near the top or edges of the stack, since clearing them can reveal the tiles beneath.
Use zoom to focus on one area at a time, then zoom out to scan the whole board for pairs you might have missed.
Before you tap, think about which tiles will become free after you remove the pair, so you do not block your next moves.
If you get stuck, rotate the scene to a new angle; a different view often makes a matching pair easier to spot.
faq: How do I select and remove a pair of tiles?
Tap or click one candy tile, then find its identical match and select it. Both tiles are removed when they match.
What is the goal of Candy Mahjong 3D?
The goal is to clear all tiles from the board by matching identical pairs.

tall-io.intro: Tall.io is a multiplayer stickman game where you grow taller by collecting items and fight other players across islands. This guide covers the controls, what to collect, and how to use swords and armor.
tips: Use the arrow keys or WASD to move around the arena early on, and pick up the collectibles you pass on the way rather than detouring far for them.
Keep an eye on your height compared to nearby players, since size is what you are building toward and what determines how you match up in fights.
Save the spacebar smash for moments when an opponent is close and in range, so you do not waste attacks swinging at empty space.
Think about when to equip or use the swords and armor you collect, because they are meant to be used strategically rather than all at once.
Check the area around you before moving to a new island, and keep moving if other players gather nearby to avoid being caught while you are growing.
faq: What is the main goal in Tall.io?
Your goal is to collect cubes, coins, and bricks scattered around the arena so you increase in height. Growing taller also makes you stronger in battles against other players.
Which keys control the stickman?
You can use the arrow keys or the WASD keys to move your stickman around the arena. The spacebar is used to attack or smash opponents.

choo-choo-charles-revenge.intro: Choo Choo Charles Revenge is a horror shooter survival game where a demonic train hunts anyone in its path. Your goal is to complete each level and destroy the train by finding keys and shooting enemies.
tips: Keep moving around the map instead of standing still, since the goal is to avoid being caught.
Hold Shift to run when you need to get away quickly, and save it for moments when enemies are close.
Use Ctrl to crouch and Spacebar to jump when you need to change position or get past obstacles.
Look for the keys on each map early, and follow the steps in order so you do not fall behind on the level goal.
Use the mouse to move the camera often so you always know where enemies are coming from before you aim with right click.
faq: What is the main goal of Choo Choo Charles Revenge?
Complete each level and destroy the demonic train. You do this by searching for keys on each map, following the steps, and shooting your enemies.
Which keys control movement?
Move with the arrow keys or the WASD keys. Hold Shift to run, press Spacebar to jump, and press Ctrl to crouch.

ragdoll-show-throw-break-and-destroy.intro: Ragdoll Show is a physics sandbox where you drag a ragdoll character into objects and watch how it reacts. The game mixes casual puzzle challenges with destruction in a realistic doll simulator.
tips: Try a few different objects before settling on one, since each one produces a different reaction when the ragdoll hits it.
Change the angle of your throw or drop. The same object can cause much more damage from a different direction.
Watch how the ragdoll falls and bounces after each hit so you can predict where the next impact will happen.
Treat the puzzle challenges as experiments: note what worked and repeat the approach that caused the most damage.
Keep sessions short and try one new setup at a time so you can clearly see which change made the difference.
faq: What is the goal of Ragdoll Show?
The goal is to throw, break and destroy the ragdoll by dragging it onto different objects and watching the chaos that follows. The game also includes logical puzzle challenges.
How do I control the ragdoll?
Drag the character onto objects in the scene. Release it to send it into the object and see what happens.

perfect-snipe-online.intro: Perfect Snipe Online is a long-range shooting game where you aim at moving targets, account for obstacles, and try to build up your score across levels.
tips: Hold your aim steady on the target before you release, since the shot fires only when you let go of the mouse or touch.
Watch how the target moves for a moment before you shoot, and aim slightly ahead of where it is heading.
On levels with obstacles or moving objects, check whether they block your line of fire before you take the shot.
If a shot misses, pay attention to where the bullet landed relative to the target and adjust your next aim to correct for it.
Collect different weapons when you can, and switch to the one that suits the distance and movement of the targets in the level.
faq: How do I shoot in Perfect Snipe Online?
Use the mouse to aim and release the click to shoot. On a touchscreen, touch the screen to aim and release to fire.
How do I get a higher score?
Hit the moving targets accurately and complete each level, since your score builds up as you progress through the game.

egg-clicker.intro: Egg Clicker is an action game about building an egg collection. Tap to gather eggs, invest in upgrades, and explore the game's mechanics to see how large your collection can grow.
tips: Tap steadily at the start, since the eggs you gather early pay for your first investments.
Save up and buy upgrades as soon as you can afford them, because they are what help your collection grow faster over time.
Compare the upgrades before you buy. A cheaper option may be the better choice early on.
Check back after you have been away, since the game includes offline progress and your collection can keep growing.
Try the different mechanics the game introduces instead of sticking to one approach, so you can find what works best for you.
faq: How do I play Egg Clicker?
Tap to gather eggs, then use your eggs to invest in upgrades. Repeat this loop to grow your collection.
Does my progress continue when I leave the game?
Yes. The game includes offline progress, so your collection can keep growing while you are away.

dinosaur-rampage.intro: Dinosaur Rampage is a 3D city-smashing action game where you stomp and smash your way through the streets. Click or tap to play, then climb the leaderboard against other dinosaurs in the same arena.
tips: Destruction performance decides your rank, so think about what you wreck, not only how fast you move. Keep an eye on which areas of the city give you the most damage.
Try different dinosaur types when you unlock them. Each one may suit a different style of play, so switch up your pick to see what works best for you.
Check the shop for skins if you want to customize your dinosaur. Save up for the ones you like rather than spending on the first option you see.
Play in short sessions to stay focused on the rampage. Taking a break between rounds can help you notice where you lost time or missed good targets.
Watch the other dinosaurs in the arena to see how they are scoring. Use their approach as a guide for where to head next and what to target.
faq: What is the goal of Dinosaur Rampage?
The goal is to cause as much destruction as you can during the rampage. When it ends, you are ranked against other dinosaurs in the same arena.
How do I control my dinosaur?
You play with mouse clicks or taps. Use clicks or taps to stomp, smash, and climb through the city.

knifer.intro: Knifer is an arcade game about precision and timing. Throw your knife at floating faces to clear the path and build up a high score.
tips: Take your time before each throw, since a miss can end the run.
Focus on timing your throw to the moment the target lines up, rather than rushing.
Try to hit targets in a row, because consecutive hits are what raise your score.
Watch the path of the floating faces so you can plan which target to clear next.
Treat each throw as a deliberate choice; steady, careful play tends to beat quick, careless attempts.
faq: What is the goal of Knifer?
Throw your knife at the floating faces to clear the path, and try to build a high score.
How do I increase my score?
Hit consecutive targets in a row to boost your score.

mystery-squishy-dumpling-blind-box.intro: Mystery Squishy Dumpling Blind Box is a collecting game where you open mystery boxes to find squishy dumplings of different rarities. Your goal is to fill every empty slot in your collection.
tips: Try all four box types rather than sticking to one, since each opening is a new chance to discover characters you are missing.
Keep an eye on which slots are still empty so you can tell at a glance which dumplings you still need.
Compare the rarity of each dumpling you get, so you know which finds are the common ones you already have plenty of and which are worth celebrating.
Open boxes steadily rather than rushing, because the more boxes you open, the more chances you have to fill the remaining gaps.
Be patient with the last few slots, since the rarest dumplings can take longer to show up and finishing the full collection takes time.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to open boxes, collect dumplings of every rarity, and fill every empty slot until your collection is complete.
How do I get dumplings?
Choose one of the four box types and open it to receive a random squishy dumpling, which may be common, rare, epic or highly valuable.

12-minibattles-two-players.intro: 12 MiniBattles is a two-player arcade game where a spinner picks a new pixel-art mini game each round, ranging from sports to zany duels. Each round is short, so you can switch between skill and quick thinking fast.
tips: Expect a different style every round, so stay flexible instead of trying to master one game.
Since each mini game is designed to be easy to learn, watch the opening moments of a new round to pick up its goal before you commit.
Keep both reflexes and planning in mind: react quickly to what is on screen, but also think a step ahead when the game gives you room to plan.
Play several rounds in a row to get comfortable with the spinner's variety, and use the early rounds to see which kinds of games suit your style.
Compete in a relaxed way with your partner, since the mix of sports and duels makes it easy for either player to win a round.
faq: How many players does 12 MiniBattles need?
It is built for two players competing against each other. The game is designed around head-to-head rounds.
How is the next mini game chosen?
A whimsical spinner decides which of the 12 mini games you play next. You do not pick the game yourself.

makeup-artist-fashion-salon.intro: Makeup Artist Fashion Salon is a dress-up and decorating game where you apply makeup, hairstyles and jewelry to create looks. You can pick from several themes, including cloud, butterfly, rainbow, Christmas and Halloween.
tips: Start with foundation so the rest of the makeup has an even base to sit on.
Choose a theme first, such as butterfly or Halloween, and let it guide your color choices for eyes, lips and accessories.
Keep eye makeup and lipstick in matching or contrasting tones so the face looks balanced rather than overloaded.
Try the necklace and earrings last, and pick a pair that suits the hairstyle you chose.
Try a few different designs before settling on one, since the game offers many styles to compare.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
The goal is to create a makeup and fashion look you like, using the cosmetics, hairstyle and jewelry on offer. There is no fixed target described, so you decide when your design is finished.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to select items and apply them. The same input works for choosing colors, styles and accessories.

dream-football-game.intro: Dream Football Strike is a soccer game where you control a striker, aim your shots, and try to score goals and lead your team to victory. It includes penalty kicks, free kicks, and fast-paced matches.
tips: Use short passes with N when a teammate is close and nearby, since they keep the ball moving and are easier to control than a long pass.
Save M for long passes when the defense is pushed up and there is open space ahead of your teammates.
Use K to sprint when you have a clear run toward goal, but ease off when you need precise control near defenders.
Move with WASD or the arrow keys to get your body into a good position before pressing Space, so your shot has room to go where you want.
In penalty and free kick situations, take a moment to line up your angle before shooting, since these set pieces are where a well-placed shot can make the biggest difference.
faq: What is the goal of Dream Football Strike?
Your goal is to aim your shots, score goals, and lead your team to victory in football matches.
Which keys control passing and shooting?
Press N for a short pass, M for a long pass, and Space to shoot. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move your character.

snake-of-bullets-collect-and-shoot.intro: Snake of Bullets is a shooting game where you steer a snake made of bullets, collecting ammo and firing at walls. It blends snake, shooter, and runner ideas into one short, relaxed session.
tips: Look ahead and pick the route that lets you reach upgraded bullets before the snake reaches traps or saws.
Keep your snake long, because the more bullets in the stack, the more points you earn.
Plan your path so the snake passes through gun-loading spots, since loaded weapons help you clear walls in your way.
Avoid obstacles where you can, because hitting one costs you a few bullets and shortens your stack.
Move your finger or cursor smoothly rather than in sharp jerks so the snake stays on the route you chose.
faq: How do I control the snake?
Swipe your finger or move your mouse cursor across the screen so the snake follows the route you want. The snake moves along the path you draw.
How do I score points?
The longer the stack of bullets, the more points you get. Keeping your snake long is the main way to build your score.

trash-master.intro: Trash Master puts you in charge of a waste recycling plant, where you set up conveyors, presses, shredders and sorting lines. Your job is to keep the factory running smoothly and efficiently.
tips: Keep the conveyor moving at all times, since stopping it is the main thing the game asks you to avoid.
Watch where material piles up or gets lost, and adjust your setup early so losses stay as low as possible.
Plan the order of your machines so waste flows from one stage to the next without jams or backtracking.
Think of each mechanism as part of one line: a fast shredder is only useful if the sorting and pressing after it can keep up.
Use WASD for precise control on a computer, or a steady finger motion on a phone, so you can react quickly when the line changes.
faq: What is the main goal in Trash Master?
You manage a recycling plant and aim to process waste with maximum speed and minimal losses. The conveyor should keep running without stopping.
What counts as success in the game?
Success means processing material efficiently, which the game describes as fast work, low losses and a conveyor that never stops. Focus on those three points.

minibattles-2-3-4-5-6-player-games.intro: MiniBattles is a multiplayer arcade collection of minigames for up to six players. Each battle is all against all, and only one player wins each round.
tips: Before the first battle, have each player find their own key so nobody has to learn controls mid-game.
Seat players so that no one's keys are hard to reach, since every player relies on a single button.
Play a series of battles rather than one, because the on-screen counter tracks who has the most wins over time.
Try several different minigames to see which ones suit your group's reflexes and which ones favour certain players.
Keep a quick rota of who starts each game so that the same player does not always get the first turn.
faq: How many people can play at once?
Up to 6 players can play at the same time, each using their own key.
What are the controls?
This is a one-button game. Player 1 uses C, Player 2 uses N, Player 3 uses P, Player 4 uses Q, Player 5 uses the Left key, and Player 6 uses the Right key.

stickman-3d-legacy-of-war.intro: Stickman 3D Legacy of War is a strategy game where you lead a stickman army across varied maps in 3D battles. Winning depends on planning, managing resources, and upgrading your units.
tips: Before each battle, look at the map layout and think about where your army can gain an advantage, since the game asks you to adapt to varied maps.
Spend resources carefully rather than all at once, so you still have enough to respond when enemies push back.
Mix different types of units instead of relying on one kind, because the game rewards diversity in your army.
Choose unit upgrades that cover your weak spots, especially after a fight shows you which enemies are giving you trouble.
Pay attention to how powerful enemies behave early in a campaign so you can prepare a counter instead of reacting too late.
faq: What is the main goal of Stickman 3D Legacy of War?
The goal is to lead your stickman army to victory in strategy-driven battles across different maps. Planning and outsmarting stronger enemies are central to winning.
How important are resources in this game?
Resources are a key part of the strategy, so you need to decide how to spend them wisely. Holding some back can help you respond to changing battles.

supermarket-simulator-dream-store.intro: Supermarket Simulator Dream Store is a management game where you grow a small shop into a busy supermarket. You decorate the store, build your team, and handle orders and discounts day by day.
tips: Decorate with the customer in mind, since the description says the goal is to captivate shoppers. Try a layout change and see whether more people stay and browse.
Hire and train staff early so the store keeps running smoothly as customer numbers grow. A small team that is well trained can be more useful than a large one that is not.
Place orders carefully so you have what shoppers want without tying up money in products that sit unsold. Check which items are selling before you reorder.
Use discounts deliberately rather than all the time. Test a discount on a few products and compare the results to see whether it actually brings in more profit.
Reinvest in the shop step by step. Spend on upgrades that help you scale up, and keep a little money in reserve so one slow day does not stall your progress.
faq: How do I make more money in Dream Store?

Focus on keeping the shop stocked with what customers want, pricing with discounts in mind, and growing the store step by step. Profit comes from managing orders and discounts well as the shop expands.
Should I expand quickly or slowly?
Expanding slowly and steadily is usually safer, because each new area or hire adds costs as well as income. Only scale up when your current shop is performing well.

chicken-merge.intro: Chicken Merge is a puzzle game that mixes merging with tower defense. You train chickens, combine matching ones into stronger units, and place them to hold back waves of enemies.
tips: Merge as often as you can. Two identical chickens fuse into a stronger one, so keeping duplicates of the same level lets you build up your strongest units faster.
Clear each wave to earn coins. Coins pay for training new units, so finishing waves quickly keeps your army growing.
Put your most elite units in the defense positions, since those are the ones that attack the enemies. Keep weaker units in reserve until they are merged up.
Move units between slots by dragging them, so you can rearrange your lineup before starting the next mission.
Spend coins on new units only when you have a plan for where they will merge or sit on the defense line, so your slots do not fill up with unmatched chickens.
faq: What is the goal of Chicken Merge?
Your goal is to deploy chickens to protect your base from waves of enemies. Start the mission and clear each wave to keep the base safe.
How do I merge chickens?
Drag and drop two chickens of the same level onto each other to fuse them into a stronger chicken. The new chicken can then be dragged onto the defense lines.

drive-car.intro: Drive Car is a skill game where you steer a car over tricky roads, collect stars, and reach the finish line without flipping over. Each level has different terrain that tests your reflexes and control.
tips: Ease off on rough or uneven ground and steer gently so the car stays level instead of tipping.
Before a bumpy section, look ahead and choose your direction early rather than correcting at the last second.
Grab stars when they are on your route, but don't risk a flip just to reach one that sits far off the path.
Learn how the car handles on each new terrain type, since the same input can feel different on different surfaces.
If your car flips, restart the level and focus on a steady, controlled approach for the tricky parts.
faq: What is the goal of Drive Car?
Your goal is to drive the car along each road, collect stars, and reach the finish line safely. Avoiding obstacles and staying upright matters as much as speed.
How do I control the car?
Use the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys to move. Small, steady inputs usually give you better control than holding a key down.

ninja-in-cape.intro: Ninja in Cape is an arcade action game with 20 levels. You fight foes with a range of weapons and use your cape to get past unique challenges.
tips: Read each level before you commit to a fight, so you can spot the foes and hazards you will face.
Try different weapons to find which ones suit your style, since the game offers an array of them.
Use your cape's abilities to get out of tight spots rather than trading hits with every enemy.
Balance agility and strategy: move to reposition first, then attack when you have a clear opening.
Expect each level to present a new challenge, so stay flexible and adjust your approach when something unfamiliar appears.
faq: What is the goal of Ninja in Cape?
Work through 20 levels by battling foes and overcoming the challenges in each one. The game rewards agility and strategy over simply rushing ahead.
How do I use the cape?
The game describes the cape as a mysterious tool that helps you overcome challenges. Try it in different situations to learn what it can do for you.

supercars-zombie-driving-2.intro: Supercars Zombie Driving 2 is a 3D racing game set in a city crowded with zombies. You drive fast supercars and must find and smash every zombie at high speed to win.
tips: Use the camera switch (C) to check what is ahead and beside you before you commit to a turn, so you can spot zombies you might otherwise miss.
Tap Space to slow down before sharp corners, then accelerate out with WASD. Losing control at high speed is the easiest way to waste time.
Plan your route through the city so you can pass through groups of zombies in one run instead of doubling back over empty streets.
Keep your speed up whenever the road is clear, since the game is built around smashing zombies at high speed.
Stay aware of where the remaining zombies are, and steer toward the areas where they are still gathered rather than circling the same block.
faq: What is the goal of Supercars Zombie Driving 2?
Find and smash all the zombies in the city at high speed to win the game.
Which keys do I use to play?
Use W, A, S and D to drive, Space to brake, and C to change the camera view.

ramp-racing.intro: Ramp Racing is a racing game where you customize powerful cars, tackle dynamic levels, and compete against players around the world. Its focus is on sharp turns and jumps.
tips: Practice sharp turns early, since they are one of the main skills the game asks for. Slowing down before a corner often keeps you more in control.
Treat jumps as a skill to learn rather than something to hit at full speed. Pay attention to how your car lands and adjust your approach for the next one.
Expect surprising challenges on each level. Watch the track ahead instead of only the path directly in front of you so you can react in time.
Log in to collect daily gifts, since they are designed to boost your progress over time.
Try racing against different global competitors to see how your times compare. Learn from runs where you lost time and repeat the sections that gave you trouble.
faq: What is the main goal in Ramp Racing?
Race through the game's levels, show off your skills against global competitors, and work your way toward becoming the speed champion.
What skills matter most in Ramp Racing?
The game highlights sharp turns and thrilling jumps, so getting comfortable with both is a good place to start.

robot-band.intro: Robot Band is a music game where you guide a troop of musical robots to build a techno beat set in Rome's Trastevere. It focuses on experimenting with sound and visuals.
tips: Move the sliders one at a time at first so you can hear how each change affects the beat before adjusting another.
Touch the different robot parts to find which ones add new sounds, then keep the ones that fit your track.
Build your soundscape in layers, starting with a steady beat and adding other sounds on top only when the mix still feels balanced.
Watch the visuals as you play, since they respond to the sounds and can help you notice when a section feels full or thin.
Take your time and try small variations, because the game rewards experimenting rather than reaching a fixed goal.
faq: What is the goal of Robot Band?
The game has no fixed goal. You guide the robots to create your own techno beat and soundscape, with room for endless creativity.
How do I change the sound in Robot Band?
Use the interactive sliders to adjust the music, and touch the sensitive parts of the robots to add or change sounds.

animal-clinic-anomaly.intro: Animal Clinic (Anomaly) puts you in a vet clinic where some patients are not what they seem. Check in animals, follow the clinic workflow, and spot the anomalies before your shift ends.
tips: Follow the clinic workflow in order: talk to the patient, stamp the forms, take a photo, register, print and place the badge, then escort them to a room. Skipping steps makes it harder to catch problems later.
Look twice at every patient before you treat them. Anomalies can look almost normal, so a quick second look during the photo or check-in step can reveal something off.
Use the security cameras to check on the clinic between tasks. Press Q or E to switch views and Space or Esc to return to your work.
Keep your inventory keys (1 to 9) ready so you can switch items quickly. If an anomaly grabs you, press LMB repeatedly to break free.
Watch your sanity while you work. Taking time to steady yourself between patients can help you keep the shift under control and finish your quota.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Finish your shifts by checking in and treating patients, while spotting anomalies hidden among the animals. You also need to keep the hospital from falling apart.
How do I move and look around on PC?
Use WASD to move and hold the right mouse button to look around. Press E to interact or use the on-screen prompt, and press Space to jump.

snowball-platformer.intro: SnowBall is a physics-based platformer where you roll a snowball through 25 holiday levels, collecting gifts before midnight. Each level ends with a special finish-line gift that you need to reach.
tips: Pay attention to momentum before you commit to a move, since the physics carry SnowBall further than you might expect.
Gather the regular gifts on the way as well as the finish-line gift, so you do not have to backtrack after reaching the end.
Early levels are gentle, so use them to learn how SnowBall bounces and rolls before the challenges grow.
If a level goes wrong, press E to leave it and try again rather than pushing through a failed attempt.
On mobile, get comfortable with the on-screen buttons on a few easy levels so your timing feels natural when things get harder.
faq: What is the main goal of SnowBall: Platformer?
You guide SnowBall through each level to collect every gift and reach the special finish-line gift. Collecting them all keeps New Year's Eve from being cancelled.
How do I move SnowBall on a PC?
Use the arrow keys or the W, A, S and D keys to control SnowBall. Press E to exit a level.

gangster-vegas-driving-simulator-online.intro: Gangster Vegas is a driving and shooting game set in an island city. You control a character on foot or drive a range of high-end cars, and you can work through more than 40 single-player missions.
tips: Press F near a car to get in, and press F again to get out. Use this to switch between driving and moving on foot when a mission calls for it.
Use WASD to steer and move, and tap Space to brake before sharp turns so you keep control of the car.
Press Tab to open the menu when you need to check your options. Doing this between missions helps you keep track of where you are.
Try several of the different cars early on to see how each one handles. Choose the one that feels most controllable for the mission ahead.
Play the missions in order and pay attention to the story details, since each one is built around its own plot.
faq: How do I get into and out of a car?
Stand near a car and press F to enter it. Press F again while inside to exit.
How do I brake?
Press Space while driving to brake. Use it to slow down before turns or obstacles.

nonogram.intro: Nonogram is a picture cross puzzle where you fill in grid squares using number clues to reveal a hidden pixel image. Each clue tells you how many filled squares appear in a row or column.
tips: Start with the largest clues, since a long run of filled squares often leaves a few cells you can fill in immediately.
Look for overlaps: if a clue's run is longer than the free space around it, the middle squares must be filled.
Use the empty-square rule. Groups must be separated by at least one empty square, so a clue like "3 1" leaves a clear gap you can mark off.
Mark squares you know are empty as well as filled ones. Crossing out empty cells keeps your row and column counts easy to track.
Work on rows and columns back and forth. Each new square you solve gives a new clue to check in the other direction.
faq: How do I know which squares to fill?
Read the numbers at the end of each row and at the top of each column. Use the clues together to find squares that must be filled or left empty, without guessing.
What do multiple numbers in one clue mean?
Each number is a separate group of consecutive filled squares. At least one empty square separates each group, so "3 1" means three filled squares, a gap, then one filled square.

super-slashman.intro: Super Slashman is an arcade game set in a futuristic city overrun by rogue robots. You fight with a cyber sword across five levels while collecting energy balls and watching the clock.
tips: Collect the green energy balls whenever you can, since they power you up for tougher fights.
Watch the timer throughout each level, and plan your route so you do not lose time on the way to enemies.
Think before you attack. Use your sword in the moments that give you the best chance to outsmart nearby robots.
Play the first level a few times to learn how enemies move, then use that knowledge in the harder levels.
Keep an eye on your score as you go, and aim to improve your skills with each run rather than rushing through.
faq: What is the goal of Super Slashman?
Your goal is to battle the rogue robots in a futuristic city, get through all five levels, and boost your score while racing against time.
How do I power up in Super Slashman?
Collect the green energy balls that appear in the levels. The description says they power you up to help you outsmart enemies.

tiny-cinema.intro: Tiny Cinema is a cozy management game where you run a small movie theatre, serving popcorn and snacks and collecting money from happy guests. Build up your theatre, then open a drive-in venue.
tips: Keep the seats clean. Messy seats slow the queue, so tidy up between films to keep guests moving.
Remember that every guest pays twice, once for snacks at the counter and once for a ticket when they take a seat. Keep the counter stocked so you never miss a sale.
Spend earnings on the pads with purpose. More seats bring in more guests, while a second popcorn machine helps you keep up with demand.
Hire helpers early if you can afford them. Staff who clean, serve and restock take work off your hands so you can focus on the busiest spots.
Finish the cinema before moving on. Completing a venue grows your fame, which boosts your income everywhere, including the Drive-In.
faq: What is the goal of Tiny Cinema?

Your goal is to run a growing movie theatre by serving snacks, selling tickets and spending your earnings on seats, machines, upgrades and helpers. Finishing venues opens new places, including the Drive-In.
How do I move and interact in the game?
Drag anywhere to walk, or use WASD or the arrow keys on a keyboard. Actions happen automatically when you walk over machines, counters, seats, cash and spending pads.

get-tall-and-fall.intro: Get Tall And Fall is a platform adventure where you grow your character using food, pets, potions and other methods. You climb the peaks of each location, unlock new worlds and aim to take the lead among players.
tips: Use E to start growing, then check whether your growth is actually going up before you move on to other activities.
Pets give income multipliers, so it is worth getting them early to speed up your progress in every world.
Potions give powerups, so save them for the harder moments in a world instead of using them right away.
Each new world is harder to level up in, so spend time earning and growing in the current world before you move on.
Practice jumping with Space or the right-side button so you can reach the peaks without falling back down.
faq: What is the goal of Get Tall And Fall?
Your goal is to boost your growth, conquer the peaks of each location, and discover new worlds. Doing this well helps you take the lead among the players.
How do I move my character?
Use W, A, S and D on a keyboard, or the joystick on the left side of the screen on touch controls. Press Space to jump.

stickman-prison-warriors.intro: Stickman Prison Warriors is a 2D puzzle adventure about a framed stickman trying to escape prison. Your job is to work out how to get him out using the blocks around him.
tips: Before you act, look at the whole room and note which blocks can be cut. Plan the order of your moves so each step sets up the next.
Cut a block only when you are sure of where it will land. Once it drops to the floor, it may be the only way to reach your next step.
Use the dropped block as a step to climb out. Check that it is firmly on the floor and in reach before you try to step on it.
If you get stuck, go back and review the layout of the room. Trying a different sequence of cuts and drops often reveals a route you missed.
Stay patient and try each puzzle with a clear head. The game rewards careful thinking more than fast clicking.
faq: What is the main goal of Stickman Prison Warriors?
The goal is to help the stickman escape from prison. You do this by cutting blocks, dropping them to the floor, and stepping on them to get out.
What do I do with the blocks in each room?
Cut a block, let it drop to the floor, and then step on it. This is how you get the stickman over obstacles and out of the room.

breakout-neon-drift.intro: Breakout: Neon Drift is a retro brick-breaker where you move a paddle to bounce a ball into rows of bricks. Clear all 10 levels, grab power-ups, and build combos to push your score higher.
tips: Move the paddle with the mouse or touch so you can react early, since the ball's angle depends on where it hits the paddle.
Aim your returns toward the edges of the bricks to open up gaps you can send the ball through to the top of the wall.
Keep track of which power-ups are active, such as lasers, multiball, or shields, and use them when the board is crowded.
Try to keep a combo going by hitting bricks in quick succession, because combo scoring rewards consistent play.
Launch the ball with a click or tap at a moment when your paddle is well positioned, so you do not lose momentum at the start of a level.
faq: What is the goal of Breakout: Neon Drift?
Break every brick in each of the 10 levels by bouncing the ball off your paddle. Chasing a high score is the other main aim.
How do I control the paddle?
Move the mouse or touch across the screen to move the paddle left and right.

icy-purple-head-2.intro: Icy Purple Head 2 is a clicker where you guide a character across frosty courses by turning it into ice and sliding. Across 30 levels, your timing and the number of clicks you make decide how far you get.
tips: Watch the whole course before you start clicking so you can plan where your slides should begin and end.
Focus on timing rather than speed, since a click made a moment too early or too late can send you into an obstacle.
Use as few clicks as possible on each level, because the game asks for strategic clicking rather than constant tapping.
If a level keeps ending the same way, pause and identify the exact obstacle that caused it before trying again.
Take short breaks between attempts so you can reset your focus and keep your timing consistent.
faq: What is the goal of Icy Purple Head 2?
Your goal is to guide Icy Purple Head through each frosty course by sliding as ice and avoiding deadly obstacles. The game has 30 levels to work through.
How does the clicking work?
The game is built around strategic clicks rather than constant input. Plan each click carefully, because timing is what decides whether you clear an obstacle.

squid-dalgona-candy.intro: Squid Dalgona Candy is a puzzle game where you carefully cut a shape out of a candy mold with a needle. Work slowly and steadily, because the candy breaks easily and the timer keeps running.
tips: Click at a steady, regular pace rather than rapid-fire clicking, since fast clicking pushes the Crack Meter toward red.
Watch the Crack Meter after every few clicks and ease off whenever it starts to climb.
Take a moment to study the shape before you begin so you know which lines to follow around the outline.
Keep an eye on the time limit and make sure you have enough time left to finish the full shape.
If the meter is rising, pause briefly before continuing, because a slow approach is what protects the candy.
faq: What is the goal of Squid Dalgona Candy?
The goal is to remove the desired shape from the candy mold with a needle without shattering the candy or running out of time.
How do I control the needle?
You use a mouse click or touch input to press the button repeatedly. Clicking regularly is how you extract the candy.

epic-defense-clash.intro: Epic Defense Clash is a battle game where you use an arsenal of weapons to fend off monstrous beasts across waves of enemies. Success depends on timing, target weaknesses, and upgrades.
tips: Pay attention to which beasts are approaching first, and choose the weapon that suits the threat in front of you.
Watch how each enemy moves before you commit to a shot, since timing matters more than rushing.
Look for weak points on the beasts and aim for them, because targeting weaknesses can make your defense much more efficient.
Spend upgrades on the weapons you use most often instead of spreading them thinly across the whole armory.
Keep an eye on how each wave ends and adjust your approach for the next one, as the waves keep getting harder to survive.
faq: What is the main goal in Epic Defense Clash?
Your goal is to survive relentless waves of monstrous beasts by fending them off with your weapons. Each wave brings more adversaries to defend against.
How do I get stronger during a run?
You can upgrade your armory to improve your weapons. Choosing which weapons to upgrade is an important part of staying alive.

army-force-war.intro: Army Force War is a war shooter where you choose a class, learn the controls, and move across different battlegrounds to complete missions. This guide covers practical habits that help you get more from each match.
tips: Think about your class before each match and choose the one that fits the mission ahead rather than sticking to the same pick every time.
Spend a few minutes getting comfortable with the controls before a serious attempt, since mastering them is central to doing well.
Scan each battleground before you commit to a route so you know where you can advance safely and where you may be exposed.
Pay attention to the mission goal and focus your actions on it instead of reacting to every target you see.
Try different game modes to find the style you enjoy most, and use what you learn in one mode to improve your play in the others.
faq: What is the main goal in Army Force War?
The game centers on completing missions across diverse battlegrounds while winning battles with your chosen class and weapons. Keep the current mission objective in mind throughout each match.
Why does class selection matter so much?
The description highlights strategic class selection as a key part of winning. Choosing a class that suits the mission gives you a better chance of success.

idle-train-empire-tycoon.intro: Idle Train Empire Tycoon has you running a railway station, buying and upgrading trains, customizing routes, and reinvesting profits to grow into a larger business. Progress builds over time as your station expands.
tips: Reinvest your early earnings into upgrading trains and routes, since more visitor traffic raises the profit from every ticket sold.
Check the route settings regularly and compare which destinations earn the most per visitor before committing your money.
Spend technology points on the station and train improvements that boost your income most, rather than spreading them evenly.
Complete daily and regular tasks whenever you log in, because they give rewards you can use to expand faster.
Furnishing waiting halls is worth doing once your income is steady, so you can compare what each space adds before buying more.
faq: What is the main goal of Idle Train Empire Tycoon?
The goal is to grow your railway station into a large, profitable business by serving visitors, reinvesting earnings, and expanding to new platforms and destinations.
How do I earn money in the game?
You earn profits by serving visitors and selling tickets, and you can invest those profits back into trains, routes, and station spaces.

euro-truck-parking.intro: Euro Truck Parking is a truck driving and parking simulator where you steer heavy trucks through tight spaces and busy roads into marked parking zones. Each level adds new challenges.
tips: Go slowly when you get close to the parking zone, since accurate placement earns higher scores than rushing in.
Use short, controlled steering inputs with W A S D or the arrow keys, and check your angle before turning the wheel further.
Reverse in small steps and stop to re-check your position, because a heavy truck and trailer swing wide when backing up.
Keep an eye on road markings and obstacles as you approach, and adjust your route early instead of correcting at the last second.
Pay attention to how the trailer follows the truck on each new level, since trailer control is one of the skills the game tests most.
faq: What is the main goal in Euro Truck Parking?
Your goal is to drive your truck and park it accurately in the designated parking zone while avoiding obstacles. Accurate parking earns higher scores.
Which keys control the truck?
Use W A S D or the Arrow Keys to drive and steer the truck.

cook-soups-3-in-a-bowl.intro: Cook Soups: 3 in a Bowl is a calm cooking puzzle where you pull ingredients out of a pot and sort them into finished portions. Your aim is to clear the pot without letting the extra slots overflow.
tips: Before you tap, scan the pot for ingredients you already have waiting in the extra slots. Taking a matching piece often lets you finish a portion and free up space.
Keep an eye on how many slots are full. Since there are only a few, avoid pulling in singles that have no partner yet unless you have room to hold them.
Try to plan a few steps ahead. If you can see that a certain ingredient will be needed to make three of a kind, prioritize collecting its matches first.
Clear the extra slots whenever you can. Freeing space early gives you more options later in a level when the pot gets harder to manage.
Play at a relaxed pace. The game has no timer, so you can take a moment to look at the whole pot before each move.
faq: What happens if I run out of room in the extra slots?
If all the extra slots fill up and a new ingredient has no room, the soup is ruined and the level is lost. You will need to restart that level.
How do I complete a level?
Collect all the ingredients from the pot. When the pot is empty, the soup is ready, the level is complete, and a new dish is added to your recipe book.

snow-slider-3d.intro: Snow Slider 3D is a downhill sledding game where you steer down snowy mountains, dodge hazards, and gather gifts. Speed builds the farther you go, so every run tests your reactions.
tips: Look a few obstacles ahead rather than only at your sled, so you have time to switch lanes before a tree or rock reaches you.
Make small, steady steering moves with the Left and Right Arrow keys instead of tapping rapidly, which can overcorrect and send you into a hazard.
Expect the speed to rise the farther you go, and stay calm in the faster stretches rather than panicking.
Grab gifts when they are on your path without leaving a dangerous line, since they are how you unlock new sleds.
Because every run's terrain is different, avoid memorizing patterns and react to what is on screen each time.
faq: How do I steer the sled?
Use the Left Arrow and Right Arrow keys to slide left and right down the mountain.
What is the goal of the game?
Race downhill, dodge trees, rocks, snowmen and other hazards, and collect gifts to unlock new sleds.

fire-boy-run-adventure.intro: Fire Boy Run Adventure is a side-scrolling running game where you guide Fireboy through dangerous levels full of traps and obstacles. You play by clicking or tapping, so timing is everything.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead before you act, since the level keeps moving and you need time to react.
Time each click or tap to match the obstacle, rather than tapping rapidly and hoping for the best.
Learn the pattern of traps in each section so you can anticipate them on later attempts.
Stay calm after a mistake and restart with a clear focus, because the game rewards steady timing over speed.
Keep your eyes on the path several steps ahead instead of only on Fireboy, so you can plan your next move.
faq: How do I control Fireboy?
You play by mouse click or tap, so use those inputs to move and jump past traps and obstacles. Practice your timing to keep Fireboy running safely.
What makes this game difficult?
The levels are full of traps and obstacles, and the running never stops, so a single bad timing can end your run. Careful observation of each hazard helps you survive longer.

police-mom-simulator.intro: Police Mom Simulator mixes police work with family life, so you move between cases, chases and home tasks. This guide covers the controls and habits that help you keep both sides running smoothly.
tips: Start each day with the family routine, then head to the police station so you are not pulled away from breakfast and school drop-off.
Use the Action key (F) only when you are close to the thing you want to interact with, so you do not waste time on nearby objects.
Hold Left Shift to sprint when you need to cover ground quickly, and save it for moments that matter, such as a suspect running away.
When driving police cars around the city, use WASD steadily rather than making sharp inputs, since the city is detailed and it is easy to drift off course.
Check the instructions with the I key or pause with P whenever you feel unsure of a control, so you can sort things out before continuing.
faq: What is the main goal of Police Mom Simulator?
You balance family responsibilities with a police career by completing family and police missions. Keeping the city safe is one part of the job, and looking after your family is the other.
Which keys do I use to move and interact?
Use WASD to move on desktop, Left Shift to sprint, and F for actions. On mobile, drag the on-screen joystick to move in any direction.

fruit-smash-master.intro: Fruit Smash Master is an action game about slicing fruit with precise swipes. Each fruit brings its own challenge, and the levels grow harder as you go. Aim for a spot at the top of the leaderboard.
tips: Slow down on the first few fruits to learn how each one moves before you try to rush.
Keep your swipes short and deliberate, since a precise cut usually works better than a wide, hurried one.
Watch each fruit's unique challenge before you swipe, and plan your next cut while the current one is in motion.
Balance speed with control: go fast when the path is clear, and ease off when a fruit needs a careful slice.
When a level gets harder, reset your focus and count on steady, strategic cuts rather than frantic swiping.
faq: What is the goal of Fruit Smash Master?
Slice through the fruits with precise swipes, work through the challenges each one brings, and aim to top the leaderboard.
How do I control the slicing?
You slice by making swipes across the screen, and precision matters more than sheer speed.

weapon-upgrade.intro: Weapon Upgrade is a shooting runner where you move through a course, shoot enemies and obstacles, and build stronger guns by buying and connecting parts. Steering with your mouse or finger keeps you on target as the weapons get more powerful.
tips: Shoot obstacles as well as enemies, since clearing them helps you progress and unlock new weapon options.
Spend your early progress on the parts that make your current gun better before chasing expensive upgrades.
Connect parts with an eye on how the finished weapon fits together, so you do not waste pieces on combinations that do not work.
Keep your aim steady when targets are small or far away, because accuracy is part of how the game tests you.
Upgrade gradually from simple guns to advanced firepower instead of rushing, so you learn how each part changes your shots.
faq: How do I move in Weapon Upgrade?
On PC, use your mouse to move around. On a phone, move your finger across the screen.
How do I upgrade my weapon?
Buy parts and connect them together to build stronger weapons. Combining parts is the key to evolving from simple guns to advanced firepower.

master-of-riding-a-pet.intro: Master of Riding a Pet is a bright 3D adventure where you ride pets across a big open world, collecting eggs and hatching a wide range of rideable companions. Your ranch is where eggs hatch and your cash grows.
tips: Choose a fast pet when you want rarer eggs, since the description says faster pets reach them. Speed matters more when you are racing a timer.
Follow the green arrows to find your egg, then head straight for the ranch. Keep an eye on the timer so the egg does not break before you get home.
Feed and age your pets regularly, because they need care to stay useful on your ranch.
Watch the sky during lightning storms, since they can mutate your pets. Decide whether to keep riding or wait it out depending on what you are carrying.
Spend the cash you earn from ranch pets on food and upgrades first, then save for radars and rebirths once your ranch is running well.
faq: What is the main goal of Master of Riding a Pet?

Find eggs hidden across the open world, carry them back to your ranch before they break, and hatch them to collect up to 30 rideable pets. Growing your ranch and rebirthing for bigger rewards are also part of the game.
How do I pick up an egg and get it home?
Follow the green arrows to an egg and touch it to pick it up. Then ride back to your ranch before the timer runs out.

sift-renegade-brawl.intro: Sift Renegade Brawl is a stickman samurai fighting game where Ryu seeks revenge for his girlfriend. You cut through enemies with your katana, chain combos, and collect trophies across the levels.
tips: Learn to chain attacks into combos early, since the game rewards stylish sequences that clear enemies quickly.
Pay attention to how enemies move and attack, and time your strikes for openings rather than swinging constantly.
Look for trophies on each level as you go, so you do not have to backtrack to find them later.
Replay levels you finished with a lower score, because you can retry any level as many times as you like to improve it.
Try both the mouse and the arrow keys or buttons to see which feels more comfortable for quick attacks and movement.
faq: What is the goal of Sift Renegade Brawl?
You play as Ryu, a samurai avenging the death of his girlfriend. Use your katana to cut down enemies and complete the missions across the levels.
How do I score higher in the levels?
Build incredible combos to eliminate enemies with style, and collect trophies along the way. You can replay any level to improve your score.

stick-vs-zombies-epic-battle.intro: Stick vs Zombies - Epic Battle is an action fighting game where stickman warriors battle zombie hordes across dynamic levels. It mixes strategic combat with platforming, so both fighting and movement matter.
tips: Try different weapons early on to see which ones work best against different zombie groups.
Watch how the zombies approach before you commit, and time your attacks to match their movement.
Use platforming to reposition yourself so you are not surrounded by the horde.
Think about each fight as a tactical choice: pick your moment to advance, retreat, or switch weapons.
Stay focused on the layout of each level, since its changing challenges reward careful, deliberate play.
faq: What is the main goal of Stick vs Zombies - Epic Battle?
You guide stickman warriors through apocalyptic levels, fighting off zombie hordes and overcoming platforming challenges to win the battle.
What kind of weapons can I use?
The game offers a variety of weapons, and choosing the right one for the situation is a key part of outsmarting the undead.

magic-action-gun-game.intro: Magic Action Gun Game is a run-and-shoot arcade game where you race forward, clear obstacles, and merge gun pieces into stronger firearms. You control everything with the left mouse click.
tips: Pay attention to the gun pieces you pick up, since merging them is how you build stronger weapons over the run.
Shoot obstacles on your way through the race so your path stays clear and you keep moving.
Take a moment to line up targets before firing, because aiming accuracy matters when you shoot down enemies.
Save your fire for the enemies that are closing in, and use rapid clicks when a crowd is coming at you.
Check which weapons you have unlocked and try different merges to find a firearm that suits how you like to play.
faq: What is the main goal of Magic Action Gun Game?
You run through a race, clear and shoot obstacles, clash with enemies, and unlock stronger weapons by merging gun pieces into firearms.
How do I control the game?
Everything is done with the left mouse click, which you use to shoot.

build-your-zombie-horde.intro: Build Your Zombie Horde is a simple strategy autobattler where you summon an undead army, defeat enemies, collect resources, and upgrade your forces to take over new lands.
tips: Summon zombies steadily rather than in one burst, so your horde keeps a steady presence on the battlefield.
Use the camera controls to check on both your zombies and the enemy positions before you decide where to summon next.
Pinch to zoom out when you want a broad view of the fight, and zoom in when you need to see a specific clash up close.
Pay attention to the resources you collect and spend them on upgrades that strengthen your army as you progress.
Press P on PC to pause when you need a moment to plan your next move without the battle moving on.
faq: What is the main goal of Build Your Zombie Horde?
Your goal is to summon an undead horde, defeat enemies, collect resources, upgrade your army, and conquer lands.
How do I summon a zombie?
On mobile, tap anywhere on the screen. On PC, click anywhere with any mouse button.

hexa-sort-master.intro: HexaSort is a calm hexagon sorting puzzle where you pick up stacks of colored tiles and drop them to merge matching colors. You move through levels at your own pace, with no timers.
tips: Before you pick up a stack, check which colors sit on top of the other stacks so you know where each tile can go next.
Think about where a stack will land before you drop it, and avoid covering a spot you will need for a later move.
Look for moves that bring matching colors together so they merge, since merging clears space and makes the board easier to read.
Keep a few open spots free when you can, because a crowded board leaves you fewer options.
Save your boosters for when you are truly stuck, and try to find a move on your own first.
faq: Is there a time limit in HexaSort?
No. The game has no timers, so you can take as long as you need on each move.
How do tiles merge?
Tiles of the same color merge automatically when they are placed together, so you mainly need to bring matching colors next to each other.

football-legends.intro: Football Legends is a quick soccer duel game where you aim and launch a player to kick the ball. Build your squad, use power-ups, and work your way up to the Legends Cup.
tips: Before you launch, take a moment to read the angle. Small changes in your drag can send the ball far off target, so aim with care.
Matches are short and end after two goals or when the timer runs out. Look for early chances to score so you are not forced to rely on the clock.
Save your power-ups for moments that matter, such as a close score or the final seconds of a match, rather than using them as soon as you get them.
Upgrade your squad with an eye on the tournaments you want to enter. Consistent results across rounds will help you reach the top spots.
If you miss a shot, adjust your aim a little at a time instead of changing everything. This makes it easier to learn how your launches affect the ball.
faq: What is the goal of Football Legends?
Win football duels against your opponents and take the top spots in tournaments to lift the Legends Cup.
How do I kick the ball?
Drag your finger to aim, then release to launch a football player and kick the ball toward goal.

halloween-horror-massacre.intro: Halloween Horror Massacre is a fast arcade game about chopping a tree while dodging branches that fall toward you. It features a cast of horror characters and rewards quick reflexes.
tips: Watch the branches as they come down so you can tell which side is safe before they reach you.
Keep your eyes on the next branch rather than the one you just passed, since the pace picks up quickly.
Stay calm and avoid rushing every chop. Short, steady reactions usually last longer than frantic button mashing.
Play a few short rounds to get used to the rhythm before trying for a high score.
Take a short break when your reactions start to slow, because quick reflexes are what this game depends on.
faq: What is the goal of Halloween Horror Massacre?
Your goal is to chop the tree while dodging the branches that descend toward you. Staying safe while you keep chopping is the core of the game.
What controls does the game use?
The game does not list its controls in the instructions, so check the on-screen prompts and try the inputs to see how the character responds. Learning them in a quick practice round is a good start.

2048-x2-merge-blocks.intro: 2048 X2 Merge Blocks is a puzzle game where you guide falling numbered blocks, line them up to merge, and keep the grid from collapsing. The aim is to reach higher merges while keeping the board clear.
tips: Before each move, check which blocks can be lined up with matching numbers so you can merge them right away.
Keep your highest-value blocks anchored in one area of the grid instead of scattering them, which helps you build larger merges over time.
Clear space early. A crowded board leaves you fewer options when new blocks start falling.
Look ahead at where the next blocks may land so you do not block the paths you need for future merges.
If the grid starts to collapse, focus on removing the blocks closest to the top first to buy yourself room to think.
faq: What is the main goal of 2048 X2 Merge Blocks?

The goal is to merge falling numerical blocks into higher numbers while keeping the board clear enough to avoid a collapse. The description says the game is endless, so you can keep merging for as long as you manage the grid well.
How do I avoid the grid collapsing?
Keep the board as open as you can by merging blocks whenever possible and not letting them pile up in one spot. Planning a few moves ahead helps you spot where the stack is getting too tall.

jewel-coloring.intro: Jewel Coloring is a puzzle game where you place gems into matching-color cells to reveal a diamond picture. Use the buffer and power-ups to work through tricky boards at your own pace.
tips: Before moving a gem, check which cells of its color are still empty so you do not block another gem of the same color.
Use the buffer below the board as temporary storage to clear space, but avoid filling it with gems you may need to reach a color soon.
Finish one color completely when you can, since completing a color unlocks extra buffer slots that give you more room to plan.
Save the wand, broom, and magnet for levels where you are stuck, rather than using them early when the board is still open.
Zoom out with the mouse wheel or a pinch to see the whole board and spot which colors are closest to completion.
faq: What is the goal of Jewel Coloring?
The goal is to place every gem in a cell of its matching color so the diamond picture is completed. Each level is solved when all the gems are in the right places.
How do I move a gem?
Select a gem, then select the cell where you want it to go. On a computer, use the left mouse button; on mobile, tap to select and move.

draw-to-smash-zombie.intro: Draw To Smash Zombie is a drawing puzzle where you sketch shapes, lines, and ramps to guide a rolling bomb into waves of silly zombies. Use your drawings to clear each wave.
tips: Look at where the bomb starts and where the zombies are before you draw anything, so you know the path it needs to take.
Simple lines and ramps are often enough. Try a short drawing first and see how the bomb moves before adding more.
Draw ramps to send the bomb up or over obstacles, and use angled lines to redirect it toward clusters of zombies.
If a drawing does not work, try a different angle or position rather than repeating the same line.
Keep your drawings clear of areas you do not need, so the bomb follows the route you intend.
faq: What is the goal of Draw To Smash Zombie?
The goal is to draw shapes, lines, or ramps so the rolling bomb can blast the zombies.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or tap to draw and play.

wonder-vending-machine.intro: Wonder Vending Machine is a simple simulation game where you pick a vending machine and pay the exact price of an item using coins. Each correct payment releases the item so you can collect them all.
tips: Check the price on the display before you pick any coins, so you know the exact sum you need to insert.
Add up your coins in your head before clicking, so you avoid getting an error message and wasting a try.
Try the toy, sweet treat and food machines in turn so you get a feel for the different prices.
Keep track of which items you have already collected, so you can focus on the ones still missing.
Take your time with each payment, since the game is about careful counting rather than speed.
faq: What is the goal of Wonder Vending Machine?
The goal is to collect all the items from the vending machines. You do this by inserting the correct amount of coins for each item.
How do I control the game?
You play with your mouse. Click a machine, choose coins, and insert the sum shown on the display.

simple-merge.intro: Simple Merge is a puzzle clicker where you combine matching doodle heroes into stronger units and tap Titans to defeat them. Gold from battles pays for upgrades and village growth.
tips: Merge heroes as soon as you have a matching pair, since stronger units make later attacks on Titans much easier.
Spend gold on upgrades when you can see which one will help your current army most rather than buying randomly.
Keep tapping the Titan during quiet moments, because steady attacks add up and are the main way to progress.
Collect rewards whenever they appear so you do not miss resources that help you grow your village.
Before facing a new boss, check that your army and strength upgrades are ready, so you are not caught with weak units.
faq: How do I win a battle in Simple Merge?
Tap or click the Titan to attack it and keep attacking until it is defeated. Stronger heroes from merging make this faster.
How do I merge heroes?
Drag one hero onto another matching hero to combine them into a stronger unit. Only matching heroes can be merged.

field-master.intro: Field Master is a farming simulator where you drive tractors and combines through the full farming cycle, from preparing soil to harvest. It mixes relaxed play with realistic farm work.
tips: Follow the farming cycle in order: prepare the soil with the tractor first, then sow, nurture the crops, and save the combine for harvest season.
Press Q to switch vehicles whenever the next job needs a different machine, so you don't have to drive back and forth across the field.
Use E to load or unload when you are at the right spot, and keep an eye on where you are before you press it.
Move in steady, straight passes across the field rather than sharp turns, which helps you cover the ground evenly.
Use the arrow keys or WASD for smooth, small steering changes, especially when lining up seeders or combines with the crop rows.
faq: What is the main goal of Field Master?
You run a farm through the full cycle, plowing fields, sowing seeds, nurturing crops, and harvesting with combines. Every step is controlled by you.
How do I switch between vehicles?
Press Q to switch vehicles. Use it to move between your tractor and the other machines as each stage of the farm work requires.

neon-velocity.intro: Neon Velocity is a fast precision platformer where you run, wall-jump, and dash through 50 cyberpunk levels that grow harder as you go. Speed and timing matter more than brute force.
tips: Use the double-tap dash to get through gaps and past threats, and plan your dash before you commit to a jump.
Keep your momentum going. Chaining runs, jumps, and dashes together is usually safer than stopping to reposition.
Watch crumbling platforms and move on quickly once they start to break, rather than lingering on them.
Study the laser grids before you move. Pause your approach at the edge of a grid and time your passage between the beams.
Since respawns are instant, treat early deaths as practice. Try a tricky section again right away and adjust your timing each attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Neon Velocity?
Move through each of the 50 levels by running, jumping, wall-jumping, and dashing while avoiding hazards such as lasers and crumbling platforms.
How do I dash?
Double-tap the A or D key, or the Left or Right Arrow key, to dash in that direction.

cat-lovescapes.intro: Cat Lovescapes is a point-and-click action puzzle game about guiding a lovesick black cat through household obstacles to reach his bell cat. Other curious felines add challenge along the way.
tips: Scan each room carefully before clicking, since the solution to a puzzle is often an object or detail already on screen.
Test interactions one at a time so you can tell which object caused a change in the scene.
Keep an eye on the other curious cats, because their movements can be part of the obstacle you need to get around.
The game is described as pressure-free, so take your time and step back if you get stuck rather than rushing through clicks.
When you are stuck, look again at what the black cat needs to reach and work backward from the goal to the obstacle in the way.
faq: What is the goal of Cat Lovescapes?
You guide a lovesick black cat through whimsical puzzles to reach his beloved bell cat. Each obstacle is a domestic setting you need to get past.
How do you play Cat Lovescapes?
It is a point-and-click adventure, so you move through the game by clicking on objects and areas in the scene. The game does not include separate instructions beyond this.

mini-pool-3d.intro: Mini Pool 3D is a colorful 3D pool game where you pocket all the balls. You can play Classic free play, work through 20 Arcade levels, or race the clock in Time Attack mode.
tips: Start in Classic free play to get a feel for how far and how hard each shot travels before you try the timed modes.
Take a moment to line up each shot from more than one angle, since the 3D view can make distances hard to judge.
In Arcade, treat each level as a puzzle and plan which ball to pocket next instead of shooting at whatever is closest.
In Time Attack, avoid rushing every shot; a missed pocket often costs more time than a few extra seconds of aiming.
If a level feels stuck, go back to Classic free play to practice the specific shot you need, then return to Arcade.
faq: What is the goal of Mini Pool 3D?
The goal is to pocket all the balls on the table. You can do this in Classic free play, in the 20 Arcade levels, or against the clock in Time Attack mode.
How do I play?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play. The game is designed to be easy to pick up.

drive-and-crash-sandbox.intro: Drive & Crash Sandbox is a car crash simulator where you launch vehicles down slopes and smash them into destructible obstacles. Its multiplayer mode lets you crash with others online.
tips: Use the camera switch (C) to watch collisions from different angles, which helps you see how parts bend and break.
Try slow motion (V) right after a big impact to follow how the damage spreads through the car.
Repair (R) your car between crashes when you want to keep testing the same vehicle from a fresh start.
Cycle through vehicles with N to compare how each one deforms, since the models crumble in different ways.
Combine Space (handbrake) with WASD to slide the car before a hit, and save Shift (nitro) for launches off slopes where extra speed matters most.
faq: What is the goal of Drive & Crash Sandbox?
The objective is simply to drive around and smash cars however you like. The game is a sandbox, so there is no set mission to complete.
How do I control the car?
Use WASD to drive, Space for the handbrake, and Shift for nitro. Press Tab to pause the game at any time.

slime-loop.intro: Slime Loop is a puzzle game where slimes travel around a loop and shoot pixels to clear a picture. Your choices of which slime to send next and when decide how smoothly each level goes.
tips: Before sending any slime, check its shot count and the color it fires, then decide whether it fits the pixels still left on the board.
Keep at least one parking space open whenever possible, since a full parking area can leave you without a useful move.
Save a parked slime when its color is still needed, and send it back onto the loop at the right moment instead of rushing it out.
Clear the colors that appear in several places in one pass, so you are not forced to return to the same color later.
Save boosters for boards that feel stuck, and try a few careful moves first so you know what the board actually needs.
faq: How do I start a slime moving?
Tap the slime on a touchscreen or click it with the left mouse button, and it will be sent onto the loop. No keyboard controls are needed.
What does the number on a slime mean?
The number shows how many shots the slime has left. Once you know this, you can plan which slime to use for each remaining color.

football-kick-3d.intro: Football Kick 3D is a fast 3D soccer game where you charge forward, tackle defenders out of the way, and push toward the goal. It is played with a single click or tap.
tips: Watch the defenders' positions before you charge so you can pick the gap that leads toward the goal.
Time your tackles for when an opponent is close to you, since knocking enemies away is how you win the ball back.
After you steal possession, keep moving forward quickly so defenders have less time to reclaim the ball.
Try to stay near the centre of the field where you have more room to change direction when a path closes.
Save your strongest pushes for the final stretch toward the goal rather than spending them early in the field.
faq: What is the goal of Football Kick 3D?
Your aim is to take the ball through the field, win it from defenders, and score by reaching the goal.
How do I control the player?
You use mouse clicks or taps to play, so every action is made with a single click or tap.

robby-1-to-speed-per-second.intro: Robby +1 To Speed Per Second is an obby where your speed keeps climbing the longer you run. Pass the tests, explore four locations, and collect pets and accessories as you go.
tips: Your speed rises every second with no cap, so keep moving rather than stopping to look around. Steady progress keeps your speed building.
Each of the four locations has its own challenges. Spend a little time learning the obstacles in a new area before pushing for maximum speed.
Use Space to jump precisely at the edges of platforms. A fast run only helps if you land every jump.
Press Tab or Escape to free the cursor when you want to check menus or the store, then press them again to return to camera control.
On a phone, use the on-screen interface to move and drag to change the camera view, so you can see upcoming obstacles early.
faq: How do I get faster in this game?
Your speed increases every second and there is no speed limit, so staying on course for longer raises your speed. Keeping your run going without falling is the main way to build it up.
What are the basic controls on a computer?
Use WASD to move, the mouse to look around, and Space to jump. Press Tab or Escape to enable or disable the cursor.

evolution-of-hamster-clicker.intro: Evolution of Hamster is a clicker arcade game where you tap to grow your hamster and build points toward a very large goal. This guide covers how to approach the climb.
tips: Keep tapping steadily rather than in short bursts, since the game is built around accumulating points over time.
Pay attention to how your points and evolution progress change as you play, so you can see which habits move you forward fastest.
Plan short sessions with breaks, because a clicker game rewards long steady progress more than one marathon run.
Try different tapping rhythms and note which feels most comfortable and productive for you over a longer session.
Set small milestones along the way, such as reaching a new evolution stage, to keep your motivation up on the long road to the final goal.
faq: What is the goal of Evolution of Hamster?
The goal is to tap your way to 5 quintillion points and transform your hamster into the best one possible.
How do I play the game?
The description says you tap to earn points and progress through evolution. No other controls are listed in the game's instructions.

heroes-of-the-dungeons-match-3-rpg.intro: Heroes of the Dungeons is a match-3 adventure where you swap gems to attack monsters, use hero abilities, and rebuild a kingdom in the castle between battles.
tips: Look for moves that make 4 or more tiles in a row or that create special blocks, since they usually deal more damage than basic matches.
Keep an eye on your team's skill charges and save hero abilities for when an enemy is weak to them, rather than using them as soon as they are ready.
Before you swap, check whether the move also charges your heroes' skills, so each turn does more than one job.
After each win, spend your loot on castle shop upgrades early, because better income makes it easier to strengthen your heroes for later stages.
Watch which enemy you are facing and focus your matches on the threats that can turn the battle, instead of only clearing whatever tiles are easiest to reach.
faq: What is the goal of Heroes of the Dungeons?
You play as the Master of Hunters, defeating invading monsters, winning fights, and rebuilding the fallen kingdom one match at a time.
How do I attack enemies?
Match three or more tiles by swapping adjacent tiles. Matches attack enemies and also charge your team's skills.

rooftop-run.intro: Rooftop Run is a fast parkour game where you race across city rooftops. You run, jump, roll, and slide while dodging obstacles, smashing barriers, and escaping enemies.
tips: Look ahead to spot obstacles and enemies early, so you have time to choose between jumping, rolling, or sliding.
Use the slide and roll moves to keep your speed up instead of stopping to get around low hazards.
Save your boost for stretches where you need to get clear of enemies or cover ground quickly, rather than using it all at once.
Use your weapon on threats that block your path, and keep running when you can get past them safely.
Replay the levels to learn where the obstacles and barriers appear, so you can react faster each time.
faq: What is the goal of Rooftop Run?
Race across the city rooftops, jumping, rolling, and sliding past obstacles while escaping enemies. The description says the aim is to be the best parkour runner.
How do I control my character on desktop?
Use the arrow keys to move up, down, left, and right. Press the Spacebar to fire your weapon and Shift to activate boost.

urban-sniper-multiplayer.intro: Urban Sniper Multiplayer is a sniper duel game set in a busy city. You hunt rivals across rooftops and alleyways, staying hidden until the right moment to strike.
tips: Pick your position before your rival does. Rooftops and alleyways offer different angles, so think about where you can watch the most open ground.
Stay hidden between shots. Moving in the open makes you easy to spot, so break line of sight as soon as you have taken your shot.
