Keep scanning the areas around you, not just the spot you are aiming at. Rivals often approach from the side or from above.
Wait for a clear opening instead of firing at the first target you see. Patience usually beats a rushed shot in a duel like this.
Adjust your plan after each duel. If a spot has been exposed, move to a new hiding place before your rival lines up on you.
faq: What is the main goal of Urban Sniper Multiplayer?
The goal is to outmaneuver your rivals in sniper duels and come out on top in the battle for supremacy across the city.
How do I avoid getting shot?
Stay hidden, keep watch over rooftops and alleys, and avoid lingering in open spots where a rival can line up a shot.

epic-battle-simulator-2.intro: Epic Battle Simulator 2 is a strategy game where you choose troops, place them on the battlefield, and lead your army against opponents. You can play through campaign levels or build your own battles in custom mode.
tips: Study the battlefield before you place troops, and think about where each unit group will meet the enemy.
Use custom mode to test different troop placements without the pressure of a campaign level.
Upgrade your army step by step, since each unit can be improved up to three levels with better gear and stats.
Watch how the smart troops and enemy bots move, then adjust your placement to counter what they do.
Use the camera controls often to check flanks and weak spots so you can respond quickly during a battle.
faq: What is the goal of Epic Battle Simulator 2?
Your goal is to defeat your opponent by choosing troops and placing them wisely on the battlefield. Campaign levels and custom battles both give you this challenge.
How do I move the camera on a computer?
Use the Arrow keys or the W, A, S and D keys to move the camera around the battlefield.

swim-or-die.intro: Swim or Die is an action game where quick tapping keeps your pet afloat. Collect Time Points to unlock skins while your reflexes are tested moment to moment.
tips: Keep a steady, quick tapping rhythm rather than tapping in bursts, since the game is built around keeping your pet afloat.
Watch the environment closely so you can react before your pet starts to sink.
Focus on collecting Time Points when you can do so safely, because they are what unlock the adorable skins.
Stay calm during fast moments. Short, controlled taps usually help more than frantic mashing.
Play a few short rounds to get comfortable with the pace before trying to chase a specific skin.
faq: What is the main goal in Swim or Die?
Your goal is to save your pet from drowning by tapping quickly to keep it afloat. Along the way, you collect Time Points.
What do Time Points do?
Time Points are collected during play and are used to unlock adorable skins for your pet.

crazy-m1neworld.intro: Crazy M1neWorld is an offline, Minecraft-style sandbox where you build a home and surroundings with cubes. When night falls, zombies appear, so you need to find shelter. Your world can be saved and continued later.
tips: Build your shelter before night arrives so you are not caught out in the open when the zombies come.
Pick a spot for your home that is easy to find again, such as near a landmark you have built.
Start small with a simple enclosed room, then expand it into a larger home and surrounding area.
Save your world before you stop playing so you can pick up where you left off next time.
Use the Tab or ESC menu when you need a break or want to check your options, and walk around with WASD to keep moving between building spots.
faq: What is the main goal of Crazy M1neWorld?
The game focuses on building a home and environment and surviving the nights, when zombies come out. Hiding from zombies at night is the key survival step.
How do I move around the world?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to walk. Press Tab or ESC to open the menu.

bodybuilder-karate-fighting.intro: Bodybuilder Karate Fighting is a 3D arcade brawler where you dodge, punch, and use special moves to outsmart rivals in arenas. Matches reward both raw power and careful timing.
tips: Watch your opponent's movements before committing to an attack. Dodging first and then countering often works better than trading blows.
Save your special moves for openings rather than using them the moment they are available. A well-timed special can turn a close fight.
Mix up your attacks instead of repeating the same punch. Rivals who expect the same pattern are easier to outmaneuver.
Learn the layout of each arena, since 3D fights can shift your position and make distance hard to judge. Keep enough space to dodge out of trouble.
Stay patient when you are ahead. Pressing too hard can leave you open, so look for clean chances to finish the fight.
faq: What is the main goal in Bodybuilder Karate Fighting?
Your goal is to defeat your rivals in arena brawls and fight your way to victory. The description focuses on combining brute strength with strategic technique.
Which skills matter most in this game?
Dodging, punching, and using special moves are the core actions named in the description. Balancing defense with well-timed attacks helps you outsmart opponents.

pixel-protocol.intro: Pixel Protocol is a fast, low-poly team arena shooter played in the browser. You fight bots in quick 4v4 matches across three maps, using three blasters, a dash and a shield.
tips: Click the game first to capture the mouse, otherwise your aim will not respond.
Switch weapons with keys 1, 2 and 3 or the mouse wheel depending on the range of the fight, and keep the one that suits the current arena.
Use Q to dash out of a bad position, such as when you are caught in the open or being focused by several enemies.
Hold E for the shield when you are taking fire and need a moment to reposition, then move out before enemies line up again.
Pick a difficulty and number of allies and enemies that feel manageable, then raise them once you can win consistently.
faq: How do I start aiming and shooting?
Click the game to capture the mouse, then aim with the mouse and fire with the mouse click. Movement uses WASD.
How do I switch between weapons?
Press 1, 2 or 3, or scroll the mouse wheel to cycle through the three blasters.

save-the-dummy.intro: Save the Dummy is a fast-paced drawing puzzle game where you sketch your way through scenes to rescue the little dummy, also called the Stickman. Your drawing skill and concentration decide how quickly you solve each puzzle.
tips: Study the whole scene before you draw. Find the obstacle and the route to the Stickman first, then draw only what you need.
Keep your lines simple and direct. Short, clear strokes are quicker to make and easier to aim than long, wobbly ones.
Pay attention to the animations. They often show what is about to happen, which helps you decide where your drawing should go.
Work quickly but stay calm. The game rewards speed, but a rushed drawing that misses its target will cost you time.
If a drawing does not solve the puzzle, watch what happened and change your approach. Try a different path rather than repeating the same line.
faq: What is the goal of Save the Dummy?
Your goal is to solve each puzzle with your drawings so you can save the little dummy, the Stickman. The game focuses on creativity, drawing skill, and concentration.
How do I draw on a PC?
Use the mouse to draw. Move the mouse to create your lines and shapes in each scene.

ludo-world.intro: Ludo World is a board game of Ludo where you roll dice to move your tokens from the start to the center. Choose classic or quick mode and climb the trophy road as you play.
tips: Plan each move around the dice value: check which token can land safely or reach a useful square before you choose.
Watch where opponent tokens sit, since landing on one can send it back to the start and a token close behind you can threaten yours.
Try both classic and quick mode to see which pace suits you, then stick with the one where you make steadier progress.
Keep an eye on the sub-quests, because completing them earns extra rewards that can help you move further along the trophy road.
Do not rush one token alone; spreading moves across several tokens keeps your options open when a roll does not fit your plan.
faq: What is the goal of Ludo World?
Move all your tokens from the start to the target square in the center based on the values you roll. The game is endless, so each round brings a new challenge.
What happens if I land on an opponent's token?
The opponent's token is sent back to the start. Look for these chances, and be careful about leaving your own tokens where opponents can land on them.

blocky-zombie-shooting.intro: Blocky Zombie Shooting is a voxel shooter where you survive waves of zombies using quirky guns, quick barricades, and tight-corner movement. You can play in arcade or survival mode.
tips: Aim for headshots early, since chasing headshot combos is a main way to build up your score.
Keep moving through tight corners instead of standing still, so the horde cannot surround you.
Build barricades before a wave reaches you rather than in the middle of a fight.
Reload during quieter moments so you are not caught empty when the next group arrives.
Try both arcade and survival modes to see which pace suits your style before committing to long runs.
faq: What is the goal of Blocky Zombie Shooting?
Survive waves of undead that swarm every lane of the voxel warzone. Each round is a fast run where staying alive is the main challenge.
How do I move and drive?
Use W, A, S and D to walk and to drive. The mouse controls where you look and aim.

marnyl-silence-the-haters.intro: MARNYL is a top-down shooter where YBORG fights endless waves of enemies while you move with WASD or the arrow keys and aim with the mouse. Survive as long as you can and grow stronger by collecting XP.
tips: Keep moving rather than standing still, since the waves are endless and staying in one spot lets enemies close in from several sides.
Because shooting is automatic, your main job is aiming. Keep the mouse pointed at the enemies that are closest to you or most dangerous.
Collect XP steadily so you level up, and pick upgrades that match the weapons you already use instead of spreading across many options.
Save Bombs and Freeze for crowded moments or when your health is low, and grab Health pickups before you need them most.
Use XP magnets when XP gems are scattered far away, so you spend less time chasing them and more time staying safe.
faq: What is the goal of MARNYL?
The goal is to survive endless waves of haters, critics, and failed musicians while leveling up YBORG. There is no set finish line described in the game's instructions.
How do I control YBORG?
Move with WASD or the arrow keys and aim with the mouse. Your weapons fire automatically, so aiming is the main thing you control.

online-car-destruction-simulator-3d.intro: Online Car Destruction Simulator 3D is a driving and crash game with realistic vehicle damage. You can drive different cars through demolition scenes and play with others in multiplayer.
tips: Press B to slow down time when a crash is about to happen, so you can judge the angle and speed before impact.
Use C to switch camera views and U for a free camera, so you can watch how each part of the car takes damage.
Press K to restore your car when it is badly damaged, and use R to reset it when you are stuck or upside down.
Try N to switch between cars, since different vehicles show different damage, and pick the one that fits the crash you want to see.
Use the spacebar handbrake with A or D to slide into turns, and save Shift nitro for straight stretches where you can keep control.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
There is no fixed goal. The game asks you to drive and crash cars however you like.
How do I restore my car after a crash?
Press K to restore the car. If it is stuck or flipped, press R to reset it instead.

obby-and-dead-river.intro: Obby & Dead River is a 3D adventure along a dangerous river. You play as a warrior who battles monsters, pirates, and dragons while exploring giant castles and facing a final boss.
tips: Take time to look around the gigantic castles, since treasures are hidden there and rushing past them can cost you rewards.
Upgrade your arsenal whenever you have the chance, so you are better prepared for tougher monsters, pirates, and dragons.
Treat each challenge as a chance to learn how enemies behave before you move on, rather than charging in blindly.
Keep your skill sharp on the river sections, because the description calls the river treacherous and mistakes there can be costly.
Save your best preparation for the final boss, and only face it after you have cleared the earlier challenges and gathered what you can.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby & Dead River?
You travel along the river of death, battle enemies, conquer challenges, and ultimately face the final boss. The description frames it as a journey of courage and skill.
Can I upgrade my weapons or gear?
Yes, the description says you can upgrade your arsenal. Collect what you find along the way and use it to strengthen your warrior.

assault-zone.intro: Assault Zone is a 3D first person shooter where you invade enemy territory and take out every guard one at a time. Move quickly, because the guards will shoot back if you hesitate.
tips: Clear guards one at a time rather than running in the open, so you are never fighting several enemies at once.
Keep moving between shots. Standing still gives the guards more time to fire back.
Use mouse aim on desktop, or the right-side drag on mobile, to line up your shot before you fire.
Before advancing, look around the area to spot where the remaining guards are so you can plan your route.
Practice the movement and aiming controls first so that you can focus on speed when the real fight starts.
faq: What is the goal of Assault Zone?
Your goal is to invade the enemy captured territory and shoot all the guards one by one. You need to eliminate them before they fire back.
How do I move and aim on desktop?
Use the Arrow keys or W, A, S, D to move the character. Move the mouse to turn and aim, then click to shoot.

obbytycoon-money-tycoon.intro: ObbyTycoon: Money Tycoon mixes obstacle-course movement with city building. You move your character, grow your business empire, and shape your city into your own.
tips: Use Shift to speed up when you cross open ground, then slow down before tricky jumps so you land where you planned.
Hold the left mouse button to rotate the camera and look ahead before you jump, so you can judge the distance and height.
Open businesses early, since they are a main source of income for buying buildings, upgrades, and your dream car.
Spend money on the upgrades and buildings that make your city work best, rather than buying everything at once.
On mobile, use the left side of the screen to move and the right side to rotate the camera, and keep your thumbs on those areas so you do not lose control mid-jump.
faq: What is the main goal of ObbyTycoon: Money Tycoon?
The goal is to move through the obby, build your favorite business, and grow your city into a place you control. Earning money through businesses lets you buy buildings, upgrades, and cars.
Which keys control movement and jumping?
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, the spacebar to jump, and Shift to speed up. Hold the left mouse button to rotate the camera.

adventure-rush.intro: Adventure Rush is a fast running and jumping game where you dodge traps and obstacles that come at high speed. Each level gets harder as you move forward.
tips: Watch the path a few steps ahead rather than the character, so you can time your jumps before obstacles reach you.
Jump at the moment you see the danger approaching instead of early, since early jumps often leave you exposed to the next trap.
Pay attention to the pattern of traps on each level; repeating the same section helps you learn when to jump.
Treat every failed attempt as practice and note exactly where you fell, then adjust your timing on that spot.
Stay relaxed and keep your inputs steady, because rushed or repeated button presses can make your jumps less accurate.
faq: What is the goal of Adventure Rush?
Run through each path, avoid the traps and dangers, and progress level by level by overcoming increasingly difficult obstacles.
How do I control the character?
Use the keyboard or the touch buttons to run and jump. Jumping at the right moment is the main skill the game tests.

monopoly-online.intro: Monopoly Online brings the classic property trading board game to your browser. Buy properties, collect rent, and try to outlast your opponents in this familiar business game.
tips: Use left clicks to move through each turn, and check the prompts on screen before you confirm a purchase or trade.
Buy properties early when you can afford them, since owning complete color groups lets you charge more rent.
Keep a cash reserve so you are not forced to sell buildings or properties when an opponent lands on your rent.
Build houses evenly across a color group rather than stacking them on one property, which keeps your rent growing steadily.
Pay attention to which properties opponents are missing, and consider trades that complete your own sets.
faq: How do I play Monopoly Online?
Use the left mouse button to take your actions in the game, such as rolling the dice and making decisions on purchases.
What is the goal of the game?
The game is a business game where you build up wealth by buying and developing properties, and the aim is to leave your opponents without money.

pop-it-infinity.intro: Pop it Infinity is a relaxing clicker where you smash pop gadgets of different shapes until the board is clear. It is played with the mouse and suits players of all ages.
tips: Scan the whole board before you start clicking so you can see which pops are left and plan a route across them.
Work in a steady rhythm instead of rushing; a calm, even pace helps you keep track of every shape.
Try clearing one area at a time rather than jumping randomly around the board, so you don't miss pops in the corners.
Keep your clicks short and precise, since the game is built around smashing each pop with a single click.
Take short breaks during long sessions; the game is designed for relaxed play, so there is no need to push for speed.
faq: What is the goal of Pop it Infinity?
The goal is to click on the pops to smash them and clear the board. Each shape of pop gadget needs to be smashed to finish a board.
What controls do I use?
You play with the mouse. Click the mouse button on the pops to smash them.

battboy-adventure.intro: Battboy Adventure is a platformer with eight levels that get harder as you go. Your goal is to avoid spikes, defeat quirky enemies, and collect stars to win.
tips: Watch the spikes before you move. Pause for a moment to see where they are, since a single touch can end your run.
Plan each jump before you make it. Fast reflexes help, but a quick look at the next platform often prevents a mistake.
Collect stars when they are safe to reach. Grabbing them along the way is part of the level, so do not rush past them.
Study how each enemy moves before you engage. Learning their patterns helps you choose the right moment to act.
Expect the levels to get harder as you progress. Stay calm in the early levels so your habits are ready for the later ones.
faq: What is the goal of Battboy Adventure?
You move through eight levels, avoid spikes, and collect stars. Finishing the levels and collecting stars is how you secure victory.
Do I need to defeat the enemies to progress?
The description mentions conquering quirky enemies as part of the journey. Watch how each one behaves and deal with them carefully as you move forward.

boss-level-pumpkin-madness.intro: Boss Level - Pumpkin Madness is a spooky retro arcade adventure starring Billy Boy. You battle eerie foes, dodge threats, and collect rockets on the way to a Halloween boss.
tips: Plan ahead when you collect rockets, since the game asks you to gather them strategically rather than grabbing them at random.
Watch for threats before they reach you, because the game rewards quick reactions at every level.
Pay attention to where enemies and hazards appear so you can dodge them without losing momentum.
Keep moving through the fast-paced action instead of pausing, since hesitation can leave you open to attack.
Save your rockets for the Halloween boss rather than spending them early, so you go into the final fight prepared.
faq: What is the main goal of Boss Level - Pumpkin Madness?
You play as Billy Boy, battling eerie foes and dodging threats while working your way up to the Halloween boss at the end.
Why are rockets important in this game?
The game asks you to collect rockets strategically, which suggests they play a key role in preparing for the boss fight.

jungle-mart-idle-game.intro: Jungle Mart is a relaxing idle game about running a jungle market. You hire helpers, upgrade efficiency, and grow your market step by step.
tips: Check your production regularly, since the game keeps progressing while you are not actively playing.
Compare the options before spending. Hiring helpers and upgrading efficiency both speed things up, so pick the one that gives you the most benefit for your current setup.
Expand your market in stages rather than all at once, and make sure your current area is running smoothly first.
Keep your workers producing steadily. A smooth production line is the core of the game, so fix any bottlenecks as they appear.
Move around the market often to interact with things and spot where progress can be improved.
faq: What is the main goal of Jungle Mart?
The goal is to maintain smooth production while hiring helpers, upgrading efficiency, and expanding your jungle market step by step.
How do I move my character?
On PC, use the W, A, S and D keys. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick. Use the same controls to interact with things in the market.

obby-extreme-cart-ride.intro: Obby: Extreme Cart Ride is a fast obstacle course where you steer a cart across tracks full of jumps, traps, and turns. Keep your speed up, stay on the track, and reach the finish line.
tips: Watch the track ahead rather than your cart, so you can line up turns and jumps before you reach them.
Tap or hold jump only when you are lined up with the next gap or ramp, since a rushed jump is a common way to fly off the track.
Use the camera control to look around corners and check what is coming before you commit to a path.
Adjust your steering early and gently. Sudden direction changes at high speed make it easier to slide off the edge.
Expect the tracks to change as you progress. Study each new section for a few seconds on your next run before you rush it.
faq: What is the goal of Obby: Extreme Cart Ride?
Your goal is to reach the finish line of each track while avoiding traps and staying on the course. Every mistake can cost you the victory.
How do I move and jump?
On PC, use W, A, S and D to move and the Space bar to jump. On mobile, use the left joystick to move and the on-screen button to jump.

farm-care-tycoon.intro: Build a farm from a few empty fields into a busy operation. Plant crops, raise animals, run factories and keep your shop stocked to earn coins for new land and machines.
tips: Stand on your fields to plant and harvest, then carry the goods to the matching shelves, since customers only pay when shelves are stocked.
Watch the counter at the top of the screen so you know how much you are carrying before you walk back to a shelf.
Pick up the cash piles as you pass them, and spend coins on unlock spots when you can afford a new field, animal or factory.
Fill the star bar to level up, because higher levels let you carry more with each trip.
Save your Income and Speed boosts for busy stretches, and spin the free wheel every 10 minutes to collect extra prizes.
faq: How do I earn money in Farm Care Tycoon?
Bring crops, animals products and factory goods to the matching shelves so customers can buy them and pay at the checkout. Collect the cash piles you find on the map to grab your money.
How do I move around the farm?
On mobile, drag on the screen. On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys, or click and drag.

guns-vs-magic.intro: Guns vs Magic is an adventure shooter where you play Silvius, a student of magic, fighting back against his former mentor Lucius and an army of enchanted creatures. You move with the arrow keys or WASD and aim with the mouse.
tips: Learn the movement and aiming controls before you press on, since you use the arrow keys or WASD to move and the mouse to aim at the same time.
Keep moving rather than standing still when enemies close in, so you are not an easy target for the creatures.
Pay attention to where enemies come from and deal with the closest threats first before turning to the rest.
Use each encounter as a chance to read the situation, since the game mixes battles of power with battles of wits and courage.
If you get overwhelmed, step back to a safer spot and regroup instead of pushing forward into a crowd.
faq: What is the goal of Guns vs Magic?
You play as Silvius and must confront Lucius and his army of enchanted creatures to stop the dark powers he has unleashed on the world.
How do I move and aim?
Use the arrow keys or WASD to move and the mouse to aim and fire.

minetap-merge-clicker.intro: MineTap Merge Clicker combines mining, block merging, and village building in an idle clicker. Tapping efficiently and planning upgrades are the main skills it tests.
tips: Focus on tapping efficiently rather than tapping at random, since clicking well is central to how this game is played.
Use merging to craft stronger tools before you push deeper, so your mining keeps pace with the challenge.
Spend upgrades strategically instead of buying whatever is available first, and think about which one will help your next steps most.
Keep an eye on monsters and prepare for them before they become a problem, rather than reacting after your village takes damage.
Try different block combinations to see what you can create, because the game rewards experimentation and discovery.
faq: What is the main goal of MineTap Merge Clicker?
The game centers on mining blocks, merging them into tools, defending against monsters, and growing a village. Progress comes from combining these parts in a steady way.
How does upgrading work in this game?
Upgrades are a key part of the challenge, so it helps to choose them with a plan rather than spending everything at once. Think about which upgrade supports your tapping and merging best.

bingo-mania.intro: Bingo Mania is a cooking bingo game where you call numbers, daub matching cells, and complete patterns to gather ingredients. Work through the kitchen tiers from cupcakes to a grand feast.
tips: Check each called number against your card right away so you don't miss a match before the next call.
Look at the target pattern before each round starts, such as a line, corner, or themed shape, and keep an eye on the cells that are closest to completing it.
Expect longer recipes to bring more cards, tighter timers, and special tiles, so practice the basic pattern checks early in Kitchen Quest.
Reach level 25 to unlock Bingo Battles, and try casual practice matches first if you want to get comfortable with timed head-to-head play.
Check your daily tasks and seasonal rewards regularly, since they add extra goals alongside the main levels.
faq: How do I win a Kitchen Quest level?
Tap the matching cells on your bingo card as numbers are called, then complete the target pattern. The game calls BINGO! automatically once the pattern is finished.
What do I earn from completing a level?
Each victory earns ingredients and progress toward your recipe, which moves through the stages gather, prep, cook, decorate, and serve.

marble-color-sort.intro: Marble Color Sort is a 3D sorting puzzle where you drop colored marbles from the top trays and match them into the boxes at the bottom. Watch the physics and plan each drop.
tips: Before you tap a tray, check the conveyor belt first. Make sure there is room for the marbles you are about to release.
Look for colors that already have a box waiting at the bottom. Sending matching marbles first keeps the conveyor clear.
Keep track of how many marbles of each color are still in play. Each box needs three of the same color, so you can see which boxes will fill next.
Avoid dropping a color that has no open box and a full belt. That combination is the fastest way to lose.
Watch how the marbles tumble before committing to a drop. The physics can send a marble somewhere you did not expect, so a short pause can save a move.
faq: What is the goal of Marble Color Sort?
Your goal is to sort every colorful marble from the top trays into the matching boxes at the bottom. Each box fills when it gets three marbles of the same color.
How do I release marbles?
Tap a tray at the top to drop its marbles. They tumble down with realistic physics and land on the moving conveyor belt.

scary-baby-in-yellow.intro: Scary Baby in Yellow is a 3D horror escape game where you search for a frightened yellow baby and guide him through a series of timed levels. Careful movement and quick decisions help you finish each stage before the clock runs out.
tips: Read the on-screen instructions carefully at the start of each level, since they tell you where to take the baby.
Keep an eye on the time limit for each level and plan your route before you start moving.
Use the mouse to look around often so you do not miss objects or paths that help you progress.
Press F to grab items only when you are sure you need them, and remember where you picked things up.
If you fail a level, you lose your progress, so take your time on early levels and avoid rushing into unknown areas.
faq: What is the goal of Scary Baby in Yellow?
Find the scared yellow baby, follow the instructions, and take him where the game tells you to. You need to complete all the levels.
What happens if I run out of time?
If you do not finish a level before its time limit, you lose your progress and must start that level again.

park-tycoon.intro: Park Tycoon is a 3D management game where you grow a single ticket booth into a busy amusement park. You collect cash, build and upgrade rides, and hire staff so the park can run on its own.
tips: Collect the cash visitors leave behind as you go, since it pays for new rides and upgrades.
Stand behind the booth to sell tickets early on, so money comes in while you build the rest of the park.
Hire staff once you can afford it, so cashiers, operators, vendors, cleaners and technicians handle the work instead of you.
Keep litter cleared and fix breakdowns quickly, because these actions are how you earn stars needed to unlock Pirate Bay.
Check in on your daily missions and come back often, since the park keeps earning while you are away.
faq: How do I unlock Pirate Bay?
You unlock Pirate Bay by earning stars. Stars come from keeping visitors happy, cleaning litter and fixing breakdowns.
How do I build or upgrade a ride?
Walk onto a build tile to open a new ride or upgrade an existing one. Rides can be upgraded up to level 5.

escape-strange-girl-s-house-2.intro: A private detective searches an isolated house for a missing person, exploring rooms, collecting items, and solving puzzles in this first-person point and click adventure. Read carefully and pay attention to every sound.
tips: Check every room thoroughly before moving on, since useful items can be hidden in small or easy-to-miss spots.
Collect everything that looks like it could be useful, then try combining items in your inventory to see if they create new tools.
Read all notes and clues closely, because they contain hints that point you toward the next step.
When you get stuck, try using your current items on different objects in the room, not only the ones that seem obvious.
Listen carefully, since the game notes that every sound matters and may give you a clue about what to do next.
faq: What is the main goal of Escape Strange Girl's House 2?
You need to find out what happened to the missing person who vanished a month ago and escape the house alive. Progress comes from exploring, collecting items, and using them in the right places.
How do I progress through the puzzles?
Tap or click to explore locations, collect useful items, and combine objects in your inventory to make new tools. Use these items on other objects to solve puzzles and unlock new areas.

santa-vs-zomby.intro: Santa Vs Zomby is a physics-based sports-style game where you launch Santa at zombies to knock them down and recover the stolen gifts. Clear every level to save Christmas.
tips: Before each launch, look at how the zombies and structures are arranged and pick the target that will cause the most damage to the rest.
Use the physics to your advantage: a heavy hit that topples a support can bring down several zombies at once.
Try different launch angles and strengths on the same level to learn how Santa travels, rather than repeating the same shot.
Aim for the zombies that are hardest to reach first, so you do not run out of chances to clear them later.
If a level stalls, rethink the order of your shots instead of rushing; a calm, planned sequence usually clears more enemies.
faq: How do I play Santa Vs Zomby?
Click or tap to launch Santa at the zombies. Use the physics of each hit to make them fall or crash until all enemies are destroyed.
What is the goal of each level?
Destroy all of the zombies in the level to complete it and move on. Clearing every level recovers the gifts.

ninja-vs-ragdolls-sharp-knife-throw.intro: Ninja vs Ragdolls: Sharp Knife Throw! is a knife-throwing game where you aim at ragdoll stickman enemies and clear each level by defeating all of them. Precision and timing matter more than speed.
tips: Watch how the enemies move before you throw, and wait for a moment when your target is in a clear position.
Focus on accuracy first. The game rewards more precise throws with faster wins, so slow, careful aim usually beats rushing.
Look at the whole stage before throwing. Puzzles and destructible objects around the enemies can help you hit them indirectly.
Try the different types of knives available to you and notice which ones suit the targets and distances in each stage.
Keep your aim steady and throw in a single, deliberate action. Each tap or click sends the knife where you point, so a clean aim avoids wasted throws.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to defeat all of the ragdoll enemies on a level by hitting them with your knives. Accurate throws help you win faster.
How do I throw a knife?
On PC, aim with the cursor and click the left mouse button. On mobile devices, tap the spot you want to hit, and the knife flies toward that point.

dessert-maker.intro: Dessert Maker is a cooking game where you build sweet treats such as ice cream, popsicles, waffles, bingsu and rolled ice cream. You mix flavors, add syrup and icing, and decorate each dessert as you like.
tips: Try a base dessert first to learn how each ingredient changes the final result before you start combining many things.
Pick one or two flavors that go well together and build around them, so your dessert looks and tastes consistent.
Use syrup and icing early in the process, then add decorative toppings last so they stay visible on top.
Experiment with combos on different dessert types, since a topping that works on waffles may look different on bingsu or a popsicle.
Stock the fridge with a variety of finished desserts so you have a mix of styles to show off in your display.
faq: What is the main goal of Dessert Maker?
The goal is to create desserts you like, mixing flavors and adding toppings to make your own unique designs. There is no fixed target, so you play by experimenting and decorating.
How do I make a combo?
Combine ingredients such as syrup and icing on your dessert to create a combo. Try different pairings to see which results you enjoy most.

black-hole-attack.intro: Black Hole Attack is a fast arcade game where you guide a black hole, collect weapons quickly, and face boss battles. Speed, reflexes, and quick decisions matter throughout.
tips: Collect weapons early, before the pace picks up, so you enter each stage with more options.
Keep your eyes moving across the screen so you can spot weapons and threats before they reach you.
Before each boss fight, think about what you already have and choose your response quickly rather than hesitating mid-battle.
Play a few short rounds in a row to build reflexes, then aim to beat your own best score for a steady climb on the leaderboard.
If a run goes badly, restart and focus on one improvement at a time, such as faster weapon pickup or quicker boss reactions.
faq: What is the main goal in Black Hole Attack?
You guide an all-consuming black hole, gather weapons quickly, and get through intense boss battles while climbing the leaderboard.
How do I score points and climb the leaderboard?
The game's description says you climb the leaderboard by testing your reflexes and performing well in its fast-paced play, but it does not list specific scoring rules.

epic-empire-tower-defense.intro: Epic Empire: Tower Defense is a strategy game where you defend your kingdom from waves of goblins, ogres, and bosses. You place towers, control three heroes, and work to hold the line.
tips: Spread your towers so that enemies coming along the path are hit by more than one tower at a time.
Keep your three heroes active during waves rather than letting one do all the work, since you control all of them at once.
Save your strongest defenses for boss waves, because bosses are much tougher than regular enemies.
Replay earlier levels when you need to grow stronger, since leveling up depends on replaying them at higher difficulty and rewards.
Check the daily challenge levels regularly, as they offer extra rewards that can help you progress.
faq: What is the main goal of Epic Empire: Tower Defense?
You defend your kingdom from waves of enemies by placing towers and controlling your heroes. Your aim is to defeat all the bosses and hold the line.
How do I level up my heroes faster?
Replay levels several times, since each replay raises the difficulty and the rewards. Leveling up also unlocks new skills and abilities.

robby-escape-the-rooms.intro: Robby: Escape The Rooms is an adventure where you work through a series of rooms, solving puzzles, finding hidden objects, and getting past mini obstacle courses before time runs out.
tips: Look around each room before moving on. Hidden objects are part of the challenge, so check corners, shelves, and areas off the main path.
Use the right mouse button or the camera controls to turn around often. Spotting clues quickly saves time when the clock is running.
Practice jumping on the mini-obby sections early in a room. Learning the timing of your Space Bar jumps keeps you from falling and losing progress.
Keep track of what you have already found and tried. Since the puzzles get harder as you go, reusing the logic from earlier rooms can help.
Pause with Tab or Escape when you need to think through a puzzle. This lets you plan your next move without the timer pushing you to rush.
faq: What is the goal of Robby: Escape The Rooms?
Your goal is to solve the puzzles in each room, find the hidden objects, and get out. The game has 50 rooms, and each one has its own task.
What are the basic controls on a computer?
Use WASD to move, the right mouse button to change the camera view, and the Space Bar to jump. Press Tab or Escape to pause.

bee-careful.intro: Bee Careful is an arcade adventure where you guide a determined bee through busy environments. Dodge predators, gather pollen, and get past obstacles while building your score.
tips: Watch the predators before you commit to a path, since staying out of their way is what keeps the bee going.
Collect pollen whenever it is safe to do so, because it is a core part of your progress.
Plan your route through each environment rather than reacting only at the last moment, since the obstacles are designed to be outmaneuvered with strategy.
Look out for power-ups and use them when they will help you most, since they are meant to boost your score.
Expect the pace to pick up as you move through levels, so stay focused and keep your attention on the screen.
faq: What is the main goal in Bee Careful?
You play as a bee moving through intricate environments. Your aim is to dodge predators, collect pollen, and outmaneuver obstacles as you progress.
How do I increase my score?
Collect pollen and use power-ups, which are described as ways to boost your score. The game rewards careful movement as well as collecting.

master-checkers.intro: Master Checkers is a two-player board game based on Italian Checkers. You move pieces diagonally, jump over your opponent's pieces, and try to crown a piece as a king. You can play against the computer, a local player, or online opponents.
tips: Captures are mandatory, so check every move for jumps you must make before you choose a move. Think about where your piece lands after the jump.
Watch for multiple jumps in one turn. A single move can capture several pieces, so look for paths where one jump sets up the next.
Before advancing a piece, look at the squares behind it. An opponent may be able to jump it if the landing square on the other side is empty.
Try to reach the far row carefully. Getting a king lets a piece move both forward and backward, which gives you more options for defending and attacking.
Keep your pieces together where possible. Pieces that support each other are harder to jump than single pieces standing alone.
faq: How do I win the game?

The instructions describe capturing opponent pieces by jumping and crowning pieces as kings, so your aim is to capture the opponent's pieces while keeping your own. Check the in-game rules screen for the exact winning condition.
Can a single piece move backward?
No. Single pieces can only move forward, toward the opponent. Only a piece that has become a king can move either forward or backward.

crash-test-simulator-3d.intro: Crash Test Simulator 3D is a driving game about steering and collisions. You drive different cars through maps full of ramps, jumps and obstacles to see how each one deforms and loses parts.
tips: Higher speed causes more destruction, so build up speed before hitting ramps or obstacles if you want to see the most damage.
Each car loses parts differently, so try the same obstacle with several cars to compare how durable they are.
Use the truck to crush other cars when you want a heavier impact, and watch how the collision affects both vehicles.
Pay attention to the barrels of fuel on the maps, since they can explode and destroy your car.
Switch between the four camera views to find the one that makes it easiest to judge distance and see the damage as it happens.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
The game is about testing how strong each car is by driving it through crash scenarios and watching the parts break off. There is no parking or precise driving challenge.
Does the speed of my car change the result?
Yes, the game says that a higher speed leads to more destruction of the car, so faster impacts show more damage.

your-obby-parkour.intro: Your Obby Parkour is a 3D obstacle course where you run and jump through themed regions to reach the end of each stage. Use WASD to move and Space to jump, and watch for lava, ice, traps and hidden paths along the way.
tips: Watch the layout before you jump. Look ahead with the mouse wheel zoom to judge gaps, trampolines and spinning traps before you commit.
Slow down on icy slides. Slippery ice paths carry momentum, so keep short, controlled jumps when you reach them.
Take your time in horror mazes. It is easy to get lost there, so note landmarks and follow the route you have already checked.
Explore for shortcuts. Hidden paths and secret shortcuts can save a lot of time on the harder stages, so look off the main route.
Play with friends if you want company. The game supports multiplayer, so you can compare routes and share tips on tougher regions.
faq: What is the goal of Your Obby Parkour?
Your goal is to get to the end of each stage. Harder regions add more dangers, so progress is measured by how far you can get safely.
What are the controls?
Use WASD to move and the Space bar to jump. Press TAB to pause, Shift for the cursor, and use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out.

euro-2020-2021.intro: Euro 2020 (2021) is a football game built around free kicks. You pick one of 10 teams and aim to win the championship. Mouse or touch controls handle both kicking and defending.
tips: Try a few of the 10 teams before settling on one, so you can see which squad suits your style of play.
Before each kick, look closely at the target area and decide where you want the ball to go rather than kicking in a rush.
Pay attention to when the game switches you into defending, and react to the attacking side's position instead of waiting.
Stay consistent with your approach from match to match, so you can learn what works and repeat it when the stakes rise.
If you lose a round, replay it and focus on one thing you want to improve, such as accuracy or defence, instead of changing everything at once.
faq: How do I kick the ball?
Use your mouse or touch input to take the free kick. Aim carefully before you release, since accuracy decides whether the shot scores.
How do I defend?
The same mouse or touch controls are used for defending. Watch the opponent's kick closely and respond in time to block it.

space-tower-defense.intro: Space Tower Defense is a tower defense game where you protect a futuristic base from waves of enemies. You place towers on 3D battlefields and upgrade them as the fighting gets harder.
tips: Plan your tower placement before the first wave arrives, since the layout of the battlefield decides how long enemies stay in range of your towers.
Watch which way enemies move in each wave and place towers so they cover that route rather than clustering in one spot.
Spend upgrades steadily instead of all at once so your defenses keep pace as the waves grow stronger.
If a wave breaks through and your defenses fail, use what you learned about the enemy path to rearrange your towers on the next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Space Tower Defense?
Your goal is to protect your futuristic base from enemy waves by placing and upgrading towers. If your defenses fail, you have to start again.
How do I win a round?
You win by holding off the enemy waves until your base survives. Strong tower placement and timely upgrades are the main way to get there.

zombies-4-weapon-merge.intro: Zombies 4 Weapon Merge is an arcade shooter where you merge weapons into stronger guns and fight off endless waves of zombies. You play by clicking or tapping.
tips: Think about each merge before you make it, since the description says every decision matters. A stronger gun is only useful if it helps you handle the waves coming next.
Keep your weapons matched and merged as early as you can. Waiting too long to upgrade can leave you under-armed when the zombies get thicker.
Take a moment to aim before you shoot. Steady, deliberate clicks or taps usually work better than rapid, careless ones.
Plan your strategy around the endless waves rather than one fight at a time. Spend your attention on the zombies closest to you first so the crowd does not overwhelm you.
Pay attention to which weapons you have on hand so you can choose merges that complement each other. Building a clear plan for your guns makes the strategy side of the game pay off.
faq: What is the goal of Zombies 4 Weapon Merge?
The goal is to survive the endless waves of zombies by merging weapons into powerful guns and shooting them down. Your merges and aim decide how long you can keep going.
How do I play the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. Match and merge weapons, then aim and shoot at the zombies.

hotgear.intro: Hotgear is a racing game set in a open city, where you customize your car, take on missions, and try to outrun pursuers in high-speed chases. It is built around car choice and driving through the streets.
tips: Try several cars from the available options before settling on one, since each run can feel different depending on the vehicle you pick.
Spend a few minutes exploring the open city before starting missions so you learn the roads, shortcuts, and places where you can build up a lead.
Pay attention to the mission goal before each run so you know whether you should prioritize speed, escaping, or reaching a specific point.
Use customization to adjust your ride toward the way you like to drive, and change it when a mission seems to favor a different style.
During chases, keep your focus on the road ahead and avoid taking risky turns at high speed, since crashes will cost you time in the pursuit.
faq: What is the main goal in Hotgear?
The game asks you to complete explosive missions and high-speed getaways in a city full of pursuits. Read each mission's objective on screen before you start.
Can I customize my car?
Yes, the game lets you customize your ride. Choose options that suit how you drive and the missions you plan to play.

100-doors-mystery-room-escape.intro: Test your logic and observation skills in 100 Doors: Mystery Room Escape. Crack codes, solve riddles, and find hidden objects to unlock doors and escape each room.
tips: Inspect every object in a room closely before trying a solution. Clues like cryptic symbols or gear shapes often hint at what to do next.
Pick up and keep items you find, since hidden keys and objects are often needed to open doors later.
When you find a keypad, look for codes written in the room before guessing. Noting any numbers or symbols you spot can help you match them up.
Think outside the box. If a mechanical puzzle or riddle stalls you, try examining a different part of the room and come back to it.
Progress saves automatically, so you can take a break between rooms and pick up exactly where you left off.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to unlock all 100 doors and escape each room by solving its puzzles.
How do I interact with objects on a desktop?
Use the left mouse button to click objects, pick up items, tap keypad codes, and open doors.

mr-dude-king-of-the-hill.intro: Mr. Dude: King of the Hill is a 3D action game where you help a criminal escape residents on a mountain by knocking out, dragging, and throwing opponents. Use the controls and objects to clear the way to the top.
tips: Pick up objects with F and switch between them with keys 1, 2 and 3 so you always have the right item ready before an enemy reaches you.
Use right mouse button to aim before you throw, since a well-aimed shot is more useful than rapid, careless throws.
Use the ragdoll physics to your advantage: knocking an enemy into objects or off ledges can clear several opponents at once.
Use E to grab ledges when the terrain is steep or crowded, so you can get out of danger or reach higher ground.
Keep moving with WASD and jump with Space rather than standing still, because enemies are waiting on the mountain and staying in one place makes you an easy target.
faq: What is the main goal of Mr. Dude: King of the Hill?
Your goal is to avoid getting caught, defeat all the enemies, and conquer the mountain. Each level is about pushing your way through the residents who want to hand you over to the police.
How do I attack enemies?
Use the left mouse button to hit or throw shots, and hold the right mouse button to aim. You can knock out, drag, and throw opponents using the physics system.

schoolboy-runaway-room-escape.intro: Schoolboy Runaway is a first-person stealth escape game where you search a house for hidden objects while your strict parents keep giving you chores. Use the tips below to plan your moves and avoid getting caught.
tips: Before you move, look around the room and note which objects might be useful, since you need to find hidden items to get out.
Keep an eye on where your parents are before you walk or interact, because the game is built around stealth.
Check the chores your parents give you, since completing them may be part of the path to escaping.
Rotate the camera slowly to scan corners and shelves, so you do not miss small hidden objects.
On PC, use WASD to move and the mouse to look around, and on phone, use the left joystick to walk and swipe the right side to turn the camera.
faq: What is the goal of Schoolboy Runaway?
Your goal is to escape the room by searching for hidden objects in the house while avoiding your strict parents. The game is a first-person stealth quest.
How do I interact with objects on PC?
Use the left mouse button to interact with objects, and use WASD to walk and the mouse to rotate the camera. On phone, tap objects to interact.

merge-adventure.intro: Merge Adventure is a cozy puzzle game about combining coffee, garden, and renovation items to fill customer orders. Each finished order brings rewards you use to restore the neighborhood one step at a time.
tips: Tap your producer items regularly, since they create the new objects you need for merging and orders.
Check the customer orders before you merge, so you don't combine away the items a current order is asking for.
Focus on one merge chain at a time to keep the board uncluttered and make it easier to spot identical items.
Spend rewards on the building upgrades that bring your current renovation stage closer to completion.
Experiment with different merges when you have spare items, because discovering upgraded objects is part of the progression.
faq: How do I win a renovation stage?
You win by fulfilling orders, collecting the required resources, and completing that area's building upgrades.
How do I merge two items?
Click and drag one item onto an identical item with a mouse, or touch and drag on a touchscreen.

grand-prix-hero.intro: Grand Prix Hero is a 3D racing game where you compete across several continents in the Grand Prix Series. Steer around traffic, use boost at high speed, and collect coins to upgrade your car.
tips: Keep your car centered when you can, so you have room to swerve when traffic appears ahead.
Look ahead rather than at your car, since spotting gaps in traffic early gives you more time to react.
Save boost for stretches where you are already at high speed, so it adds more distance.
Try to collect coins along your route when it does not put you into danger, since they help you upgrade for the next race.
Use each race to learn the traffic pattern, then adjust your lane choices on later attempts.
faq: How do I steer on mobile and desktop?
On mobile, use touch to steer. On desktop, use the cursor keys or WASD.
What is the main goal of the game?
Race through the Grand Prix Series across multiple continents while dodging traffic and finishing competitive races.

fall-guyz.intro: Fall Guyz is an arcade obstacle course where you run, jump, and race other characters to the finish. Learn the layout of each map and time your jumps to stay ahead of the field.
tips: Study each map on your first attempt so you know where the platforms and dangerous objects are before you race.
Anticipate obstacles a few moves ahead instead of reacting at the last second, since timing is what keeps your character on track.
Plan your jumps carefully before you commit, because a bad jump over a platform can cost you the lead.
Try again after each run and aim to beat your previous score, using what you learned about the course.
Pick the character that suits your style, and remember that you can unlock up to 7 more as you play.
faq: What is the goal of Fall Guyz?
Run around the map, jump over obstacles, and arrive first before the other characters. You also complete levels and try to collect the most points.
How do I control my character?
Use the arrow keys to move on a computer, or use the mouse. On a touch screen, tap the screen to move.

alien-bubbles.intro: Alien Bubbles puts you in control of a dinosaur who fights back against an alien invasion. Use your launcher and arrows to pop colorful bubble invaders and protect Earth.
tips: Plan each shot before you fire. The description stresses strategic shots, so look at the whole group of bubbles before choosing where to aim.
Look for bubbles of the same color that sit close together. Popping a cluster in one shot clears more space than hitting bubbles one at a time.
Save power-ups for tough moments. Using them early can leave you without help when the invaders get dense.
Keep an eye on how the bubbles are arranged. Clearing a path to the bubbles near the top or edges can open up better shots later.
Take a moment to check which color arrow you have ready before you shoot, so you do not waste a turn on a shot that does not help.
faq: What is the main goal of Alien Bubbles?
Pop the colorful bubble invaders with your dinosaur's launcher to stop the alien invasion and save Earth.
How do power-ups help in Alien Bubbles?
Power-ups give you extra help against the invaders. Use them wisely, ideally when the bubbles are hardest to clear.

gang-blast.intro: Gang Blast is a cover-based escort shooter where you fight through dinosaur hordes to protect an evacuation and get everyone to safety. Play with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Use cover before you start shooting, since the game is built around staying protected while you clear the way.
Spend your cash on the weapon or perk that fits the threat in front of you rather than buying randomly.
Look at the whole route before moving the group, so you know where the guards and dinosaurs are likely to come from.
Keep the people you are escorting in mind at all times, because one mistake can put the whole rescue at risk.
Clear the path ahead in small steps and check that the evacuation is still safe before advancing.
faq: What is the main goal in Gang Blast?
You need to escape from the dinosaur hordes, protect your evacuation, and clear a route to freedom. The rescue succeeds only if everyone is escorted to safety.
How do I control the game?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The instructions do not list any other controls.

basket-battle.intro: Basket Battle is a head-to-head basketball game where you try to score while stopping your opponent from doing the same. Strategy and quick blocks decide who comes out ahead.
tips: Pay attention to your opponent's shots and timing, since knowing when they are likely to score helps you prepare your block.
Do not spend every moment chasing points. Protecting your side of the court matters just as much as making your own shots.
Save your best attempts for moments when your opponent is out of position, so each shot you take has a better chance of counting.
Watch for openings after a block, because turning a defensive stop into a quick score can swing the match in your favor.
Stay focused for the full match, since the game rewards steady, careful play more than rushing in without a plan.
faq: What is the main goal of Basket Battle?
The goal is to make your shots count while preventing your opponent from scoring. You win by outplaying them on both offense and defense.
How can I get better at blocking in Basket Battle?
Keep an eye on your opponent's shooting pattern and react early rather than waiting to see the shot. Staying ready on defense gives you more chances to stop their attempts.

pretty-tidy-asmr-organizing.intro: Pretty Tidy is a calm puzzle game about sorting, organizing, and tidying messy spaces. It pairs soft sounds and gentle music with a relaxed, stress-free pace.
tips: Use headphones so you can hear the soft ASMR sounds and background music clearly.
Tackle one group of objects at a time, such as all the toys or all the sorting tasks, so the room feels less cluttered as you go.
Take a short break between puzzles if you notice the calm feeling wearing off, then come back when you feel settled.
Pay attention to the small details in each scene, since the cute objects and funny toys often carry the most charm.
Play in a quiet space with few distractions so you can focus on the sorting and tidying steps.
faq: What is the goal of Pretty Tidy?
Your goal is to turn messy spaces into perfectly tidy ones by cleaning up, organizing, and sorting items.
What kinds of puzzles are included?
The game includes a variety of calming puzzles, including sorting, tidying, funny toys, and cute objects.

knives.intro: Knives is an arcade challenge where you throw knives at a spinning target while avoiding blades already stuck in it. Timing and precision decide how far you get, and the leaderboard tracks your results.
tips: Watch the target for a few rotations before your first throw so you can judge its speed and rhythm.
Pay close attention to the gaps between the knives already in the target, since a throw that hits an existing blade ends your attempt.
Plan each throw around the target's position at the moment the knife would arrive, not where it is when you start aiming.
Expect the difficulty to rise, so stay patient early on and keep your timing consistent rather than rushing.
Treat every throw as a practice rep, and if you miss, note what made the timing go wrong before your next attempt.
faq: What is the goal of Knives?
Throw knives at a spinning target while avoiding the blades already stuck in it. The game is built around precise, well-timed throws.
Does the game get harder as I play?
Yes, the description says the difficulty increases over time, so the later stages demand sharper timing.

football-crash.intro: Football Crash is a sports game where you steer a player past aggressive defenders with single-finger swipes and aim for touchdowns. The defenders grow more persistent as you go.
tips: Watch where the defenders are moving before each swipe, and pick a gap that they cannot close in time.
Avoid rushing straight at the end zone. Small changes of direction can keep you out of a defender's path.
Keep your finger ready for quick follow-up swipes, since a defender can close a gap within a moment.
Expect the defenders to become more tenacious over time, so stay alert and don't get comfortable with your early routes.
Treat each attempt as a chance to learn how defenders react, and use those patterns to plan your route next time.
faq: How do I control my player?
You control your player with single-finger swipes. Swipe to move your player and dodge the opponents on the field.
What is the goal of the game?
Your goal is to navigate your player to a touchdown while dodging defenders. The defenders become more tenacious as the challenge goes on.

draw-action.intro: Draw Action is a stickman fighting game where you draw lines to attack enemies. Each pattern you draw triggers a different attack, so learning them is the key to clearing each level.
tips: Experiment with different patterns early on to see which attack each one produces, then remember the ones that work best against each enemy type.
Tap the leg or arm of the blue character before drawing so your pattern lands on the right target.
Try pushing enemies toward the water instead of only wearing down their health, since a fall can defeat them outright.
Improve your character's characteristics whenever you can, because the enemies grow stronger, faster, and more numerous as you progress.
Save your strongest combo attacks for groups or tough enemies, and keep simpler strokes for weaker foes so you can avoid taking damage.
faq: What is the goal of Draw Action?
Defeat all the enemies on each level by reducing their health to zero or by pushing them out of the location so they fall into the water.
How do I attack an enemy?
Tap the leg or arm of the blue character, then draw a pattern. The shape you draw determines which attack you perform.

bob-save-stuart.intro: Bob Save Stuart is a single-player arcade action game. Bob must raise the cage, collect bananas, and run ahead of purple smoke while avoiding purple monsters to save his friends.
tips: Keep track of where the purple smoke is at all times and head for the cage before it reaches you or your friends.
Grab bananas along your route when they are close, but do not wander far off your path while the smoke is spreading.
Use the double jump to clear obstacles and get past danger quickly instead of stopping to think mid-jump.
When a purple monster gets close, move away from it right away rather than waiting to see how close it gets.
Learn which direction you can run safely so you can switch quickly between WASD and the arrow keys if one feels more comfortable.
faq: What is the main goal of Bob Save Stuart?
Raise the cage, collect the bananas, and run before the purple smoke arrives so that you can save your friends.
What controls are used to move Bob?
You can move with WASD or the arrow keys, and touch controls are available as well.

stickman-archer-kick.intro: Stickman Archer Kick is a shooting puzzle game where you use a bow and arrows to kick stickmen and save them. Complete all levels and collect stars to unlock new characters.
tips: Before each shot, look at where the stickman is standing and what is around them, since the goal is to save them rather than just hit them.
Pay attention to how the ragdoll physics move the stickmen after an impact, so you can plan a follow-up shot if needed.
Collect stars as you go, because they are what unlock new characters.
If a level stalls, try a different angle or approach instead of repeating the same shot.
Play one level at a time and finish each before moving on, since you need to complete all levels to save every stickman.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Archer Kick?
You take the bow and arrows to kick the stickmen and save their lives. Completing all levels saves them all.
How do I unlock new characters?
Collect stars during play, and use them to unlock new characters.

bunny-stack-jump.intro: Bunny Stack Jump is an arcade game where you guide a lively bunny to stack blocks higher and higher. Timing your jumps well earns style points while you avoid hazards.
tips: Focus on jump timing before anything else, since a well-timed jump is what keeps your stack growing.
Keep an eye on the ghost ship and other dangers so you can react before they reach your bunny.
Look for style points as a goal in each run, and try to earn them through clean, controlled jumps rather than rushed ones.
Pick up power-ups when they are safe to reach, and think about how each one might help you survive a longer climb.
Since the game pursues endless heights, aim to improve your height a little at a time instead of trying to climb everything in one attempt.
faq: What is the main goal of Bunny Stack Jump?
The goal is to guide your bunny to stack blocks as high as you can while earning style points and avoiding dangers.
How do I earn style points?
The description says style points come from masterfully timed jumps, so focus on landing your jumps at the right moment.

obby-theme-park-world.intro: Obby: Theme Park World is an open-world adventure set in a water park. Run around, find hidden areas, ride slides, and collect stars to unlock new zones and attractions.
tips: Explore the park before rushing ahead, since hidden areas are part of the game and may reveal stars you would otherwise miss.
Collect stars whenever you pass them, because more stars unlock new attractions and levels faster.
Try different routes on the slides and paths, and compare how they feel so you can find the one that gives you better results.
Replay slides you have already ridden to improve your results, especially once you have new routes to compare against.
Keep the camera turned so you can see upcoming slides and jumps, which helps you plan your movement ahead of time.
faq: What is the main goal of Obby: Theme Park World?
Your main goal is to explore the water park, ride slides, and collect stars. Stars unlock new zones, features, attractions, and levels.
How do I move my character and control the camera?
Use WASD to move and the mouse to control the camera. The on-screen controls and swipe gestures are also available for movement and camera control.

santa-gift-matching.intro: Santa Gift Matching is a holiday puzzle where you line up gifts for Santa. Each festive level gets harder, and you can aim for high scores and quick finishes.
tips: Scan the whole board before you start moving. Spotting likely matches early helps you plan a route instead of guessing.
Since quick completion earns bonus points, look for the fastest path through each level rather than working one piece at a time.
Pay attention to how the challenge grows. Early levels are a good time to build a steady routine you can keep when things get harder.
Keep your moves accurate. Repeated mistakes slow you down, which costs you the time bonus you are trying to earn.
Replay a level you finished slowly to see where you lost time, then try the same level again with a cleaner approach.
faq: What is the goal of Santa Gift Matching?
Your goal is to align the gifts for Santa across each festive level. Finishing with a high score and completing levels quickly both matter.
How do I control the game?
You can play with a mouse or a touchscreen. Use whichever feels more comfortable for steady, accurate moves.

alien-catcher.intro: Alien Catcher is a two-player adventure where you and a friend direct two intervention agents to catch aliens during an invasion. Each player has their own set of keys for moving, hiding, and using equipment.
tips: Agree with your partner on which area each agent covers so you do not get in each other's way while hunting aliens.
Use the hide key when an alien is close or a threat is nearby, then come out once the danger has passed.
Save the laser gun for aliens that are moving toward you, and keep an eye on how often you fire.
Use the catcher capsule and the trap at the right moments, since placing them well matters more than using them quickly.
Check on your partner's agent regularly, because helping each other is often the easiest way to catch more aliens.
faq: What is the goal of Alien Catcher?
You direct two intervention agents to catch aliens that have invaded the world. Working together with your friend is central to the game.
How do the two players control their agents?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, shoots with F, and hides with S. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys and hides with the down arrow.

snow-mo-cannon-shooting-game.intro: Snow Mo-Cannon is a winter shooter where you aim a cannon at waves of snowball invaders. Hold your position, read each wave, and keep the snow bears from taking the field.
tips: Learn the tap and drag controls early in a calm wave so your aim feels natural before the pace picks up.
Watch where the snowballs are coming from and fire at the closest threats first, so the field does not fill up around your friends.
Upgrade your cannon as soon as you can afford to, since a stronger cannon makes the later waves much easier to hold.
Pay attention to the start of each wave to spot patterns, then use that rhythm to plan your shots instead of firing at random.
Save your focus for boss battles by staying calm and steady, because rushing shots during a boss fight often leaves you open to attack.
faq: How do I aim and fire the cannon?
Use tapping and dragging to fire at the snowball invaders, as described in the game's controls. Practise on early waves to get comfortable with the timing.
What is the goal of Snow Mo-Cannon?
Defend your snowy friends across endless waves and boss battles before the snow bears claim victory over the winter battlefield.

minicat-fisher.intro: MiniCat Fisher is an adventure game where you play as a cat hunting fish with harpoons. You aim and fire using mouse clicks or touch, and you can try different harpoons and items along the way.
tips: Try each harpoon and item you unlock to see which one suits the fish you are going after.
Pay attention to the type of fish before you fire, since some are cute and others are bizarre and may behave differently.
Take your time with each shot instead of clicking rapidly, because a well-aimed harpoon is more useful than a fast one.
Use the early fishing sessions to learn how the harpoons and items work before trying harder catches.
Keep playing with different fish to discover the full range of catches, since the game is built around encountering many kinds of fish.
faq: What is the goal of MiniCat Fisher?
You play as a cat who hunts fish with harpoons. The aim is to catch the fish you encounter while trying out the different harpoons and items.
How do I control the cat?
The game is played with a mouse click or a touch screen. Click or tap to aim and fire your harpoon.

ice-man-3d.intro: Ice Man 3D is an action fighting game where you battle thugs using icy powers. Dodging, timing, and upgrading your abilities help you move through the city levels.
tips: Watch an enemy's attack before you react, and dodge when the timing lines up rather than moving randomly.
Spend upgrades on the abilities that match how you fight, so your strongest moves are ready when you need them.
Adjust your approach when a new enemy type appears, since tougher foes often punish the same habits that worked earlier.
Take a short break after a hard fight to reset your focus before the next level, as steady timing matters more than button mashing.
Replay earlier levels if you struggle, to get more comfortable with the dodge timing before facing the toughest thugs.
faq: What is the goal of Ice Man 3D?
Your goal is to battle thugs with your icy powers and progress through the levels to restore peace to the city.
How do I get better at fighting in Ice Man 3D?
Focus on dodging and timing your attacks, and watch how each enemy moves before you commit to a move.

the-road-home-granny-escape.intro: You wake up trapped in a boarded-up house with an evil Granny and Grandpa hunting you. Explore, solve puzzles, craft items, and find a way out using WASD to move, C to crouch, and Space to jump.
tips: Enemies react to sound and movement, so slow down near them and crouch with C when you need to be quieter.
Pick up every item you find, since crafting combines resources and some of them may be needed later to survive or open a path.
Look for keys, locked rooms, and hidden objects before you commit to a route, because a找到 key or clue may reveal another escape path.
Keep track of which rooms you have already searched so you can focus on new areas when you are being chased.
Try different routes, since the game has multiple escape paths and secret endings, and a different choice may lead to a better result.
faq: What is the main goal of The Road Home: Granny Escape?
Your goal is to escape the old people's house by finding useful items, solving puzzles, and using what you collect to your advantage.
How do I avoid Granny and Grandpa?
They react to sound and movement, so move carefully, stay quiet, and crouch with C when you need to pass close to them.

ninjas-blade.intro: Ninjas Blade is an adventure game where you play as Ryu, the last warrior of his clan, fighting through enemies to reach Tengu. Battles, combos, traps and boss fights test your speed and precision.
tips: Use the sword for close enemies and save shuriken for targets you cannot reach safely in melee.
Move right to keep progressing, but pause your advance when a group of enemies appears so you can deal with them one at a time.
Watch the ground and surroundings before each jump, since deadly traps are part of the challenge.
Practice short combo sequences with the sword attack to learn how enemies respond to your timing.
Use the pause key to take a breath and plan your next move when a fight gets crowded.
faq: What is the goal of Ninjas Blade?
Your goal is to fight through hordes of enemies, avoid traps, and reach the main antagonist, Tengu.
Which keys control Ryu on desktop?
Press A to move left, D to move right, W to jump, G to attack with the sword, and H to throw shuriken. Esc pauses the game.

neon-jumper.intro: Neon Jumper is an endless runner where you guide a small green square through glowing circuits by tapping to jump and tapping again to double jump. Your goal is to survive as long as you can and set a new world record.
tips: Save your double jump for moments when you need extra height or distance, rather than using it as soon as you leave the ground. Holding it in reserve gives you a safety option when a gap or obstacle appears.
Watch the path a few steps ahead instead of staring at your square. Spotting the next gap early gives you time to decide when to make your first tap.
Keep your taps steady and rhythmic. Tapping too quickly can waste your second jump before you need it.
Pick up coins and power-ups when they are on your route, but don't risk a dangerous landing just to grab them. Staying alive is what keeps your run going.
Play several short runs in a row to learn the timing of the track. Each run will feel more controlled as you get used to the speed.
faq: What is the goal of Neon Jumper?
The game is endless, so the goal is to survive as long as possible. Longer runs help you set a new world record.
How do I control the green square?
Tap or click once to jump, then tap or click again in the air to double jump. Mouse clicks and taps both work.

lovely-doll-creator.intro: Lovely Doll Creator is a dress-up game where you build your own avatar face and style. You pick skin tones, eye colors, hairstyles and hair colors to make a doll that looks like you or like someone new.
tips: Choose the skin tone first, since it sets the base for the rest of the face and makes it easier to judge other choices.
Try a few hairstyle and hair color combinations before settling on one, because the colors can change how the whole look feels.
Pick eye color with the face shape in mind so the features look balanced together.
Work in order from face to hair to accessories, so you do not have to redo earlier choices when you add new details.
Use the mouse or tap controls to test each option up close before you decide, and keep swapping until the avatar looks right to you.
faq: What is the goal of Lovely Doll Creator?
The goal is to create your own avatar face and style by choosing skin tones, eye colors, hairstyles, hair colors and more.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to select and change the options for your doll.

kickoff-academy-football-tycoon.intro: Kickoff Academy is an idle arcade tycoon where you build a youth football academy from a single ball crate. Grow your training ground, develop trainees, and climb the league.
tips: Walk onto the pads to unlock new areas and facilities, since your training ground grows one step at a time.
Hire ball boys and water carriers early so the drills keep running while you are away, because your staff keep earning when you are not playing.
Check each trainee's stats, position and rarity before deciding whether to sell or promote them when they graduate.
Focus on your Power Shot timing during away matches, since the shot is timing-based and tapping or clicking at the right moment matters most.
Return each day to collect daily rewards, finish quests and take part in the Daily Cup, as these are the extra sources of progress besides idle income.
faq: What is the main goal of Kickoff Academy?
You build and grow a youth football academy, develop trainees, and sell or promote graduates while climbing from the bottom division to the top of the league.
How do I score in away matches?
Press Space or left click on desktop, or tap on mobile, to take the Power Shot, and time your input well because the shot depends on timing.
