stick-army.intro: Stick Army is a building game where you lead stick-figure soldiers through hazardous environments. You construct defenses on the fly and outmaneuver enemies as the challenges escalate.
tips: Build defenses early in each stage, before enemies reach your soldiers, since you can't easily fix a weak position once the fighting starts.
Look at the terrain and hazards before placing anything, and plan your defenses around the routes enemies are most likely to take.
Pause to think when a new challenge appears. Quick decisions matter, but a short moment of planning often prevents losing soldiers.
Watch how each new challenge differs from the last, and change your approach instead of repeating the same defense.
Treat each decision as part of a larger plan. Positioning your army to outmaneuver enemies usually works better than reacting to them one at a time.
faq: What is the goal of Stick Army?
You lead your stick-figure army through challenging environments and defeat enemies to win. The game focuses on tactical planning and quick thinking.
Do I need to build defenses to progress?
Building strategic defenses is a central part of the game, so placing them well is important. Plan where they go based on the environment and enemy movement.

kingdom-tower-defense.intro: Kingdom Tower Defense puts you in control of a magic king who must hold off waves of monsters and enemies before they reach the castle. Collect money, upgrade your weapons, and use special powers to last longer.
tips: Spend your early money on weapon upgrades before buying extra power-ups, since stronger shots make every later wave easier to clear.
Keep an eye on which enemies are closest to the castle and aim there first, so nothing gets through to damage your tower.
Save a special power for crowded moments when a large group of enemies is heading in, instead of using it on a single target.
Improve your tower's properties as well as your weapons, because the description says these upgrades help you resist monsters for longer.
Watch for the final boss and keep some money and powers in reserve so you are not caught with empty resources when it arrives.
faq: How do I aim and shoot?
On desktop, point with the mouse and click to shoot. On touch devices, touch the screen to aim and shoot.
How do I earn money for upgrades?
Collect the money that you gain during battles, then use it to upgrade your weapons and buy new power-ups.

halloween-monsters-merge.intro: Halloween Monsters Merge is a physics puzzle where you drop monsters onto the playing field. Matching monsters merge into a bigger one, and you must keep the stack below the top lane.
tips: Aim each drop so the new monster lands against a matching one, since that is how merges happen.
Keep the largest monsters near the bottom of the field, where they have room to sit without reaching the top lane.
Use the left and right arrows to position the next monster before you drop it, rather than dropping it in a rush.
Watch the top lane closely and slow down when the field starts to fill, because a single stack that crosses it ends the session.
Merging newer, larger monsters earns more points, so make a few clean merges in a row to boost your score and coins.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Merge identical monsters to create larger ones, unlock all the monsters, and aim for first place on the leaderboard.
How do I control the monsters?
Use the left and right arrow keys to move the next monster. Press the down arrow or the space bar to drop it, as shown in the instructions.

black-friday-store-manager.intro: Black Friday Store Manager is a 3D shopping management game where you run a clothing store, stock shelves and serve customers. Your early choices about what to sell and where to spend coins shape how quickly the store grows.
tips: Keep shelves stocked before they run empty, since customers can only buy what is on display.
Spend your first coins on items that bring in more money quickly, then reinvest the earnings in expansion.
Compare cheap fast fashion with premium designer products before committing, and watch which one sells faster in your store.
Use staff upgrades to keep up with customer demand once the store starts getting busy.
Unlock new areas when you can afford them so your store has room for more products and customers.
faq: How do I play Black Friday Store Manager?
Use mouse clicks or taps to move your character around the store, restock shelves and serve customers. Earn coins from each sale and spend them on expansion, staff and new areas.
What should I spend my coins on first?

Focus on investments that help you earn more coins, such as stocking products that sell well or hiring staff to speed up service. Expanding and unlocking new areas makes more sense once your income is steady.

ninja-obby-parkours.intro: Ninja Obby Parkours is a fast 3D runner where you keep moving and avoid falling. You have 3 lives in solo play, or you can race a friend in 2 player mode.
tips: Keep moving forward at all times, since the goal is to last as long as you can without falling.
Use the double jump for longer gaps or higher jumps. Press the jump key a second time while you are still in the air.
Look ahead to where you will land instead of watching only the platform under you, so you can start your jump in time.
You only have 3 lives, so after a fall, slow down a little and plan your next jumps more carefully.
In 2 player mode, focus on your own character and keep a steady rhythm, because the race is about who gets farther.
faq: What is the goal of Ninja Obby Parkours?
Keep moving and survive for as long as you can without falling off the course. You start with 3 lives, and the game ends when you lose all of them.
How do I double jump in solo mode?
Press the space bar two times to double jump. Use WASD to move.

just-golf.intro: Just Golf offers 210 minimalist golf puzzles where precise shots and careful planning matter more than speed. Aim for stars on every level to test your mastery.
tips: Read the whole layout before your first shot to spot obstacles and the route toward the hole.
Use the aim assist to check your angle, but still think about power so the ball stops where you want it.
Take a moment to plan around obstacles rather than rushing, since a bad early shot can make the rest of the level harder.
If a level feels stuck, try a different line of play instead of repeating the same shot.
Go back to levels where you missed stars once you feel more confident, because the stars are the main mark of mastery.
faq: How many levels does Just Golf have?
The game has 210 minimalist golf puzzles to work through.
What is the aim assist for?
The aim assist helps you line up your shots more precisely, so you can focus on technique and placement.

city-bike-stunt-2.intro: City Bike Stunt 2 is a motorcycle racing and stunt game with a open Free Riding map, a Garage for upgrades, and a Racing section with timed levels. You can play alone or with a friend in 2 Player mode.
tips: Explore the Free Riding map before you start racing to learn the layout and spot where diamonds are easiest to collect.
Save your diamonds for upgrades that suit your riding style, and check the Garage often to see what you can afford next.
In the Racing section, focus on the time limit: steady, clean riding usually matters more than taking risky shortcuts that might cost you seconds.
Use Nitro in short bursts on straight stretches rather than all at once, so you still have a boost available when you need speed on a turn.
Use the camera button when you need a better view of the road ahead, especially when you are approaching a turn or a jump.
faq: How do I unlock new motorcycles?
You unlock new motorcycles by passing the levels in the Racing section, where you have to race against the time limit.
Where do I get diamonds?
Diamonds are collected in the Free Riding map, and you spend them in the Garage on upgrades and design changes.

obby-keyboard-worlds-1-speed-and-jump.intro: Obby Keyboard Worlds is a parkour adventure where you run, jump, and leap between islands across giant keyboard worlds. Build your speed and midair jumps while dodging swinging hammers and tricky obstacles.
tips: Train your running speed early, since faster movement makes long leaps between islands easier to land.
Learn when to use midair jumps. Press Space again or hold the jump button only when you need the extra distance, so you do not waste them on short gaps.
Keep an eye on swinging hammers and time your moves so you pass each one right after it swings by.
Use the speed and zoom controls to find a view that lets you see upcoming platforms and obstacles clearly before you jump.
Upgrade your sneakers and consider rebirthing when you feel stuck, since both are meant to boost your progress.
faq: What is the goal of Obby Keyboard Worlds?
Your goal is to reach the finish in every world by running, jumping, and leaping between islands while avoiding obstacles.
How do I use midair jumps?
Press Space to jump, then press Space again or hold it to use your available midair jumps. On mobile, tap or hold the jump button.

police-car-parking-game.intro: Police Car Parking Game asks you to park a patrol car in 3D environments without hitting obstacles. Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer and move, and the mouse to click buttons.
tips: Move slowly when you get close to the parking space, since small taps let you correct your position without overshooting.
Before you start moving, look at where the obstacles are around the car so you know which gaps are safe to pass through.
Plan the route into the space first, then drive it in steady steps instead of making sudden sharp adjustments.
If you bump something, take a moment to reverse and reposition rather than pushing forward into the same obstacle.
Practice the forward and backward controls on their own so you get a feel for how the car responds before harder missions.
faq: What is the goal of Police Car Parking Game?
The goal is to park the police car safely without hitting any obstacles.
Which keys control the car?
W or Arrow Up moves the car forward, S or Arrow Down moves it back, A or Arrow Left moves left, and D or Arrow Right moves right.

art-master-puzzle.intro: Art Master Puzzle mixes jigsaw puzzling with coloring. You start with a black-and-white picture and fill it in by matching colored pieces from the bottom of the screen to their spots.
tips: Before you place anything, scan the whole picture to find the easiest areas to start with, such as distinct shapes or edges.
Compare each piece's color and shape with the picture before tapping, so you don't have to move it back later.
Work on one region at a time, finishing a section before moving on, so the image fills in clearly and you can spot gaps.
Use the free hints when you get stuck, rather than guessing repeatedly, to keep your progress steady.
Pay attention to how the picture changes as you add pieces, since the colors shift from gray to full color and can reveal what goes next.
faq: What is the goal of Art Master Puzzle?
The goal is to restore each picture by placing the colored pieces into their correct positions. As you fit pieces, the black-and-white image gradually turns into a full-color picture.
How do I place the pieces?
Tap a colored piece at the bottom of the screen and place it into its matching position on the image. Check that the piece fits the correct area before you place it.

train-drift.intro: Train Drift is a racing game where you steer massive locomotives through scenic landscapes, pulling off drifts while dodging rival trains. Each race tests your precision and reflexes.
tips: Look ahead of your train rather than at its nose, so you can start each drift before the turn arrives.
Try to keep your drifts controlled and steady instead of sharp and sudden, since big locomotives can be hard to correct once they slide.
Keep an eye on competing trains around you and plan your line early so you have room to dodge them without losing speed.
Replay a race to learn the corners and the spots where you tend to lose control, then focus on those sections next time.
Stay calm after a mistake and recover your line quickly, because every race rewards steady reflexes over rushed moves.
faq: What is the goal of Train Drift?
You race a massive locomotive through landscapes, performing drifts and dodging competing trains to get through each race.
What makes Train Drift challenging?
Precise steering and quick reflexes are needed, since drifting with a heavy train and avoiding rivals at the same time demands close attention.

yatzy.intro: Yatzy is a dice game where you roll five dice over 13 rounds to build the best scoring combinations. Each category can be used only once, so every choice matters for your final total.
tips: Keep an eye on the Upper Section early. Reaching 63 points there earns a 50-point bonus, so try to collect several dice of the same number when you can.
Use your re-rolls wisely. Keep the dice that work toward a specific combination and re-roll the rest instead of starting over.
Don't spend a strong category on a weak roll. If a roll doesn't fit any category well, consider which open category has the least impact on your total.
Save flexible categories for later rounds when you're unsure what you'll roll. Combinations like Full House and Straights are worth planning around.
Watch for Yatzy opportunities. Five of a kind scores in the Lower Section, and an extra Yatzy earns a 100-point bonus.
faq: How many times can I roll in one round?
You can roll up to 3 times per round. After each roll, you choose which dice to keep and which to re-roll.
How do I earn the Upper Section bonus?
Score 63 or more points in the Upper Section (Ones to Sixes) to earn a 50-point bonus.

anna-s-story-dress-up-diy.intro: Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY is a paper doll styling game where you put together outfits for Anna. You can dress her for costume parties, dates, and holidays like Halloween and Christmas.
tips: Pick an occasion first, then build the look around it, such as a spooky costume for Halloween or a dressy outfit for a date.
Try several combinations for the same event to see how different clothes and accessories change the overall style.
Save the designs you like best so you can come back to them and compare them later.
Mix pieces from different categories to create a more unique look instead of copying a single themed set.
Share your favorite creations with friends to see how they would style Anna for the same occasion.
faq: What is the main goal of Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY?
The game is about being creative. Your aim is to craft unique looks for Anna for a range of occasions and build outfits you enjoy.
Which occasions can I dress Anna for?
The description mentions costume parties, romantic dates, and festive holidays such as Halloween and Christmas.

crash-glass-boom.intro: Crash Glass Boom is a ball game built around placing balls strategically and matching colors so they vanish. Levels get harder as you go, so careful observation pays off.
tips: Before you place a ball, look at the whole board and check which colors are already near each other.
Plan a few moves ahead rather than reacting to the newest ball, since the strategy is about where pieces end up.
When a level feels stuck, pause and study the layout for patterns you missed instead of making quick random placements.
Pay attention to how the board changes after each disappearance, because the next color match often becomes clearer.
Expect later levels to demand more focus, so take short breaks to keep your observation sharp.
faq: What is the main goal in Crash Glass Boom?
The goal is to place balls so that matching colors lead to disappearances. Clearing the board this way is how you move through the challenge.
Do levels get harder as I play?
Yes, the game says levels grow tougher over time. Your observational skills and strategy become more important as the challenge increases.

chrome-dino-game-original.intro: Chrome Dino Game is an endless runner where you guide the dinosaur over cacti and under pterodactyls while the speed keeps rising. Your goal is to survive as long as you can and beat your high score.
tips: Jump early rather than late. Cacti come at you quickly, and a jump started too close to the obstacle often leads to a crash.
Watch for pterodactyls at different heights. Duck with Arrow Down for the low ones, and jump over the ones closer to the ground.
Keep your eyes further ahead than the dinosaur. Spotting the next obstacle early gives you time to choose between jumping and ducking.
Expect the pace to change. As the speed rises, shorter timing gaps matter more, so stay relaxed and keep your rhythm steady.
After a crash, decide whether to use the rewarded ad for an extra life. Taking the extra life lets you continue from where the run ended.
faq: What is the goal of Chrome Dino Game?
The goal is to survive as long as you can while the speed rises, and to chase a higher score each run.
Which keys control the dinosaur?
Press Space or Arrow Up, or tap, to jump. Press Arrow Down to duck under flying pterodactyls.

santa-snow-runner.intro: Santa Snow Runner is an action run through snowy landscapes. You steer Santa past obstacles on treacherous paths, collect gifts for bonuses, and push through levels that get harder as you go.
tips: Watch the path a few steps ahead rather than the obstacle directly in front of Santa, so you have time to react.
Pick up gifts when it is safe to do so, since they give bonuses, but do not chase them into danger.
Learn the pattern of each obstacle type early, because the levels become more challenging and reactions need to be quicker.
Keep your movements small and steady instead of making sudden changes, which can lead you into the next hazard.
If you keep losing at the same spot, slow down and replay that section with a clear plan before trying again.
faq: What is the goal of Santa Snow Runner?
Guide Santa through snowy landscapes, dodge obstacles, and collect gifts for bonuses while the levels grow more challenging.
Do gifts help my score?
Collecting gifts earns special bonuses, so grabbing them safely during a run can make a real difference.

mineworld-horror-the-mansion.intro: MineWorld Horror The Mansion is a Minecraft-style horror shooter where you investigate a mansion where police officers and a medic went missing. Expect zombies, weapons, and an escape to find.
tips: Switch between first and third person with C to see what is around you, then pick the view that suits the moment: third person for spotting threats, first person for aiming.
Use the sights with the right mouse button before firing at distant zombies, since a steadier aim saves ammunition.
Reload with R when you have a quiet moment, not in the middle of a group fight, so you are never caught with an empty weapon.
Crouch with Left Ctrl or go prone with X when you are in danger of being spotted, and sprint with Left Shift only when you have a clear route.
Melee weapons are useful when you are low on ammo or need to save bullets, so keep one ready for close encounters with zombies.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You are sent to the mansion to check what happened to the missing officers and medic while you wait for backup. You need to survive the zombies and find a way out.
How many weapons are there and what types?
The game has six weapons in total: two melee weapons and four ranged weapons. Switching between them as the situation changes is a key part of staying alive.

color-water-sort-3d.intro: Color Water Sort 3D is a 3D puzzle where you pour colored liquid between tubes until every tube holds just one color. Levels grow from simple to brain-teasing, so you can take your time and plan each pour.
tips: Look at the top layer of every tube before you pour, since that is the only liquid you can move next.
Plan two or three pours ahead rather than reacting to the first obvious move, because a quick pour can bury a color you need later.
Try to free up one tube early, so you have a spare place to set aside a color that is in the way.
Group all liquid of the same color together as you go, keeping each tube as uniform as possible instead of leaving mixed tubes for later.
If you get stuck, step back and check which colors are split across several tubes, then focus on joining one of those colors first.
faq: How do I win a level?
You win when all liquid of the same color is grouped together and every tube holds only one color.
How do I pour water from one tube to another?
On PC, left-click a tube to select it, then left-click another tube to pour. On mobile, tap a tube and then tap a second tube to complete the pour.

bottle-flip-game.intro: Bottle Flip 3D is an arcade puzzle where you tap the screen at the right moment to flip a plastic bottle onto objects in a series of rooms. Timing is the key skill.
tips: Watch the bottle's rotation before you tap, and time your tap for the moment it is upright enough to land on a surface.
Start with the larger, flatter objects in each room, since they give the bottle more room for error.
Pay attention to which objects are trickier than others, and be ready to adjust your timing for them.
Try a few gentle taps to learn how high the bottle jumps before attempting harder landings.
If you keep missing the same kind of object, pause your attempts and watch how the bottle reacts before trying again.
faq: What is the goal of Bottle Flip 3D?
Your goal is to flip the plastic bottle so it lands on various objects without falling. You move through rooms filled with obstacles.
How do I control the bottle?
Tap the screen at the right moment to make the bottle jump, flip, and bounce. Buttons on the page are clicked with the mouse.

ninja-samurai-runner-online.intro: Ninja Samurai Runner Online is an action runner where you race forward, dodge adversaries, and vault over obstacles. Collect coins and ninjas to power up as you work through the levels.
tips: Keep your eyes on the path ahead rather than on your character, so you can react to adversaries and obstacles before they reach you.
Plan your dodges early. Reacting at the last second leaves little room for error when the chase speeds up.
Make a habit of picking up coins and ninjas when it is safe to do so, since they are what power you up for harder moments.
Stay alert at the start of each level to learn where obstacles tend to appear, then use that pattern on your next attempt.
If you keep getting caught, slow your pace of decisions and focus on one threat at a time instead of trying to react to everything at once.
faq: What is the goal of Ninja Samurai Runner Online?
The goal is to conquer each level by dodging adversaries, vaulting over obstacles, and reaching victory at the end of the chase.
What do I need to collect during a run?
Collect coins and ninjas, which help you power up as you move through the levels.

brutal-battle-royale.intro: Brutal Battle Royale is a 3D shooter where you search the map for weapons and try to eliminate every enemy to win. Move, aim and shoot carefully, because every fight matters.
tips: Pick up weapons early and check what you have before you move into open areas, so you are never caught without a weapon you can use.
Use the mouse wheel to switch weapons based on the distance to the enemy, since the right weapon for a close fight is not always the right one at range.
Reload with R when you have a quiet moment rather than in the middle of a firefight, so you are not left empty when an enemy appears.
Jump with Space to change your height and break up your movement, which can make you a harder target while you aim with the left mouse button.
Use P to pause when you need to plan your route or think about where enemies might be, then continue with a clear idea of your next move.
faq: What is the goal of Brutal Battle Royale?
The goal is to search for weapons on the map and shoot all enemies to win the battle royale.
How do I shoot and reload?
Press the left mouse button to shoot and press R to reload your weapon.

lumbering-at-sea.intro: Lumbering At Sea is a 3D hypercasual arcade game where you collect materials to build your own ship and then compete against others. Play is controlled with a mouse click or tap.
tips: Focus on gathering materials early, since you need them to build your ship before you can compete.
Keep your inputs steady rather than rapid-fire clicking, so each action you take is deliberate.
Watch how your ship and materials change as you build, and check what you still need before spending resources.
Between rounds, review how you did against other players and adjust your approach for the next attempt.
Play in short sessions at first to learn the rhythm of gathering, building and competing before pushing for bigger rewards.
faq: What is the goal of Lumbering At Sea?
Your goal is to collect materials, build your own ship, and then compete with others to win rewards.
How do I control the game?
Use a mouse click or tap to play. There are no other controls mentioned in the instructions.

find-part-in-love-story.intro: Find Part in Love Story is a puzzle game where you help a loving couple through funny situations by finding hidden objects. Each level gives you an assignment, and you use a scanner to search the scene.
tips: Read the assignment carefully before you start scanning, since it tells you exactly which object to look for.
Scan the heroes first, then the area around them, so you can narrow down where the object might be.
Check the details in the scene, such as small items near the couple, rather than focusing only on the largest objects.
Use logic about the situation: the funny scenario often hints at what object is needed to solve it.
Work through the levels in order and aim to complete all of them, since the story continues from one situation to the next.
faq: What is the goal of Find Part in Love Story?
Your goal is to help the couple get out of funny situations by finding the desired object in each level and completing all the levels.
How do I play each level?
Read the assignment, point the scanner at the heroes and their surroundings, then find the desired object and click on it.

lumen-descent.intro: Lumen Descent is a precision platformer where you carry your light down through a forgotten tower. Each of its 12 floors asks for careful jumps, well-timed dashes, and steady nerves.
tips: Activate checkpoints as soon as you reach them, so a missed jump sends you back only a short distance.
Before attempting a difficult jump, pause with P and study the layout to plan your landing spot and timing.
Use Dash with Shift to clear hazards in one motion instead of trying to slow down and react mid-air.
When you fall, press R to retry right away rather than walking back, which keeps your rhythm sharp.
Explore the floors for the tower's secrets, but keep your core route clean so you do not rush into hazards.
faq: How many floors are there in Lumen Descent?
The game has 12 dangerous floors to descend through, each with its own handcrafted obstacles.
What does the Dash control do?
Pressing Shift performs a dash that lets you move past hazards quickly. Use it to cross gaps or avoid danger in the moment.

dress-up-babi-doll.intro: Dress Up Babi Doll is a dress up game where you style a cute doll with clothes, skin color, face expression, hairstyle, hats and purses. It is played with a mouse or by tapping.
tips: Pick the skin color and face expression first, so the outfit choices that follow suit the look you are going for.
Try a full outfit in one color family, then add a matching hat and purse to tie the look together.
Compare a few dresses side by side before you commit, since the game offers many options to browse.
Change one piece at a time and look at the whole doll after each change to see how the pieces work together.
Keep a simple theme in mind, such as casual, party or winter, so each choice feels connected to the last.
faq: What is the goal of Dress Up Babi Doll?
The goal is to dress up the doll however you like, choosing clothes, skin color, face expression, hairstyle, hats and purses. There is no set target described in the game.
How do I control the game?
Use your mouse or tap the screen to select items and make changes to the doll.

siren-head-nightmare-scary-survival.intro: Siren Head Nightmare is a Granny-style survival game set in a haunted mansion. You have no weapons, so staying hidden, listening carefully, and collecting tools are your main ways to get through each night.
tips: Stop and listen before you move into a new room. Sound is your main warning that Siren Head is nearby.
Move slowly and cautiously. Rushing makes noise and can lead you straight into the creature's path.
Pick up every useful tool you find, since you will need them to survive more than one night.
Hide when danger is close instead of trying to run. With no weapons, avoiding detection is your best option.
Pay attention to the layout of the mansion as you explore. Knowing where you have already searched helps you plan your route on later nights.
faq: What is the goal of Siren Head Nightmare?
You need to escape the haunted mansion while being pursued by Siren Head. You must survive multiple nights to do so.
Can I fight back against Siren Head?
No. You have no weapons, so the game relies on hiding, staying quiet, and avoiding the creature.

murder-mafia.intro: Murder Mafia is a one-button puzzle game about deception. You use a disguise and careful planning to outwit the mafia and eliminate the Don.
tips: Watch each new scenario for a moment before you press the button, since every move is described as a gamble.
Plan your next few moves rather than reacting to the last one, because the game rewards cunning over speed.
Keep your disguise in mind at every step, since staying unnoticed is central to the challenge.
When a scenario changes, reset your plan instead of repeating what worked before, as the situations are always shifting.
If you get caught, note what triggered it so you can avoid the same mistake on your next try.
faq: What is the goal of Murder Mafia?
Your goal is to outwit the mafia and eliminate the Don. You do this by using cunning strategy and a perfect disguise.
What controls does Murder Mafia use?
The game is played with one button. Because of this, timing and choosing the right moment to press matter a lot.

vexon.intro: Vexon is a first person shooter built around firefights and precise aiming. You pick your weapons, then choose team battles or solo play as you rise through the ranks.
tips: Pick your arsenal with the match type in mind, since team battles and solo play may reward different loadouts.
Focus on precise aim over spraying shots. Landing accurate hits is central to the shooting finesse the game asks for.
Think strategically before each firefight. Holding position, choosing when to engage, and watching your surroundings can matter as much as your reflexes.
Use the rewarding challenges to guide your progress. Working toward them gives you a clear target as you climb the ranks.
In team battles, coordinate with your teammates and avoid charging in alone, so your side can cover each other during firefights.
faq: What is the main goal in Vexon?
The game focuses on intense firefights and rising through the ranks by completing rewarding challenges. Success depends on both strategy and shooting skill.
Can I play Vexon alone or with others?
Yes. You can join epic team battles or go solo, depending on how you want to play.

backrooms-exit-protocol-0.intro: Backrooms: Exit Protocol 0 is a horror survival adventure set on Level 0. Find the keycard, solve puzzles, avoid the monster, and work your way out of the backrooms.
tips: Explore slowly at first and look around each area before moving on, so you know where the monster is likely to come from.
Use crouch when you want to move quietly through tight or dark spaces, and save running for when you need to get away.
Keep track of the keycard and any items you pick up, and drop items you no longer need with R so you stay organized.
Solve puzzles by checking every object you can interact with, since clues are often close to the puzzle itself.
Use the menu with Tab, or the top-right button on mobile, to review your progress and plan your next move when you feel stuck.
faq: What is the goal of Backrooms: Exit Protocol 0?
Your goal is to explore Level 0, find the keycard, solve the puzzles along the way, and escape the backrooms while avoiding the monster.
How do I avoid the monster?
Move carefully, crouch when you need to stay quiet, and run only when you have a clear path away from danger. Keep an eye on your surroundings at all times.

granny-s-mansion.intro: Granny's Mansion is a first-person horror escape game. You search for clues and use objects to get out of an unknown building while a sinister grandmother moves nearby, with only your light to see by.
tips: Search each room carefully for clues, since you need them to work out how to leave the building.
Keep your light in mind as your only source of vision, and use F to light your way when you need to see clues or objects.
Use E to interact with objects, and check items you pick up before moving on so you do not waste time backtracking.
Move slowly with WASD when you hear or suspect the grandmother is close, so you can keep track of where she is.
Press R to restart if you get trapped or lose track of your progress, and press L to lock the cursor if your view starts drifting while you play.
faq: What is the main goal of Granny's Mansion?
Your goal is to escape the unknown structure as quickly as you can. To do this, you look for clues and pass the required objects.
How do I move and interact in the game?
Use W, A, S and D to move around. Press E to perform actions such as interacting with objects.

letterhold.intro: LetterHold is a word-building board game for one to four players. Draw letters, spell words on a 15x15 board, and claim premium squares before your opponent does.
tips: Read the preview value on each tile before you commit. Swapping a letter for a higher-value one or stretching a word across a premium square can add more than a longer word alone.
Look for hooks. Placing a word that connects to letters already on the board can score both words in the same turn.
Use Undo while you are still building a word. Undo lifts the last tile, and Undo-all returns the whole turn to your rack so you can try a different plan.
Save blanks for moves that need them. A blank can stand for any letter, so it is most useful when it completes a high-scoring word or a tile-clearing turn.

If your rack is weak, consider Exchange over a low-scoring play. Swapping chosen tiles back into the bag can give you better letters for later turns, and Hint can point you to a move when you run dry.
faq: How do you win LetterHold?
The game ends when the bag is empty and one player uses up their rack. The player with the highest score at that point wins.
What is the difference between Pass and Exchange?
Pass gives up your turn without changing your rack. Exchange lets you swap chosen tiles back into the bag and draw new ones.

kick-a-lucky-block-tsunami-waves.intro: Kick the Lucky Block as far as you can and see what Brainrot you roll. Once you land, you have to outrun the tsunami you set off yourself.
tips: Kick farther for bigger rewards, but remember that longer kicks also bring a stronger tsunami, so decide how much risk you want on each attempt.
Use weights and leg training to build your kick distance early, since a stronger kick helps you reach the rewards the game offers.
Each kick is a chance to roll a new Brainrot, so keep kicking to build your collection rather than stopping after one lucky or unlucky roll.
Place the Brainrots you collect on your plot as soon as you can, because they are what generate your income.
Play in short sessions, as the game is built for quick rounds, and take a break if the randomness of the rolls starts to frustrate you.
faq: What is the main goal of Kick a Lucky Block: Tsunami Waves?
Your goal is to kick the Lucky Block as far as possible. After you land and turn into a Brainrot, you must escape the tsunami.
How do I get better rewards?
The farther you kick, the bigger the rewards, but the greater the danger from the tsunami. Balancing distance and safety is the key to getting the most out of each round.

draw-to-help.intro: Draw to Help is a drawing puzzle where you look at a small scene, work out what is missing, and draw the fix with your finger or mouse. Click or tap and drag to draw.
tips: Study the whole picture before you draw. The story clues usually show what the character needs, such as food for a hungry dog or shelter for a cat in the rain.
Think about the simplest solution first. Puzzles like this often work with one clear object rather than a complicated drawing.
Keep your drawings rough and bold. The game does not require drawing skill, so focus on making the shape clear enough to read.
Use the helpful hints when you get stuck, then go back and try the puzzle again yourself to build your problem-solving habit.
Watch how the characters react after each drawing. Their reactions confirm whether your idea matches what the scene needed.
faq: What is the goal of Draw to Help?
Your goal is to figure out what is missing in each picture and draw the solution so the characters are helped. Each scene tells a short story.
What controls do I use?
Click or tap and drag to draw. Use the same action to make your lines and shapes in each puzzle.

bubble-boom.intro: Bubble Boom is a classic bubble shooter where you aim and fire bubbles to pop matching colors across colorful levels. The playfield slowly descends, so you need to clear bubbles before they reach the bottom line.
tips: Pop bubbles in groups of three or more of the same color, since that is the only way to clear them.
Look for shots that clear several bubbles at once, especially ones that drop loose bubbles hanging from the group.
Keep an eye on the bottom line and work faster when the field gets low, because the level descends gradually.
Aim carefully before each shot instead of rushing, since a missed shot can add to the crowd without clearing anything.
Watch the color layout across the field and plan which color you will shoot next so you are not stuck with a bad match.
faq: What do I need to do to pop bubbles?
Shoot at least three bubbles of the same color into a group. Groups of three or more are what pop.
What happens if the level goes down too far?
The level gradually descends, and if it reaches the bottom line you lose the game.

tiger-tank.intro: Tiger Tank puts you in a tank during World War II battles. Move across intricate battlefields, use cover well, and upgrade your vehicle to win each encounter.
tips: Use cover before you fire. Stay behind terrain or obstacles so you can shoot at enemies while they have a harder time hitting you.
Learn how your tank moves and turns before a tough fight. Smooth, short movements usually help you line up shots better than rushing in.
Scout the battlefield layout first. Knowing where the cover is lets you plan a route that lets you flank opponents instead of meeting them head-on.
Spread your upgrades around based on how you play. With over 30 options in the tech system, pick the ones that match your style, whether that is armor, firepower, or mobility.
Keep an eye on each encounter and reposition when a spot stops working. Retreating to better cover and trying again is often more effective than pushing forward into open ground.
faq: What is the main goal in Tiger Tank?

You fight through World War II battlefields, using strategic cover to outmaneuver opponents and dominate each encounter. The description does not list specific missions or win conditions, so play to the objectives you see on screen.
How do I upgrade my tank?
Your vehicle has an advanced tech system with over 30 upgrade options. Choose upgrades that suit how you like to fight to make your tank more effective in battle.

hoop-stars.intro: Hoop Stars is a basketball game built around dunking and a reverse style of dribbling. Your goal is to challenge opponents across the world and collect every trophy.
tips: Start by practicing dunks, since the game is built around them and that is the main way to play it.
Spend your first few minutes testing the reverse dribbling until you understand how it responds before you try to play under pressure.
Pay attention to which challenges give you trophies so you can plan a route through the game toward collecting them all.
Keep your attention on the ball and the court during each match, because the fun of this style of play depends on controlling your moves.
Come back after a short break if a challenge feels tough, and try again with fresh focus rather than rushing through.
faq: What is the main goal in Hoop Stars?
The goal is to challenge the world and collect all the trophies, using dunks and reverse basketball dribbling along the way.
What makes reverse dribbling different?
The game describes it as true reverse basketball dribbling, but the page does not explain the exact technique, so the best way to learn it is to try it in play.

mad-mad-unicorn.intro: Mad Mad Unicorn is an endless action game where you fly a unicorn through the skies, dodging missiles and hitting birds for points. Collect magic carrot power-ups to keep the chaos going.
tips: Because the controls are one-touch, practice small, deliberate presses first and watch how far each one moves your unicorn before you commit to tighter gaps.
Keep your eyes on incoming missiles early rather than reacting at the last second, since the game is an endless rush and small mistakes add up.
Treat birds as points you can aim for, but don't chase them into danger. Staying alive longer usually matters more than any single hit.
Grab magic carrot power-ups when they are safe to reach, and think about where you'll be a moment later so you don't fly straight into trouble.
Play in short sessions and notice which patterns of missiles and birds trip you up, then adjust your route on the next run.
faq: What is the goal of Mad Mad Unicorn?
The goal is to fly as far as you can through the skies while dodging missiles and hitting birds for points. The game is endless, so the challenge is to keep going against the odds.
How do the controls work?
The game uses one-touch controls, so each press is the only input you need to steer your unicorn. Learning how much each press moves you is the quickest way to improve.

stacky-dash-nail.intro: Stacky Dash Nail is a fashion stacking game where you build tall nail stacks using simple mouse controls. Each move matters as you aim for bigger rewards and greater heights.
tips: Plan each move before you make it, since the game rewards careful strategy over rushed play.
Keep your stack as centered as you can, so the higher sections have a steadier base.
Use your early challenges to get a feel for how the mouse controls respond before you aim for height.
Expect the challenges to get harder over time, so stay focused and adjust your approach as the complexity grows.
Take short breaks when a stack gets unstable, then come back with a clearer plan for the next build.
faq: What is the goal of Stacky Dash Nail?
The goal is to build the tallest and most impressive nail stacks you can. Taller, well-built stacks lead to bigger rewards.
How do I control the game?
The game uses simple mouse controls. Use the mouse to guide each piece as you build your stack.

dogs-vs-aliens.intro: Dogs vs Aliens is a dog-themed game where you rescue kidnapped pets and push back alien bullies. You move around the world, gather resources, and upgrade your dogs to face tougher foes.
tips: Collect resources as you explore, since you need them to evolve your dogs. Spending them as soon as you can keeps your team strong for harder fights.
Watch which enemies you can beat and which ones are too strong. Evolve your dogs before taking on tougher aliens or bosses.
Follow the quests and talk to the characters, because they reveal the story about the island and point you to new tasks.
Explore the beach, park, city square, and forest to find new dogs and resources. Freeing more dogs gives you more options in battle.
Stay alert in the park, since alien bosses can show up while you are busy with other enemies. Keep your dogs healthy and ready before you move on.
faq: What is the main goal of Dogs vs Aliens?
You win by saving all the kidnapped pets and sending the aliens back to the Moon. Along the way, you hand over defeated enemies to the base.
How do I move and attack?
On PC, use WASD or the mouse to move. On mobile, drag your finger to move. Attacks happen automatically when you get close to an enemy.

space-shooter-boss.intro: Space Shooter Boss is a fast arcade shooter where you steer a spaceship through waves of enemies and meteor showers to reach the final boss. Keep moving, keep firing, and stay out of harm's way.
tips: Keep your ship moving side to side rather than sitting still, since staying in one spot makes you an easy target.
Hold the left mouse button to fire continuously so you never miss a window to shoot during busy waves.
Watch the incoming meteors and enemy shots early, and move toward open gaps before they reach you.
Grab power-ups when they are safe to reach, but do not let chasing them pull you into the path of enemy fire.
Save your focus for the final boss by staying calm through the earlier waves and dodging rather than trading hits.
faq: How do I steer the spaceship?
Move the mouse left or right to steer the ship. Your ship follows the cursor along the horizontal line.
How do I shoot?
Hold the left mouse button to shoot continuously. Release it when you need to pause firing or focus on dodging.

obby-1-click-wall-breaker.intro: Obby: +1 Click Wall Breaker is a kicking simulator where you train your legs, raise your kick power, and smash through barriers to unlock new worlds. Your strength keeps building as you play.
tips: Tap or click steadily from the start, since every tap makes your character stronger and speeds up progress.
Collect wins whenever you can, because they unlock stronger kicks that help you break tougher barriers.
Look for pets and auras that boost your strength, and equip the ones that help most with the barriers you are facing.
Consider rebirthing once progress slows, since it gives permanent bonuses that carry over into your next run.
Come back after time away, because your power keeps growing while you are offline.
faq: How do I attack and gain power?
Use the left mouse button on PC to gain power and interact with attacks. On mobile, use the on-screen controls to move, jump, and swipe to rotate the camera.
How do I get stronger faster?
Every tap helps you progress, and collecting wins unlocks stronger kicks. Pets and auras also give boosts that multiply your strength.

flipper-dunk-3d.intro: Flipper Dunk 3D is a sports game about timing a perfect dunk. You use simple one-tap controls to get through hoops and obstacles that get harder as you advance.
tips: Watch the hoop and obstacles for a moment before your first tap so you know where you need to be.
Keep your taps well timed rather than rushed, since precision matters more than speed.
Use each attempt to learn how the obstacles move or sit, and adjust your timing next time.
Stay patient when you miss a dunk. Each level builds on the skills you already have, so take it one dunk at a time.
Pay attention to how each new level changes the layout, and expect to adapt your timing as the challenge grows.
faq: What is the goal of Flipper Dunk 3D?
The goal is to make the perfect dunk by getting through hoops and obstacles with well-timed taps.
How do the controls work?
The game uses simple one-tap controls, so each tap is the only input you need to manage your dunk.

car-escape.intro: Car Escape is a traffic puzzle where you free cars stuck in a jam. Tap each car to drive it along the arrow, and plan the order so no vehicle crashes into another.
tips: Before tapping anything, scan the whole jam and check which cars have a clear path in the direction their arrow shows.
Look for the car that is blocking the most others and move it first, since clearing one exit often frees several cars at once.
Plan the sequence before you start. Moving a car in the wrong order can trap another vehicle that was free a moment ago.
Tap gently and deliberately on each car so you move the one you intended, rather than rushing through taps.
If a move leaves you stuck, think about which vehicle is still in the way and reconsider the order from the beginning of the jam.
faq: What is the goal of Car Escape?
Your goal is to guide every vehicle out of the congested area by moving each car along the direction shown by its arrow. Each car needs a clear route to escape.
How do I move a car?
Tap the car gently and it will move in the direction indicated by its arrow. Choose your moves carefully, because the car will follow the path shown.

solitaire-emperor-secrets-of-fate.intro: Solitaire Emperor - Secrets of Fate is a Tarot-themed solitaire puzzle. Clear every card from the field, and each level mixes cards with different mechanics to keep the play varied.
tips: Look at the full layout before your first move and note which cards block others, so you can plan a sequence that opens the field.
Draw from the deck only when you have no other moves, since a larger deck left at the end of a level earns more coins.
Build continuous chains whenever you can, because chains are how you earn coins.
Save your gold card for a moment when a chain would otherwise break, since it keeps the chain going.
When you are stuck, throwing a gold card is an option, but check first whether a deck draw would get you moving without spending it.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
You need to remove all cards from the playing field to complete a level.
In what order are cards removed?
Cards are removed following the classic scheme: ace, king, queen, jack, ten, and so on down the ranks.

catdoku.intro: CatDoku is a cozy logic puzzle where you place cats on a board so that each row, column, and colored zone holds exactly one cat, and no two cats touch. The levels get harder as you progress.
tips: Begin with the row, column, or colored zone that has the fewest empty cells left, since it offers the fewest options.
After each placement, mark off the touching cells around the cat, including diagonals, along with its row and column.
Pay attention to colored zones that fit entirely within one row or column, because a cat placed there also fixes that row or column for the rest of the board.
Work through the board one step at a time and double-check each new cat against all three rules before moving on.
If you get stuck, use the hint to reveal a correct position, then keep solving the rest yourself.
faq: What is the goal of CatDoku?
Place cats on the board so that every row and column has exactly one cat, every colored zone has exactly one cat, and no two cats are in neighboring cells, including diagonally.
How do I place or remove a cat?
Tap an empty cell to place a cat, and tap a cell with a cat again to remove it.

lazy-orcs.intro: Lazy Orcs is a one-player 3D clicker where you get the orcs to work so the king can earn enough money to build his castle. You control everything with the mouse.
tips: Click steadily and keep the pace going, since the goal is to build up money over time.
Watch how the money total changes after each action so you can tell which activity pays off the most.
Spend your earnings on whatever helps the orcs work more, if the game gives you that option, before you chase small gains.
Take short breaks from clicking to check your progress, so you do not lose track of how close the king is to the castle.
faq: What is the goal of Lazy Orcs?
You need to earn enough money for the king to build his castle. The king will not force the orcs to work, so you have to get them to do it.
How do I control the game?
The game is played entirely with the mouse. Click to make the orcs work and earn money.

ant-moving-simulator.intro: Ant Moving Simulator is a block-clearing puzzle where you pick numbered boxes so your ants can collect matching blocks. Each level asks you to clear every block while managing limited space.
tips: Before each click, check which slots are empty and make sure the box you move leaves room for your next few moves.
Look at linked boxes first, since they move as a group and need enough empty slots for the whole set.
Scan the board for colors that have only a few blocks left, and clear them early to free up space.
Save power-ups for levels where you get stuck rather than using them right away, so you have help when it matters most.
If you feel boxed in, pause the game and map out two or three moves ahead before you click again.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear every block on the board by moving numbered boxes so your ants can collect the matching colors.
How do I move a box?
Click or tap a front numbered box to slide it into an empty slot. Ants then collect reachable blocks of the same color automatically.

jump-and-fly.intro: Jump and Fly is a tap-based forest adventure where you guide a squirrel or a bee through vibrant landscapes. Timing your jumps and collecting coins are the core of the run.
tips: Watch the rhythm of your jumps rather than tapping quickly, since the game centers on mastering timing.
Use tap-and-hold to control how high you go, and release at the point that keeps you clear of upcoming obstacles.
Collect coins when they are on your path, because they are the way to earn power-ups.
Scan the landscape ahead for gaps or side routes, as hidden paths are part of the game.
Practice with the squirrel or the bee to see which feels more comfortable to control before pushing for longer runs.
faq: What is the main goal in Jump and Fly?
You guide a squirrel or a bee through a forest by jumping, collecting coins, and moving through the landscape. The description emphasizes flying high and discovering hidden paths.
How do I control the character?
Tap to jump, and tap and hold to adjust the jump. Holding changes how high your character flies.

zombie-colosseum.intro: Zombie Colosseum is an adventure game about surviving endless zombie hordes. You manage scarce resources, fight tactically, and use your arsenal as the difficulty rises.
tips: Treat your resources as limited from the start and decide what each one is worth before you spend it.
Avoid rushing into large groups of zombies. Pick your fights so you are not drained before the harder stages.
Save your most powerful weapons for moments when the hordes are closing in rather than using them on the first enemies you see.
Pay attention to how the challenges change as you go, and adjust your approach when the difficulty increases.
Take a moment to look at what you have left before each new stage so you can plan your next move.
faq: What is the main goal of Zombie Colosseum?
The goal is to survive the relentless zombie hordes and outlast the apocalypse. Careful resource management and tactical combat are central to doing so.
How do I stay alive for longer?
Manage your scarce resources carefully and choose your battles instead of engaging every zombie you meet. Using your arsenal at the right moments makes a big difference.

ultimate-robo-duel-3d.intro: Ultimate Robo Duel 3D is an arena fighting game where you control a robot against the computer or a friend in 2 PLAYER mode. Each player has its own set of keys for moving, punching, kicking, and special attacks.
tips: Before you start a match, look at the key layout for your player. Knowing where Punch, Kick, Special Hit, Bullet, and Grab sit lets you attack without looking down.
Try a few rounds against the computer first to learn how your robot moves and how each attack feels before you face a friend.
Do not rely on one attack. Mix Punch and Kick so your opponent has to guess which move is coming next.
Keep your robot moving around the arena instead of standing still. This makes it harder for your opponent to line up their attacks.
In 2 PLAYER mode, each player should keep their hands on their own keys. Player 1 uses W, A, S, D and Player 2 uses the arrow keys, so the two sets do not overlap.
faq: How do I move my robot?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys.
Can I play against a friend?
Yes. Choose the 2 PLAYER mode to fight a friend on the same keyboard, or play against the computer instead.

cooking-match.intro: Cooking Match is a bubble shooter where you match ingredients to turn them into dishes. Plan your moves while keeping an eye on the clock.
tips: Look for the largest group of matching ingredients before each move, since bigger clusters are what earn bonus points.
Think one or two moves ahead so you don't leave a board that forces a small, low-value match.
Don't rush every shot. Quick decisions help under the timer, but a short pause to scan the board often saves more time than it costs.
Watch for setups where one shot can clear several matches at once, especially when the board gets crowded.
When a level feels stuck, check which colors or ingredients you have the most of and build around them.
faq: How do I earn bonus points in Cooking Match?
Create larger clusters of matching ingredients. The game rewards bigger groups with bonus points.
Is there a time limit?
Yes. The game asks you to race against time, so keep your moves efficient as you play.

urban-derby-stunt-and-drift.intro: Urban Derby Stunt And Drift is a 3D racing game where you drive, perform stunts, and collect coins. Use the money you earn to unlock new vehicles as you explore the open map.
tips: Spend a few minutes roaming the open map before chasing levels, so you learn how your car steers and grips the road.
Pay attention to how each vehicle handles, since the cars feel different, and pick the one that suits your driving style.
Practice drifting and stunts in quiet areas, then use the same controls in the more challenging levels.
Use Space to brake before tight turns and release it when you want to keep your momentum through the curve.
Press C to try different camera angles and choose the view that makes it easiest to judge distance and turns.
faq: How do I earn money in the game?
You earn money by performing stunts and collecting coins. The money you collect is used to unlock new vehicles.
What do the controls do?
Arrow Keys drive the car, Space brakes, F activates nitro, and C changes the camera. Esc or Tab pauses the game.

speeding-ball.intro: Speeding Ball is a 3D arcade golf game where each hole gives you only one stroke. Your goal is to roll the ball into the hole on that single attempt.
tips: Study the whole hole before you act, including the distance, slopes and obstacles between the ball and the cup.
Plan your line first, then take your shot, since you cannot correct a bad stroke on the same hole.
Pay attention to the ball's speed and how far it will travel, because a shot that is too strong can overshoot the hole as easily as a weak one undershoots it.
Use the 3D view to check the angle from more than one perspective so you do not misjudge the direction.
If a hole seems very hard, stay patient and treat it as a calculation problem rather than rushing the click or tap.
faq: How many strokes do I get on each hole?
Each hole gives you only one stroke, so you need to make your calculation carefully before you act.
How do I play Speeding Ball?
Use a mouse click or a tap to play, and make your one shot count by aiming so the ball drops into the hole on the first try.

mushroom-runners.intro: Mushroom Runners is an endless runner where you dodge obstacles, crush enemies, and collect mushrooms to grow bigger while riding the Happy Flying Cloud. Quick reactions and good timing keep you running.
tips: Watch the ground ahead rather than the obstacle right in front of you, so you have time to decide whether to jump or stomp.
Use jump to clear obstacles and stomp when you need to drop down quickly onto enemies below you.
Keep your inputs short and steady. Holding or repeating a jump can make you land on the next obstacle at a bad moment.
Collect mushrooms when it is safe to do so, since growing bigger is part of the core loop, but don't chase them into danger.
Practice on a few runs to learn the rhythm of the level's obstacles, because the run only gets faster and more demanding over time.
faq: What is the goal of Mushroom Runners?
The goal is to keep running as long as possible by dodging obstacles, crushing enemies, and collecting mushrooms to grow huge.
How do I jump and stomp?
On mobile, touch the screen to jump and swipe down to stomp the ground. On desktop, press the up key to jump and the down key to stomp.

rise-up-hero.intro: Rise Up Hero is an arcade game about climbing a vertical course while avoiding obstacles. Each level brings new challenges, so timing and planning your moves matter.
tips: Watch the obstacles for a moment before you move, and look for the pattern they follow.
Focus on precise timing rather than rushing, since a small mistake can send you back.
Treat each level as a new challenge and notice what changes from the previous one.
Use the visuals to plan a route upward before you commit to a jump or move.
If you keep failing at the same point, pause and try a different approach instead of repeating the same move.
faq: What is the goal of Rise Up Hero?
The goal is to climb upward through a vertical journey by navigating obstacles and defying gravity. Each level gets harder with unique challenges.
Does the game rely more on speed or strategy?
The description points to both, with strategy and precise timing being the keys to success. Good timing usually matters more than moving quickly.

4-colors-pgs.intro: 4 Colors PGS is a card game where you play against up to three AI opponents. The goal is to empty your hand before they do, so timing and planning matter.
tips: Before each move, count how many cards you have left compared with your opponents. A player with fewer cards is closer to winning, so pay attention to who is getting close to empty.
Look for turns where you can get rid of more than one card, instead of playing single cards slowly. Clearing your hand faster is the whole objective.
Keep track of which cards have already been played. This helps you judge what your opponents are likely to be able to do next.
Don't hold onto a card just because it looks useful. If a move lets you shed cards and keep up with the AI, it is often the better choice.
Play a few rounds to learn how the AI tends to respond. Noticing its habits will help you time your moves more effectively.
faq: What is the main goal of 4 Colors PGS?
The goal is to empty your hand of cards before your opponents do. Each round is a race against up to three AI players.
How many opponents will I face?
You play against up to three clever AI opponents. The number of opponents in a game is up to three, so you may face fewer.

tumble-tower-survival.intro: Tumble Tower Survival puts you on top of a giant wooden block tower while disasters make blocks slide, topple, and crash into the water. Stay on your feet longer than everyone else to be the last Tumbler standing.
tips: Before a disaster hits, use the mouse or right-side drag to look around and find which blocks look most stable. Move toward them early rather than waiting for the blocks to start moving.
Use the mouse wheel or pinch to zoom out so you can see the whole tower and spot blocks that are sliding or tilting.
Save your jumps for climbing back onto a higher block after a shake. Jumping in the middle of a disaster can throw you off balance.
Pick up power-ups when you can do so safely, since they are the tool meant to help you stay on your feet. Do not chase one across a block that is already sliding.
If the game gets busy, use the pause button or the P or Esc key to take a moment and check your position.
faq: What is the goal of Tumble Tower Survival?
Survive each disaster and stay on the tower. Anyone who falls into the water is out, and the last Tumbler standing wins.
How do I move and jump?
On desktop, use WASD or the arrow keys to move and Space to jump and climb. On mobile, drag on the left side of the screen to move and tap the JUMP button.

merge-combo.intro: Merge Combo is a puzzle game where you drag and merge identical blocks to build bigger numbers and chain combos for points. It is about planning merges so your board stays clear as the numbers grow.
tips: Before each drag, look for pairs of identical blocks and choose the merge that leaves the most room on the board.
Try to set up combos by making a merge that creates a new block matching a neighbor, so one move can trigger a chain.
Keep the largest numbers near one edge or corner so smaller blocks can keep merging around them.
Avoid filling the middle of the board with single blocks that have no matching partner, since they block future merges.
Pause to scan the whole board before moving, because a small change in order can make a much bigger chain possible.
faq: What is the goal of Merge Combo?
The goal is to merge identical blocks to create larger numbers and earn points, aiming for the highest number you can reach.
How do I merge blocks?
Drag one block onto another identical block to combine them into a single larger block.

jewel-magic.intro: Jewel Magic is a match 3 puzzle game where you swap neighboring jewels to line up three or more of the same color. Clear enough points within the moves or time limit to win each level.
tips: Look for moves that match four or five jewels in a row, since the instructions say longer matches create special bombs.
Save your power-ups for tough spots where no simple match is available instead of using them right away.
Before each swap, check whether the move also sets up a second match, so one swap can clear more jewels.
Keep an eye on your remaining moves or time so you can focus on the highest-scoring matches when you are running low.
Work from the bottom of the board when possible, because clearing lower jewels can cause new matches to form above them.
faq: How do I make a match in Jewel Magic?
Swap two neighboring jewels so that three or more jewels of the same color end up in a row. Those jewels are then removed from the board.
What are the special bombs for?
Matching three or more jewels in a row can create special bombs, which the game rewards with extra points. Using them well is a good way to speed up your score.

toca-life-adventure.intro: Toca Life Adventure brings several Toca Life locations together in one endless 2D adventure. Collect balls to raise your score and unlock new characters as you explore.
tips: Explore each location, since the game combines City, Vacation, Office, Hospital and more in one place, so you can find where balls are most common.
Collect balls steadily rather than rushing, because every ball adds to your score and brings you closer to unlocking new characters.
Keep track of which characters you have already unlocked so you know which ones you are still working toward.
Try switching between locations often to keep the adventure fresh and to see which setting gives you the easiest route to the balls.
Play with a friend if you want to compare scores, since the game also lists a 2 Player tag.
faq: How do you increase your score in Toca Life Adventure?
Collect balls, because each ball you gather increases your score.
How do you unlock new characters?
Collect balls during your adventure, which also helps you unlock new characters.

flower-merge-triple-puzzle.intro: Flower Merge - Triple Puzzle is a casual matching puzzle where you collect flowers into a merge tray and clear three identical ones at a time. Plan each move so the tray never fills up.
tips: Before tapping a flower, check how many tray slots are free, since the game ends if the tray fills up.
Look for flowers that already have two copies in the tray and try to complete the set before adding new types.
Avoid spreading the tray across many different flowers; keeping only a few types in play makes matches easier to find.
Save boosters for levels where you are stuck with no clear move, rather than using them at the start.
If a level feels crowded, pause and scan the board for the flower type that appears most often, since clearing it frees up space fastest.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear all the flowers from the board by matching three identical flowers in the merge tray.
What happens if the tray fills up?
The game is over, so it is important to plan your moves before adding more flowers.

fnf-trick-or-die.intro: Explore the house of Lemon Demon and find a way to rescue Girlfriend from Friday Night Funkin'. This stealth adventure rewards careful movement, smart item use, and staying out of sight.
tips: Move slowly and check each room before you enter it, so you know where you can safely go next.
Use T to unhide whenever you want to leave a hiding spot, and plan your exit before you commit to a hiding place.
Pick up items with F as soon as you find them, since you will need them later to get through the house.
Use G to drop an item when you no longer need it, which helps you keep track of what you are carrying.
Think about your route before you start moving, because the stealth focus means quick, noisy mistakes can cost you progress.
faq: What is the main goal of FNF: Trick or Die?
Your goal is to enter the house of Lemon Demon and rescue Girlfriend from Friday Night Funkin'. Everything you do should move you closer to that rescue.
How do I move around the house?
Use W, A, S and D to move. Pick up or use an item with F, drop an item with G, and unhide with T.

jump-to-the-rhythm-of-songs-musical-ball.intro: Jump on the tiles in time with the music and try to reach the end of each track. This guide covers the controls, how to earn points, and how to keep your ball on the platforms.
tips: Listen to the beat before you start moving, and try to match your moves to the rhythm rather than reacting late to each tile.
Keep your finger or mouse steady and make small, controlled moves, since quick overcorrections are a common way to miss a tile.
Focus on reaching the end of the track first, then work on earning more points on the levels you have already finished.
Try a few levels in a row to get used to the speed of each song before you aim for a high score.
Check the leaderboard to see how your score compares, and use it as a goal to beat on your next run.
faq: How do I move the ball?
On a phone, move your finger left or right, or swipe left or right. On a computer, hold the left mouse button and move the mouse.
How do I earn points?
You earn points by completing levels and jumping on the tiles to the beat. Completing more levels earns more points and helps you unlock new music tracks.

i-want-to-be-king.intro: I Want to Be King is a quick-thinking strategy game where you can play as a cunning assassin or a watchful king. Simple tap controls keep the action easy to pick up, while each choice can lead to surprising results.
tips: Think about which role you are playing before you act, since the assassin and the king approach threats in different ways.
Pause to read the situation before each tap, because every decision can change how the next moment unfolds.
Try both roles if you can, so you learn how deception and vigilance each play out.
Keep your taps deliberate rather than rushed, since the controls are simple and mistakes usually come from hasty choices.
When an outcome surprises you, note what you did just before it, so you can make a more informed choice next time.
faq: What is the main goal of I Want to Be King?

The game centers on strategy and quick wit, with you choosing whether to deceive as an assassin or outsmart threats as a king. The description does not spell out a specific win condition, so explore the choices to see what each one leads to.
How do the controls work?
The game uses simple tap controls, so you interact by tapping on the screen. Keep your inputs deliberate, since each tap can affect what happens next.

car-eats-car-sea-adventure.intro: Car Eats Car: Sea Adventure is a highway racing game where you overtake rivals, build and upgrade your own cars, and dodge police during chases. Each race tests your driving and your use of speed and weapons.
tips: Save turbo for straight stretches or moments when you need to close a gap on a rival, rather than using it up at the start.
Use the brake before tight bends so you keep control, then accelerate out of the turn.
Keep your balance steady with A and D, especially when you are carrying speed, so the car does not drift off course.
Think about when to fire bombs. Use them when a rival or police car is directly in front of you, not when you are too far away to hit.
Before you face the boss, make sure your car is upgraded, since the fight is a tougher test of your driving.
faq: What is the main goal of Car Eats Car: Sea Adventure?
You race on the highway to overtake enemies, free captured evil cars from prison, and fight the boss to survive the crazy races.
Which keys control the car?
W is gas, S is brake, and A and D handle balancing. The arrow keys can also be used for gas, brake, and balancing.

bois-d-arc-bow-shooting.intro: Bois d'Arc is a medieval defense game where you shoot arrows from castle towers. Lead your shots, time powerful releases, and hold off waves of advancing enemies.
tips: Aim ahead of moving enemies rather than at where they are now, since the game centers on leading targets.
Save your most powerful shots for moments when enemies bunch together or reach a dangerous point, instead of firing everything at once.
Watch the wave pattern closely early on so you can plan which threats to handle first before they reach your tower.
Spend upgrades on the areas that are causing you the most trouble, so each choice directly helps your defense.
Pay attention to timing: a short pause before a shot can be worth more than rushing several weaker ones.
faq: What is the main goal of Bois d'Arc?
You defend your kingdom from advancing enemy waves by shooting them from castle towers. Keeping the enemies from reaching your defenses is the core challenge.
How do I aim my shots?
The game focuses on leading enemies, so you need to aim slightly ahead of their movement. Check any in-game prompts for the exact controls, as none are listed in the game's instructions.

car-eats-car-arctic-adventure.intro: Car Eats Car: Arctic Adventure is a racing game where you overtake rivals on the highway, build and upgrade your own car, and escape police chases. Each run mixes driving skill with combat and boss fights.
tips: Save turbo for straight stretches or right after a clean overtake, since it is most useful when you can hold a steady line.
Use the A and D keys to stay balanced on bumps and curves, and avoid sharp steering that can make you lose control.
Tap the brake with S before tight turns instead of braking hard mid-corner, so you keep enough speed to pull away from chasers.
Use bombs with Space when a rival or police car is directly in front of you, rather than firing them at long range where they are easy to miss.
Upgrade your car in the incubator with the parts that fit your driving style, then fight the boss only once your car feels reliable in normal races.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
You race against rivals on the highway, overtake enemies, and try to free the evil cars held in prison. Along the way you also upgrade your car and survive police chases and boss fights.
Which keys control the car?
Use W to gas and S to brake, while A and D balance the car. The arrow keys can also handle gas, brake, and balancing, X activates turbo, and Space fires bombs.

bmg-crash-test.intro: BMG Crash Test is a racing simulator where you drive different cars into hammers, presses, springboards and other obstacles on large tracks. Your aim is to test each car's strength and set new records.
tips: Use the B key to slow down time when a hammer, press or jump is coming up, so you can plan your line before the impact.
Press C to switch camera views and pick the one that shows the obstacle ahead most clearly.
Try the same track with a few different cars with the N key, since cars with different builds can react differently to the same hit.
Use TAB to pause when you need a moment to look at the layout and decide on your route through the hazards.
Use the spacebar handbrake sparingly with WASD steering, so you can slide or stop the car at the right point near an obstacle.
faq: What is the goal of BMG Crash Test?
The goal is to test how well each car holds up on extreme tracks and set new records. You do this by driving through hammers, presses, ramps and other obstacles.
What do the controls do?
WASD moves the car, the spacebar is the handbrake, and C changes the camera view. TAB pauses the game, B slows down time, and N switches to the next car.

stickman-army-the-resistance.intro: Stickman Army The Resistance is a 2D arcade strategy game set in a desert war. You lead a small stickman force through waves of enemies, balancing attack and defense while upgrading your gear.
tips: Balance your spending between offense and defense rather than pouring everything into one side, since a weak wall or a weak attack can both cost you a wave.
Aim carefully before committing shots, because the game rewards precise targeting more than rapid, careless clicking.
Check your upgrades after each wave and prioritize the ones that help you survive the next group of enemies.
Collect rewards whenever they appear, as they can help you keep up with the growing strength of later waves.
Pay attention to how each wave arrives so you can shift your focus between defending your position and pushing back the attackers.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Army The Resistance?
The goal is to fend off waves of enemies in the desert war and lead your stickman army to victory against overwhelming odds.
How important is aiming in this game?
Precision is key, so take a moment to target enemies accurately instead of firing wildly.

blocks-puzzle.intro: Blocks Puzzle is a spatial puzzle game where you place unique blocks to clear lines and score points. Each move makes the board more demanding, so planning ahead matters.
tips: Look at the shape of each block before you drag it, and ask where it fits best on the board.
Try to fill gaps in a row or column so that you can clear lines and free up space.
Avoid leaving small, isolated holes on the board, because they make later blocks harder to place.
Keep some open space in the middle of the board so you have room to place larger or awkward pieces.
As lines disappear, check the new layout before your next move, since the challenge grows with each turn.
faq: How do I move the blocks?
Use the drag-and-drop controls to pick up a block and place it on the board.
How do I score points?
Points are earned by arranging blocks so that lines clear from the board.

attack-and-dash.intro: Attack & Dash is an action game where you control a stickman ninja with a sword. You plan each dash to defeat every enemy in a short arena and reach the end.
tips: Pause before every dash and check where each enemy and obstacle sits, since one wrong direction can leave the hero exposed.
Plan the order of your strikes before you launch, starting with the enemies that could hit you first if left alone.
Use short, precise dashes when enemies are close together, and save longer launches for open gaps between them.
Keep an eye on dangerous obstacles along your path, and treat each arena as a planning puzzle rather than a race.
If you fail a level, watch how the enemies move and try a different sequence of attacks next time.
