tag-valley.intro: Tag Valley is a blocky chase game where runners sprint from line to line while a knife-wielding chaser tries to tag them. Runners want clean escapes, and anyone caught joins the chasers.
tips: Save your dash for the moment the chaser closes in, since it is your fastest way to break away. Using it too early can leave you with nothing when you need it most.
Watch the chaser's position rather than the safe line. Moving sideways to keep distance often works better than running straight at the goal.
Use jumps when you are standing still to get past obstacles or change direction quickly. Pick your moment so you are not caught mid-air.
If a teammate is caught, get next to them and hold E to revive them. Reviving keeps your team in the match and helps you win three clean escapes in a row.
Collect gems on the field whenever it is safe to do so, since they let you open knife and emote crates. Grab them on the way across rather than making detours into danger.
faq: How do I win as a runner?
Get across from one safe line to the other and make three clean escapes in a row before the timer runs out. If the chasers catch everyone first, they win instead.
How do I win as a chaser?
Catch every runner in the match. Each runner you tag joins the chasers, so the pressure builds as the run goes on.

swing-obby-for-brainrots.intro: Swing Obby for Brainrots is an obstacle course game where you swing and fly to rescue Brainrots. Your main tools are the spacebar to grab the hook and the WASD keys to steer mid-flight.
tips: Press the spacebar early enough to catch the hook at the right moment, since a late grab can waste momentum you need for the next jump.
Use W, A, S, and D while you are in the air to adjust your path, and make small corrections rather than large, sudden movements.
Before each swing, look ahead to where you want to land so you can plan the direction and timing of your grab.
Practice the rhythm of your swings on the easier parts of the course, then apply the same timing to harder sections.
Stay calm after a missed grab and reset your approach instead of rushing the next swing, which often leads to another fall.
faq: What is the main goal in Swing Obby for Brainrots?
The goal is to ride and enhance your Obby so you can fly through the course and rescue the Brainrots.
How do I grab the hook and move through the air?
Press the spacebar to grab the hook and fly. While you are in flight, use the W, A, S, and D keys to control your direction.

usa-luxury-4x4-suv-offroad-driving-simul.intro: Drive luxury 4x4 SUVs over mud, rocks, rivers, snow and mountain paths. This guide covers the main controls, modes and how to earn coins for new vehicles.
tips: Start in Free Roam to learn how the SUV responds to acceleration, braking and your chosen control style before attempting timed or obstacle runs.
Switch on 4x4 Mode when the ground is muddy or steep, since it gives extra traction and helps you keep moving.
Ease off the accelerator on steep slopes and sharp turns so the wheels keep their grip instead of sliding.
Use Time Trial to practise smooth, precise lines through a route, and Obstacle Challenges to build control over rocks and water crossings.
Complete challenges to earn coins, then save them for unlocking new SUVs or upgrading wheels, paint and accessories.
faq: How do I earn coins in the game?
You earn coins by completing challenges. Coins can then be used to unlock luxury SUVs and customize your vehicle.
Which control options can I use to drive?
You can choose between tilt, steering wheel or touch controls. Pick the one that gives you the most precise steering on sharp turns and slopes.

zombie-can-t-jump.intro: Zombie Can't Jump puts you in a junkyard facing waves of zombies. Build defenses, gather weapons, and work with friends to hold out as long as you can.
tips: Build your defenses before the next wave arrives, not after the zombies are already at your position. A gap in your barrier is often where a fight is lost.
Scavenge for weapons whenever it is safe, and keep track of which ones you have. Having a backup option ready can save you when your main weapon runs low.
Coordinate with teammates on who covers which area. Splitting duties so no single spot is left unguarded makes the zombie hordes easier to manage.
Pay attention to where the zombies are coming from and reinforce that side first. Spreading your defenses too thin usually leads to being overrun.
Play in short sessions and take breaks when you feel your focus slipping. Staying alert matters more than pushing on tired, since mistakes are easy to make late in a round.
faq: What is the main goal in Zombie Can't Jump?
You need to survive the relentless zombie hordes in the junkyard for as long as possible. Your wits, defenses, and teamwork are what keep you going.
How do I get better weapons?
Scavenge the junkyard for weapons as you go. Looking through the area carefully gives you more options to fight back.

soccer-dash.intro: Soccer Dash is an arcade soccer game where you drag to aim and release to kick the ball past obstacles and players to score a goal. The game slows down while you aim, giving you time to plan each shot.
tips: Use the slow-motion moment while dragging to study the obstacles and players before you release.
Plan the path of the ball, not just the first kick, so you can see where it might end up after bouncing off or passing traps.
Make small drag adjustments and check the direction before letting go, since each kick is a single launch.
Watch the positions of soccer players closely and aim for gaps between them rather than the most direct line to the goal.
If a shot goes wrong, use the next kick to reposition the ball calmly instead of rushing a risky aim.
faq: What is the goal of Soccer Dash?
The goal is to get past all the traps and score a goal with the soccer ball.
How do I control the ball?
Drag to choose the direction of the kick, then release to launch the ball. The game slows down while you drag so you can aim carefully.

grand-city-stunts.intro: Grand City Stunts mixes stunt challenges with street races against CPU racers, and you can play alone or with a friend on the same keyboard. Finishing first in a race is what earns the reward.
tips: Learn the handbrake early on Player 1 (Space) or Player 2 (Right Shift), since it helps you take sharp turns without losing as much speed.
Save your nitro (F for Player 1, K for Player 2) for straightaways or the final stretch of a race rather than using it right away.
Use the look back key (T for Player 1, L for Player 2) to check where the CPU racers are before you commit to an overtake or a risky line.
If your car gets stuck or you fall off track during a stunt, use respawn (R for Player 1, O for Player 2) to get back in the action quickly.
In two player mode, keep an eye on your friend's position too, since the race is still against the CPU racers and finishing first is what counts for the reward.
faq: What is the goal of Grand City Stunts?
You race against CPU racers and try to finish in first place to receive a reward. The game also includes stunt sections alongside the races.
How do the two player controls work?

Player 1 uses W, A, S, D to move, F for nitro, T to look back, R to respawn and Space for handbrake. Player 2 uses the arrow keys, K for nitro, L to look back, O to respawn and Right Shift for handbrake.

club-guard.intro: Club Guard is a simulation where you work the entrance of a nightclub. You check visitors for prohibited items, then decide who gets in, who gets turned away, and who gets a warning. Every visitor and every night is different.
tips: Check pockets, bags and clothing carefully, since contraband can be hidden in several places on a visitor.
Pay attention to each visitor's dialogue and behavior, because the odd requests and reactions often hint at what they are hiding or whether they are breaking the rules.
Decide on a consistent standard early, such as strict, fair, or lenient, and apply it to everyone so your choices feel deliberate rather than random.
Use warnings for minor issues before escalating, since the game lets you expel or warn visitors and this gives you more control over how the night goes.
Expect the unexpected: fights and strange requests can appear at any time, so stay alert and reassess your approach as each situation develops.
faq: What is the main goal of Club Guard?
You keep order at the nightclub entrance by checking visitors and deciding who is allowed inside. You also work to maintain the club's atmosphere.
What kinds of items should I look for?
The game asks you to find prohibited items, including weapons, alcohol, and other contraband. Searching pockets, bags, and clothes is how you uncover them.

tanks-blitz.intro: Tanks Blitz is a tank battle game that mixes realistic simulation with fast arcade action. You upgrade your tanks and fight against opponents from around the world.
tips: Pick your upgrades with a plan rather than at random, since the game is built around strategic tank upgrades.
Learn how your tank handles before engaging, so your movements and aim feel natural in battle.
Choose the control scheme you are most comfortable with, either touch or keyboard, and stick with it so your reactions stay consistent.
Watch the battlefield before you commit. Blending simulation with arcade action rewards careful positioning as well as quick reflexes.
Use each battle to notice what worked and what did not, then adjust your upgrades and tactics for the next fight.
faq: What is the goal of Tanks Blitz?
Your goal is to dominate the battlefield and defeat opponents in tank battles. The game asks whether you can rise as a strong tank commander.
Which controls can I use?
The game supports touch or keyboard controls, so you can play with whichever you prefer.

squidgame-io.intro: SquidGame.io is a multiplayer .io game where you collect gems to grow and hunt smaller players. You steer with the mouse, click to boost, and can customize your character with hats and colors.
tips: Collect gems early to grow, since a bigger character is what lets you hunt smaller players.
Keep an eye on players around you and pick targets that are clearly smaller than you.
Use boost in short bursts to catch a target or get away, rather than holding it down all the time.
Move with the mouse toward open areas with gems so you keep growing instead of getting stuck in crowds.
Choose a hat and color you like before you start, so your character is easy to recognize during a match.
faq: What is the main goal in SquidGame.io?
The goal is to collect gems to grow and hunt smaller players. Staying alive while growing is the core of each match.
How do I move my character?
Use the mouse to move. Your character follows the direction of your cursor.

airplane-pilot-simulator.intro: Airplane Pilot Simulator puts you in the cockpit as an aspiring pilot. You fly different aircraft through missions that focus on safe landings and rescues.
tips: Start each flight with a clear plan for how you will land, since safe landings are a core part of the missions.
Make small, steady control inputs and avoid sudden corrections, which helps you keep the aircraft stable.
Try a few different aircraft to learn how each one responds, because the handling may differ between them.
Before each mission, check what the objective is, such as a landing or a rescue, so you know what to prioritize.
Practice in the open sky first to build familiarity with your controls before you attempt the more demanding missions.
faq: What is the main goal of Airplane Pilot Simulator?
You navigate a variety of aircraft through missions, with the aim of ensuring safe landings and successful rescues.
What kinds of missions will I face?
The game describes missions that include safe landings and successful rescues, flown in an open sky setting.

jelly-mob-rush.intro: Jelly Mob Rush is a 3D runner where you lead a wobbly crowd of jelly people down a candy lane. Choose gates that grow your mob while you dodge kitchen hazards.
tips: Read both numbers on each gate before you pass it. Adding and multiplying gates grow your crowd in different ways, so a multiply gate with a small crowd can beat a bigger addition.
Steer early rather than at the last moment. Moving the crowd gradually keeps it together and gives you room to reach the gate you want.
Pick a lane toward the gates you need before reaching pizza cutters or sweepers. Staying in open space makes it easier to squeeze past hazards.
Keep your crowd large before the red jelly army at the end of a stage. A bigger mob gives you more to work with when you face them.
Use the macaron staircase when you can reach it safely, since it offers a coin multiplier. Spend coins on upgrades, skins, and hats between runs to build up over time.
faq: What is the main goal of Jelly Mob Rush?
Grow your jelly crowd by choosing the right gates while avoiding kitchen tools. Beat the red jelly army at the end of a stage to keep going.
How do I steer the jelly crowd?
Drag left or right anywhere on the screen, or use the A and D arrow keys. To start a run, drag anywhere on the start screen.

run-guys-knockout-royale.intro: Run Guys: Knockout Royale is a multiplayer racing game with seesaw runs and a mountain climb. You play by clicking or tapping, and the slowest players get knocked out at each level.
tips: Keep your balance on the seesaws by making small, steady taps rather than rapid ones, since overreacting can tip you off.
Watch the trap floors and spinning wooden columns ahead of you, and adjust your path early instead of reacting at the last moment.
Stay near the front of the pack, because each level knocks out the slowest players and falling behind is the main way to get eliminated.
In mountain climbing, plan your jumps toward the summit so you land with enough room to reach the crown instead of overshooting.
Pay attention to other racers' positions and use their movement to judge where the hazards and openings are coming up.
faq: What is the goal of Run Guys: Knockout Royale?
The goal is to get through each level without being knocked out. In seesaw mode, reach the finish line, and in mountain climbing, be the first to reach the summit and jump onto the crown.
How do I control my character?
Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The game is controlled entirely with these inputs.

mix-monsters-fun-merge.intro: Mix Monsters: Fun Merge is a puzzle game where you cross different monsters to produce eggs. Break the eggs to hatch unique creatures and see what you can discover.
tips: Try crossing different pairs of monsters, since the game is built around combining them to get eggs.
Pay attention to whether each egg is Common, Rare, or Legendary, so you can tell which combinations are giving you better results.
Break each egg once you have it, because the monster inside only appears after the egg is broken.
Keep a mental note of combinations that worked well so you can repeat them later instead of guessing again.
Play in short sessions, since the game is designed for quick entertainment and steady skill building.
faq: What is the main goal of Mix Monsters: Fun Merge?
The goal is to cross different monsters to get eggs, then break those eggs to hatch unique monsters.
What are the different types of eggs?
Eggs come in three types: Common, Rare, and Legendary. Each one is a different kind of egg you can get from crossing monsters.

bridge-race.intro: Bridge Race mixes collecting and racing. You gather colored blocks to build stairs up to the next floor, while trying to keep rivals from taking over your path. Reach the last level to win.
tips: Focus on collecting blocks in your own color, since those are what build your stairs.
Keep an eye on your opponents so you can spot when they are moving toward your stairs.
Grab blocks quickly without stopping, because speed decides who builds the next floor first.
Protect the stairs you have already built, since losing them sets you back in the race.
Plan each move toward the next floor instead of only chasing the closest block.
faq: What is the goal of Bridge Race?
Your goal is to collect colored blocks, build stairs to the next floor, and reach the last level before your opponents. You can't win until you get there.
How do I control my character?
The game is played by sliding, as shown in the instructions. Slide to move and keep up with the race.

pixel-flow.intro: Pixel Flow is a puzzle game about timing and order. Tap to send cannons onto the conveyor, match them to pixel blocks of their color, and clear the board one piece at a time.
tips: Before each tap, check which color the cannon you are about to send will hit, so every shot has a target.
Keep an eye on the spare slots, since they are limited. Avoid filling them with cannons that have no useful target yet.
Think about the order of your shots, not just the next one. Clearing a color in the right sequence keeps the board moving.
Do not overload the conveyor. Sending too many cannons at once can block your later moves.
Look for chances to build combos by lining up shots that break pixels in quick succession.
faq: What is the main goal of Pixel Flow?
Clear the board piece by piece by firing each cannon at pixels of its matching color, in the right sequence.
What does tapping do?
Tapping sends a cannon onto the conveyor, where it will fire at pixels of its matching color.

minimarket-67-7-store-tycoon.intro: Run your own minimarket from a small shop to a larger store. Stock shelves, hire staff, upgrade equipment, and keep customers happy as your business grows.
tips: Keep your shelves stocked before you focus on anything else, since empty shelves mean lost sales.
Spend early earnings on service speed upgrades, because serving customers faster brings in more money over time.
Hire employees when customers start waiting, so the queue doesn't push visitors away.
Check on how happy your visitors are regularly, and act on problems before they grow.
Save up for store expansion once your income is steady, so you don't stall your cash flow.
faq: How do I move my character on PC?
Use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move around the store.
How do I move my character on mobile?
Move the joystick at the bottom of the screen to control your character.

zombotron-re-boot.intro: Zombotron Re-Boot is an action game where you hunt treasure across alien worlds overrun by zombies. You must survive with limited resources while avoiding traps on every level.
tips: Spend your limited resources carefully and save them for the zombie groups or traps you can't avoid.
Look at each area before moving ahead so you can spot traps and plan a safer route.
Take on zombies in a way that keeps your options open, rather than rushing into the largest group.
Treasure is the reward for getting through a level, so focus on surviving each stage rather than chasing it recklessly.
If you lose a level, try it again and note which traps or zombie positions caught you, since levels reward perseverance.
faq: What is the goal of Zombotron Re-Boot?

You play as a space hunter exploring alien zombie-infested worlds to uncover valuable treasures while surviving each level. The description says every level tests your mettle and rewards your perseverance.
How do I survive longer in the game?
Use your limited resources wisely and avoid the treacherous traps placed through each level. Planning your moves with cunning strategies gives you the best chance to keep going.

ghost-walker.intro: Ghost Walker is a 2.5D arcade platformer about fighting through underground crime waves with a sword. This guide covers practical habits for handling its aiming, jumping and enemy encounters.
tips: Use the slow-down when you aim to plan the shot before you commit, since the description says time slows as you aim.
Because you have unlimited aerial jumps, treat jumping as a way to reposition constantly rather than saving it for emergencies.
Watch where bullets are coming from and move out of their line early instead of reacting at the last second.
Pick your engagements: stealth is part of the design, so approaching a group quietly can be safer than charging in.
Expect relentless challenges and keep your pace steady, retrying a tricky section with a different approach rather than repeating the same move.
faq: What is the main goal of Ghost Walker?

The game focuses on battling through underground crime waves while using your sword, aerial jumps and stealth to overcome challenges. Progress comes from surviving and outmaneuvering bullets and adversaries.
How do I get better at Ghost Walker?
Focus on using the aim slow-down to line up shots and on using repeated air jumps to dodge incoming threats. Try different approaches when a section keeps defeating you.

abyss-muncher.intro: Abyss Muncher is a pixel-art underwater roguelite where you hunt smaller creatures, avoid giant predators, and evolve your life-form with mutations, skills and relics. Each dive gives you a fresh chance to climb the food chain.
tips: Hunt the smaller creatures early to gain experience and grow before you take on the bigger threats.
Keep track of where the giant predators are and steer around them until you are strong enough to handle them.
When you choose upgrades, think about how your skills and relics work together rather than picking each one in isolation.
Save the Essence and Crystals you collect for lasting upgrades and new creatures, since they strengthen your future dives.
If you are new, play the Guided Dive first to learn the basics, and you can replay it from Settings whenever you need a refresher.
faq: How do I grow stronger during a dive?
Eat smaller creatures to gain experience, then choose upgrades as you evolve. Growing in this way is the core of each run.
Which keys or buttons do I use to play on desktop?
Use WASD to swim, Space to activate your innate skill, and J, K or L for your acquired skills. Click buttons to pick upgrades, open menus and pause.

online-cats-multiplayer-park.intro: Online Cats Multiplayer Park is a racing game where you run, jump, guess, and race as a kitty against other players in real time. It offers seven modes to choose from, all played with mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Try each of the seven modes early on to see which ones suit your play style best.
In Grab A Shabby Ball, keep an eye on where the ball is moving and head toward it, since touching it is how you earn points.
Watch your opponents as well as the course, because the arena is real-time and their moves can change what you should do next.
Since the game is controlled with a single click or tap, time your clicks carefully rather than pressing rapidly.
Stay in the match and keep trying, as each mode gives you another chance to compete for points or the finish.
faq: How do you earn points in Grab A Shabby Ball?
You earn points by competing with your opponents and touching the ball. Getting to it first matters most.
How many modes are there and how do I choose one?
The game has seven modes, and you can pick the one you want to play from the options offered.

escape-from-wave-for-brainrots.intro: Escape from Wave for Brainrots is a running game where you grab Brainrots, outrun a rising tsunami, and deliver them to your base. Speed and quick decisions decide how many you save.
tips: Grab the rarer Brainrots early, since the description says faster action gives you more chances to save the most valuable ones.
Plan your route back to the base before you pick up a Brainrot so you are not caught by the wave while looking for a way out.
Use Space to jump over obstacles on the way, and keep moving instead of stopping to look around.
Rotate the camera with the right mouse button to check where the wave is coming from without losing your direction.
Press E at the right moment when near a Brainrot, and keep an eye on the wave so you do not waste time in its path.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Grab Brainrots, run away from the tsunami, and deliver them to the base before the wave catches you.
How do I interact with a Brainrot?
Stand near it and press the E key on a computer. On a phone, use the pop-up window that appears above the animal.

stealth-robbery-of-a-house-together.intro: Stealth robbery of a house together is a two-player heist game where you sneak through a guarded house, grab furniture and valuables, and bring them to the van. You can play alone or with a friend on the same device.
tips: Watch the guards' patrol paths before you move, and wait for a clear gap instead of rushing into a room they are about to enter.
If a guard spots you, run right away. Getting caught is the main risk, so keep an escape route in mind before you grab anything.
Prioritize the most valuable items first, since the more valuable an item is, the faster the progress bar fills.
In two-player mode, coordinate with your partner so one player can lure or distract attention while the other collects loot.
Plan your route to the van before you pick things up, so you spend less time carrying items past guards.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
Collect furniture and valuables from the house and take them to the van to fill the progress bar and complete the level.
How do I control my character on PC?
Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, and Player 2 moves with the arrow keys.

penalty-shooters-3.intro: Penalty Shooters 3 is a soccer penalty shootout where you take turns scoring and blocking shots. Power-ups, precise timing, and a clock make each one-on-one duel tense.
tips: Watch the moment before each kick closely, since timing decides most outcomes in this game.
Save your power-ups for the shots where they matter most, such as a close score or a late round.
Stay calm when the clock is running low. Rushing a shot or a block often costs more than a few extra seconds.
When you are defending, focus on reading the shooter's movement rather than reacting to the last moment only.
Treat each round as a fresh duel. Shaking off a missed save or goal helps you keep your precision for the next one.
faq: What is the main goal of Penalty Shooters 3?
The goal is to win a soccer shootout by scoring penalty shots when you attack and blocking them when you defend. Becoming the champion is the overall aim.
How do power-ups help in the game?
The description says power-ups are a strategic element that can help you score or block shots. Using them at the right time is a key part of doing well.

drift-race-in-the-open-world.intro: Drift Race in the Open World is a timed racing game set on urban streets. You drift through corners, explore the open map, and customize your car to race against the clock.
tips: Practice drifting in quiet areas of the map before racing, so you learn how your car responds when it slides.
Keep an eye on the clock and plan your route through each stretch rather than racing at full speed into every corner.
Explore the open world between races to spot hidden secrets, which can help you learn the layout of the streets.
Treat crash scenarios as practice for control: notice what speed and angle caused the crash so you can avoid it next time.
Try different customizations and see how they change the way your car handles in drifts, then keep the setup that feels most precise.
faq: What is the goal of Drift Race in the Open World?
The goal is to race against the clock while mastering drifts and keeping your car under control on the urban streets. The game also invites you to unlock hidden secrets as you explore.
What are the controls?
The game's instructions do not list specific controls, so check any on-screen prompts or the game's menus when you start playing.

2048-shoot-merge-number-3d.intro: 2048 Shoot Merge Number 3D combines aiming and shooting with the number-merging rules of 2048. You shoot numbered blocks so matching values join, working toward 2048 and beyond in endless mode.
tips: Aim for spots where your shot will touch a matching number, since a match is what starts a merge.
Clear space regularly by merging, because the board fills up and the game ends when it is full.
Before each shot, look at the whole board and choose the merge that removes the most blocks, not just the first match you see.
Build your merges in order from 2 to 4 to 8 so that higher numbers have room to form near the top.
Keep a steady, unhurried rhythm, since one-touch controls are simple and most mistakes come from rushing.
faq: What is the main goal of 2048 Shoot Merge Number 3D?
Your goal is to shoot numbered blocks so that matching numbers merge, climbing from 2 up to 2048. Because the mode is endless, you can keep going past 2048.
How do I aim and shoot?
Use a mouse click or a tap to aim and fire. The controls are one-touch, so the same input handles both aiming and shooting.

mixed-world-weekend.intro: Mixed World Weekend is a puzzle clicker where you team up with cube companions to get past circular foes. The puzzles grow harder as you move through them, so careful planning matters.
tips: Look at the whole puzzle before you act. Note where the foes are, where your cube companions can go, and where a platform would help most.
Plan your platforms before you build them. A platform placed in the wrong spot can block your route or waste your chance to reach the next area.
Test one idea at a time. If a move does not get you closer to your goal, go back and try a different approach instead of repeating it.
Use sliding and your tongue to set up the next step, not just to escape danger. Think of each move as a way to prepare the path ahead.
Expect the puzzles to get harder. Take a short break when you get stuck, then return with fresh eyes to spot the solution you missed.
faq: What is the goal of Mixed World Weekend?
You team up with your cube companions to outsmart the circular foes and work through puzzles that become more challenging as you progress.
How do the cube companions help you?
The description says you team up with them to solve puzzles, so use their help when a single move is not enough to get past a foe or obstacle.

pixel-art-color-by-numbers.intro: Pixel Art - Color by Numbers is a casual coloring game where you fill a grid by matching each cell to its correct number. You draw pixels with mouse clicks to build a finished picture.
tips: Work on one number at a time so your choices stay consistent across the whole picture.
Start with the largest areas of a color, since they fill quickly and give you a clear sense of the image.
Hold the click for 2 seconds and then drag when a region is large, rather than clicking each pixel one by one.
Check the numbers near edges and boundaries carefully, because a single wrong pixel is easy to miss in a small grid.
Take short breaks and look at the picture from a distance to spot any gaps or mistakes before you continue.
faq: What is the goal of Pixel Art - Color by Numbers?
The goal is to color every pixel with the correct number to reveal a complete pixel artwork. You follow the number on each cell to finish the picture.
How do I color pixels in the game?
Left click to draw a single pixel. To draw multiple pixels at once, hold the left click for 2 seconds and then drag across the grid.

chicken-farm.intro: Chicken Farm is an idle tycoon game where you buy chickens, collect eggs, and turn them into cash. Merging matching chickens unlocks rarer breeds that earn more.
tips: Collect your eggs regularly, since they are what you turn into cash for buying more chickens.
Spend your earnings on new chickens as soon as you can afford them, because each chicken lays eggs automatically and adds to your income.
Watch for identical chickens on your farm and merge them to get rarer, more profitable breeds.
Use WASD to move and the mouse to control the camera so you can check your whole farm and see where new chickens fit.
Expand your farm and upgrade your coop as you progress, since this unlocks new features.
faq: How do I make money in Chicken Farm?
Collect the eggs your chickens lay and exchange them for money. You then use that money to buy new chickens and expand your farm.
How do I get rarer chickens?
Merge identical chickens to get rarer, more profitable breeds. Keep an eye out for matching pairs on your farm.

dead-seek.intro: Dead Seek is a 3D zombie shooter where you fight off waves of infected using a range of weapons. Move with WASD on desktop or the on-screen controls on mobile, and focus on staying alive.
tips: Shooting is automatic, so your main job is positioning. Keep moving and choose where you stand rather than trying to aim every shot.
Keep your distance from the zombie hordes. Backing away while they approach gives your weapons more time to do their work.
Upgrade the weapons you use most often so your firepower grows with the enemies you face.
Try different weapons from your arsenal to see which ones handle crowds and which handle tougher targets best.
Explore new zones carefully. Each area is crawling with infected, so check your surroundings before moving deeper in.
faq: How do I move my character?
On desktop, use the WASD keys to move. On mobile, use the on-screen controls to move around.
Do I need to aim my weapons?
No. Shooting zombies is automatic, so you can focus on moving and staying out of danger.

hard-working-man.intro: Hard Working Man is an offline farming and survival simulator where you start with nothing and rebuild a homestead. Gather materials, craft tools, and grow your settlement one step at a time.
tips: Gather several different resources early instead of focusing on just one, since you start with nothing and need materials for tools, buildings, and parts.
Check what each building or tool needs before you spend resources, so you do not run short on a material you still need for something else.
Use the bazaar to sell crops when you have a surplus, and use the income to buy seeds and tools that speed up your progress.
Upgrade your buildings step by step rather than rushing into large projects, so your settlement grows at a steady pace.
Keep an eye out for secrets as you play, since exploring the farm and its options can reveal ways to improve your homestead.
faq: What is the main goal of Hard Working Man?
The goal is to rebuild your farm from nothing and grow it into a homestead or settlement by gathering resources, crafting, and building. The game encourages steady progress over quick results.
How do I play the game?
Every action is based on clicking. Click on different resources to gather materials, then use them to build houses, craft tools, and create useful parts.

aquapark-surfer-race.intro: Aquapark Surfer Race is a sea racing game where you ride the waves, pass rival surfers, and race the clock. Use the acceleration zones and watch for obstacles to take the champion title.
tips: Look ahead to spot acceleration zones early so you can line up for them before you reach them.
While boosted by an acceleration zone, you are invincible, so it is a good time to push through obstacles or challenging wave sections.
Watch how the waves shift as you move, since the landscape changes and the best line is not always the same.
Keep an eye on the clock as well as on rival surfers, so you do not lose too much time while trying to overtake someone.
Plan your route a few waves ahead and avoid reacting only at the last moment to obstacles.
faq: What is the goal of Aquapark Surfer Race?
You race against time and rival surfers across changing sea landscapes to prove your surfing skills and claim the champion title.
What do acceleration zones do?
Hitting an acceleration zone gives you an invincibility boost, which helps you keep your speed and get through danger.

hellgate-1993.intro: Hellgate 1993 is a retro first-person shooter across eight hostile worlds, each with two combat missions and a boss. This guide covers how to manage your resources and get through the campaign.
tips: Check your health, armor, and ammo before opening each new door, since ambushes are part of the campaign.
Use M to open the automap often so you can spot unexplored areas and secret routes you have not reached yet.
Keep an eye out for keycards and terminals, because they unlock sealed sectors that may hold better weapons and supplies.
Switch weapons with 1 to 5 or the mouse wheel based on the enemy in front of you, and save your strongest weapon for tougher foes.
Stay at a distance from explosive barrels when enemies are close to you, because the blast can hurt you as well.
faq: What is the goal of Hellgate 1993?
Fight through eight hostile worlds, each made up of two combat missions and a boss encounter, to bring the light back to the last surviving human signal.
How do I use the Reward Ad options?
If your health or ammo becomes critical, you can use a Reward Ad once per attempt for an Emergency Supply. After dying, one Reward Ad can restore you with a Revive.

obby-but-you-re-on-a-motorcycle.intro: Obby, but you're on a motorcycle is a racing obby where you ride a bike through a series of tracks filled with ramps, loops, and tricky turns. Each track is different, so you need to adapt quickly as you go.
tips: Use the brake (Spacebar on PC, right-side button on mobile) before sharp turns and tricky sections so you keep control instead of crashing.
Slippery roads and slanted ramps behave differently, so ease off the throttle on those sections rather than flooring it.
Hold the right mouse button and drag (or drag across the screen on mobile) to pan the camera and look ahead before a jump or loop.
Think about your landing before you launch off a ramp, since a bad landing is one of the most common ways to crash.
Try a track a few times to learn where the surprises are, then use that knowledge to move faster on your next attempt.
faq: How do I move my motorcycle?
On PC, use WASD or the arrow keys. On mobile, use the joystick on the left side of the screen.
What does the brake do and when should I use it?
The brake is Spacebar on PC and the button on the right side on mobile. Use it before tight turns or when you feel you are losing control on a fast section.

head-ball-hyper-casual-game.intro: Head Ball is a fast-paced sports game where you control your character's head to hit balls and climb the ranks. Its controls are simple, but each match rewards careful, strategic play.
tips: Watch where the ball is heading before you move, since the game is fast and reacting late is the most common mistake.
Spend your first few matches getting a feel for how your head moves and where your hits land before you try anything ambitious.
Keep your character near the middle of the play area when you can, so you can reach balls coming from either side.
Stay calm between rallies and avoid rushing every hit, because steady, deliberate contact usually beats wild swings.
Review how each match went and note which kinds of shots worked, then apply that approach in your next match to keep climbing.
faq: What is the main goal of Head Ball?
You control your character's head to hit balls during matches, and your aim is to climb the ranks as you play.
How hard is it to learn the controls?
The controls are described as simple, so most of the challenge comes from timing your hits and choosing a strategy during each match.

dream-home-merge-story.intro: Dream Home: Merge Story is a cozy merge puzzle where you combine identical items, complete orders, and spend stars to renovate an old house room by room. This guide covers how to plan moves and manage your board and energy.
tips: Before each merge, check which items the current orders need and work toward those first, so your moves produce useful results.
Keep a few cells empty at all times. Free space gives new items somewhere to appear and leaves room for future merges.
Look for pairs of identical items on the board before you spend energy, and plan a chain of merges where possible.
Save your energy for merges that finish orders or create the higher-level items you need, rather than spending it on small moves.
Spend stars on renovations and upgrades when you return to the room, and choose the changes that make the most visible progress in your home.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to merge identical items, complete the orders shown at the top of the screen, and use the stars you earn to renovate the house into a cozy home.
What happens when I run out of energy?
You can wait for your energy to recover or refill it with an available option, such as crystals, which can help restore energy faster.

cheese-collector-rat-runner.intro: Cheese Collector - Rat Runner is an arcade adventure where you guide rats along a rope, dodging obstacles while grabbing cheese and bonus points. Quick reactions matter most.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead rather than the cheese, so you have time to react before each one reaches your rats.
Because the controls use one tap, focus on timing your taps rather than tapping rapidly, since extra taps can throw off your rhythm.
Keep your eyes on the rope path and plan your next move a moment early, especially when obstacles come in quick succession.
Go for the cheese when it is safe to do so, but don't take risks that could end your run, since survival is what keeps the points coming.
Practice short runs to learn how the obstacles are spaced, then aim for steady, calm timing in longer attempts.
faq: What is the goal of Cheese Collector - Rat Runner?
Your goal is to race along the rope, dodge dangerous obstacles, and snatch as much cheese and bonus points as you can while keeping your rats alive.
How do the controls work?
The game uses one-tap controls, so each tap is a single action. Good timing of those taps is the key to staying safe.

heart-calcopus.intro: Heart Calcopus is a timed math game set underwater, where you solve bubbling equations quickly to earn the octopus's approval. Each round rewards both speed and accuracy.
tips: Aim for accuracy first. Wrong answers usually cost more time than a slightly slower correct one, so build a steady rhythm before pushing for speed.
Practice quick mental math on the operations that appear most, such as addition, subtraction, and multiplication, so you can answer without stopping to calculate.
Break larger numbers into smaller parts, like splitting 38 + 47 into 38 + 40 + 7, to make answers faster to work out under time pressure.
Keep your own score log after each session so you can see whether your speed or accuracy is the weak point and focus practice there.
Try to beat your previous best one attempt at a time rather than chasing a big jump, since small consistent gains add up over repeated plays.
faq: What is the goal of Heart Calcopus?
The goal is to solve the math equations that appear as bubbles, quickly and correctly, to earn the octopus's approval.
How is progress measured in the game?
Your performance is tracked through scores, so the main way to measure progress is to compare each new score with your past scores and try to beat them.

happy-zoo-mahjong-triple-match.intro: Happy Zoo: Mahjong Triple Match asks you to clear a layered tile pyramid by sending animals into a tray and matching three of a kind. Plan each move so the tray never fills with mismatched animals.
tips: Before each tap, check which tiles you would uncover, since covered tiles stay locked until the ones above them are cleared.
Favor moves that bring a third matching animal into the tray, so a pair can merge and free up space quickly.
Keep an eye on how many different animals are sitting in the tray and avoid adding a new species when it would leave you with no match.
Save your undo and shuffle boosters for moments when you are truly stuck rather than using them early.
If you are running out of options, step back and look for the tile that frees the most locked animals before picking a move.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Clear the whole layered pyramid of animal tiles by moving them into the tray and merging each set of three identical animals.
What happens if the tray fills up?
If the tray fills with animals that do not match, the run ends, but you can rescue it with coins.

love-story-find-the-piece.intro: Love Story: Find the Piece is a puzzle game about a couple and their funny situations. You read the scene, search the illustration with a scanner, and pick the right item to solve each task.
tips: Read the text in the picture carefully before you start searching, since it usually points to what kind of item you need.
Move the magnifying glass slowly across the illustration so you do not miss small objects in the background.
Think about the story: ask yourself what the character is thinking or hiding, and look for items that fit that idea.
If a task stalls, scan the whole picture again rather than focusing on one corner, because the answer is often in an unexpected place.
Work through the levels in order, since each completed task moves the story forward and helps you get used to how the clues are written.
faq: What is the goal of Love Story: Find the Piece?
The goal is to solve each puzzle by finding the right item in the illustration and clicking it. You complete all the levels to finish the story.
How do I use the scanner?
Swipe the magnifying glass or scanner over the illustration to search for hidden items. When you find the right one, click it to solve the task.

100-doors-escape-from-prison.intro: In this escape game, you play Beren, an inmate who has lost his memory. Investigate each cell, solve its puzzles, and find the hidden path out.
tips: Examine every corner of a room before trying anything. The description stresses sharp observation, so small details like marks, objects, or odd spots are often the key clues.
Keep track of what you have found in each cell. Items and notes may be needed again later when you reach a new room.
If you are stuck, look again at the room for things you have not interacted with yet. A path that seems closed may open once you have examined everything else.
Think about how each puzzle connects to your past. The story of your lost memory is pieced together through the mysteries, so clues can carry meaning beyond the current room.
Take a short break when a puzzle stops making sense. Returning with fresh eyes often helps you notice the hidden path you missed.
faq: What is the goal of 100 Doors - Escape from Prison?
The goal is to escape from prison by solving the puzzles in each room and finding the hidden path to freedom. Along the way you also uncover what happened to Beren.
How do I solve the puzzles?
Rely on careful observation. Look closely at each cell, investigate objects and details, and think about how the clues fit together to reveal a way forward.

fruit-slasher.intro: Fruit Slasher is a fast-paced 3D arcade action game where you slice fruit with quick finger swipes. Your reflexes and precision decide how high your score climbs.
tips: Keep your swipes short and precise rather than wide and sloppy, so you can move on to the next fruit quickly.
Watch for explosive obstacles before you swipe, and only cut through a fruit when the path is clear of them.
Aim for combos by slicing several fruits in one motion, since chaining them is the main way to build a high score.
Stay near the centre of the action so you can react to fruit appearing from different directions.
Play a few rounds to learn the rhythm of how fruit comes in, then start looking ahead instead of reacting only to what is on screen.
faq: How do I slice the fruit?
Use quick finger swipes across the fruit as it appears. Clean, precise cuts are what the game is built around.
How do I get a higher score?
Chain several fruits together into combos, since combos are the key to scoring highly in this game.

sorting-cute-animals.intro: Sorting Cute Animals is a relaxing puzzle where you arrange animals in cells so that matching ones line up. The goal is to clear the field by placing three identical animals together.
tips: Scan the whole field before moving anything so you can spot which animals have matching pairs or groups of three.
Start with animals that already have two of a kind nearby, since completing a trio is the quickest way to clear space.
Keep the cells near the shelves as open as you can, so you still have room to place animals as you sort.
Move animals one at a time and check the result after each move, so you don't block a group you were about to finish.
If you get stuck, look for an animal that is alone and see whether moving it next to its match makes a trio possible.
faq: What is the goal of the game?
You need to find the same animals, place them on the same shelf, and completely clear the field of all animals to pass the level.
How do I connect three animals?
Place identical animals next to each other so that three of the same kind are together in the cells.

lanternbloom.intro: Lanternbloom is a colour-matching puzzle where you send fireflies to a lantern string. Light lanterns by gathering three of a colour before too many fireflies pile up.
tips: Before you send a firefly, check which colours are already waiting, so you can aim for the third match of a colour.
Keep an eye on the waiting count. Seven waiting fireflies end the night, so clear matches early instead of letting fireflies build up.
Use undo when a move leaves you with a clumsy waiting group, since it is quicker than starting the level over.
Try a level a few times on your own before using the hint, so you practise reading the board.
On the keyboard, move the highlight with the arrow keys or W, A, S and D, then press Enter or Space to send the firefly. This is slower to start but makes careful planning easier.
faq: What is the goal of Lanternbloom?
Send fireflies to the lantern string and light lanterns by gathering three fireflies of the same colour. Avoid letting seven fireflies wait at once, because that ends the night.
How do I undo a move or restart a level?
Use the undo button around the string, or press U, Z or Backspace on the keyboard. To start the level again, use the restart button or press R.

baby-taylor-babysitter-daycare-2.intro: Help Taylor and her mom look after her less-than-one-year-old cousin while his aunt is at an emergency meeting. This dress-up and babysitting game is played with mouse or clicks.
tips: Check the diaper often, not only when the baby starts crying. A dirty diaper is the main thing that upsets him, so cleaning it right away keeps him calm.
Alternate between feeding and playing with the baby so he doesn't stay in one activity for too long.
Pay attention to what the baby seems to need next and respond before he gets upset, since waiting makes it harder to settle him.
Try to keep a steady rhythm of care, moving from one task to the next, so that no need is left unattended for long.
Play the game a few times to learn how each task works, so you can handle them quickly when things get busy.
faq: What is my goal in Baby Taylor Babysitter Daycare 2?
You help Taylor and her mom care for the baby by feeding him, playing with him, and cleaning his diaper while his aunt is busy.
What happens if I don't clean the baby's diaper?
The description says the baby will cry because of the uncomfortable feeling, so you should clean a dirty diaper immediately.

stickman-team-force.intro: StickMan Team Force is a stickman fighting game where a team is recruited to stop a high-tech organization that wants to take over the streets. Shoot, switch heroes, and use your special moves to push back the threat.
tips: Press C to change hero often so you can use whichever stickman fits the current fight best.
Use Z or mouse clicks to shoot steadily rather than wildly, so you keep your attention on the enemies that matter most.
Save the Space special for tougher moments instead of spending it on the first enemies you meet.
Watch which enemies are closest to you and deal with them first, since letting several reach you at once makes fights harder.
Keep switching between heroes during a long fight so no single stickman takes all the damage.
faq: What is the goal of StickMan Team Force?
You lead a team of stickmen recruited to bring order to the world by stopping a high-tech organization that wants to take over the streets.
How do I shoot?
Press Z or click the mouse to shoot.

chicken-dash.intro: Chicken Dash is a fast platform game where you guide a little chicken to the finish line by running and jumping over obstacles. Collect coins along the way to raise your score.
tips: Watch the obstacles ahead before you commit to a jump, since the description says you need to time your jumps well.
On desktop, use the Up Arrow to jump and the Right Arrow to move forward. Short, controlled presses can help you land safely.
On mobile, tap the right side of the screen to move and tap and swipe up to jump. Start your swipe early so the jump happens before the obstacle.
Grab coins when you can do so without risking a bad jump, because they add to your score.
If you fall, try the same section again and focus on one obstacle at a time until your timing feels consistent.
faq: What is the goal of Chicken Dash?
Help the chicken run and jump through each level to reach the finish line while avoiding obstacles.
How do I control the chicken on desktop?
Press the Up Arrow to jump and the Right Arrow to move forward. You can also click and drag to move the chicken.

russian-car-drift-3d.intro: Russian Car Drift 3D is a casual isometric driving game about drifting around slick tracks using tap controls. You can collect items, unlock new cars, and keep your progress as you practice.
tips: Start slowly and focus on keeping your car under control before trying to drift through tight sections.
Learn how your car reacts on the slick surface, since a drift that starts too early or too late can send you into an obstacle.
Collect the valuable items you pass when it is safe to do so, but do not let chasing them cause a crash.
Because progress does not reset, take breaks and return to difficult spots later instead of rushing through them.
Try each unlocked car on the same track to see how its handling differs, then use the one that suits your drifting style.
faq: What is the main goal of Russian Car Drift 3D?
The goal is to master drifting while navigating slick tracks, conquering obstacles, and collecting valuable items. Along the way you can unlock diverse cars.
How do the controls work?
The game uses seamless tap controls. Practice tapping gently and in time with the turns so your car slides smoothly rather than spinning out.

stickman-shooter-2.intro: Stickman Shooter 2 is a shooting game where you defend your base against waves of alien and soldier attacks. Destroy enemies, collect coins, and use them to upgrade your arsenal.
tips: Spend coins on upgrades early, since stronger weapons make the later waves much easier to hold.
Pick up coins as soon as they appear, because they are what you need to improve your arsenal between fights.
Keep your aim on the enemies closest to the base, since they reach your fort first and do the most damage.
Watch how each wave arrives and where enemies come from, so you can focus fire before they get close.
Stay patient and conserve your defense; you need to last until the final wave, not just clear the first few.
faq: What is the goal of Stickman Shooter 2?
Your goal is to defend the base from alien and soldier attacks, destroy every enemy, and hold out until the last wave.
How do I control the game?
The game uses the mouse or touch controls, so you aim and shoot by pointing and clicking or tapping.

hockey-hero.intro: Hockey Hero is a one-on-one shootout game where you take shots at a tough goalie. You get 10 attempts to build up points and climb the leaderboard.
tips: Treat each of your 10 attempts as a chance to learn the goalie's pattern, and avoid rushing every shot.
Balance speed and precision: a fast shot that misses the net scores nothing, so aim first and then shoot.
Keep track of how many attempts you have left so you can decide when to take a risky shot and when to play it safe.
Watch how your points add up after each shot to see which approach is paying off.
Replay the game to improve your score and aim for a higher spot on the leaderboard.
faq: How many shots do you get in Hockey Hero?
You get 10 attempts in each round to score as many points as you can.
What is the goal of Hockey Hero?
Your goal is to score points by beating the goalie in one-on-one shootouts and to reach the top of the leaderboard.

game-factory.intro: Game Factory is a game-making studio where you build your own game in one of six genres. You set the rules, draw the sprites, add music, then test and publish your creation.
tips: Pick the genre first, since it shapes which settings matter most. Then adjust speed, gravity, and enemy count in small steps so you can see what each change does.
Use the Test button after every few changes instead of waiting until the end. Short test runs make it easier to spot problems in your settings or sprites.
Mix your own pixel sprites with the ready-made ones so your game has a clear look. Keep your sprites easy to tell apart so players can read the action quickly.
Choose a music track that fits the pace you set in your game. A fast runner and a slow tower defense game will suit very different tracks.
Before you publish, play your game through once more and make sure it is fair and finishable. Then share the code with friends and ask them what felt too hard or too easy.
faq: How do I start a new game?
Click Create Game, choose one of the six genres, and then customize its settings. After that you can move on to drawing sprites and picking music.
How do I earn coins and XP?
You earn coins and XP when you publish a game. Coins can be used to upgrade your studio and unlock new genres and sprite packs.

blocky-combat-swat-original-2026.intro: Blocky Combat Swat Original 2026 is a voxel shooter with single-player missions, multiplayer arenas, and a leaderboard. Move with WASD, aim and shoot with the mouse, and switch weapons with the scroll wheel.
tips: Use the scroll wheel to switch weapons often so you always have the right gun for the distance you are fighting at.
Keep moving with WASD instead of standing still, since staying in one place makes you an easy target in fast arenas.
Use the environment to your advantage, because the levels are destructible and walls or cover can be broken during a fight.
In single-player missions, scout the area first and plan your route so you do not run into a stronghold without a clear plan.
Press Tab to check the in-game menu whenever you need to review options before or between rounds.
faq: How do I move my character?
Use the W, A, S and D keys to walk around. Movement is the main way to stay out of enemy fire.
How do I shoot and aim?
Use the mouse to aim and shoot. Keeping your aim steady is important for hitting targets at range.

badland.intro: Badland is a scary side-scrolling challenge where you guide a nimble creature through an eerie silhouette world. Timing, reflexes, and quick decisions help you survive the moving screen.
tips: Keep your eyes on the terrain ahead rather than your creature, so you can react before hazards reach you.
Focus on precise flapping: small, well-timed taps usually keep you steadier than rapid, uneven ones.
Because the screen never stops moving, plan a few seconds ahead and avoid pushing yourself into tight gaps with no room to adjust.
Pay attention to transformative objects, since they can change how your creature moves and how you should respond.
Stay calm after a mistake and restart with a clear idea of what went wrong, which makes the next attempt easier to manage.
faq: What is the goal of Badland?
You guide a nimble creature through atmospheric challenges, surviving treacherous terrain while the screen keeps moving. Survival and strategy are both central to progressing.
What controls does Badland use?

The game's instructions do not list specific controls, but the description highlights precise flapping and quick reflexes as the key skills. Practice your timing early to get a feel for how your creature responds.

off-road-motocross.intro: Off road motocross puts you on a powerful motorcycle over dangerous tracks with obstacles to clear. Keep your balance, pick your speed, and work on your stunts and skills as you race.
tips: Make small, steady balance corrections with W and S instead of big jerky presses, since over-correcting is often what throws the bike off.
Use A and D to build speed deliberately, and ease off before a rough patch so you keep control through the obstacles.
Before a jump or uneven section, get your balance set ahead of time rather than reacting once you are already in the air.
Try stunts when the ground ahead is clear, so you can focus on landing the bike safely and keep your momentum.
Upgrading your vehicles is part of the goal, so note which parts of a track slow you down and aim to improve your skills there first.
faq: What is the goal of Off road motocross?
You race a motorcycle over dangerous off-road tracks, overcome obstacles, and work to become the top rider while improving your skills.
Which keys control the motorcycle?
Use W and S or the up and down arrows to keep your balance and control the bike, and A and D or the left and right arrows to speed up and get past obstacles.

angry-gran.intro: Angry Gran is a comedy action game where Gran takes on pesky neighbors across everyday streets. Use her quirky weapons to turn ordinary neighborhoods into chaotic battlegrounds.
tips: Try each quirky weapon early to learn what it does, since the weapons are the main way you deal with the neighbors.
Look around the street before acting, because the everyday objects around you may be useful as you move through each scene.
Switch up your approach if one method is not working, and keep experimenting to find what works best against different neighbors.
Pay attention to what is happening on screen after each action so you can plan your next move instead of reacting randomly.
Play in short sessions to keep the chaotic, fast pace fresh and to avoid getting stuck on the same stage for too long.
faq: What is the goal of Angry Gran?
The game is about Gran taking on pesky neighbors using quirky weapons while the streets become a comedic battleground.
What weapons can I use?
Gran is armed with quirky weapons, and trying different ones is a good way to see which suits each situation.

stickman-rescue-draw-2-save.intro: Stickman Rescue Draw 2 Save is a casual puzzle game where you draw lines to protect a stickman from danger. Each level presents a new threat, and your job is to find a drawn solution that keeps him safe.
tips: Look at the whole scene before drawing anything. Identify where the danger is coming from, such as falling rocks, flying arrows, or a deep pit, and decide what the stickman needs to stay safe.
Start with the simplest solution that could work. A short shield over the stickman may be enough for falling objects, while a bridge is better for gaps.
Draw with a few clear, deliberate lines rather than many small ones. Clean shapes are easier to read and less likely to leave gaps the danger can pass through.
If a drawing does not work, watch closely what happened and adjust your next attempt instead of repeating the same line in the same place.
Pay attention to the position of the stickman and the hazard before you start. Small changes in where you draw can decide whether the rescue succeeds.
faq: What is the goal of each level?
Your goal is to keep the stickman safe from the danger shown in the level and complete the rescue mission. You do this by drawing a shield, a bridge, or a clever device.
How do I draw in the game?
Use your mouse to click and drag, or use your finger to draw lines on the screen. The instructions say you can click or tap to play.

bomb-the-castle.intro: Bomb the Castle is a turn-based artillery game where you drive a castle on wheels, aim your shots, and blast through a rival castle to uncover its crew. Each battle rewards careful aiming and smart use of your crew.
tips: Before you fire, check the arc of your shot and whether a swinging gate is in the way. Timing a shot through a gate can be more useful than pure power.
Use the drag-and-release aim to test angles, and remember that returning to the starting point cancels a shot. Take advantage of this when your aim is off.
Move onto power strips and grab floating crates when you can, since these give you useful advantages during a battle.
When a Rainmaker shell is in the air, tap to split it and spread its damage across more of the target area.
Between battles, spend time training your crew and upgrading your castle's walls and wheels. A sturdier castle lets you survive longer and keep attacking.
faq: What is the goal of Bomb the Castle?
Destroy the opposing crew or the rival castle to win each battle. Blasting through the enemy castle is how you uncover its crew.
How do I aim and fire with the keyboard?
Use W and S (or the up and down arrows) to aim, and Q and E to adjust power. Press Space or Enter to fire.

t-rex-n-y-online.intro: T-Rex N.Y is a demolition shooter where you control a huge robot T-Rex moving through the streets of New York. Your aim is to destroy everything in your path as you rampage through the city.
tips: Use the arrow keys to move your T-Rex around the streets, and keep an eye on what is ahead so you can plan your route through the city.
Press Z and X to attack. Try both keys early on to learn which one suits your style of play.
Focus on the buildings and objects in your way, since destruction is the main goal of the game.
Keep moving rather than staying in one spot, so you can clear new areas of the city as you go.
Practice your timing with the attack keys, because a steady rhythm of attacks helps you clear obstacles more smoothly.
faq: What is the goal of T-Rex N.Y?
Your goal is to destroy everything in your way as you rampage through the streets of New York with your robot T-Rex.
Which keys do I use to play?
Use the arrow keys to move your T-Rex. Press Z or X to attack.

master-checkers-multiplayer.intro: Master Checkers Multiplayer is a classic checkers board game with a modern look. You can play against global players, test your skills against the AI, or share a local match with a friend.
tips: Before each move, check what your opponent can capture on their next turn, not just what you can capture now.
Try to trade pieces when you are ahead in material, since fewer pieces on the board make it easier to convert an advantage.
Keep your pieces grouped together rather than spreading them out, so that one jump cannot leave a single piece exposed.
When playing the AI, pay attention to whether it repeatedly takes the same kind of trade, and plan your moves to exploit that pattern.
Think two or three moves ahead when a piece is close to the far edge of the board, because a single misstep there can give your opponent a king.
faq: What is the main goal of Master Checkers Multiplayer?
The game is a classic checkers match, so the aim is to capture or block your opponent's pieces until they have no legal move left. The description emphasizes that each move needs foresight.
Can I play against other people or only the computer?
You can challenge global players online, test yourself against the AI, or play a local match with a friend on the same device.

last-shift.intro: Last Shift is a fast top-down 3D shooter where five workers fight machines across five chapters. Dodge enemy fire, stand still to attack, and choose upgrades as you level up.
tips: Keep moving to dodge enemy fire, and only stop when you need your hero to attack automatically.
Pick level-up abilities that fit your hero, such as Ricochet or Chain Lightning for crowds, or Force Field when enemies press in from several sides.
Try different heroes early to see how their weapons work, since the Programmer's homing bolts and the Garbage Collector's piercing bags play very differently.
Use the pause key P to step away and plan your route when a room gets crowded.
Finish daily quests and spend gear upgrades steadily, so each new run starts a little stronger.
faq: What is the goal of Last Shift?
You play as one of five ordinary workers fighting back against machines that are taking over. Clear the rooms in each chapter and defeat the boss at the end of each one.
How do I attack in Last Shift?
Stand still and your hero attacks automatically. Moving stops your attacks, so you need to balance movement for dodging with stillness for firing.

robot-attacks.intro: Robot Attacks is a fast arcade game where you defend your city against waves of mechanical enemies. Quick clicks or taps, smart base upkeep, and well-timed power-ups keep you alive.
tips: Watch each wave as it starts so you know what is coming before the enemies reach your base.
Keep your clicks or taps fast and steady, since reaction speed matters most when waves escalate.
Spend time fortifying your base early, so you are not scrambling to repair it once the waves get harder.
Save power-ups for the moments when pressure is highest instead of using them the moment you get them.
Stay calm and focused, because a single missed second can cost you ground in this high-stakes showdown.
faq: What is the main goal in Robot Attacks?
Your goal is to defend your city by stopping escalating waves of robots before they overwhelm your base.
How do I control the game?
You play by clicking or tapping quickly to respond to the robots as they attack.

gladiators-merge-and-fight.intro: Gladiators Merge and Fight is an action fighting game where you combine materials to build stronger gear for your hero. Each match is a one-on-one duel in the arena, and your upgrade choices shape how you fight.
tips: Merge materials with a plan in mind rather than at random, so your hero's arsenal grows in a direction that suits how you like to fight.
Before each duel, think about which upgrades you have available and which ones give you the most useful advantage.
Watch how your opponent moves and attacks early on, then look for the weakness you can exploit.
Change your tactics if your current approach is not working instead of repeating the same moves.
Treat each decision as important, since small choices in upgrades and tactics can add up over a run.
faq: What is the main goal of Gladiators Merge and Fight?
Your goal is to claim your place as a champion by winning one-on-one duels in the arena. Each merge and upgrade should help you win the next fight.
How do I get stronger during a run?
Merge materials to forge better gladiators and upgrade your hero's arsenal. Pick upgrades that match your planned tactics.

collect-brainrots-on-a-skateboard-online.intro: Steal a Brainrot from the arena, carry it across the finish line, and place it on a podium so it starts earning money. This guide covers the core loop, controls, and how to avoid losing your loot.
tips: Watch the guard before you grab a Brainrot. Only move in when he is looking away, and keep an eye on him while you ride back.
Use E to interact with a Brainrot, and hold it down when the game asks for a longer press.
Get your Brainrot across the finish line and onto a podium quickly, since that is when it begins generating money.
Spend money on speed, jump power, or a faster board to reach higher islands. Upgrades let you take on the more valuable catches.
Use keys 1-9 to switch between backpack slots so you always have the item you need ready, and use the left mouse button to activate it.
faq: How do I earn money in this game?
Steal a Brainrot, carry it across the finish line, and place it on a podium. It then generates money over time.
What happens if the guard catches me?
You tumble across the ground and your loot scatters, so you may need to gather it again.

super-motocross.intro: Super Motocross is a fast dirt bike racing game with ramps, jumps, and obstacles. Your goal is to reach the finish line without crashing, and you play with simple mouse clicks or taps.
tips: Watch the ramps before you hit them and adjust your speed so you land with the bike level.
Ease off the speed a little before big jumps, since too much speed can send you over the landing area.
Use short, steady inputs to keep your balance instead of holding the controls down the whole time.
Scan each obstacle as you approach it so you can decide whether to clear it or slow down.
If you crash, restart with a clear plan for the section that caused it rather than rushing the same jump again.
faq: What is the goal of Super Motocross?
Ride your dirt bike through each level and reach the finish line without crashing. Staying upright is the main challenge.
How do I control the bike?
The game is played with mouse clicks or taps. Use them to accelerate and balance as you move through the course.

gothic-new-era.intro: Gothic New Era is a dress-up game where you style a goth girl arriving at Nevermore Academy. You choose dark outfits and looks that suit her gothic princess style before her trip.
tips: Pick one dark color direction early, such as black or deep shades, and keep your choices within it so the final look feels cohesive.
Try a gothic dress first, then compare it with a school uniform to see which one gives the more unique image you want.
Check the whole outfit together before moving on, since a single mismatched piece can break the gloomy style you are building.
Use the same click or tap steps to revisit earlier choices, and compare looks side by side in your head to refine the final image.
Think of the character's story as you dress her, since the game is about a girl entering a strange new school and finding friends.
faq: What is the main goal of Gothic New Era?

Your goal is to update the gothic girl's wardrobe while staying true to her dark style, so she can create a unique image before going to Nevermore Academy. The game also invites you to help her find friends.
How do I control the game?
Use a computer mouse click on a computer, or a simple touch on a touch screen. The same action works for selecting items and moving through the dressing steps.

word-search-and-quiz.intro: Word Search & Quiz mixes word-search grids, picture puzzles, riddles, spelling challenges and trivia across several themed chapters. You can practise vocabulary and general knowledge at your own pace.
tips: In word search modes, scan the grid for unusual letter pairs or the first letter of a target word before swiping, which is often faster than reading every row.
In Picture Puzzles, study the image for objects that match the hidden words before you search, since the picture narrows down what to look for.
In Riddle Word Search, work out the likely answer from the clue first, then look for that exact word in the grid rather than testing random strings.
In Word From Image, say the object's name to yourself and count its letters, then check the scrambled tiles for each one before you tap.
When a question or word stumps you, use a hint to remove wrong answers or reveal letters, and come back to replay it later to raise your chapter completion.
faq: What is the goal of Word Search & Quiz?
Your goal is to complete each chapter by solving its puzzles and answering its questions. Replaying questions can bring a chapter to 100% completion.
How do I select letters in the word search modes?
Swipe with your finger or mouse across the letters to highlight and connect them. The highlighted letters form the word you are looking for.

dream-home.intro: Dream Home is a cozy 3D builder where you design and furnish a house from scratch, then inside it, decorate the yard. You can also take on client orders that grade your work and help you level up.
tips: Build the walls and floors before adding furniture, so you can paint and place items without having to redo them later.
Read each client order's brief before you start building, since your work is graded against what the brief asks for.
Switch to walk mode after finishing a room to check it from eye level, including the stairs, and compare how it looks by day and by night.
Press R to rotate an item before placing it so it fits neatly against walls and in corners.
Try the daily special challenge order when you can, and focus on one house until you are comfortable before working on several plots at once.
faq: How do I earn experience and level up?
Fill client orders by building to the brief. You are graded on your work, and the grade earns you experience.
How do I remove something I placed?
Select the item and press Delete to sell it. Selling is the way to clear out furniture or decor you no longer want.

mazean-com.intro: Mazean is a multiplayer first person shooter where you pilot a robotic warrior through fast, real-time laser battles. Team play and arena movement matter as much as aim.
tips: Try the different laser weapons early and note which ones suit your range and pace, then pick a favorite before committing to a fight.
Keep moving rather than standing still, since the arenas are built for outmaneuvering enemies and staying in one spot makes you an easy target.
Plan your route through each arena and learn where the cover and openings are so you can change position quickly when foes press in.
Stay in contact with your teammates and coordinate pushes or retreats, because the game is designed around collaboration.
Expect constant pressure from enemies, so avoid chasing a single target into unknown space and check your surroundings often.
faq: What is the main goal of Mazean?
You command a robotic warrior in real-time FPS battles and work with your team to assert dominance over the enemy. The game is built around multiplayer combat.
How should I choose a weapon?
Experiment with the diverse laser weaponry to see which fits your playstyle and the situations you face most often. Switching between weapons based on the fight can help you adapt.

cooking-shawarma-idle-game.intro: Cooking Shawarma Idle Game is a food stall simulation where you prepare and serve customer orders for shawarma, fries, pasta and cold drinks. Build your kitchen and grow your shop over time.
tips: Read each customer's request before you start, since orders can include shawarma, fries, pasta or cold drinks and each needs to be correct.
Add extras like ketchup, mayo, fries or pickles only when the customer asks for them, so the order matches exactly.
Choose upgrades based on what slows you down most, whether that is slicing, the lavash station or cooking speed.
Keep an eye on your fries and meat while they are in progress so you can move on to the next step without waiting.
When the order is complete, drag it to the customer right away to keep them happy and keep the line moving.
faq: What is the main goal of the game?
Your goal is to prepare and serve customer orders accurately and quickly, keeping customers happy and earning rewards. As you grow, you can upgrade your kitchen and take your shawarma shop further.
How do I make a shawarma?

Slice the meat by holding the right mouse button and dragging, then click the right mouse button several times on ingredients to add them to the shawarma. On mobile, tap and drag to slice and tap several times to add ingredients.

tractor-trial.intro: Tractor Trial is a racing game where you drive a tractor over off-road terrain, passing obstacles and traps while keeping the tractor balanced. You steer with the arrow keys or W A S D on desktop, or with on-screen buttons on mobile.
tips: Ease off the throttle before rough patches so the tractor stays level instead of tipping.
Watch the terrain ahead and plan your line early, since traps are easier to avoid when you have time to react.
Make small, steady inputs rather than sharp turns, especially on slopes or uneven ground.
If the tractor starts to lean, ease back on the controls and let it settle before moving on.
Practice on the first few obstacles to learn how the tractor responds to acceleration and braking before the course gets harder.
